DEINE ROLLE

Entwirf intelligente Agentic-AI-Lösungen für Kundenprozesse: Du konzipierst und realisierst Azure-native agentische Lösungen zur Automatisierung, Unterstützung und Optimierung von Geschäftsprozessen auf Basis von Azure AI Foundry, Azure OpenAI Service, Azure AI Agent Service, Semantic Kernel und weiteren Azure-KI-Services – von der ersten Idee bis zum stabilen Betrieb in der Produktion.
Agenten- und Prozessarchitekturen: Du entwirfst agentenbasierte Architekturen inklusive Tool-Integration, Memory-Persistenz, Multi-Agent-Orchestrierung, Retrieval-Augmented Generation, Guardrails und Evaluationsmechanismen. Dabei integrierst du KI-Agenten als digitale Prozessassistenten, Entscheidungsunterstützer oder autonome Teilprozess-Akteure in bestehende Kundenprozesse.
Gestalte Prozessflows & Systemintegrationen: Du gestaltest intelligente Prozessabläufe, Agenten-Workflows und Toolchains, bindest Wissensquellen, RAG-Pipelines, Fachanwendungen und Analytik-Komponenten ein und integrierst externe Systeme über Azure-Services wie Azure Functions, Logic Apps, Event Grid, Service Bus, Azure Storage, Cosmos DB, Azure SQL, Azure AI Search oder API Management.
DevOps & Delivery für KI-Agenten: Du verankerst CI/CD, Infrastructure as Code, z. B. Terraform, Bicep oder Azure Developer CLI, automatisiertes Testing sowie Logging und Tracing, z. B. Azure Monitor, Application Insights, Log Analytics und OpenTelemetry, in deinen Architekturen und sorgst für sichere, reproduzierbare Deployments agentischer Anwendungen in produktionsnahen und produktiven Kundenumgebungen.
Übernimm End-to-End-Projektverantwortung: Du begleitest Kunden über den gesamten Lifecycle – von Prozessanalysen, Potenzialbewertungen, Assessments und Zielbild-Workshops über Architektur- und Designphasen bis zur Implementierung – und übernimmst Verantwortung für Qualität, Skalierbarkeit und Betriebssicherheit der entwickelten agentischen Prozesslösungen.
Begleite Kunden umfassend: Du übersetzt Konzepte wie Tool-Use, RAG-Pipelines, Session-Memory, Multi-Agent-Delegation, Grounding, Guardrails und Evaluation in verständliche Entscheidungsgrundlagen, erstellst Architektur-Roadmaps und unterstützt Teams durch Reviews, Coaching und Wissenstransfer. Dabei berätst du Kunden insbesondere dazu, welche Prozesse sich für agentische Automatisierung eignen, wie Agenten sicher in bestehende Arbeitsabläufe eingebettet werden und wie Fachbereiche, IT und Betrieb gemeinsam tragfähige Lösungen entwickeln.

DEIN PROFIL

Azure-Expertise und Architekturverständnis: Du hast mehrjährige praktische Erfahrung mit Microsoft Azure, kennst die Eigenheiten und Limits zentraler Services, z. B. Azure Functions, Azure Kubernetes Service, Azure Container Apps, Event Grid, Service Bus, Cosmos DB, Azure SQL, Azure Storage, Azure AI Search, Entra ID, Key Vault und Virtual Network, und entwickelst skalierbare, sichere Cloud-Architekturen für produktionsreife KI-, Agenten- und Prozessautomatisierungslösungen.
Azure AI, OpenAI & LLM-Agenten: Du hast mit Azure AI Foundry, Azure OpenAI Service oder Azure AI Agent Service gearbeitet und weißt, was produktionsreifer Betrieb von LLM- und Agentenlösungen bedeutet. Idealerweise bringst du Erfahrung mit Tool-Calling, Function Calling, Agents, Knowledge Sources, Vector Search, Guardrails, Prompt-Evaluation und Content Safety mit. Kenntnisse in Frameworks wie Semantic Kernel, LangChain, LlamaIndex, AutoGen oder CrewAI sind ein Plus. Du verstehst, wie agentische Systeme Tools nutzen, Kontext verwalten, Aufgaben delegieren und sicher in bestehende Prozess- und Systemlandschaften eingebettet werden.
Prozessverständnis und agentische Automatisierung: Du bringst praktische Erfahrung in der Analyse, Modellierung und Optimierung von Geschäftsprozessen mit und verstehst, wie agentische Tools Prozesse unterstützen, automatisieren oder teilweise autonom ausführen können. Du erkennst geeignete Anwendungsfälle für Agentic AI, bewertest Nutzen, Machbarkeit und Risiken und übersetzt fachliche Anforderungen in umsetzbare technische Lösungsansätze.
DevOps-, IaC- und Container-Skills: Du verfügst über Projekterfahrung mit Infrastructure as Code, z. B. Terraform, Bicep oder Azure Developer CLI, CI/CD-Pipelines, z. B. Azure DevOps oder GitHub Actions, und Container-Plattformen wie AKS oder Azure Container Apps. Du verankerst Testing, Observability und Security-Guardrails in deinen Delivery-Prozessen. Kenntnisse zu Compliance, z. B. DSGVO, BSI, ISO 27001, sowie Microsoft-Azure-Zertifizierungen sind wünschenswert. Idealerweise hast du Erfahrung darin, KI- und Agentenlösungen reproduzierbar, überwacht und sicher in produktive Kundenumgebungen zu überführen.
Beratungskompetenz: Du kannst komplexe technische Sachverhalte adressatengerecht erklären und überzeugst in Workshops, Reviews und Management-Präsentationen. Du berätst Kunden souverän bei der Identifikation geeigneter Prozesse, der Bewertung von Automatisierungspotenzialen sowie der Einführung agentischer Lösungen an der Schnittstelle von Fachbereich, IT und Betrieb.
KI Kompetenz: Du verfügst über vertiefte KI-Expertise, gestaltest deren verantwortungsvollen Einsatz in deinem Verantwortungsbereich aktiv mit und fungierst als Enabler für Kunden sowie intern bei adesso. Dabei bringst du ein gutes Verständnis für Responsible AI, Guardrails, Evaluation, Monitoring, Prompt- und Tool-Design, RAG-Architekturen sowie den sicheren Umgang mit Unternehmensdaten mit.
Sprachkenntnisse: Sehr gute Deutsch- und gute Englischkenntnisse

DEIN PROFIL

Azure-Expertise und Architekturverständnis: Du hast mehrjährige praktische Erfahrung mit Microsoft Azure, kennst die Eigenheiten und Limits zentraler Services, z. B. Azure Functions, Azure Kubernetes Service, Azure Container Apps, Event Grid, Service Bus, Cosmos DB, Azure SQL, Azure Storage, Azure AI Search, Entra ID, Key Vault und Virtual Network, und entwickelst skalierbare, sichere Cloud-Architekturen für produktionsreife KI-, Agenten- und Prozessautomatisierungslösungen.
Azure AI, OpenAI & LLM-Agenten: Du hast mit Azure AI Foundry, Azure OpenAI Service oder Azure AI Agent Service gearbeitet und weißt, was produktionsreifer Betrieb von LLM- und Agentenlösungen bedeutet. Job Description

Role: Senior Engineer (.NET, AWS & AI Engineering)

Department: Engineering

CreateFuture is an AI-native consulting partner where people do work that matters and are supported to do it well. We work side by side with our clients, challenging what's not working and helping them to build the future.

We work alongside organisations such as PayPal, adidas, NatWest, FanDuel, and Money Saving Expert, building digital products and services that make a difference while always putting people first. Our commitment to craft, quality, and culture has helped us scale to over 600 people in just a few years.

About the role and team:

We are seeking an experienced Senior Engineer with a strong background in .NET, AWS, and modern AI-assisted engineering practices to join a team delivering and modernising a broad range of business-critical applications and services. This role combines hands-on software engineering with technical leadership responsibilities, helping drive engineering quality, platform improvement, and modern development practices across a varied .NET landscape.

The successful candidate will work across a diverse technology stack that includes legacy .NET Framework applications, WCF and WPF services, alongside modern applications being developed on the latest versions of .NET through to .NET 10. You will play a key role in building scalable cloud-native solutions, improving existing systems, and helping shape engineering standards and delivery practices.

This role requires someone comfortable operating within challenging technical environments, able to work closely with engineering teams and stakeholders to simplify, improve, and evolve existing services. Strong communication and stakeholder management skills are essential, as many existing platforms and services have significant operational and organisational investment behind them.

Key Responsibilities

Design, develop, and maintain applications and services using .NET technologies and AWS cloud platforms.
Work hands-on across a broad .NET technology landscape including .NET Framework, WCF, WPF, and modern .NET applications.
Contribute to the adoption of AI-assisted engineering practices and harness engineering approaches across the development lifecycle.
Identify opportunities to simplify, rationalise, and improve existing systems and services.
Design and implement Infrastructure as Code solutions using Terraform.
Support cloud-native engineering practices and platform improvements across AWS environments.
Contribute to frontend application development using Next.js or similar modern JavaScript frameworks.
Collaborate with engineering teams and stakeholders to deliver pragmatic technical solutions.
Promote best practices in software engineering, maintainability, scalability, and operational excellence.
Support teams through technical challenges and modernisation initiatives.

Work effectively with stakeholders across the business, navigating complex and sensitive technical discussions where required.

Required Experience

Strong experience as a Senior Software Engineer working within .NET environments.
Good experience across both modern .NET and legacy .NET Framework applications.
Strong experience with AWS cloud technologies.
Experience implementing Infrastructure as Code using Terraform.
Good understanding of AI-assisted development tooling and harness engineering concepts, with active engagement in the space.
Experience working within complex or evolving technical environments.
Frontend development experience using Next.js or similar JavaScript frameworks.
Strong communication and stakeholder management skills.
Comfortable working hands-on within challenging technical environments.

Ability to work collaboratively across engineering and business teams.

Nice to Have

Experience modernising legacy enterprise applications and services.
Exposure to WCF, WPF, and broader legacy Microsoft technology stacks.
Experience supporting platform consolidation or transformation initiatives.
Familiarity with CI/CD pipelines, DevOps practices, and engineering automation tooling.

What we'll offer you:

We trust people to do their best work. That means flexibility over rigid rules, impact over activity, and real investment in your growth both professionally and personally. You'll be part of a supportive, and friendly culture, surrounded by smart, curious people who care deeply about what they do.

We offer flexible working, including hybrid and remote options. Our office hubs are located in Edinburgh, Leeds, Manchester, London and Bulgaria, with occasional travel to client sites or CreateFuture offices when needed.

We trust you to manage your time balancing collaboration with client time and focused work. What matters is the impact you have, not how busy you look.

Our hiring process

We try to keep our hiring process clear, fair and respectful of your time. We aim to get back to everyone who applies and we will be upfront about where you are in the process.

It usually looks like this:

Call with our Talent Acquisition Team
Role specific capability interview

Inclusion at CreateFuture

We believe diverse teams build better workplaces and better products. We want CreateFuture to be a place where people feel able to be themselves and do their best work.

How You’ll Support Our Mission

Our Data Platform team owns the development of a robust platform designed to empower all ESO customers to extract, transform, and utilize data from our various applications for their reporting needs. This platform supports multiple tools, including embedded third-party BI visualizations, a first-party flat file extractor, and direct SQL read-only access. We are committed to continuously enhancing these tools by adding new features, overhauling existing functionalities, and delivering the best possible user experience for our customers.

The team operates cross-functionally across the entire organization, supporting data mesh initiatives that enable domain teams to own their data products. We provide the platform and tooling needed to make this ownership seamless and effective, collaborating across time zones and countries to drive innovation.

Reporting to the Engineering Manager, you will join our Data Platform team, contributing to its mission of enabling our customers and internal teams to fully harness the power of their data to improve community health and safety.

What You’ll Be Doing – The Day To Day

You can expect to work as a full-stack engineer with a focus on front-end development, helping balance the team’s expertise while being fully capable of contributing to and learning from back-end development efforts. This role is ideal for someone passionate about creating excellent user experiences while also diving into back-end systems regularly.

Our Current Stack:
C#, .NET Core, Angular, Typescript, Snowflake, Azure DevOps, Terraform, Azure PAAS / Serverless, EF Core, SQL Server, Redis, Sonar, Snyk, Cypress, Application Insights, New Relic. This is what you can expect to work with, but we are always open to using other technologies where they add value!

Our development engineers lead by championing a culture of personal ownership and customer-focused execution. We love those who pride themselves in how they contribute through excellent solutions and end-user experiences, as much as clean and clear code. Our team is made up of highly experienced engineers with a deep expertise across the stack, creating an incredible opportunity to learn from seasoned professionals while contributing your own skills and ideas. We foster an environment where collaboration and mentorship thrive, making it a supportive space to grow and refine your expertise.

We are an Agile development shop and interact regularly with project stakeholders to ensure that the solutions we build align with customer needs and business goals. To support this methodology, we use regular retrospectives and objective measurements to drive continuous improvement and empower our developers to make informed technology and implementation decisions. As part of the development process, you will be involved in design sessions, and you’ll have the opportunity to learn and teach through peer review of code and completed solutions.

Who You Are - some of the essential things required to be successful in the role:

Three+ years of experience in software engineering and software design and architecture principles. 
Two+ years of experience with Typescript and UI development in Angular.
Two+ years of experience with C# .NET. 
A solid understanding of SQL and relational database concepts for reporting.
Demonstrated experience with Git for source control, branching and merging (i.e. gitflow)

Experience of some of the following technologies, and a passion to learn and grow across many of the remainder:  

Logging, monitoring and alerting frameworks (e.g. Application Insights, New Relic)
OO concepts, design patterns, modern .NET web frameworks 
Snowflake, Databricks, Redshift, BigQuery, or other similar platforms focused on efficient data extraction, transformation, and reporting
Serverless, PAAS and containerized cloud applications 
Messaging and eventing technologies, (e.g. Azure Service Bus, MQ) 
Working with standardized external file structures (XML, JSON, Parquet, Fixed Length, etc.)

ESO is a fast-paced, growing data, technology and research company passionate about improving community health and safety through the power of data. We pioneer innovative, user-friendly software to meet the changing needs of today’s EMS agencies, fire departments, and hospitals. We’re small enough to be nimble and fun, but big enough to be a great place to work. We serve thousands of customers out of our offices across the US, Canada and Northern Ireland.

to join the Tech

What we do:

Everyone has an idea of what a water company does. Here in Yorkshire, we make sure that over 5.4 million people living in the region and the millions of people who visit our region each year, can rely on our services, and have clean and safe drinking water on tap and that their wastewater is taken away. But for us, it’s so much more than this. We look after communities, protect the environment, and plan to look after Yorkshire’s water, today, tomorrow 24/7, 365 days a year. We provide essential water and wastewater services to every corner of the Yorkshire region, and play a key role in the region’s health, wellbeing, and prosperity. New environmental legislation, unprecedented levels of investment and changing expectations from customers means that this is an exciting time to discover opportunities within the water industry. The Tech team are a key part of how we plan to meet the changing expectations of customers and regulators.  

Join us as a Senior Software Developer and help shape the future of our cloud-based platforms. Working with .NET (C#) and Azure, you'll design and deliver scalable microservice APIs that power customer-facing applications. Collaborating with architects and cross-functional Agile teams, you'll have the opportunity to influence technical direction, champion best practices, and build innovative solutions that make a real impact across the business.

Where you fit in:

As our Senior Software Developer / Integration Manager you will:

Input into the design and lead development of global APIs, and the associated integration whilst maintaining and supporting the IT Programme of work. 
Contribute to the software development standards and governance whilst ensuring that deliverables by you and the wider team adherence to them.
Contribute to the technical procurement and adoption standards for commercial services and systems.

Deliver software services that are robust, reliable and secure in nature, which are technically fit for purpose and meet specified acceptance criteria. 
Keep abreast of changes within their software domain, demonstrating innovation to exploit existing and new technologies to promote reduce costs, manage risk and build resilience.
Undertake specialist detailed and complex troubleshooting activities within your technical discipline.

What skills & qualifications you will need:

Strong background in C# / .NET development (Framework and/or Core) with commercial experience delivering robust and reliable API services within Azure cloud environment.
Proven track record of driving sustainable performance against challenging business targets, in two or more of the following technical disciplines: 
-API development using Microsoft .NET 8 (C#, ASP.NET, MVC, WCF, etc.)
- MS SQL and database design experience including writing SQL scripts.
Excellent understanding of Service Oriented Architecture design that integrate correctly
Excellent knowledge of documentation, testing and release management principles with the ability to prioritise and execute tasks in a dynamic, changing environment.
Highly motivated and self-reliant with a personal drive for continuous development you will have proven analytical and problem-solving abilities and excellent interpersonal skills.
Extensive knowledge of the system development lifecycle including DevOps processes, CI/CD, writing Unit Tests etc.

Although we operate 24 hours a day, 365 days a year, it’s important to us that we support flexible working patterns and job share options (when we can), to help you make the best of both your work and home life. We know that juggling childcare responsibilities or getting that ideal work/life balance isn’t always easy! Do we sound like your cup of tea?

If you’re an experienced Senior Software Developer professional
and want to help us deliver great service for our customers whilst looking after the environment, then be sure to apply today to find out what a career with Yorkshire Water can offer you.   

If successful for the role, you will be required to undergo pre-employment checks that will include a Basic Disclosure Check, carried out through a Third-Party Company, prior to commencing employment. Depending on the role, you may also be required to go through the security vetting process for either a Counter Terrorist Check or Security Check clearance. jobs.title: Windows Software Manager
jobs.description:
ABOUT ORGANOX:

OrganOx is a commercial stage organ technology company dedicated to developing technologies to improve outcomes for patients with acute or chronic organ failure. The company was established as a spin out of the University of Oxford in 2008 and is now part of the Terumo Group. OrganOx is a pioneer in normothermic machine perfusion (NMP). It's flagship platform, the metra®, is available for use in the U.S., Europe, Canada, and Australia. It has been utilized in over 7,000 liver transplants to date to keep donor livers in a metabolically active state outside the body enabling longer preservation times and functional assessment of the organ prior to transplant, leading to an increased number of organs available for transplant. Founded in 1921, Terumo Corporation (TSE:4543) strives to fulfil its mission of "Contributing to Society through Healthcare" by providing a comprehensive range of solutions in the fields of therapeutic procedures, hospital operations, and life sciences in more than 160 countries and regions.

Position Summary

The Windows Software Manager is responsible for leading the design and development of software at OrganOx, for device-hosted applications and services running on Windows-based platforms, ensuring delivery of robust, high-quality solutions for regulated medical environments. The role combines deep technical expertise developing Graphical User Interfaces (GUI), connectivity solutions and implementing cybersecurity mitigations, with strong leadership of teams, projects and cross-functional stakeholders.

Operating with a system-level perspective, the Windows Software Manager takes end-to-end ownership of the application software, driving alignment with quality standards and regulatory compliance requirements. The role also serves as a key technical representative for OrganOx, engaging confidently with external stakeholders including regulatory bodies, partners, and customers.

This is an on-site role in Oxford with flexibility.

Listed below are the major responsibilities of the role and a brief description of some of the key tasks to be performed. This list is not totally exhaustive.

Major Responsibilities

Under direction from the Director, Embedded Software Development, the Windows Software Manager will be responsible for:

Resource management

Lead and manage a team of Windows software engineers, fostering a high-performance culture of collaboration, continuous improvement, and engineering excellence
Providing line management, including goal setting, performance reviews, development planning, and ongoing coaching
Mentor and support engineers in low-level design, debugging, and real-time system development challenges
Define and maintain an effective team structure, including roles, responsibilities, operating mechanisms, and supporting infrastructure
Plan and manage resource allocation, including headcount planning, role definition, workload distribution, and optimisation of team utilisation across distributed teams.
Oversee recruitment activities, including identifying hiring needs, interviewing, candidate evaluation, hiring recommendations, onboarding, and probation management.
Maintain visibility of team capabilities (knowledge, skills, and abilities) and develop targeted training and development plans to address gaps and enhance performance.
Facilitate clear and effective communication within the team and across stakeholders, ensuring alignment with wider organisational objectives.

Planning

Manage project timelines, resources, and budgets, ensuring projects are delivered on time and within scope.
Guide technical decisions, design reviews
Ensure robust software integration with cross-functional teams
Drive Agile or hybrid Software Development Life Cycle (SDLC) practices
Author and execute a roadmap of developments to improve the Software Engineering function, with emphasis on application-level software
Financial forecasting and spend tracking against approved department and project budgets

Technical Oversight & Execution

Provide technical leadership for the development of application-level software for Class II and Class III medical devices.
Oversee the full software development lifecycle, including requirements definition, architecture, implementation, testing, and maintenance.
Ensure compliance with applicable regulatory standards and frameworks, including FDA, ISO 13485, IEC 62304, and other relevant safety standards.
Establish and enforce high-quality software engineering practices, including code reviews, architectural governance, and design best practices.
Contribute hands-on expertise in complex or critical technical areas when required.
Drive design principles that support modularity, testability, maintainability, scalability
Oversee release quality, defect management, and continuous improvement initiatives

Process and tools

SOPs (Standard Operating Procedures) and Work Instructions supporting Software Engineering
Selection, development, and qualification of Software Engineering tools and systems.

Continuous Improvement & Innovation

Stay current with industry trends, emerging technologies, and best practices in software and medical device development.
Continuously improve development processes, tools, and engineering practices
Drive innovation in IoMT-enabled medical devices, ensuring seamless integration with cloud and connected systems.
Introduce automation, performance optimisation, and data-driven analytics.
Oversee and approve Software Engineering Design History Files (DHF)
Adhere to the letter and spirit of OrganOx's Code of Conduct and all other company policies

Requirements

Skills & Experience

Proven track record in the development, release, and maintenance of Class II/III medical device software or similarly safety-critical systems.
Deep understanding of the Software Development Life Cycle (SDLC), including agile methodologies and comprehensive testing strategies (unit, integration)
Proven understanding of edge-to-cloud architectures
Solid experience designing OTA update mechanisms, including safe update strategies (e.g. rollback, validation, compatibility)
Strong working knowledge and application of messaging technologies (e.g. Azure IoT Hub, MQTT, AMQP).
Solid expertise in C#, C++ and .net framework
Familiar with Real-Time Operating System (RTOS) concepts (task scheduling, interrupts, concurrency) and Board Support Package (BSP).
Familiarity with Unified Modelling Language (UML) and object-oriented design principles
Demonstrated ability to build, lead, and develop high-performing engineering teams with a collaborative leadership approach
Strong systems-thinking capability, with the ability to view and optimise across software layers under real-world constraints
Proven problem-solving skills, including proactive identification and mitigation of technical risks.
Experience with model-based and model-driven development, and simulation tools to accelerate development and testing. Strong expertise in IoMT technologies and cloud-based system integration.
Comprehensive knowledge of regulatory standards and frameworks, including IEC 62304, ISO 14971, FDA guidance, ISO 13485 and ISO 62366.
Ability to tailor compliance approaches while maintaining focus on risk, cybersecurity, scalability, maintainability and reliability
Proven experience managing external technical partners and ensuring quality deliverables across the full product lifecycle
Track record of driving process improvements to enhance efficiency, compliance, and product quality
Skilled in both developing innovative solutions and maintaining existing products in line with QMS (Quality Management System) and industry standards.
Highly effective in applying problem-solving techniques (e.g. brainstorming, 5-whys, fishbone), supported by demonstrable structured and rigorous approach to define activities and achieve tangible deliverables with limited supervision
An effective communicator, who readily engages in a timely and proactive manner
Passion for innovation and commitment to developing medical devices that improve patient outcomes

Qualifications

Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, or a related field

Benefits

At OrganOx, we value innovation, evidence, integrity, teamwork, respect, and passion. We offer competitive compensation and comprehensive benefits, including healthcare and retirement plans. We support work-life balance and provide opportunities for ongoing professional development.

We are an equal opportunity employer, and all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to age, disability, gender reassignment, marriage and civil partnership, pregnancy and maternity, race, religion or belief, sex, sexual orientation race, or any other characteristics protected by law.

jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer - Intelligent Document Processing
jobs.description:
Life at UiPath

The people at UiPath believe in the transformative power of automation to change how the world works. We’re committed to creating category-leading enterprise software that unleashes that power.

To make that happen, we need people who are curious, self-propelled, generous, and genuine. People who love being part of a fast-moving, fast-thinking growth company. And people who care—about each other, about UiPath, and about our larger purpose.

Could that be you?

Life at UiPath

The people at UiPath believe in the transformative power of automation to change how the world works. We’re committed to creating category-leading enterprise software that unleashes that power.

To make that happen, we need people who are curious, self-propelled, generous, and genuine. People who love being part of a fast-moving, fast-thinking growth company. And people who care about each other, about UiPath, and about our larger purpose.

Could that be you?

Your mission

UiPath’s Intelligence Document Processing drives understanding of the documents and messages on which a business runs: invoices, claims, contracts, customer emails. We use frontier LLMs to turn all of that into structured data that automations and AI agents can act on. You'll be building the product that does it: the ingestion and extraction pipelines, the APIs customers build their operations on top of, and the systems that make those models useful, fast and trustworthy at enterprise scale.

Increasingly that work is agentic. What you build is what lets AI agents ingest, understand, retrieve and reason over enterprise documents at volume, without giving up accuracy, security or governance.

It's a product engineering role with complex systems and LLM-in-production problems underneath it. The same service handles a customer's first ten documents and another's ten million, runs in our cloud and inside a bank's own air-gapped datacentre, and has to be good enough that a business will act on its output. Knowing how well the models are actually doing, and what to do when the answer is "not well enough", is a large part of the job.

You'll write in several languages here, and pick up new ones as the problem demands. We care much more about how you think than about what you've written it in. We're looking for someone who loves building things, learns fast, and wants to own product outcomes rather than tickets.

What You'll Do At UiPath

Work with engineers, product managers and customers to design, build and operate the AI systems behind UiPath's document processing products.
Build across the pipeline: ingestion, parsing and extraction, indexing and retrieval, and the evaluation that tells us any of it is working.
Take features from idea to production and stay with them, measuring whether they actually worked, and improving them when they didn't.
Solve genuinely hard problems in concurrency, latency and distributed systems, so the platform holds up under high-volume production workloads.
Build for environments we don't control: multi-cloud, on-premises, air-gapped, and under strict security and compliance requirements.
Use coding agents as a serious part of your toolkit, and help the team get better at it. Where to trust them, where not to, and how to keep quality high as the tooling changes underneath us.
Work with teams across UiPath and across locations to innovate and build best-in-class document processing, and occasionally with customers directly. Because the fastest way to understand a product is to watch someone use it.
Contribute to our engineering culture: mentor, review, hire, and push back when something isn't good enough.

What You'll Bring To The Team

A solid track record (5+ years) building and operating large-scale commercial services that real customers depend on.
Strong programming ability and the confidence to pick up whatever language a problem calls for. You'll meet Python, Rust and C# here, but we don't expect you to arrive knowing them all.
Real-world experience with cloud platforms (Azure, AWS or GCP) and containerised deployment on Kubernetes. You understand how production systems get shipped, monitored and scaled, not just written.
Comfort with data at scale: SQL, and the trade-offs between different storage and search systems.
Experience working with coding agents, and opinions about them, What responsible use looks like, where they earn their keep and where they cost you, and how you keep evaluating them in an ecosystem that changes every few months.
An appreciation for tools that catch bugs before runtime — type systems, tests, and designs that make bad states unrepresentable. Especially in the age of coding agents.
A pragmatic grasp of computer science fundamentals. We care about solving real problems with the right data structure, not reciting one from a textbook.
Experience shipping LLM-backed products to production is a strong plus: prompting, evaluation, and everything else that turns a model into a feature people will trust.
Familiarity with document processing is a plus: OCR, layout, and the messy reality of documents as they actually arrive.
An opinion on what makes good code and good architecture, and the ability to argue it, including against us.
You're a builder and a problem-solver at heart.

Maybe you don’t tick all the boxes above—but still think you’d be great for the job? Go ahead, apply anyway. Please. Because we know that experience comes in all shapes and sizes—and passion can’t be learned.

Many of our roles allow for flexibility in when and where work gets done. Depending on the needs of the business and the role, the number of hybrid, office-based, and remote workers will vary from team to team. Applications are assessed on a rolling basis and there is no fixed deadline for this requisition. The application window may change depending on the volume of applications received or may close immediately if a qualified candidate is selected.

We pride ourselves on our diversity and inclusive workplace that provides equal opportunities to all persons regardless of age, race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, and expression, national origin, disability, neurodiversity, military and/or veteran status, or any other protected classes. About the Role

You will be responsible for assessing complex existing application and integration landscapes, particularly Microsoft technology-based estates, identifying modernization opportunities, and designing scalable, resilient, secure, maintainable and cloud-agnostic target solutions aligned to business capabilities and enterprise architecture standards.
You will bring strong functional understanding and technical depth to translate business workflows, operating processes, integration dependencies, data flows, control points, reporting requirements and non-functional needs into practical modernization blueprints. The role involves defining migration-ready architecture patterns across .NET, C#, Microsoft SQL Server, Azure and related Microsoft-based technologies, evaluating technology options, guiding engineering teams, and ensuring solutions address scalability, availability, disaster recovery, RPO/RTO, security, auditability, observability, operational resilience and long-term supportability.

Skills and Experience Required

Core Skills (must-have):

Enterprise Solution Architecture
Application Legacy Modernization
Cloud-Agnostic Architecture
Microservices
Kafka / Event-Driven Architecture
Kubernetes
API & Integration Modernization
HA/DR design
DevSecOps / GitOps

Nice to Have:

Financial Services / Capital Markets domain experience
DORA / operational resilience awareness

Key Competencies:

Strong enterprise solution architecture experience in large-scale legacy modernization, application transformation, distributed systems, financial services platforms or high-volume transaction processing environments.
Ability to assess legacy estates including monolithic applications, tightly coupled integrations, shared databases, batch workflows, reporting platforms, operational bottlenecks and technology obsolescence risks.
Ability to understand business capabilities, functional workflows, operating models, reporting needs, controls, data dependencies and user journeys, and translate them into executable modernization solutions.
Deep understanding of microservices, domain-driven design, API design, database-per-service, event-driven architecture, asynchronous messaging and enterprise integration design patterns.
Hands-on knowledge of Kafka or equivalent event streaming platforms, IBM MQ, REST, gRPC, FIX, SFTP, schema registry, message transformation, replayability, retry, exception handling and reconciliation patterns.
Strong experience with Kubernetes, Docker, container orchestration, cloud-native deployment, CI/CD, GitOps, Terraform, secrets management and DevSecOps engineering practices.
Good working knowledge of Azure and/or GCP cloud services, cloud landing zones, networking, identity, security, observability, resilience and workload deployment patterns.
Hands-on exposure to Azure architecture and Microsoft-based modernization patterns, including App Services, AKS, Azure SQL or SQL Server modernization, Entra ID, Key Vault, Azure Monitor and secure enterprise deployment practices.
Knowledge of cloud-agnostic architecture principles, multi-cloud deployment considerations, workload portability, exit strategy, high availability, disaster recovery, RPO/RTO definition and cross-environment resilience patterns.
Working knowledge of enterprise data platform concepts such as batch and streaming data flows, data quality, metadata, lineage, governance and regulatory data controls will be an advantage.
Strong understanding of Microsoft application landscapes including .NET, C#, WPF, Microsoft SQL Server, stored procedures, SSIS/SSRS awareness, Azure services, PostgreSQL, Redis, relational modelling, reporting platforms and approaches for modernizing legacy enterprise applications.
Experience defining migration approaches such as strangler pattern, phased cutover, parallel run, dual operation, output reconciliation, rollback design, hyper-care and legacy decommissioning.
Ability to evaluate trade-offs across business value, functional fit, technology choices, portability, performance, resilience, security, operational complexity, cost and regulatory or audit expectations.
Experience defining non-functional requirements, performance baselines, availability models, disaster recovery approaches, observability KPIs, operational runbooks and support models.
Ability to communicate effectively with business stakeholders, product owners, operations users, engineering teams, senior stakeholders and client technology teams.
Financial services, capital markets, trade lifecycle, risk, regulatory reporting, data warehouse modernization or operational resilience exposure will be an advantage.

Microsoft Certified: Azure Solutions Architect Expert
Google Cloud Professional Cloud Architect
TOGAF® Enterprise Architecture Practitioner

What You Will Do

Lead enterprise solution architecture for legacy modernization initiatives covering business capabilities, application architecture, integration, data, cloud, security, DevSecOps, observability and operational supportability.
Assess existing application portfolios, monolithic platforms, shared databases, batch processing flows, integration dependencies, reporting workloads and operational constraints to define modernization priorities and solution options.
Understand business processes, user journeys, data flows, upstream/downstream dependencies, reporting needs, control requirements and operational pain points to shape fit-for-purpose enterprise solution designs.
Translate functional and non-functional requirements into modernization roadmaps, architecture decisions, solution blueprints, integration patterns, service boundaries, data models, deployment views and implementation guidance.
Architect enterprise-grade application solutions using microservices, domain-aligned service design, API-first integration, event-driven workflows, service-owned databases and containerized runtime models.
Design enterprise integration solutions using Kafka, IBM MQ, REST APIs, gRPC, FIX, SFTP, schema registry, canonical events, adapters, retries, idempotency, dead-letter handling and reconciliation patterns.
Architect cloud-native and platform-agnostic solutions using Kubernetes, Docker, OpenShift, AKS/GKE or equivalent platforms, with appropriate runtime, networking, secrets, identity, deployment and portability considerations.
Provide Azure-focused architecture guidance including Azure landing zones, compute, networking, identity, security, monitoring, deployment, integration and migration patterns for enterprise application modernization.
Provide architecture guidance for application-facing data needs including data access patterns, reporting integrations, data contracts, auditability, lineage awareness and alignment with enterprise data platforms.
Define and review technical designs involving .NET, C#, WPF, Microsoft SQL Server, PostgreSQL, Redis, middleware, reporting platforms, stored procedures and modernization of legacy Microsoft-based enterprise applications.
Assess and document non-functional requirements including performance, scalability, latency, availability, resilience, disaster recovery, failover, security, auditability, monitoring and operational support.
Define high availability and disaster recovery architecture including active-active or active-passive patterns, failover design, backup and restore strategy, cross-region or cross-cloud resilience, RPO/RTO targets and business continuity considerations.

About Us

Ascent has recently been acquired by Acuity Analytics . This is both a significant milestone for us and a tremendous opportunity for you.

Acuity Analytics is a business with a strong global reputation, an impressive client base, and ambitious growth plans. We deliver deep insights and domain-led digital transformation to high-growth and heavily regulated organisations. To our customers, we bring a partnership that provides the talent, technology, and capability to enhance performance and operational efficiency.

As part of our continued growth, we are looking for an Enterprise Architect
to help shape the future of our engineering organisation and drive technical excellence across our modernization practice.

About the Role

This role is responsible for architecture assessment, target-state definition, and modernization alignment for complex enterprise application landscapes undergoing legacy transformation. You will focus on shaping scalable, resilient, secure, and governable architectures that progressively move monolithic, tightly coupled, batch-oriented systems toward modular, event-driven, cloud-enabled and operationally observable platforms.

The role requires strong hands-on architecture depth across application modernization, integration architecture, microservices, APIs, event streaming, container platforms, database modernization, DevSecOps, observability, resiliency, and governance. You will collaborate with business, application, data, infrastructure, security, DevOps, operations, and delivery teams to define transition roadmaps, manage architectural risks, establish guardrails, validate implementation choices, and ensure modernization is delivered through controlled, incremental, and enterprise-grade transformation practices.

Skills and Experience Required

Core Skills (must-have):

Enterprise Architecture
Legacy Modernization
Application Architecture
Microservices Architecture
Event-Driven Architecture
API & Integration Architecture
Cloud-Agnostic Architecture
Domain-Driven Design
Strangler Pattern Migration
DevSecOps

Kubernetes

MSSQL / PostgreSQL

Key Competencies:

Proven enterprise architecture experience across large-scale legacy modernization, distributed systems, integration platforms, database ecosystems, cloud-enabled platforms, and regulated enterprise environments.
Strong ability to assess monolithic, tightly coupled, database-centric and batch-driven estates and translate findings into practical target-state architecture and migration roadmaps.
Deep understanding of microservices architecture, domain-driven design, service decomposition, database-per-service patterns, distributed workflows, sagas, APIs, and contract-first design.
Strong knowledge of event-driven architecture, Kafka-based event streaming, schema management, asynchronous processing, replayability, idempotency, dead-letter handling, and integration resilience patterns.
Hands-on architecture experience with Microsoft .NET ecosystems, REST / gRPC APIs, middleware platforms, enterprise messaging, MSSQL, PostgreSQL, and application modernization technologies.
Strong understanding of cloud-agnostic and hybrid architecture principles including Kubernetes, Docker, containerized deployment, cloud portability, platform engineering, and workload isolation.
Experience with DevSecOps, CI/CD, infrastructure-as-code, automated quality gates, release orchestration, environment promotion, vulnerability scanning, and audit-ready change management.
Ability to define resilience and operational readiness requirements including high availability, disaster recovery, failover, observability, monitoring, logging, tracing, SLOs, incident handling, and support transition.
Good appreciation of enterprise data platforms like Databricks , governed reporting, data lineage, data quality, auditability, regulatory evidence, and interaction between operational systems and analytical data platforms.
Excellent stakeholder management, architecture governance, decision facilitation, risk articulation, technical communication, and cross-functional coordination skills.
Ability to balance target-state architecture ambition with delivery pragmatism, coexistence constraints, incremental migration, business continuity, operational stability, and regulatory expectations.
Strong documentation discipline across architecture blueprints, transition states, decision records, integration contracts, dependency maps, runbooks, governance artifacts, and executive-level architecture narratives.

TOGAF® Enterprise Architecture Practitioner / TOGAF® 9 Certified
AWS Certified Solutions Architect – Professional, or Microsoft Certified: Azure Solutions Architect Expert
Certified Kubernetes Administrator (CKA)

What You Will Do

Own enterprise architecture assessment and target-state definition for large-scale legacy modernization initiatives across application, integration, data, infrastructure, security, and operations domains.
Assess current-state monolithic applications, shared database dependencies, batch processing models, middleware integrations, reporting dependencies, operational constraints, and resiliency gaps to define pragmatic modernization pathways.
Define future-state architecture aligned to separation of concerns, microservices, database-per-service, API-led integration, event-driven processing, cloud portability, automated delivery, observability, and enterprise governance principles.
Establish architecture guardrails, reference patterns, decision records, integration standards, data ownership principles, service boundary guidance, and non-functional requirements for scalable and resilient modernization delivery.
Guide decomposition of tightly coupled legacy capabilities into domain-aligned services, reusable platform components, controlled interfaces, independently deployable modules, and governed operational workflows.
Support migration strategy using incremental modernization patterns such as strangler migration, parallel run, coexistence, controlled cutover, rollback planning, reconciliation, and phased capability transition.
Provide architecture direction for integration modernization across messaging, APIs, file-based interfaces, event streaming, schema governance, idempotent processing, error handling, retry mechanisms, and dead-letter handling.
Partner with data architecture teams to align application modernization with governed data platforms, lineage, auditability, data quality, reporting readiness, and operational data consumption patterns.
Drive architecture alignment across cloud, on-premise, and hybrid deployment models including Kubernetes, containerization, platform engineering, DevSecOps, CI/CD, infrastructure-as-code, secrets management, and environment readiness.
Define and validate resilience, high availability, disaster recovery, failover, monitoring, logging, tracing, alerting, operational readiness, and supportability requirements for business-critical enterprise platforms.
Facilitate architecture governance forums, technical design reviews, solution walkthroughs, migration readiness assessments, risk reviews, and cross-team decision-making across delivery workstreams.

Create and maintain architecture documentation including current-state assessments, target-state blueprints, transition architectures, integration views, dependency maps, decision logs, operational runbooks, and modernization roadmaps.

Job summary

Across government, cloud technology underpins the delivery of secure, scalable and modern digital services. As organisations adopt cloud-first strategies, strong architecture is essential to ensure platforms are well-designed, governed and able to deliver long-term value. Ofgem plays a vital role in the UK’s energy system, protecting consumers and enabling a more secure, fair and sustainable energy future, and a robust Architecture capability is central to this mission.

Within the Digital, Data and Security Services (DDSS) directorate, we are modernising our technology estate and expanding our use of Microsoft Azure as a core platform. This includes building secure, scalable and cost-effective solutions that support data, AI and digital services across the organisation.

As a Principal Technical Architect (Azure), you will play a key role in shaping how Azure is designed and used across Ofgem. You will define standards and governance, guide technical decision-making and support delivery teams to build high-quality cloud solutions. Working across programmes and domains, you will ensure architectural consistency, manage risk and embed architectural best practice across our Azure environment.

This is a highly influential technical role within a fast-paced and evolving environment, requiring deep Azure expertise and strong architectural capability.

Job description

You will be responsible for:

Defining and shaping Azure architecture standards, aligned to organisational and government frameworks
Establishing and embedding architectural patterns, principles and governance
Providing oversight and assurance for complex cloud solutions
Supporting architectural decision-making and managing technical risk
Promoting reusable frameworks and best practice across teams
Collaborating with stakeholders to align technology and business needs
Evaluating emerging Azure capabilities and supporting their adoption
Mentoring architects and engineers, building capability across DDSS

We are looking for:

A highly experienced technical architect who can shape and guide cloud architecture in a complex environment. You will bring strong Azure expertise alongside the ability to influence across teams.
You may come from a infrastructure, cloud, enterprise or platform background, but you will demonstrate:

Strong experience designing and delivering solutions on Microsoft Azure
Solid understanding of cloud architecture, governance and optimisation
Experience contributing to architectural standards and decision-making
Knowledge of security, identity and compliance in cloud environments
Ability to collaborate across teams and guide technical outcomes

Relevant certifications (e.g. Azure Solutions Architect Expert) is expected (or achievable).
Experience with Infrastructure as Code, DevOps or regulated environments is beneficial.
This is an opportunity to play a key role in shaping Ofgem’s architecture capability and Azure cloud platform. You will help ensure systems are secure, scalable and fit for the future, supporting digital transformation and services that impact consumers across Great Britain.

Person specification

Essential Criteria

Extensive experience in design and delivery of complex solutions on Microsoft Azure (Lead Criteria).

Demonstrable proficiency in technical direction, team mentorship, and guidance across multi-disciplinary IT teams and architects (Lead Criteria).

Understanding Azure security frameworks, compliance standards, and identity management models.
Proven capability in the definition and implementation of governance models for cloud adoption and optimisation.
Proficiency in architectural modelling tools such as Archi and frameworks, such as ArchiMate, UML, or equivalent, with the ability to create and maintain architectural artefacts.

Holds or can obtain the following certifications or equivalent:

Formal Architectural Qualification such as BCS EA Certification or equivalent.
Cloud Architecture Certification: Microsoft Azure Solution Architect (Expert).

Desirable Criteria

Experience with Infrastructure as Code and DevOps practices.
Understanding government digital standards and assurance processes.

Behaviours

We'll assess you against these behaviours during the selection process:
Seeing the Big Picture
Making Effective Decisions
Leadership

Technical skills

You will also be asked to prepare a presentation. Full details of the presentation will be included in the invitation to interview.

Benefits
Alongside your salary of £63,443, OFGEM contributes £18,379 towards you being a member of the Civil Service Defined Benefit Pension scheme. Find out what benefits a Civil Service Pension provides (opens in a new window).

Ofgem can offer you a comprehensive and competitive benefits package which includes; 30 days annual leave after 2 years; Excellent training and development opportunities; The opportunity to join the generous Civil Service pension which also includes a valuable range of benefits; hybrid working (currently 1 day a week in the office but this is kept under review), flexible working hours and family friendly policies. Plus lots of other benefits including clean and bright offices based centrally, engaged networks and teams and an opportunity to contribute to our ambitious and important targets of establishing a Net Zero energy system by 2050. This exciting blend of professional challenge and personal reward identifies career opportunities at Ofgem as something to get excited about.

Things you need to know

Artificial intelligence

Artificial intelligence can be a useful tool to support your application, however, all examples and statements provided must be truthful, factually accurate and taken directly from your own experience. Where plagiarism has been identified (presenting the ideas and experiences of others, or generated by artificial intelligence, as your own) applications may be withdrawn and internal candidates may be subject to disciplinary action. Please see our candidate guidance (opens in a new window) for more information on appropriate and inappropriate use.

Selection process details

This vacancy is using Success Profiles (opens in a new window), and will assess your Behaviours, Experience and Technical skills.

When you press the ‘Apply now’ button, you will be asked to complete personal details (not seen by the sift panel), your career history and qualifications.
You will then be asked to provide a 1250 word ‘personal statement’ evidencing how you meet the essential and desirable skills and capabilities listed in the role profile. Please ensure you demonstrate clearly, within your supporting statement, how you meet each of the criteria listed in the role profile.

The Civil Service values honesty and integrity and expects all candidates to abide by these principles. You must ensure that any evidence submitted as part of your application or used during interview, including your CV and any statements or examples, are truthful and factually accurate. Ofgem takes any incidences of cheating very seriously. Please ensure all examples provided are of your own experience. Any instances of plagiarism or other forms of cheating will be investigated and, if proven, the relevant applications will be withdrawn from the process. Please note that plagiarism can include presenting the ideas and experiences of others, or generated by artificial intelligence, as your own.

Please refer to Civil Service candidate advice on the acceptable use of artificial intelligence within the recruitment and selection process - Artificial intelligence and recruitment , Civil Service Careers

The personal information we have collected from you will be shared with Cifas who will use it to prevent fraud, other unlawful or dishonest conduct, malpractice, and other seriously improper conduct. If any of these are detected, you could be refused certain services or employment. Your personal information will also be used to verify your identity. Further details of how your information will be used by us and Cifas, and your data protection rights, can be found by [ https://www.cifas.org.uk/fpn ].

At Ofgem, we expect our staff to carry out their roles with honesty, fairness and openness. They should follow the Civil Service code and be free from any influence or bias. We are committed to making sure interests are recognised, declared and managed appropriately so that we can fulfil our duties as an energy regulator. The AEP / RT-CDP Data Architect will lead the design and ongoing development of the organisation’s customer data foundation within Adobe Experience Platform (AEP). With a strong emphasis on Adobe Real-Time Customer Data Platform (RT-CDP), this position is accountable for ensuring customer data can be collected, structured, connected, governed, and activated effectively across the enterprise.
Serving as the technical authority for the AEP data layer, the architect will turn marketing and business objectives into scalable data solutions. They will collaborate with solution architects, data engineers, marketing teams, and security and privacy stakeholders to enable real-time personalisation, customer analytics, and activation across channels.

This is a contract role and is 3.5 days Per week. There maybe occasional travel into the London based office.

Principal Accountabilities

Set the architectural direction for the complete AEP and RT-CDP data lifecycle, covering source ingestion, XDM design, identity resolution, profile configuration, and downstream activation.
Develop and maintain Adobe Experience Data Model (XDM) schemas, datasets, and data flows for both profile-enabled and non-profile use cases.
Create reusable architecture patterns and technical standards for batch, streaming, and real-time data ingestion.
Design solutions that can scale across multiple brands, markets, and regions where required.
Define how data from a range of source platforms and applications should be onboarded into AEP.
Determine the appropriate modelling approach for customer attributes, behavioural events, and other data types, applying established XDM best practices.
Work alongside data engineering teams to ensure ingestion processes are reliable, performant, maintainable, and properly documented.
Establish and govern the RT-CDP identity framework, including identity namespaces, matching and stitching rules, and merge policies.
Set standards for profile enablement and define the criteria that data must meet before it is ready for audience creation and activation.
Convert business, marketing, and customer-experience requirements into clear data architecture blueprints and detailed solution designs.
Provide authoritative guidance on AEP data design throughout discovery, implementation, and delivery.
Review proposed solutions, identify technical and data-related risks, and support teams with architecture decisions.
Explain design options, dependencies, limitations, and trade-offs clearly to both technical teams and senior non-technical stakeholders.

Experience and Capabilities

At least five years of experience working in a Data Architect position or a closely related architecture role.
Strong practical knowledge of Adobe Experience Platform, with experience in Real-Time CDP and, ideally, other products within the Adobe ecosystem.
Demonstrated experience in enterprise data architecture, customer data solution design, or solution architecture.
Strong knowledge of:
Event-based and event-driven data structures
Customer and profile data modelling techniques
APIs, JSON, and data transformation principles
Identity resolution and unified customer profile concepts
Batch, streaming, and real-time integration patterns
Experience working with at least one major cloud data environment, such as Microsoft Azure, Amazon Web Services, or Google Cloud Platform.
A sound understanding of GDPR, data governance, consent, and privacy-by-design principles as they apply to customer data platforms.

Please apply for immediate consideration.

The University of Edinburgh is a world-class organisation. We are a large University covering a wide range of activities. In Professional Services, we support the University’s research and teaching, offering many career and role specialisms.

The Opportunity

We're looking for a Senior Web Developer to help lead the continuous development and ongoing support of the University's central web services, principally the Web Publishing Platform (EdWeb 2) — the open-source, Drupal-based service behind nearly 170 environments and over 600 subsites, curated by more than 1,200 editors and reaching around 30 million users a year from across the world.

The work is focused on shaping and validating an end-to-end service model, including service mapping, early-stage integration activity and the development of an initial working capability within a secure test environment. 

The programme includes multiple related delivery streams being delivered by a mixed supplier and Scottish Government team. These streams cover user-facing digital journeys, supporting content and information architecture, and the underpinning service model and technical approach required to enable future phases. 

That architecture is documented in both a PoC High Level Design and Full-Service High-Level Design, supported by Architecture Decision Records.
The next phase requires: 
one or more iterations of the Full Service HLD based on a re-evaluation of technical and integration constraints. 
a body of options papers and ADRs that show the reasoning, alternatives and trade-offs behind each decision before the decision is written up. 
integration strategies for each justice partner that are specific to that partner's systems, appetite and supplier landscape. 
low level design of sufficient depth to assure, cost, plan and build a Beta.

Substantial experience as a technical architect on complex, integration-heavy digital services, with a track record of designs that were successfully delivered. 
Demonstrable ownership of HLD and LLD artefacts through multiple iterations and formal architectural assurance, in a governed public sector or comparably regulated environment. 
Deep, practical systems integration expertise: event-driven and message-based architecture, service buses, asynchronous patterns, idempotency, replay, dead-lettering, eventual consistency, change data capture and reconciliation. 
Strong API design and integration with legacy and third-party systems that you do not control and cannot change.

Security and privacy by design: authentication and identity (OIDC/OAuth2, federated identity), threat modelling, data protection and information governance for sensitive personal data.

Stakeholder credibility. Able to hold a design position under sustained challenge from an assurance function, concede accurately when the challenge is right, and negotiate with partner organisations whose interests are not aligned with the programme's.

Experience in the justice, policing or public safety sector
Familiarity with Scottish Government common components; ScotAccount, Digital Mailbox, SG Cloud Platform, Scottish Government Design System and the Digital Scotland Service Standard. 
Experience designing services for vulnerable users
Experience with viewpoint-based architecture description (Rozanski & Woods or similar) and with C4 or equivalent modelling. 
Multi-organisation programme experience where architectural progress depends on organisational agreement.

jobs.title: Software Engineer
jobs.description:
At Longshot Systems we build advanced platforms for sports betting analytics and trading.

We're looking for a Software Engineer to join the team that owns and develops our trading platform. Longshot is a small, focused company and so the role suits someone who can architect and implement whatever is needed to meet our next product, performance or stability goal. The team owns the technical standards and coding guidelines, CI/CD, observability and security. This role suits someone who wants to ship features and contribute to the wider technical excellence in the team and platform.

The trading platform at Longshot handles integrations with many bookmakers and exchanges worldwide. It normalises and combines the global odds data for many sports and makes it available internally for strategies to trade on. We handle thousands of odds updates and trades per second and have very strict bounds on latency, correctness and overall quality of the feed and trading. You would be at the heart of this team: integrating more trading venues, optimising key parts of the platform, making trading safer and faster, etc. We also maintain a significant historical data repository and support wider trading and research efforts around the company.

Our key platform systems are all in Golang, with message buses and databases at the core of the architecture. You don't need to be fluent in Golang, but it would help. It's easy to learn and we have a team full of experts able to teach you.

We are a hybrid working company, working Thursdays in our London (Farringdon) office and flexible the rest of the week. Our typical working hours are 10 am to 6 pm UK time, Monday to Friday, but we support flexible working and trust our team to manage their own schedules to meet their goals.

Interview Process

Intro call (30 mins) - your background + interests
1st Technical interview (30 mins) - live code review & pair programming
2nd Technical interview (60 mins) - deep dive technical questions
Full assessment day (10:30-5pm) - a one day systems programming exercise designed to be similar to the real work we do in the team. Meet some of the team, see the office, have a nice lunch (on us)

Bachelors or Masters in a quantitative or technical subject (e.g. Maths, EE, Physics, Comp Sci) from a top university
2+ years experience building mission critical distributed systems (finance, gaming, telco, ad-tech, etc.) where throughput, correctness and availability are a hard requirement
Proven track record delivering and maintaining production systems in at least one systems language (Go, C++, Rust, Java, C#, etc.), with clear, idiomatic designs
Startup experience: shipping products in small, fast moving teams
Architecture & design: Able to reason about trade offs and produce clean, evolvable service boundaries
Cloud & DevOps: comfortable working in AWS, linux and wrangling build pipelines. We have dedicated DevOps people, but you do need to be competent in the core skills here

The Role:

Spire is making a fundamental shift in how it operates its constellation. We are moving from a model where trained operators watch dashboards and escalate to experts, to one where the system is fully autonomous, self-healing, and data intelligent. This Director will lead that transformation. You will set the technical vision, define the architecture, build and inspire the team, and personally raise the standard for what modern space operations look like. 
The old model relies on operators, escalations, manual processes, and institutional knowledge locked in the heads of a few experts. It does not scale and it does not belong in a modern space company. We know what we want to replace it with: SRE principles applied to a constellation, autonomous fault handling, AI-driven anomaly detection, low toil, high data quality, and continuous improvement baked into the system.

This is not a role for someone who wants to graduate out of technical work. If your ideal week is back-to-back 1:1s, sprint ceremonies, and stakeholder syncs, this is not the right fit. jobs.title: Forward Deployment Engineer
jobs.description:
Forward Deployed Engineer (FDE)

Build technology that solves real business problems
We are looking for an experienced Forward Deployed Engineer (FDE)
to work at the intersection of technology, data, AI and the business.

This is not a traditional software engineering role. You will work directly with our investment, operations and distribution teams, spending time with the people who use our technology to understand their workflows, identify meaningful problems and build solutions that make a measurable difference.

You will have the autonomy to take ideas from problem definition through to production, often moving from prototype to a working solution in days or weeks rather than months.

The role
As a Forward Deployed Engineer, you will:
Work directly with business teams to understand their workflows, challenges and opportunities.
Identify high-impact problems where software, automation, data or AI can improve how we operate.
Rapidly prototype solutions, test them with users and iterate based on real-world feedback.
Take successful prototypes through to production, building secure, reliable and maintainable services.
Work across the full technology stack, including backend services, APIs, data pipelines and user-facing applications.
Integrate data and systems across APIs, databases, files and message queues, turning complex and fragmented data into useful products and services.
Apply modern AI and LLM capabilities to accelerate delivery and create new ways of working.
Partner closely with engineering, data and platform teams to align with architecture, security and technology standards.
Maintain a strong focus on security, governance, data protection and operational resilience, particularly where solutions interact with client assets and regulated activity.

About you
You are a hands-on engineer and pragmatic problem solver who enjoys being close to the people you build for.
You are comfortable operating in environments where the problem is not always clearly defined. You can ask the right questions, challenge assumptions, make sensible trade-offs and move quickly from an idea to something users can actually work with.
You are equally comfortable discussing architecture with engineers, mapping a business process with a subject matter expert, or explaining a technical trade-off to a senior stakeholder.
Most importantly, you care about building the right thing, not simply building things right.

Experience needed for the role:
4+ years of professional software engineering experience, with a track record of delivering and supporting production systems.
Experience taking projects end to end, from problem definition and design through development, deployment and ongoing improvement.
Experience working directly with users, clients or business stakeholders is highly desirable.
Strong experience integrating APIs, databases, files and messaging systems, and working with complex or imperfect real-world data.
Experience in financial services, investment management, asset management or another regulated, data-intensive environment is highly desirable.
Experience using modern AI/LLM technologies, or a demonstrated ability and enthusiasm to adopt them quickly.

Technical skills
We are looking for strong engineering fundamentals rather than a specific technology background. Experience with one or more of the following is valuable:
Programming: Python, TypeScript/JavaScript, Java, C# or Go.
Full stack development: backend services, APIs and modern web applications.
Data: SQL, PostgreSQL, Azure SQL, data modelling, cloud storage and graph technologies, including GraphRAG.
Cloud and infrastructure: Azure, containers, CI/CD and infrastructure as code.
Security: authentication, authorisation, data isolation, input validation and secure handling of sensitive information.
AI: LLMs, AI-assisted development, intelligent automation and emerging AI application patterns.

If you are an engineer who enjoys solving ambiguous problems, working directly with users and turning ideas into production technology, we would like to hear from you.

jobs.description:
About the job:

Impact at Scale
: We are part of Allegro, developing high-performance IT systems for OneBox backend.
Massive Scale
: Design and build high-availability systems used by tens of thousands of users. This is high-performance engineering in practice.
Modern Tech Stack
: Work with a world-class environment using C#, .NET Core, ASP.NET, REST, PostgreSQL, Azure, Docker, Kubernetes, EntityFramework, and Redis.
True Ownership & Autonomy
: We live by a "you build it, you run it" philosophy. You'll join an autonomous team with full ownership of the services you create, from design to deployment.
Complex Challenges
: You will tackle complex backend problems, using technology to solve real-world business challenges.

Join the team building the backend powering our OneBox network! Imagine walking down the street, spotting a OneBox parcel locker, and knowing that your code helps drive it – that's the kind of impactful project you'll be working on. Our systems process millions of parcels, operating at high scale, high complexity, and deep integration close to the hardware.

In this role, you will work with physical machines, shape our backend architecture, and scale our infrastructure to support a continuously growing fleet of OneBoxes. We prioritize high reliability, modern engineering practices, and a supportive team culture, offering you a unique opportunity to solve complex real-world challenges at scale.

Important things for you

Flexible working hours in the hybrid model (4/1) - working hours start between 7:00 a.m. and 10:00 a.m. We also have 30 days of occasional remote work.
The salary range for this position depending on the skill set is as follows (contract of employment, tax-deductible cost):
PLN 14 600 - 20 825

Annual bonus based on your annual performance and company results.
Our team is based in Warsaw.

We are looking for people who:

Have solid, fluent proficiency in C# and .NET Core / ASP.NET
for building reliable, maintainable backend systems;
Demonstrate solid proficiency in designing and maintaining REST APIs
and microservices;
Work confidently with relational databases like PostgreSQL
, including data modeling and basic database performance tuning;
Have hands-on experience with cloud-native tooling such as Docker and Kubernetes
;
Have experience working with asynchronous messaging systems like Azure Service Bus
or similar message brokers;
Understand caching concepts and usage of tools like Redis
to support system performance;
Have experience with large IoT device networks or similar systems (a plus), or are open, excited, and aware of working with such device ecosystems;
Enjoy sharing knowledge, and encouraging good engineering practices;
Are eager to grow toward end-to-end task ownership across the software development lifecycle with mentorship from senior engineers;
Are comfortable participating in architectural discussions and contributing to overall system design;
Are proficient in Polish and English (at least B2 level).

What's in it for you:

Well-located offices (with e.g. fully equipped kitchens, bicycle parking, terraces full of greenery) and excellent work tools (e.g., raised desks, ergonomic chairs, interactive conference rooms).
A 16" or 14" Dell with Windows and all the necessary accessories.
A wide selection of fringe benefits in a cafeteria plan - you choose what you like (e.g., medical, sports or lunch packages, insurance, purchase vouchers).
English classes that we pay for related to the specific nature of your job.
A training budget, inter-team tourism (see more here), hackathons, and an internal learning platform where you will find multiple trainings.
An additional day off for volunteering, which you can use alone, with a team, or with a larger group of people connected by a common goal.
Social events for Allegro people - Spin Kilometers, Family Day, Fat Thursday, Advent of Code, and many other occasions we enjoy.

And that's just the beginning! You can read more about the benefits here.

#goodtobehere means that:

You will join a team you can count on
- we work with top-class specialists who have knowledge- and experience-sharing in their DNA.
You will love our level of autonomy
in team organization, the space for continuous development, and the opportunity to try new things. You get to choose which technology solves the problem and you are responsible for what you create.
You will value our Developer Experience
and the full platform of tools and technologies that make creating software easier. We rely on an internal ecosystem based on self-service and widely used tools such as Kubernetes, Docker, Consul, GitHub, and GitHub Actions. Thanks to this, you can contribute to Allegro from your very first days on the job.
You will be equipped with modern AI tools
to automate repetitive tasks, allowing you to focus on developing new services and refining existing ones (also leveraging AI support).
You will create solutions that will be used (and loved!)
by your friends, family and millions of our customers.
You will meet the Allegro Scale
, which starts with over 1000 microservices, an open-source data bus (Hermes) with 300K+ rps, a Service Mesh with 1M+ rps, tens of petabytes of data, and production-used machine learning.
You will become part of Allegro Tech
- We speak at industry conferences, cooperate with tech communities, run our own blog (it's been over 10 years!), record podcasts, lead guilds, and we organize our own internal conference - the Allegro Tech Meeting. We create solutions we love (and can) to talk about!

Send us your CV and… see you at Allegro!
