WTW's Insurance Consulting and Technology business is a global leader in P&C, Life and Health insurance software and advisory services, with over 1,700 colleagues across 35 markets. More than 1,000 insurers worldwide trust our combination of advisory insight and advanced software to help them navigate complexity and drive sustainable growth.

Joining Endava, you'll work exclusively with WTW to help embed AI-enabled engineering practices, modern ways of working and deep insurance technology expertise, contributing to the next generation of products and services for insurers worldwide. Working as part of a dedicated team established through a Build-Operate-Transfer (BOT) model, you'll collaborate closely with WTW while building your career as an Endava employee, supporting the long-term success of this strategic partnership.

About the Role

As a Senior Full Stack Software Engineer, you will join an experienced cross-functional engineering team responsible for designing, developing and evolving the Authentication and Authorization capability used across multiple products and engineering teams.

This is not a traditional application development role. Instead, you will help build a reusable identity platform that enables other engineering teams to adopt standardised authentication and authorisation services while improving security, developer experience and operational efficiency.

The capability provides shared identity and access management services that help applications authenticate users securely, authorise access to business resources and integrate with enterprise identity providers.

Built on Auth0, Fine-Grained Authorization (FGA) and modern Azure services, it includes reusable SDKs, reverse proxy services and developer tooling that make secure integration simpler across ICT’s technology landscape.

You will work closely with architects, product teams, platform engineers and business stakeholders helping deliver secure, scalable and high-quality technology solutions that create value for WTW and its customers. You will be expected to work with a high degree of autonomy, take ownership of significant work packages and make sound technical decisions within the agreed platform direction.

What Success Looks Like

In this role you will:

Help deliver secure, reusable authentication and authorization services used by multiple product teams.
Build high-quality .NET APIs, Angular administration tools and integration services that are maintainable and easy to operate.
Improve the reliability, scalability and security of shared identity services through well-tested engineering changes.
Support platform adoption by improving SDKs, documentation, developer tooling and integration patterns.
Contribute to automation, CI/CD and cloud platform improvements that make delivery faster and more predictable.
Collaborate with architects, product owners, QA, DevOps and consuming product teams to solve identity and access management challenges.
Actively learn, share knowledge and contribute to a positive engineering culture within the Quartz team.

Identity Platform Development

Design, develop and maintain authentication and authorization services using modern .NET technologies.
Develop reusable platform services supporting secure authentication and authorization across multiple business applications.
Build scalable REST APIs and integration services used throughout the organisation.
Develop and maintain Angular-based administration portals supporting user, group and permission management.
Contribute to the evolution of Fine-Grained Authorization (FGA) capabilities and centralized access management services.

Platform Services & Developer Experience

Develop reusable SDKs, libraries and APIs that simplify integration with the enterprise identity platform.
Build developer tooling that improves onboarding and adoption of shared authentication services.
Improve developer experience by simplifying authentication, authorization and platform integration.
Produce and maintain technical documentation supporting engineering teams consuming the platform.
Help minimise breaking changes by designing stable, reusable platform interfaces.
Take ownership of technical designs and implementation approaches for assigned capabilities, identifying dependencies, risks and trade-offs and following work through to a production-ready outcome.
Lead focused technical work packages and provide practical guidance to other engineers contributing to the same capability.

Cloud & Platform Engineering

Develop cloud-native services running on Microsoft Azure.
Build and maintain reverse proxy capabilities using Azure API Management.
Support Infrastructure as Code implementation using OpenTofu/Terraform.
Contribute to CI/CD pipelines and deployment automation using Azure DevOps.
Support continuous improvements in platform scalability, security and operational resilience.

Engineering Excellence

Write unit, integration and automated tests ensuring platform quality and reliability.
Participate in peer reviews, architecture discussions and technical design sessions.

Strong knowledge of object-oriented programming and modern software design principles.

Identity & Security

Strong understanding of OAuth 2.0, OpenID Connect (OIDC) and JWT.
Good understanding of modern authentication and authorization concepts.
Experience integrating applications with enterprise identity providers.
Understanding of secure API design and identity-based access control.

Experience with Azure DevOps, Git and CI/CD pipelines.
Experience using Infrastructure as Code with Terraform or OpenTofu.
Understanding of Azure API Management or similar API Gateway technologies.

Front-End Development

Experience building administrative or developer-facing web applications.

Engineering Practices

Strong communication and collaboration skills.

Ability to influence technical outcomes across team boundaries, communicate delivery risks and contribute to decisions affecting shared platform consumers.

From AI platforms to digital transformation, we partner with enterprise leaders to build what’s next.

The leading provider of vehicle lifecycle solutions, with headquarters in Chicago, enables the companies that build, insure, and replace vehicles to power the next generation of transportation. Its platform delivers advanced mobile, artificial intelligence, and car technologies. It connects a network of 350+ insurance companies, 24,000+ repair facilities, hundreds of parts suppliers, and dozens of third-party data and service providers. The customer's collective solutions enhance productivity and help clients deliver better experiences for end consumers.

What You’ll Do

Design and evolve cloud-native architectures across the full platform stack — compute, API management, messaging, eventing, and data primarily on Microsoft Azure (e.g., App Services, Container Apps, API Management, Service Bus, Event Hubs, Azure SQL); equivalent AWS services welcome, Azure preferred

Provide technical leadership on cloud modernization, legacy-to-microservices migration, AI-readiness, and platform performance
Embed security and compliance practices across designs, including identity management, access control, and encryption
Work with product and data teams to integrate AI and Generative AI capabilities (e.g., Azure AI Foundry, AWS Bedrock / AgentCore, or comparable platforms) into core products and help drive AI-powered automation across the platform
Champion the use of AI and intelligent automation to lift engineering productivity, code quality, and delivery velocity

What You’ll Bring

Extensive professional experience in .NET application architecture and development, with a strong C# foundation
Proven experience designing and deploying cloud-native solutions (Azure or AWS) using microservices, RESTful APIs, and distributed-system design
Hands-on experience with AI-assisted development tooling (e.g., GitHub Copilot, Claude Code, Cursor, or comparable agentic coding tools) and proven ability to apply them to lift team-wide engineering productivity
Proven experience with security protocols (OAuth2, OpenID Connect) and identity providers (Okta, Azure AD / Entra ID)
Working knowledge of application security best practices — secure APIs, rate limiting, secrets management, RBAC, and Managed Identities
Demonstrated ability to produce and present architecture artifacts (diagrams, specifications, solution blueprints)
Solid understanding of data integration patterns and event-driven systems, primarily on Microsoft Azure (e.g., Event Hubs, Service Bus, Kafka); equivalent AWS services welcome, Azure preferred

jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer (MES & Distributed Systems)
jobs.description:
About Lumilens

At Lumilens we are building the critical photonics infrastructure that powers tomorrow’s AI supercomputing. From chip-to-chip optical interconnects to scalable photonic engines, Lumilens is unlocking a new era of computing faster, cooler, and massively more efficient.

We’re a well-funded startup backed by Mayfield and led by veterans who’ve built and scaled some of the most transformative technologies in the industry. This isn’t incremental innovation, it’s a ground-floor opportunity to rethink the optical layer from the silicon up. You’ll work alongside a team of world-class engineers solving some of the hardest challenges in optics, systems, and scale. Every line of code, every design decision, every breakthrough you help deliver will shape the infrastructure of tomorrow.

If you're looking for mission, momentum, and the chance to make an outsized impact—jump on the rocket ship. We’re just getting started … and we are building a team in Kraków
.

About The Role

We are building a next-generation Manufacturing Execution System (MES) to power high-volume production of advanced silicon photonics devices (800G, 1.6T, and beyond). This system will serve as the operational backbone of our manufacturing—integrating shopfloor control, data systems, and external platforms (ERP, vendors, contract manufacturers).

As a Senior MS Dynamics Business Central Developer
, you will join our global Tech team and play a pivotal role in shaping the technical backbone of our operations. In this senior role, you will take full ownership of core development initiatives, optimize complex system architectures, and partner closely with cross-functional teams to engineer innovative, scalable solutions. and based in Warsaw
.

YOU COME WITH

5+ years of hands-on development experience with MS Dynamics Business Central or Dynamics NAV, ideally within a Microsoft Partner or enterprise environment
Deep expertise in AL programming, Visual Studio Code, and Business Central development frameworks
Proven track record of delivering scalable, high-quality technical solutions for complex business processes

Practical experience leveraging AI-powered tools and services to enhance ERP functionality
Strong problem-solving skills with a focus on optimising Business Central performance
Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills with the ability to collaborate effectively across technical and business teams, paired with fluency in English

WHY WESTWING

If you are looking for a place where ambition meets creativity, where ideas turn into impact fast, and where people are trusted to grow - you have found it.

At Westwing, we’re building the Superbrand in Design with a team that’s shaping the future of beautiful home & living.

Here Is What You Can Look Forward To

A high-performance culture built on trust, feedback and collaboration
An inspiring, international environment that empowers you to think big, take ownership, and grow beyond your comfort zone
A flexible hybrid setup with 2 office days per week - because strong connections and quick collaboration make great ideas happen

The integrated platform combines Shop, Daily Specials, Stores, the B2B Service (Westwing Business) and the Westwing Design Service. Westwing’s team works together on its shared purpose to “Excite people to create homes that unlock the full beauty of life”. Founded in 2011, Westwing is headquartered in Munich and went public on the Frankfurt Stock Exchange in October 2018.

Our team is a diverse group of professionals aiming for high performance, working together at a fast pace in an inspiring, international and informal environment that enables you to grow your career while working with a brand and products our customers love. We’re made up of passionate people who are creative enough to disrupt the status quo, brave enough to fail and smart enough to win. So come, be part of the “wow, you work at Westwing?” crowd.

Diversity is deeply rooted in our culture. Our mission doesn’t stop to inspire only your design choices, it continues to embrace an inclusive lifestyle filled with respect to everyone’s uniqueness, cultural differences and equal opportunity.

Project Description:

Luxoft is an industry-leading software integrator and solution house for automotive OEMs and suppliers. There are millions of cars on the road today with solutions designed by DXC-Luxoft.

You will work with one of the biggest car manufacturer to design and implement a cloud foundation platform for customer's workloads and business applications. A Data Mesh platform built on top of it to exchange, integrate, and process data from multiple internal systems. The Data Mesh platform applies domain-oriented data ownership, treats data as a product, and uses federated governance, enabling controlled data usage to support future AI applications.
AI Labs is a sub-product of the Data Mesh platform: an interface and services layer that gives teams self-serve access to the AI-ready datasets they need, without having to connect to each underlying source system individually.
The solution is designed and built through iterative collaboration with the client's team and other stakeholders to identify, manage, and document requirements across data domains. Our approach is iterative, adaptive, and proactive: each team member owns a specific domain area and its deliverables, and coordinates closely with that domain's data owners and downstream consumers.

Your Skills And Experiences

- BS degree in Computer Science or related technical field or equivalent practical experience

jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer, Desktop
jobs.description:
What is Box?

Box (NYSE: BOX) is the leader in Intelligent Content Management. Our platform enables organizations to fuel collaboration, manage the entire content lifecycle, secure critical content, and transform business workflows with enterprise AI. We help companies thrive in the new AI-first era of business. Founded in 2005, Box simplifies work for leading global organizations, including JLL, Morgan Stanley, and Nationwide. Box is headquartered in Redwood City, CA, with offices across the United States, Europe, and Asia.

By joining Box, you will have the unique opportunity to continue driving our platform forward. Content powers how we work. It's the billions of files and information flowing across teams, departments, and key business processes every single day: contracts, invoices, employee records, financials, product specs, marketing assets, and more. Our mission is to bring intelligence to the world of content management and empower our customers to completely transform workflows across their organizations. With the combination of AI and enterprise content, the opportunity has never been greater to transform how the world works together — and at Box you will be on the front lines of this massive shift.

Why Box needs you:

As a Senior Software Engineer on the Desktop Applications team at Box, you'll be at the heart of building and evolving the products that millions of users rely on every day - Box Drive, Box Tools, and Box for Office on both Windows and macOS. You'll work across the full depth of the desktop stack, from virtual file systems and OS integrations to sync, networking, and UI, helping shape how enterprise content comes to life on the desktop. You'll collaborate closely with Product Managers, QA engineers, and designers to deliver features that are fast, reliable, and secure - and you'll bring a growth mindset and a passion for leveraging AI tools to accelerate your impact.

What you'll do:

Design, develop, and ship high-quality features for Box's desktop applications (Box Drive, Box Tools, Box for Office) on Windows and macOS, ensuring they are performant, user-friendly, and secure
Work across the full desktop stack — including virtual file systems, data persistence, OS integrations, network and sync layers, and UI — to solve complex technical challenges at scale
Contribute to cross-platform development using React Native, bridging front-end and native desktop experiences
Collaborate daily with Product Managers, QA engineers, and designers to translate requirements into robust, well-tested software
Lead and participate in design discussions, architecture reviews, and code reviews to uphold engineering quality and share knowledge across the team
Diagnose and resolve complex performance, reliability, and compatibility issues affecting millions of end users
Attend and engage in weekly stand-ups, team meetings, and manager 1:1s
Work collaboratively with other engineers, team members, and across teams
Play a role in developing and fostering Box culture in the Warsaw office and represent Box Poland internally and externally
Participate in our on-call rotation, available at all times while on-call to help respond to and triage any issues that arise

Who you are:

We are an AI-first company. This means you approach your work with a growth mindset and find ways to leverage AI to help make faster, smarter decisions that will 10X your impact at Box.

5+ years of professional desktop software development experience
Proficient in C++, C#, and/or Swift, with a strong command of software design and architecture principles
Demonstrated experience building and shipping desktop applications on Windows and/or macOS
Comfortable working across the full desktop stack: virtual file systems, OS integrations, networking, sync, and UI
Experienced with unit testing and functional testing practices in an agile team environment
Passionate about building software that is user-friendly, performant, and secure
Strong problem-solving skills with the ability to diagnose and resolve complex technical issues
Able to assess, communicate, and complete project milestones with your manager and team members in a time-sensitive manner
Must speak English proficiently

Preferred Skills:

Experience with Windows systems-level programming (Win32 APIs, multi-threading, IPC, COM)
Cross-platform development experience across both macOS and Windows
Prior experience using AI coding tools (e.g., GitHub Copilot, Cursor) as part of your daily workflow

Percentage of Time Spent:

15% design and architecture
60% coding, code reviews, and testing
15% bug fixes
5% documentation
5% meetings

Methodology:

Agile management — Scrum
Issue tracking — Jira
Knowledge repository — Box / Confluence / GitHub Enterprise
Code reviews — GitHub Enterprise
Version control — GIT
CI/CD — Jenkins
Communication — Slack / Zoom

Benefits

Check out the overview of Life at Box which include general perks and benefits.

Box lives its values, with community and in-person collaboration being a core part of our culture. Boxers are expected to work from their assigned office a minimum of 3 days per week. Your Recruiter will share more about how we work and company culture during the hiring process.

At Box, we believe unique and diverse experiences benefit our culture, our products, our customers, our company, and our world. We aim to recruit a passionate, high-performing workforce that reflects the world we live in. If you are head-over-heels about this role but unsure if you meet all the requirements, we encourage you to apply!

EQUAL OPPORTUNITY

We are an equal opportunity employer and value diversity at our company. jobs.description:
Senior SQA Engineer – Test Automation / Manual Testing

Job Title:

Senior SQA Engineer – Test Automation / Manual Testing

About us:

Accuris launched in May 2023 as a standalone company and was formerly known as S&P Global’s Engineering Solutions division. Accuris has been an integral part of the engineering ecosystem for more than 60 years and is valued for standards content and workflow solutions including Engineering Workbench, Goldfire, Haystack, and Parts Management Solutions.

The Team:

The Engineering Workbench team builds and evolves a flagship Accuris product used globally by engineering professionals. The team focuses on delivering robust, scalable, and secure cloud-based solutions in AWS, supported by strong software quality practices across manual testing, automation, defect management, and CI/CD validation.

You will collaborate closely with software developers, QA specialists, Product Owners, IT partners, and engineering stakeholders. The team values ownership, practical test automation, clear communication, continuous improvement, and proactive collaboration across disciplines.

The Impact:

As a Senior SQA Engineer, you will design software testing plans, create and execute manual and automated tests, and help ensure the quality of web applications and services throughout the full product lifecycle, including Production.

You will guide the team on when and how to automate effectively, influence testability during design and development phases, coordinate defect management, and provide clear test results, regression feedback, and quality insights to development teams.

Responsibilities:

Design software testing plans and create and execute both manual and automated tests using test automation tools including, but not limited to Selenium and Playwright.
Understand the concepts behind automation, know when automation is appropriate, and guide the team on how to create the right tests.
Coordinate team members to solve issues assigned to the team and support timely resolution of quality risks.
Monitor Production quality and coordinate resolution of issues assigned to teams.
Ensure compliance of team testing activities with project rules, quality standards, and agreed processes.
Participate in functional testing during CI/CD processes and support reliable product releases.
Organize and monitor defect management processes within teams.
Influence the inclusion of testability during design, grooming, and development phases.
Test the product in all phases of its lifecycle, including Production.
Interface with developers in the project by providing clear test results and identifying regression areas.

What We’re Looking For:

Key qualifications:

Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
4+ years of automation engineering experience with Selenium WebDriver and/or Playwright using C#/.NET and xUnit frameworks.
Experience testing web applications built with .NET Core, microservices, and AngularJS, including cross-browser and cross-device validation using automated tools.
Solid knowledge of databases, including the ability to write CRUD operations, work with JOINs, and validate data-driven application behavior.

Key soft skills:

Strong collaboration skills with the ability to coordinate testing activities, defect management, and issue resolution across development teams.
Clear, structured communication with developers, including the ability to provide test results, regression areas, and actionable defect information.
Proactive approach to quality, testability, production monitoring, and continuous improvement throughout the software development lifecycle.
Good spoken and written English.

Required Knowledge / Technologies:

Selenium WebDriver, Playwright, C#/.NET, xUnit frameworks, manual testing, automated testing, functional testing, and test case/script design and execution.
Testing of web applications in .NET Core, microservices, AngularJS, client-server application architecture, RESTful APIs, and CI/CD processes.
Databases and SQL, including CRUD operations, JOINs, data validation, and practical understanding of application data flows.
Docker containerization basics, AWS cloud services such as EC2, S3, RDS, or similar, and development tools such as Visual Studio, VS Code, or Rider.
Agile software development, Azure DevOps / ADOPS bug tracking, defect management, and exposure to performance and load testing tools such as CloudTest, Cloud Testing using ADOPS, or K6 are considered a plus.

What’s in it for you:

Opportunity to shape testing strategy and improve automation practices for a flagship product used globally.
Hands-on work across manual testing, automation, API testing, CI/CD validation, production quality monitoring, and defect management.
Close collaboration with experienced developers, Product Owners, IT partners, and engineering stakeholders in an Agile environment.
Corporate support for personal growth and career development, provision of all necessary equipment, and benefits including medical package, Multisport, life insurance, and the internal Wellbeing program.

The Location:

Poland.

Budget:

PLN 20,000–24,000 gross per month, with flexibility depending on seniority and experience, plus 5% bonus.

Compensation/Benefits Information

Accuris states that the anticipated base salary / budget for this position is PLN 20,000–24,000 gross per month, with flexibility depending on seniority and experience. Final base salary for this role will be based on the individual’s geographical location as well as experience and qualifications for the role. In addition to base compensation, this role is eligible for a 5% bonus as well as comprehensive benefits. For more information on benefits, please reach out to the recruiter assigned to the role.

Benefits include a medical package, Multisport, life insurance, internal Wellbeing program, corporate support for personal growth and career development, and provision of all necessary equipment.

jobs.title: Engineering Manager
jobs.description:
About the job:

Are you excited about leading high-scale platform engineering in the core fintech sector? We are searching for a dynamic Engineering Manager who leads the platform engineering team responsible for JVM and .NET platform health, DevOps tooling, CI/CD, observability, and deployment infrastructure across all FinTech products.

You will be accountable for platform reliability, cost efficiency, developer velocity, and AI readiness across the FinTech engineering organization. For this position, the candidate must be an engineer specializing in either .NET or Java.

Important things for you:

Flexible working hours
in the hybrid model (4/1) — working hours start between 7:00 a.m. and 10:00 a.m. We also have 30 days of occasional remote work.
Depending on your annual assessment and the company's results we offer:
Annual bonus
based on your annual performance and company results.
Long term discretionary incentive plan
based on Allegro.eu shares (restricted stock units).
Our team is based in Warsaw
.

Your responsibilities:

Leads and manages a cross-functional platform engineering team.
Drives platform adoption and removes technical and operational blockers across product teams.
Oversees infrastructure provisioning, cloud resource management, and container orchestration on Azure Kubernetes Service (AKS).
Coordinates fleet-scale migrations, including JVM and .NET platform development, Java, .NET, and Spring Boot upgrades.
Optimizes CI/CD pipelines, GitOps deployment safety (canary releases, configuration versioning), and infrastructure cost efficiency.
Integrates AI tools into platform engineering workflows to accelerate developer velocity company-wide.
Manages capacity, sequencing, and cloud budgeting (Azure).
Runs team ceremonies, conducts 1:1 sessions, provides performance feedback, and leads talent acquisition.

Main challenges in this role:

High cloud logging and observability costs requiring validation and deployment of alternative logging backends like VictoriaLogs.
Scaling pipeline throughput and deployment safety to match the accelerated development speed driven by AI tools.
Modernizing JVM and .NET platform and tracking library adoption across products.
Balancing tight roadmap deadlines with team capacity and high operational interrupt volumes.

This is the right job for you if:

You are a strong leader with competencies in People Management, Talent Development, Strategic Thinking, Problem-Solving & Decision-Making, and Stakeholder Management.
You have crucial job-specific skills including Back-End Programming, Business Continuity and Resilience Planning, Software Architecture, DevOps and CI/CD, Agile Methodologies, and Scalability and Resilience.
You possess knowledge in Cloud Infrastructure Management (Microsoft Azure), Container Orchestration (AKS, Istio Service Mesh), Infrastructure as Code (Pulumi), and JVM and .NET Platform Management.
You exhibit general competencies such as Communication, Change Agility, Risk Savvy, Change Management, Continuous Improvement & Innovation, Resilience and Adaptability, AI Literacy, and Analytical Thinking.
You are fluent in Polish (C1) and have a strong command of English (B2).

What's in it for you:

Well-located offices (with e.g. fully equipped kitchens, bicycle parking, terraces full of greenery) and excellent work tools (e.g., raised desks, ergonomic chairs, interactive conference rooms).
A 16" or 14" MacBook Pro or corresponding Dell with Windows (if you don't like Macs) and all the necessary accessories.
A wide selection of fringe benefits in a cafeteria plan - you choose what you like (e.g., medical, sports or lunch packages, insurance, purchase vouchers).
English classes that we pay for related to the specific nature of your job.
A training budget, inter-team tourism (see more here), hackathons, and an internal learning platform where you will find multiple trainings.
An additional day off for volunteering, which you can use alone, with a team, or with a larger group of people connected by a common goal.
Social events for Allegro people - Spin Kilometers, Family Day, Fat Thursday, Advent of Code, and many other occasions we enjoy.

And that's just the beginning! You can read more about the benefits here.

#goodtobehere means that:

You will join a team you can count on - we work with top-class specialists who have knowledge- and experience-sharing in their DNA.
You will love our level of autonomy in team organization, the space for continuous development, and the opportunity to try new things. You get to choose which technology solves the problem and you are responsible for what you create.
You will value our Developer Experience and the full platform of tools and technologies that make creating software easier. We rely on an internal ecosystem based on self-service and widely used tools such as Kubernetes, Docker, Consul, GitHub, and GitHub Actions. Thanks to this, you can contribute to Allegro from your very first days on the job.
You will be equipped with modern AI tools to automate repetitive tasks, allowing you to focus on developing new services and refining existing ones (also leveraging AI support).
You will create solutions that will be used (and loved!) by your friends, family and millions of our customers.
You will meet the Allegro Scale, which starts with over 1000 microservices, an open-source data bus (Hermes) with 300K+ rps, a Service Mesh with 1M+ rps, tens of petabytes of data, and production-used machine learning.
You will become part of Allegro Tech - we speak at industry conferences, cooperate with tech communities, run our own blog (it's been over 10 years!), record podcasts, lead guilds, and we organize our own internal conference - the Allegro Tech Meeting. We create solutions we love (and can) to talk about!

Send us your CV and... see you at Allegro!

and data platforms

You will play a key role in advancing a modern enterprise data platform that enables data-driven decision-making across Vattenfall while continuously improving automation, governance and user experience.

jobs.title: Director, Global WMS Software Engineering and Product Design
jobs.description:
Join our R&D Tech Hub in Warsaw

We’re building a new R&D Tech Hub in Poland and are looking for people who want to make a real impact from day one. You’ll be part of a globally connected team, helping to shape the culture and ways of working at our new location. This is a hands-on role in a supportive environment, where collaboration, learning, and adaptability are key.

We value practical problem-solving, diverse perspectives, and people who take ownership. If you're ready to contribute to meaningful projects and help lay the foundation for a growing team, we’d like to hear from you.

About the role: What's in the Box

HelloFresh is searching for an action-oriented servant leader for our warehouse management system (WMS) Software Engineering and Product functions. This leader owns the full software delivery lifecycle for HelloFresh's global warehouse fulfillment and inventory control domain — from architecture and product design through engineering execution, quality assurance, and operational reliability. You will drive a culture of product & engineering excellence, leveraging modern agentic tooling and AI-assisted workflows to increase team velocity, reduce defect escape rates, and accelerate deployment confidence.

You will collaborate closely with stakeholders across technology, operations, automation/production technology, procurement, and finance to deliver innovative solutions on our strategic WMS platform — Infios's Warehouse Advantage (Körber/Highjump) — while balancing competing priorities and technical resource demand.

The Director of WMS Engineering and Product will
work with key technology and product leaders across HelloFresh to enable the inventory management and control domain strategy, evaluate technology-related priorities, and translate stakeholder needs into actionable roadmaps. The ideal candidate combines impeccable management and communication skills with a practitioner's instinct for modern software delivery — knowing how to build high-performing teams, establish engineering health metrics, and integrate AI-assisted tooling that meaningfully accelerates quality and velocity.

What you’ll do: The Recipe

WMS Solution Ownership: Provide technical direction, development oversight, and performance accountability for HelloFresh's deployment of Infios's Warehouse Advantage (Körber/Highjump) WMS platform across all global locations
Integration Architecture & Reliability: Drive WMS application layer Integration architecture to upstream tooling and host systems via CI/CD pipelines [Debezium/Kafka to Snowflake/Databricks]
Platform Architecture: Partner/ support as needed the Hosting Architecture team in the optimal sizing and performance of WMS Architecture in AWS
Agentic Engineering & Developer Productivity: Champion and drive adoption of agentic engineering practices across the team: automated code review tooling (e.g., AI-assisted PR analysis, static analysis agents, LLM-powered code quality gates), AI-augmented test generation and execution, and intelligent deployment pipelines. Measure and report the impact of these practices on delivery velocity and defect escape rate
CI/CD & Deployment Automation: Own the maturity roadmap for CI/CD pipelines. Establish automated deployment workflows with robust rollback strategies, feature flagging, environment-specific gate checks, and infrastructure-as-code practices — enabling high-confidence, low-friction releases across all WMS environments
Quality Engineering & Test Automation: Partner with WMS Services and Support leadership to build a world-class QA function. Drive adoption of automated regression suites, AI-assisted edge case generation, and contract testing for integrations. Push teams beyond happy-path coverage toward comprehensive scenario validation, including automated performance and load testing for peak fulfillment periods
Engineering Metrics & Continuous Improvement: Establish DORA metrics (deployment frequency, lead time for change, change failure rate, and mean time to restore) as the foundation of engineering health reporting for the WMS organization. Set baselines, publish improvement targets, and use metric trends to identify bottlenecks, prioritize tooling and process investments, and communicate engineering performance to senior leadership
Technical Roadmap & Architecture Governance: Partner with peers and senior leadership on architectural decision-making for WMS platform evolution, integration patterns, and technology transitions. Champion the use of structured design reviews to maintain coherent, scalable technical direction. Lead evaluations to refactor or replace legacy systems, including risk mitigation and transition planning
Vendor & Capacity Management: Work with department leadership to source and partner with 3rd-party vendors to augment internal engineering capacity and expertise. Maintain vendor performance accountability and ensure structured knowledge transfer to build durable internal capability
People Leadership & Talent Development: Coach, develop, and retain high-performing engineers, product managers, and team leads. Partner with HR and Talent Acquisition to build organizational depth — playing an active role in recruiting, onboarding, and career development
International Standardization/ Release Consolidation. Partner with departmental leadership, peer domains, and executive leadership to own the long term roadmap for product consolidation to a single application release version administered globally
Cross-functional Leadership. Serve on both the Fulfillment Technology and overall Automation & Technology leadership teams, reinforcing HelloFresh DNA values, establishing KPIs, and prioritizing strategic initiatives at a departmental level

What you’ll bring: The Ingredients

Technical/Engineering Experience

10+ years of warehouse management system (WMS) software engineering and implementation experience with a tier-one WMS in an RF-based distribution, manufacturing, or e-commerce fulfillment environment
3+ years of direct hands-on experience with Infios's Warehouse Advantage (Körber/Highjump) WMS platform with SQL Server
3+ years managing application integrations via microservices and associated toolsets, including REST APIs, event-driven architectures, and ETL pipelines
Demonstrated experience implementing or scaling CI/CD pipelines, including automated testing gates, deployment automation, and infrastructure-as-code (IaC) practices across multi-environment WMS or fulfillment technology stacks
Hands-on familiarity with agentic and AI-assisted engineering tools — including automated code review platforms, AI-assisted test generation, and LLM-powered developer productivity tools (e.g., GitHub Copilot, CodeRabbit, SonarQube AI, or equivalent) — with a track record of driving meaningful team-wide adoption and measurable impact
Experience defining and tracking engineering delivery and quality metrics (DORA metrics or equivalent) and using data to drive process improvement and leadership reporting
Experience leading evaluations to refactor or replace legacy systems, including developing and executing technology transition plans with appropriate risk mitigation strategies

Product Experience

Experience leading a design and product process that scales a digital technology operations ecosystem across volume growth, multiple brands, and new digital properties
Strategic thinker with the ability to build and execute innovative digital product strategy while executing tactically against multiple competing priorities simultaneously
Proven ability to translate business requirements into technical specifications, roadmaps, and delivery plans — and to communicate progress and tradeoffs clearly to both technical and non-technical stakeholders
Demonstrated ability to build leadership support for proactive technology investments, making the business case for engineering quality, automation, and platform modernization

Above all, we are looking for people who will make HelloFresh Group better.
We believe there are many different ways of developing skills and we love diverse experiences! So even if you don’t “tick all the boxes” but think you’d thrive in this role, we would really like to learn more about you.

What we offer: The Toppings

Health - You’re covered from your first day with private health insurance.
Flexible Working - We work in-office 3 days a week to align on goals, with flexible hours to support work-life balance and personal needs
Time Off - You receive 26 days of paid vacation each year, providing you time to rest and recharge.
Learning and Development - An annual Learning & Development budget and a Mentoring Program to support your ongoing professional growth.
Employee Referral Program - Our team members can take part in our internal employee referral program and receive a bonus for recommending successful candidates to open roles.
Daily Comforts - Free coffee, drinks, and fresh fruit are available to keep you refreshed throughout the day.

jobs.title: Senior Java Developer – Smart Manufacturing (M/F/NB)
jobs.description:
Dołącz do Etteplan

W Etteplan wierzymy, że technologia ma sens tylko wtedy, gdy pomaga rozwiązywać realne problemy biznesowe. Tworzymy i rozwijamy rozwiązania software'owe dla klientów z różnych gałęzi przemysłu, łącząc kompetencje z obszaru software, inżynierii i digitalizacji.

Obecnie poszukujemy Senior Java Developera
, który dołączy do projektu realizowanego dla międzynarodowego klienta z sektora przemysłowego i będzie współtworzył rozwiązania wykorzystywane w codziennej działalności organizacji działających na rynkach międzynarodowych.

O projekcie

Dołączysz do zespołu rozwijającego platformę wspierającą procesy produkcyjne oraz zarządzanie dokumentacją i jakością w środowisku przemysłowym. Rozwiązanie wykorzystywane jest przez międzynarodowe organizacje i odgrywa istotną rolę w ich codziennej działalności operacyjnej.

Projekt obejmuje zarówno rozwój nowych funkcjonalności, jak i utrzymanie oraz stopniową modernizację istniejących rozwiązań. Nie jest to wyłącznie development ani wyłącznie maintenance - zależy nam na osobach, które potrafią spojrzeć na system całościowo, proponować usprawnienia i brać odpowiedzialność za jakość dostarczanych rozwiązań.

Na co dzień będziesz współpracować z międzynarodowym zespołem oraz ekspertami biznesowymi i technicznymi po stronie klienta.

Jak wykorzystujemy AI?

W tym projekcie narzędzia AI są naturalnym elementem codziennej pracy zespołu. Wspierają analizę kodu, implementację nowych funkcjonalności, automatyzację powtarzalnych zadań oraz zwiększanie efektywności procesu wytwarzania oprogramowania.

Szukamy osoby, która świadomie wykorzystuje rozwiązania AI jako wsparcie swojej pracy i chce rozwijać ten sposób tworzenia oprogramowania.

Dlaczego warto?

W tej roli:

rozwijasz rozwiązania wykorzystywane przez międzynarodową organizację z sektora przemysłowego,
masz realny wpływ na kierunek rozwoju systemu oraz jakość dostarczanych rozwiązań,
pracujesz w środowisku, które ceni samodzielność, inicjatywę i odpowiedzialność zamiast szczegółowego zarządzania zadaniami,
współpracujesz bezpośrednio z doświadczonym zespołem oraz klientem,
wykorzystujesz nowoczesne narzędzia AI wspierające proces tworzenia oprogramowania,
masz możliwość okazjonalnych wyjazdów służbowych do Finlandii lub Norwegii.

W tej roli będziesz odpowiadać za:

rozwój oraz utrzymanie aplikacji opartych o Javę,
implementację nowych funkcjonalności oraz analizę i usuwanie błędów,
pracę z relacyjnymi bazami danych oraz warstwą dostępu do danych,
integrację aplikacji z pozostałymi komponentami środowiska klienta,
współpracę z zespołami technicznymi i biznesowymi,
dbanie o jakość kodu, wydajność oraz dobre praktyki inżynierskie,
proponowanie usprawnień oraz aktywny udział w rozwoju systemu,
wykorzystywanie narzędzi AI wspierających proces wytwarzania oprogramowania.

Jesteś naszym brakującym ogniwem, jeśli:

masz kilkuletnie doświadczenie komercyjne jako Senior Java Developer,
bardzo dobrze znasz Javę oraz środowisko WildFly,
posiadasz praktyczne doświadczenie z Hibernate, JPA lub innymi rozwiązaniami ORM,
pracowałeś/-aś z bazami danych Microsoft SQL Server oraz Oracle,
rozumiesz zagadnienia związane ze środowiskami kontenerowymi, maszynami wirtualnymi oraz infrastrukturą aplikacyjną,
lubisz przejmować odpowiedzialność za realizowane rozwiązania i doprowadzać zadania do końca,
dobrze odnajdujesz się zarówno przy rozwoju nowych funkcjonalności, jak i utrzymaniu istniejących systemów,
wykorzystujesz narzędzia AI jako wsparcie codziennej pracy programistycznej,
swobodnie komunikujesz się w języku angielskim.

Docenimy również doświadczenie w jednym lub kilku z poniższych obszarów:

integracja systemów z wykorzystaniem brokerów komunikatów, takich jak RabbitMQ,
rozwój i utrzymanie aplikacji działających w środowiskach produkcyjnych,
projektowanie lub rozwój systemów o rozproszonej architekturze,
współpraca z klientami z sektora przemysłowego lub produkcyjnego,
wykorzystanie narzędzi AI do automatyzacji i usprawniania procesu developmentu,
zainteresowanie tematyką spawalnictwa lub doświadczenie zdobyte w branży przemysłowej.

W Etteplan możesz liczyć na:

rozwój poprzez pracę w międzynarodowym środowisku i różnorodnych projektach oraz wymianę wiedzy w grupach kompetencyjnych,
budżet szkoleniowy i indywidualną ścieżkę rozwoju wspieraną przez regularne spotkania z managerem,
prywatną opiekę medyczną Medicover, kartę MultiSport, grupowe ubezpieczenie na życie oraz dofinansowanie do posiłków,
elastyczne godziny pracy i możliwość współpracy w modelu hybrydowym,
udział w inicjatywach technologicznych oraz społecznościach eksperckich,
możliwość okazjonalnych wyjazdów służbowych do krajów nordyckich.

Jak przebiega proces rekrutacyjny?

Aplikacja Prześlij nam swoje CV (najlepiej w języku angielskim). W formularzu poprosimy Cię również o informację o oczekiwaniach finansowych, preferowanej formie współpracy oraz dostępności.
Analiza aplikacji Przyjrzymy się Twojemu doświadczeniu i sprawdzimy, jak odpowiada ono potrzebom projektu.
Rozmowa z HR (online) Podczas około godzinnego spotkania porozmawiamy o Twoim doświadczeniu, motywacji oraz oczekiwaniach, a także opowiemy więcej o projekcie i sposobie pracy zespołu.
Rozmowa techniczna (online) Spotkasz się z przedstawicielami zespołu projektowego. Porozmawiamy o Twoich doświadczeniach z Javą, realizowanych projektach oraz podejściu do rozwiązywania problemów technicznych.
Decyzja i feedback Niezależnie od wyniku procesu wrócimy do Ciebie z informacją zwrotną.

Możesz też zajrzeć na naszą stronę internetową lub Facebooka i zobaczyć, co ciekawego się u nas dzieje!

Nasza firma wdrożyła procedury ochrony sygnalistów zgodnie z obowiązującą ustawą. Każda osoba ma prawo zgłaszać nieprawidłowości w bezpieczny sposób, a zgłoszenia są objęte pełną ochroną prawną. Więcej informacji: https://www.etteplan.com/pl/kodeks-postepowania/

jobs.description:
Company Description

Inetum Polska

The ideal candidate should be customer-focused, technically strong, detail-oriented, and capable of managing support issues from initial analysis through final resolution. We are looking for a highly skilled Technical Support Software Engineer with strong expertise in Azure AI, Cognitive Services, Machine Learning, and IoT. We are looking for a strong Backend Engineer or Full-Stack Engineer with deep backend expertise who can combine software engineering
excellence with a Forward Deployed Engineer
mindset.

This person will work closely with clients, architects, product teams, and business stakeholders to rapidly understand problems, design practical solutions, build prototypes, and deliver production-ready applications.

The ideal candidate is comfortable working in ambiguous environments, translating business needs into technical solutions, and using modern AI development tools to accelerate design, coding, testing, documentation, and delivery. A person who enjoys solving complex business problems rather than working with a predefined technology stack.

Required experience and skills:

Experience in consulting, client-facing engineering, solution engineering, or Forward Deployed Engineering.
Approximately 5+ years of professional software development experience.
Strong backend development experience using technologies such as Java, C#, Python, Node.js, TypeScript, or similar.
Experience designing REST APIs, event-driven services, integrations, and distributed systems.
Strong knowledge of relational and non-relational databases.
Experience with cloud platforms such as Azure, AWS, or Google Cloud.
Understanding of software architecture, security, scalability, performance, and maintainability.
Hands-on experience with Git, automated testing, CI/CD, containers, and modern development practices.
Ability to independently investigate unfamiliar systems and quickly become productive.
Strong problem-solving, communication, and stakeholder-management skills.
Ability to work directly with clients and operate effectively when requirements are incomplete or rapidly evolving.
Practical experience using AI coding tools such as GitHub Copilot, Cursor, Claude Code, ChatGPT, or similar.
Valid work permit

AI Engineering capabilities:

Understanding of LLM-based application architecture.
Experience with prompt engineering, structured outputs, tool calling, agents, and RAG patterns.
Ability to evaluate AI-generated code for correctness, security, performance, and maintainability.
Experience using AI tools to accelerate the complete software-development lifecycle.
Ability to move quickly from an idea or natural-language requirement to a working prototype without compromising production engineering standards.

Additional experience that will help you succeed:

Frontend experience with React, Angular, Vue, or similar frameworks.
Experience with Kubernetes, Docker, serverless platforms, or microservices.
Knowledge of enterprise platforms such as Salesforce, Microsoft, Creatio, or comparable systems.
Experience delivering AI agents, copilots, workflow automation, or intelligent enterprise applications.
Familiarity with observability, infrastructure as code, API management, and integration platforms.

Your future role

Design, develop, and maintain scalable backend services, APIs, integrations, and data-processing solutions.
Build full-stack applications when required, with primary ownership of backend architecture and implementation.
Work directly with clients and business stakeholders to understand challenges and translate them into working software.
Rapidly prototype, validate, and roll out new solutions.
Take end-to-end ownership, from requirements discovery and solution design to deployment and operational support.
Integrate enterprise platforms, cloud services, databases, APIs, and AI capabilities.
Use AI-assisted development tools for code generation, refactoring, testing, debugging, documentation, and rapid experimentation.
Apply rapid “vibe coding” techniques responsibly while maintaining security, maintainability, testing, and engineering quality.
Build AI-enabled applications using LLMs, agents, retrieval-augmented generation, tool calling, and structured data.
Establish reusable development patterns, accelerators, templates, and engineering standards.
Support CI/CD pipelines, automated testing, monitoring, observability, and production troubleshooting.
Collaborate with architects, DevOps engineers, data engineers, frontend developers, and client delivery teams.
Communicate technical decisions, trade-offs, risks, and recommendations clearly to both technical and non-technical audiences.

CV check and then HR screening

Technical interview
with our Architects
Meeting with Business
(optional, depends on case)

Then, last thing to do will be to sign a contract with us. Deloitte is simply your best choice.

Let us introduce you the job offer by EY GDS Poland – a member of the global integrated service delivery center network by EY.

Copilot Studio Developer
works within a technologically versatile team located in Poland, providing consulting services to biggest market players in EMEIA region and around the globe.

The opportunity

With a constant growth of our business and customers’ needs we are willing to move our projects on the new track. We are able to offer you a senior developer role with opportunity to support your further professional growth. You will work as part of a team that designs, develops, tests, deploys and supports different types of solutions using Power Platform, RPA and other modern technologies. You will work with the most recognizable and influential players on the financial markets within the challenging projects.

Skills And Attributes For Success

To qualify for the role, you must have

Proven track record integrating Power Platform solutions with enterprise systems via REST APIs, Azure Functions, or Logic Apps.

Ideally, you’ll also have

Experience in using Autogen or Microsoft Agent Framework
Experience with .Net framework.
Solid scripting or coding in JavaScript or C# for custom connectors and UI tweaks.
SQL Server or Azure SQL schema design and performance tuning.

EY Global Delivery Services (GDS) is a dynamic and truly global delivery network. jobs.description:
Company Description

⚡️ Why Altium?

Altium is transforming the way electronics are designed and built. From startups to world’s technology giants, our digital platforms give more power to PCB designers, supply chain, and manufacturing, letting them collaborate as never before.

Constant innovation has created a transformative technology, unique in its space
More than 30,000 companies and 100,000 electronics engineers worldwide use Altium
We are growing, debt-free, and financially strong, with the resources to become #1 in the EDA industry

Job Description

Role Overview:

Senior Site Reliability Engineer ensures the reliability, availability, and performance of large-scale software systems through a blend of software engineering and systems administration. Key responsibilities involve automating operational tasks, improving observability, and contributing to incident management, while also collaborating with development and technology teams to build more reliable and scalable applications. 

Join Altium as a Senior Site Reliability Engineer to ensure the reliability and performance of the Altium Cloud Platforms.

Key Responsibilities

Understanding how an Altium Cloud Platform works
Pioneer improvements in observability, including logging, monitoring, and application performance management (APM), ensuring system reliability and proactive issue detection.
Develop and implement reliability frameworks and patterns that standardize and elevate the resilience of our SaaS products across multiple regions and environments.
Cultivate a shared responsibility model where the SRE team collaborates with and educates engineering teams on reliability best practices.
Contribute to incident response and management, ensuring rapid resolution, clear stakeholder communication, and post-incident analysis for continuous improvement.
Participate in system design consulting, platform management, infrastructure upgrades and capacity planning.
Partner closely with engineering and development teams to enhance product stability, observability, and manageability through best practices in reliability engineering.
Partner closely with DevOps/Operations, drive automation initiatives, promote Infrastructure as Code (IaC), and streamline deployment processes to improve operational efficiency and scalability.
Champion Service-Oriented Organization (SOO) principles to ensure accountability and clarity in service ownership.

Qualifications

6+ years in SRE, DevOps or related role in a large-scale environment
Software development experience (ideally working with and as a .NET developer)
Strong understanding of SDLC, microservice and HA architecture
Observability - NewRelic, ELK, Grafana, PagerDuty, OTEL or similar
Experience with Kubernetes clusters in production setting, AWS, IOC
Experience with operational tasks
Knowledge of CI-CD tooling Jenkins, Gitlab, GitHub, ArgoCD or similar
Knowledge of IaaC Terraform, Ansible
Basic knowledge of networking fundamentals
Experience with relational databases (mysql, postgres) as a plus

Additional Information

Altium Limited, a part of the Renesas Group and headquartered in San Diego, California, is a global software company accelerating the pace of electronics innovation. We are redefining electronic product creation in a software-defined world with our industry-first cloud-based platform that unites every stakeholder and phase of electronics development.

From startups to world’s technology giants, our digital platforms give more power to PCB designers, supply chain, and manufacturing, letting them collaborate as never before. At Altium, our teams are empowered to innovate, collaborate globally, and help create the future of electronics development.

We believe in rewarding our employees with a competitive benefits package alongside their salary. More information will be provided during the hiring process.

jobs.description:
Project Description:

You will join a long-term, enterprise-scale project for a global client in the investment banking domain. The project focuses on building and evolving a set of mission-critical backend services that support complex business workflows, regulatory processes, and system integrations across the bank’s ecosystem.

The platform is based on a distributed microservices architecture, leveraging Spring Boot, event-driven communication, and BPM-driven process orchestration. The system operates in a cloud-enabled, containerized environment, with a strong emphasis on security, scalability, resiliency, and maintainability.

You will work closely with architects, QA engineers, DevOps, and business stakeholders in an agile setup, contributing not only code but also technical direction, best practices, and mentoring.

Responsibilities:

• Design, develop, and maintain enterprise-grade backend services using Java 11+ and Spring Boot
• Contribute to the design and evolution of distributed microservices architectures
• Implement and integrate REST and SOAP APIs and event-driven solutions using Kafka
• Develop and maintain business process workflows using a BPM engine (preferably Flowable)
• Ensure high standards of code quality by applying SOLID principles, Clean Code, and design patterns
• Write and maintain comprehensive unit and integration tests using JUnit, TestNG, Mockito, and WireMock
• Work with relational and document databases such as PostgreSQL, MongoDB, and Azure Cosmos DB
• Implement security and authentication mechanisms using OAuth2, JWT, and Spring Security
• Collaborate with DevOps teams on containerization and deployment using Docker and Kubernetes
• Participate actively in agile ceremonies (refinement, planning, reviews, retrospectives)

- Solid experience in JVM programming languages (ideally Java11+) and design patterns
- Frameworks: Spring Boot
- Proven track record of enterprise level application development for 7+ years
- Understanding of distributed microservices architectures and communication patterns
- Experience with relational and document databases (PostgresSQL, MongoDB, Azure Cosmos)
- Testing Frameworks (JUnit, TestNG, Mockito, WireMock)
- Messaging & Integration (Kafka, REST, SOAP)
- Security & Authentication (OAuth2, JWT, Spring Security)

- Experience with Agile mode of working

jobs.title: Senior Java Developer – Smart Manufacturing (M/F/NB)
jobs.description:
Dołącz do Etteplan

W Etteplan wierzymy, że technologia ma sens tylko wtedy, gdy pomaga rozwiązywać realne problemy biznesowe. Tworzymy i rozwijamy rozwiązania software'owe dla klientów z różnych gałęzi przemysłu, łącząc kompetencje z obszaru software, inżynierii i digitalizacji.

Obecnie poszukujemy Senior Java Developera
, który dołączy do projektu realizowanego dla międzynarodowego klienta z sektora przemysłowego i będzie współtworzył rozwiązania wykorzystywane w codziennej działalności organizacji działających na rynkach międzynarodowych.

O projekcie

Dołączysz do zespołu rozwijającego platformę wspierającą procesy produkcyjne oraz zarządzanie dokumentacją i jakością w środowisku przemysłowym. Rozwiązanie wykorzystywane jest przez międzynarodowe organizacje i odgrywa istotną rolę w ich codziennej działalności operacyjnej.

Projekt obejmuje zarówno rozwój nowych funkcjonalności, jak i utrzymanie oraz stopniową modernizację istniejących rozwiązań. Nie jest to wyłącznie development ani wyłącznie maintenance - zależy nam na osobach, które potrafią spojrzeć na system całościowo, proponować usprawnienia i brać odpowiedzialność za jakość dostarczanych rozwiązań.

Na co dzień będziesz współpracować z międzynarodowym zespołem oraz ekspertami biznesowymi i technicznymi po stronie klienta.

Jak wykorzystujemy AI?

W tym projekcie narzędzia AI są naturalnym elementem codziennej pracy zespołu. Wspierają analizę kodu, implementację nowych funkcjonalności, automatyzację powtarzalnych zadań oraz zwiększanie efektywności procesu wytwarzania oprogramowania.

Szukamy osoby, która świadomie wykorzystuje rozwiązania AI jako wsparcie swojej pracy i chce rozwijać ten sposób tworzenia oprogramowania.

Dlaczego warto?

W tej roli:

rozwijasz rozwiązania wykorzystywane przez międzynarodową organizację z sektora przemysłowego,
masz realny wpływ na kierunek rozwoju systemu oraz jakość dostarczanych rozwiązań,
pracujesz w środowisku, które ceni samodzielność, inicjatywę i odpowiedzialność zamiast szczegółowego zarządzania zadaniami,
współpracujesz bezpośrednio z doświadczonym zespołem oraz klientem,
wykorzystujesz nowoczesne narzędzia AI wspierające proces tworzenia oprogramowania,
masz możliwość okazjonalnych wyjazdów służbowych do Finlandii lub Norwegii.

W tej roli będziesz odpowiadać za:

rozwój oraz utrzymanie aplikacji opartych o Javę,
implementację nowych funkcjonalności oraz analizę i usuwanie błędów,
pracę z relacyjnymi bazami danych oraz warstwą dostępu do danych,
integrację aplikacji z pozostałymi komponentami środowiska klienta,
współpracę z zespołami technicznymi i biznesowymi,
dbanie o jakość kodu, wydajność oraz dobre praktyki inżynierskie,
proponowanie usprawnień oraz aktywny udział w rozwoju systemu,
wykorzystywanie narzędzi AI wspierających proces wytwarzania oprogramowania.

Jesteś naszym brakującym ogniwem, jeśli:

masz kilkuletnie doświadczenie komercyjne jako Senior Java Developer,
bardzo dobrze znasz Javę oraz środowisko WildFly,
posiadasz praktyczne doświadczenie z Hibernate, JPA lub innymi rozwiązaniami ORM,
pracowałeś/-aś z bazami danych Microsoft SQL Server oraz Oracle,
rozumiesz zagadnienia związane ze środowiskami kontenerowymi, maszynami wirtualnymi oraz infrastrukturą aplikacyjną,
lubisz przejmować odpowiedzialność za realizowane rozwiązania i doprowadzać zadania do końca,
dobrze odnajdujesz się zarówno przy rozwoju nowych funkcjonalności, jak i utrzymaniu istniejących systemów,
wykorzystujesz narzędzia AI jako wsparcie codziennej pracy programistycznej,
swobodnie komunikujesz się w języku angielskim.

Docenimy również doświadczenie w jednym lub kilku z poniższych obszarów:

integracja systemów z wykorzystaniem brokerów komunikatów, takich jak RabbitMQ,
rozwój i utrzymanie aplikacji działających w środowiskach produkcyjnych,
projektowanie lub rozwój systemów o rozproszonej architekturze,
współpraca z klientami z sektora przemysłowego lub produkcyjnego,
wykorzystanie narzędzi AI do automatyzacji i usprawniania procesu developmentu,
zainteresowanie tematyką spawalnictwa lub doświadczenie zdobyte w branży przemysłowej.

W Etteplan możesz liczyć na:

rozwój poprzez pracę w międzynarodowym środowisku i różnorodnych projektach oraz wymianę wiedzy w grupach kompetencyjnych,
budżet szkoleniowy i indywidualną ścieżkę rozwoju wspieraną przez regularne spotkania z managerem,
prywatną opiekę medyczną Medicover, kartę MultiSport, grupowe ubezpieczenie na życie oraz dofinansowanie do posiłków,
elastyczne godziny pracy i możliwość współpracy w modelu hybrydowym,
udział w inicjatywach technologicznych oraz społecznościach eksperckich,
możliwość okazjonalnych wyjazdów służbowych do krajów nordyckich.

Jak przebiega proces rekrutacyjny?

Aplikacja Prześlij nam swoje CV (najlepiej w języku angielskim). W formularzu poprosimy Cię również o informację o oczekiwaniach finansowych, preferowanej formie współpracy oraz dostępności.
Analiza aplikacji Przyjrzymy się Twojemu doświadczeniu i sprawdzimy, jak odpowiada ono potrzebom projektu.
Rozmowa z HR (online) Podczas około godzinnego spotkania porozmawiamy o Twoim doświadczeniu, motywacji oraz oczekiwaniach, a także opowiemy więcej o projekcie i sposobie pracy zespołu.
Rozmowa techniczna (online) Spotkasz się z przedstawicielami zespołu projektowego. Porozmawiamy o Twoich doświadczeniach z Javą, realizowanych projektach oraz podejściu do rozwiązywania problemów technicznych.
Decyzja i feedback Niezależnie od wyniku procesu wrócimy do Ciebie z informacją zwrotną.

Możesz też zajrzeć na naszą stronę internetową lub Facebooka i zobaczyć, co ciekawego się u nas dzieje!

Nasza firma wdrożyła procedury ochrony sygnalistów zgodnie z obowiązującą ustawą. Każda osoba ma prawo zgłaszać nieprawidłowości w bezpieczny sposób, a zgłoszenia są objęte pełną ochroną prawną. Więcej informacji: https://www.etteplan.com/pl/kodeks-postepowania/

W tym projekcie narzędzia AI są naturalnym elementem codziennej pracy zespołu. Wspierają analizę kodu, implementację nowych funkcjonalności, automatyzację powtarzalnych zadań oraz zwiększanie efektywności procesu wytwarzania oprogramowania.

Szukamy osoby, która świadomie wykorzystuje rozwiązania AI jako wsparcie swojej pracy i chce rozwijać ten sposób tworzenia oprogramowania.

Dlaczego warto?

W tej roli:

rozwijasz rozwiązania wykorzystywane przez międzynarodową organizację z sektora przemysłowego,
masz realny wpływ na kierunek rozwoju systemu oraz jakość dostarczanych rozwiązań,
pracujesz w środowisku, które ceni samodzielność, inicjatywę i odpowiedzialność zamiast szczegółowego zarządzania zadaniami,
współpracujesz bezpośrednio z doświadczonym zespołem oraz klientem,
wykorzystujesz nowoczesne narzędzia AI wspierające proces tworzenia oprogramowania,
masz możliwość okazjonalnych wyjazdów służbowych do Finlandii lub Norwegii.

W tej roli będziesz odpowiadać za:

rozwój oraz utrzymanie aplikacji opartych o Javę,
implementację nowych funkcjonalności oraz analizę i usuwanie błędów,
pracę z relacyjnymi bazami danych oraz warstwą dostępu do danych,
integrację aplikacji z pozostałymi komponentami środowiska klienta,
współpracę z zespołami technicznymi i biznesowymi,
dbanie o jakość kodu, wydajność oraz dobre praktyki inżynierskie,
proponowanie usprawnień oraz aktywny udział w rozwoju systemu,
wykorzystywanie narzędzi AI wspierających proces wytwarzania oprogramowania.

Jesteś naszym brakującym ogniwem, jeśli:

masz kilkuletnie doświadczenie komercyjne jako Senior Java Developer,
bardzo dobrze znasz Javę oraz środowisko WildFly,
posiadasz praktyczne doświadczenie z Hibernate, JPA lub innymi rozwiązaniami ORM,
pracowałeś/-aś z bazami danych Microsoft SQL Server oraz Oracle,
rozumiesz zagadnienia związane ze środowiskami kontenerowymi, maszynami wirtualnymi oraz infrastrukturą aplikacyjną,
lubisz przejmować odpowiedzialność za realizowane rozwiązania i doprowadzać zadania do końca,
dobrze odnajdujesz się zarówno przy rozwoju nowych funkcjonalności, jak i utrzymaniu istniejących systemów,
wykorzystujesz narzędzia AI jako wsparcie codziennej pracy programistycznej,
swobodnie komunikujesz się w języku angielskim.

Docenimy również doświadczenie w jednym lub kilku z poniższych obszarów:

integracja systemów z wykorzystaniem brokerów komunikatów, takich jak RabbitMQ,
rozwój i utrzymanie aplikacji działających w środowiskach produkcyjnych,
projektowanie lub rozwój systemów o rozproszonej architekturze,
współpraca z klientami z sektora przemysłowego lub produkcyjnego,
wykorzystanie narzędzi AI do automatyzacji i usprawniania procesu developmentu,
zainteresowanie tematyką spawalnictwa lub doświadczenie zdobyte w branży przemysłowej.

W Etteplan możesz liczyć na:

rozwój poprzez pracę w międzynarodowym środowisku i różnorodnych projektach oraz wymianę wiedzy w grupach kompetencyjnych,
budżet szkoleniowy i indywidualną ścieżkę rozwoju wspieraną przez regularne spotkania z managerem,
prywatną opiekę medyczną Medicover, kartę MultiSport, grupowe ubezpieczenie na życie oraz dofinansowanie do posiłków,
elastyczne godziny pracy i możliwość współpracy w modelu hybrydowym,
udział w inicjatywach technologicznych oraz społecznościach eksperckich,
możliwość okazjonalnych wyjazdów służbowych do krajów nordyckich.

Jak przebiega proces rekrutacyjny?

Aplikacja Prześlij nam swoje CV (najlepiej w języku angielskim). W formularzu poprosimy Cię również o informację o oczekiwaniach finansowych, preferowanej formie współpracy oraz dostępności.

jobs.title: Developer .Net within Payments & Reporting | SEB, Solna
jobs.description:
SEB is more than a bank. We are a technology-driven financial institution where everything starts from our customer needs and business outcomes. AI, data and modern engineering are natural parts of how we work, build and deliver value. From core banking platforms to agentic AI , automation, cybersecurity and cloud, we offer a broad tech landscape and many paths to grow. Together, we are shaping secure, responsible and future- proof solutions for our customers and society. Are you ready to take on a new challenge?

About the role:

Accounts & Payments is undergoing a major transformation from a business and market as well as from an architectural perspective. As a .NET Developer within Payments & Reporting, you will play a key role in SEB’s digital transformation journey, helping to shape the future of the bank. You will be part of an agile international team of highly motivated and creative colleagues that work in close collaboration with our product owners and business specialists. Cross collaboration and interaction with other teams within Technology with focus on our delivery is also part of the work. The team’s main responsibility is to develop and maintain systems for the Payments domain.

Our technical landscape is based on a modern microservices architecture, with responsive web applications developed using contemporary engineering practices. Our stack includes C#, .NET, MSSQL, Kafka, Angular and JavaScript/TypeScript. We use Docker, Kubernetes, and OpenShift for containerization. For version control we use GitHub and GitHub Actions for CI/CD.  Most of our containers use Linux so some basic Linux skills are required. Since our applications run 24/7, on-call is part of the job.

To thrive in the role, we believe you have:

5+ years programming experience with C#
Experience working with front end technologies Angular/React (willing to up-skill in Angular if needed)
Experience in using AI-tools and you want to use AI-tools for most of the development tasks.
Experience in developing microservices and Single Page Applications.  
Experience in developing and executing API- and integration tests based on software requirements. Using tools such as ReadyAPI, Protractor, Selenium and Web-based UI tests.
A passion for development including test automation with a creative and curious mindset for new technologies, platforms, and tools. You often have taken the initiative to implement new technologies and/or tools for test automation.
A strong sense of responsibility and a collaborative, team-oriented mindset, with a deep appreciation for teamwork and agile methodologies. You have actively been improving collaboration with other teams.
A focus on delivering high-quality service to internal counterparties and stakeholders
A university-level education in a field related to Information Technology, Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a closely related subject 
A very positive, problem solving and helpful person

It would be considered an advantage, if you have:

Experience deploying and hosting applications in GCP
Have some experience around performance tuning and security compliance
Experience from financial industry in general and the payments sector in particular

What we offer:

Entrepreneurial Scandinavian environment: work-life balance, international working environment, hybrid work model, empowering and welcoming culture
Growth culture: extensive training and learning opportunities, local and international internal mobility possibilities, long-term stability
Modern environment: innovative company in forefront of technology, challenging, cutting-edge work, excellent office environment, agile and modern ways of working
Additional monetary benefits: paid seniority vacation and volunteering days, allocations to Your pension fund, profit sharing program, and additional health insurance

Do you want to be part of SEB?

It is our fundamental belief that inclusion and diversity is crucial for our future success. We strive to have an inclusive, value-driven culture where employees feel valued, respected, and involved irrespective of who they are, what they believe or where they come from.

We encourage you to submit your application no later than 2026-10-01 via the link in this advertisement. If you have any questions about the position, please contact Hiring Manager Johan Gasslander at johan.gasslander@seb.se. Kindly note that we do not accept applications via email.

Please be aware that our final candidates undergo background checks, a process that includes for example identity control, verification of qualifications, credit checks, company engagements and history of crime. In some cases, we also apply random drug checks. During employment, employees within SEB can also expect to undergo recurring background checks.

SEB Sweden has a redeployment responsibility, which means that this position might be covered by internal redeployment.
