jobs.title: .NET-utvecklare
jobs.description:
.NET-utvecklare till Story House Egmont i Malmö/Köpenhamn

Vill du vidareutveckla system som våra läsare litar på — hos en arbetsgivare som ger tillbaka till samhället.

Om Story House Egmont

Story House Egmont är ett av Skandinaviens ledande medieföretag. Vi skapar engagerande berättelser och innovativa produkter för både tryckta och digitala plattformar. Vår satsning på e-handel och digital marknadsföring växer snabbt tillsammans med vår stabila medieverksamhet.
Bland våra varumärken inom Publishing finner du Hemmets Journal, ICA kuriren, Svensk Golf, Hus&Hem, King/Cafee, Kalle Anka & Co, Bamse och Fantomen, för att nämna några, och för att möta våra engagerade läsares förväntningar, bygger vi nu om många av våra tekniska plattformar, där vi går mot en modern, molnbaserad miljö, med hjälp av agentbaserad utveckling.

Din roll hos oss

Som .NET-utvecklare blir du en nyckelspelare i teamet som utvecklar och underhåller våra prenumerationstjänster. Vi driver redan idag det mesta i en cloud native-miljö på Docker/K8s. Databaslagret är en mix av SQL Server och PostgreSQL. Du får vara med och forma både arkitektur och arbetssätt — och du blir en del av ett team där agentbaserad utveckling redan är vardag och din roll handlar om att sätta riktning, granska och orkestrera snarare än att skriva varje rad själv. Här finns utrymme att påverka både hur vi jobbar och vad vi bygger.
Rollen är hands-on utveckling. Du rapporterar till Head of Subscription Systems och ingår i ett team på 9 personer — utvecklare och applikationsspecialister. Du har direktkontakt med användare och kommunicerar dagligen med dina teamkamrater som sitter utspridda på våra kontor i Malmö och Köpenhamn.

Dina arbetsuppgifter

•Vidareutveckla och modernisera våra applikationer i senaste versioner av .NET, K8s, REST och microservices — bland annat supportsystem för e-handel, betalsystem, masterdata, marknadsföring, printplanering, kundservicesystem och prenumerationsmotor.
•Arbeta agentbaserat i ditt dagliga arbete — orkestrera och granska kod skriven av AI-agenter, med verktyg som Claude, Codex eller liknande.
•Ta tekniskt ägarskap för specifika produkter och vara med och påverka arkitektur och tekniska beslut.
•Driva förändringsarbete och bidra till en modern utvecklingskultur.
•Arbeta nära verksamheten, inklusive sälj- och marknadsavdelningen, för att förstå deras behov och utforma lösningar som passar dem.

Din profil

Vi söker dig som är en engagerad .NET-utvecklare med en stark teknisk grund och med en nyfikenhet på hur AI förändrar sättet vi utvecklar mjukvara på. Du trivs i en dynamisk miljö, är inte rädd för att ta ansvar, och är en lagspelare med god kommunikationsförmåga.

Kvalifikationer

•Relevant utbildning inom systemutveckling eller motsvarande erfarenhet.
•Minst 3 års erfarenhet av systemutveckling med .NET och C#.
•Erfarenhet av att arbeta med relationsdatabaser, till exempel SQL Server och/eller PostgreSQL.
•Erfarenhet av moderna utvecklingsprinciper, automatiserad bygg/deploy (GitHub Actions) och unit-testning.
•Nyfikenhet på och gärna praktisk erfarenhet av agentbaserad utveckling (t.ex. Claude, Codex eller liknande verktyg).
•Du talar och skriver obehindrat på ett skandinaviskt språk (svenska, norska eller danska), samt har goda kunskaper i engelska, eftersom du kommer arbeta mot flera europeiska marknader.
•Meriterande: Docker/K8s, REST, Git/GitHub, Azure, Jira/Confluence.

Vi erbjuder dig …

•en spännande roll med en stor utvecklingspotential i ett modernt mediehus.
•agentbaserad utveckling — din roll är att orkestrera, granska och sätta riktning, och du får forma hur vi bygger våra interna verktyg för det.
•cloud native miljö på Azure och K8s, .NET.
•en roll där du kan forma både arkitektur och arbetssätt.
•ett modernt och flexibelt kontor i centrala Malmö eller på Österbro i Köpenhamn

Livet hos Story House Egmont — en del av något större

Vi som jobbar inom Story House Egmont står för kreativitet, långsiktighet och öppenhet. Vi jobbar i team och hjälper och stöttar varandra för att tillsammans utveckla de bästa berättelserna och produkterna. Vi välkomnar kompetenta, drivna och nyfikna människor.

Som medarbetare i en av Sveriges ledande medieverksamheter är du också en del av något större. Egmont är en internationell och expansiv mediekoncern fylld av passionerade och kompetenta människor med olika bakgrunder, kunskaper och erfarenheter.

Egmont är en helägd stiftelse som verkar utifrån ett dubbelt syfte: att utveckla verksamheten och att stötta utsatta barn och unga. Som anställd i Egmont är du med och ger tillbaka till samhället och skapar förutsättningar för ett bra liv för nästa generation.

Om du har frågor kring tjänsten så är du välkommen att kontakta: Head of Subscription Systems, Johan Friberg, johan.friberg@egmont.se .

Adress till arbetsplatsen:
Studentgatan 4
Malmö, 211 38
Sweden

Sista ansökningsdag är 04/10/2026, men vi intervjuar löpande. Vänligen använd ”Apply Now” knappen för att ansöka till tjänsten. Vi tar ej emot ansökningar vi e-mail.

About Story House Egmont
Story House Egmont är ett av Nordens ledande och mest traditionsrika medieföretag. Vi är passionerade historieberättare och står bakom några av landets populäraste varumärken. Inom våra tre huvudområden – Media, E-commerce och Agencies – utvecklar vi engagerande innehåll, högkvalitativa produkter, innovativa tjänster och personliga mötesplatser. Vår ägare är den nordiska mediekoncernen Egmont tillsammans med Nordisk Film, TV 2 i Norge och det danska bokförlaget Lindhardt og Ringhof. Egmont är en stiftelse som varje år delar ut en stor del av sitt överskott för att stötta utsatta barn och ungdomar.
We bring stories to life.

jobs.title: Senior Software Developer
jobs.description:
The opportunity

Polestar is accelerating the transition to sustainable mobility through electric performance. Behind that journey sits a powerful digital platform enabling everything from checkout and payments to order management, delivery, retail tools, and customer self‑service.

At Polestar Digital, we build innovative, scalable solutions that power our global platform. You will join a focused team working across a critical part of the customer journey, delivering systems that customers globally and hundreds of internal users depend on every day. With real ownership, close collaboration, and global impact, you will play a key role in shaping the future of Polestar’s digital ecosystem.

We are now looking for a Senior Software Developer to join our headquarters in Gothenburg, Sweden.

Let us describe the challenge we offer

As a Senior Software Developer, you will be part of a cross‑functional agile team responsible for designing and building high‑performance, scalable solutions that support Polestar’s global digital platform.

You will take ownership of system architecture and technical decision‑making while working closely with Product Managers, Designers, and Operations teams to deliver reliable and impactful solutions. The role combines hands‑on development, system design, and collaboration, while also contributing to a strong engineering culture through mentoring and knowledge‑sharing.

You will write clean, well‑tested code and contribute to building systems that are robust, scalable, and maintainable. At the same time, you will stay up to date with modern development practices and emerging technologies, including evolving paradigms such as agentic AI.

What you'll do

You will design, build, and evolve scalable digital solutions that power Polestar’s global platform.

Your Responsibilities Include

Designing and implementing high‑performance, globally scalable systems
Taking ownership of system architecture and contributing to technical decision‑making
Writing clean, maintainable code supported by unit, integration, and automated tests
Collaborating closely with Product Managers, Designers, and Operations teams to deliver business value
Mentoring team members and contributing to a culture of knowledge‑sharing
Ensuring solutions follow modern engineering practices across quality, performance, and maintainability

jobs.title: System Developer - Portfolio Investments Applications
jobs.description:
Myntro is a company in the middle of a transformation, shifting toward a more product- and technology-driven, data-enabled business. We are looking for a System Developer who wants to join that journey and help build our future. Are you a curious builder who enjoys creating new systems, navigating complexity, and using modern technology to solve real business problems? Then keep reading!

About The Role

As a System Developer at Myntro, you'll join a small DevOps team with end-to-end ownership of applications and systems at the heart of our debt portfolio investment business. Working closely with our investment team, you'll help turn complex portfolio data into reliable systems that support valuation, purchasing decisions, and portfolio management.

Our current focus is building a new investment platform and the services around it. You'll have real opportunities to design and build new capabilities, while also improving and maintaining the existing systems that keep the business running. You'll contribute across the development lifecycle and help shape technical decisions with both immediate and long-term impact.

In this role, you will:

Design, build, and maintain systems, services, and integrations for our debt portfolio investment business.
Develop a new investment platform that supports portfolio valuation, purchasing, and management.
Take ownership from design and implementation through deployment, operation, and continuous improvement.
Build with C#/.NET, SQL, Azure services, and microservice and event-driven architectures.
Improve and simplify existing applications and data flows in a complex technical landscape.
Contribute to architecture, Azure infrastructure, code quality, testing, observability, and how we build.

Who You Are

We are looking for someone who is curious, self-driven, and likes real engineering work. You enjoy understanding both the business problem and how systems actually behave, finding weak points, and making them better. You're comfortable exploring unfamiliar areas and learning what you need to move the work forward.

You take ownership, care about quality, and like building things that hold up in production. You're pragmatic and collaborative, but you don't wait for someone else to define every step. You can move between new development, architecture, infrastructure, data, and existing applications based on what the problem requires.

AI-assisted development isn't new to you; it's already part of how you work. You have your own setup, your own opinions, and you're paying attention to where the craft is heading. That matters here. We're actively building AI into both how we develop and what we deliver, and we need people who are already leaning in, not catching up.

We see that you likely have:

A degree in Computer Science, or equivalent practical experience.
3+ years of software development experience, ideally in production-critical environments.
Strong .NET/C# development skills.
Solid understanding of SQL, data modelling, and data flows.
Hands-on experience with Azure, cloud infrastructure, and microservice architectures.
Good communication skills in Swedish and English.

Experience in investment systems, finance, or debt portfolios is not required. What matters is that you're interested in learning the business context and applying your engineering skills to it.

Why join Myntro?

At Myntro, you'll work in a small team with broad ownership and close access to the people who use what you build. The new investment platform is important to how we value, purchase, and manage debt portfolios, and there is still plenty to design, build, and shape.

This is a good place if you are looking for variety, responsibility, and the opportunity to combine software development with architecture, cloud infrastructure, data, and real business problems. You'll be part of a team that's expected to think, build, operate, and improve together.

Our culture is built on care, accountability, and the belief that the best results come from working together. Collaboration, customer focus, personal accountability, and simplicity are how we actually make decisions, not just words on a wall.

Interested? Welcome to apply!

Sounds like your next challenge? We review applications and interview on a rolling basis, so don't wait too long to apply. The role is full-time and based at our head office in central Gothenburg.

For questions regarding the role or recruitment process, please contact Azra Semic, our Talent Acquisition Specialist – azra.semic@myntro.com.

We look forward to receiving your application!

Onsite Messaging (OSM) is one of Voyado’s most important customer engagement channels. Instead of communicating through email or SMS, OSM enables retailers to engage customers directly on their websites with personalized experiences based on real-time behavior. Every interaction can be measured, understood and optimized, making OSM a key part of creating seamless customer journeys.

We’re now bringing OSM onto Voyado’s Engage platform, and this role will play a central part in making that happen. You’ll join at the beginning of that journey, helping shape both the technical direction and the engineering practices while building a brand-new team in Stockholm together with colleagues in India.

You'll act as the technical driver for Onsite Messaging. The frontend is moving into Voyado's Engage platform, while the backend continues to run and evolve on AWS — so you'll own both sides of that seam and make sure it holds together well. The transition is one chapter, not the job description. Although the role comes with significant technical ownership, it remains deeply hands-on. You’ll write code, review code, challenge architectural decisions and help the team make sound engineering choices every day.

Initially, much of the focus will be understanding the existing solution, reviewing code and working closely with our engineering team in India as knowledge and ownership gradually move to Stockholm. As the transition progresses, your focus will shift towards driving the technical roadmap, enabling new product development and shaping the future Onsite platform.

Onsite Messaging also sits on a shared JavaScript foundation that several Voyado products load on retailer sites. Getting that foundation into good shape — as a platform other teams can build on — is part of this role.

Who you are

We're looking for someone operating at around 8-10 years of engineering experience, who has been the person other engineers turn to on hard system design questions.

You don’t need experience from our exact technology stack, but we believe you’ve worked with several of the following:

Modern backend development in C#, .NET (out tech stack), or Comfortable moving between languages; Java, Kotlin, Go or similar
JavaScript and TypeScript, with experience working across both frontend and backend when needed
AWS, and serverless architecture in particular — our backend runs on that. Experience with Azure or GCP equivalents is fine if you're happy to work in AWS
Distributed systems, scalable web applications and high-traffic products
System design, software architecture and large technical migrations
CI/CD, observability, automated testing and engineering best practices

have successfully led complex technical initiatives or migration projects
enjoy reviewing code and helping other engineers grow
communicate confidently across teams, cultures and technical disciplines
thrive in environments where not everything has been defined yet
enjoy collaborating with distributed engineering teams
use AI coding tools as a natural part of software development and know how to review and quality-assure AI-generated code

High Impact. Great People. Real Growth.

30 days of vacation

Personal development opportunities
Summits and team activities
Four days from the office and one day from home

At Framna, we’re looking for a Senior Cloud & Backend Engineer who knows their way around .NET and Azure, and who likes thinking beyond the code itself. Someone who can zoom in on a tricky backend problem, zoom out to consider the architecture and infrastructure around it, and build solutions made to last.

Become part of the team

Framna partners with some of the world’s most ambitious brands, like Swish, SJ, Essity, and SEB, to create digital products that define markets and deliver real-world impact. We are more than 600 people across ten studios, building apps and digital products used by millions every day.

As our next Senior Cloud & Backend Engineer you’ll join our team in Östersund
, working alongside developers, designers, QA engineers, analysts, and product leads to take ideas from first sketch to live product.

You’ll also become part of Framna’s wider engineering and cloud community across our studios — sharing knowledge, discussing architecture, trying new approaches, and figuring out better ways to build together.

And while we collaborate across locations, Östersund is where you’ll call home. We’re looking for someone who genuinely enjoys being around their colleagues and wants the office to be a natural part of their working week.

What you’ll do

This is a senior role for someone who enjoys owning the bigger technical picture. You’ll work across backend development, cloud infrastructure, architecture, and operations, with a particular focus on .NET and Microsoft Azure
. More specifically, you will:

Design, develop, and maintain backend solutions primarily using .NET and Azure
.
Build and operate cloud infrastructure and applications with reliability, scalability, and performance in mind.
Make architectural and technical decisions that help our products stay maintainable as they grow.
Work with security, databases, networking, and cloud services to create stable and robust systems.
Collaborate closely with developers, product teams, and partners to turn both technical and business needs into great solutions.
Share your experience with the people around you, whether that means mentoring another developer, leading a technical discussion, or simply helping the team solve a particularly stubborn problem.

Who you are

We imagine you’ve spent around 6–7 years or more working professionally with backend and cloud development
, and that .NET and Azure have been a significant part of that journey
.
But years alone don’t make someone senior. We’re looking for someone who has developed the judgement that comes with experience. You know when to dig deeper, when to keep things simple, and how the decisions you make today will affect a product two years from now. You might recognise yourself if you:

Have strong professional experience with .NET and Microsoft Azure

Have worked with cloud architecture and understand the infrastructure surrounding the applications you build
Are comfortable thinking about the full lifecycle of a system, from development and deployment to monitoring and operations
Take pride in quality and don’t like solving today’s problem by creating tomorrow’s
Enjoy technical variety and are happy learning new tools or technologies when the problem calls for it
Like collaborating and sharing knowledge rather than disappearing into your own corner with a ticket
Feel comfortable taking technical ownership and helping less experienced developers grow
Enjoy working from the office and being part of the everyday life of a team

What you get

For us, it’s office first.
Our Östersund studio makes that pretty easy. With views over Storsjön, plenty of space to work together, and even a dedicated room for four-legged colleagues, it’s an office with a personality of its own. We spend time together because we believe it creates stronger teams, better collaboration, and ultimately better products.

A culture of curiosity.
On Fridays we have weekly demos, Wednesdays mean lunch-and-learns, and sometimes we throw ourselves into conceptathons just to see what happens. We gather for company conferences to share ideas, and we make room for learning when there’s something new we want to explore.

jobs.title: Customer Support Engineer
jobs.description:
Description

Customer Support Engineer – Hybrid – Gothenburg, Sweden

We seek a Customer Support Engineer to join our team at Microdeb in Gothenburg, Sweden!

About The Role

We're looking for a Support Engineer to join our team in Gothenburg. This is not a ticket-shuffling role. You'll be the person customers rely on when something breaks, when a query won't return, when a deployment misbehaves — and you'll have the technical depth to actually fix it, not just escalate it. You'll work across SQL databases, light development tasks, and customer-facing troubleshooting, with modern AI tools as a core part of how you work.

What You'll Do

Own customer issues end-to-end, from first contact through root cause and resolution.

Answer and handle incoming customer support calls as part of the day-to-day role, providing first-line technical assistance, troubleshooting issues, and taking ownership of follow-up through to resolution.

Diagnose and resolve database problems: query performance, indexing, locking, data integrity, backup and recovery.

Write and review SQL — from quick investigative queries to stored procedures and schema changes.

Read, debug, and occasionally patch application code to identify the source of issues.

Reproduce bugs in test environments, file detailed reports for engineering, and follow through. Build internal tools, scripts, and automations that reduce repeat work and speed up diagnosis.

Use AI tools (Claude, Copilot, internal LLM workflows) to accelerate investigation, draft responses, generate queries, and analyze logs.

Improve documentation and runbooks so the next person resolves the same issue faster.

What We're Looking For

Solid hands-on experience as a DBA or in a database-heavy support or engineering role. Strong SQL skills — you can write complex queries, read execution plans, and tune performance without reaching for a tutorial. Working knowledge of at least one general-purpose language (Python, C#, Java, JavaScript, or similar) — enough to read a codebase, debug, and write small fixes or tools. Fluency with AI-assisted workflows: you already use LLMs daily for coding, investigation, and writing, and you have opinions about where they help and where they don't. A bias for action: you'd rather dig in and reproduce the issue than wait for more information. Clear written and verbal communication in Swedish and English — you can explain a technical problem to a non-technical customer and to a senior engineer in the same day. Based in or willing to relocate to Gothenburg.

Nice to have

Experience with cloud databases (Azure SQL, AWS RDS, Snowflake, or similar). Familiarity with observability tools (Datadog, Grafana, OpenTelemetry). Exposure to CI/CD and infrastructure-as-code. Swedish language skills are a must for this role.

Why this role

You'll see more of the product, the codebase, and real customer problems than almost any other role. Support engineers here move into platform, backend, or SRE roles when they want to. We invest in AI tooling and expect everyone to use it well — not as a gimmick, but as leverage.

Here is a little window into our company:
Microdeb is a leading provider of integrated payment and order management solutions, helping businesses modernize their payment ecosystems. With years of experience, a dedicated team of experts, and a passion for technology, we continuously innovate to meet the evolving needs of our clients. Microdeb was acquired by Valsoft and now operates under the Aspire Software portfolio. Aspire Software, the operational arm of Valsoft, operates and manages Valsoft’s global portfolio of wholly owned software companies, providing mission-critical solutions across multiple verticals. By implementing industry best practices, Aspire delivers a time-sensitive integration process, and the operation of a decentralized model has allowed it to become a hub for creating rapid growth by reinvesting in its portfolio.

The successful candidate will be based anywhere in Sweden, working in a hybrid work model from our office in Gothenburg!

Required

About You
:

Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Information Systems, or equivalent practical experience
2+ years in a technical support, DBA, or software engineering role with direct customer or stakeholder contact
Demonstrable SQL expertise: joins, window functions, CTEs, indexing strategy, query plan analysis, and performance tuning on a major RDBMS (SQL Server, PostgreSQL, MySQL, or Oracle)
Hands-on experience administering databases: backups and restores, user and permission management, monitoring, and incident response
Proficiency in at least one programming language (Python, C#, Java, JavaScript/TypeScript, or similar) sufficient to debug application code and write small utilities
Working knowledge of Git and standard development workflows (branches, pull requests, code review)
Experience using AI coding assistants and LLMs as part of a daily workflow — writing prompts that produce useful output, knowing when to verify, knowing when not to use them.
Strong written and spoken English. Eligible to work in Sweden

Preferred

Experience with cloud-hosted databases (Azure SQL, AWS RDS or Aurora, Google Cloud SQL, Snowflake, BigQuery)
Familiarity with Linux command line, shell scripting, and basic networking (DNS, TLS, HTTP, firewalls)
Exposure to containerization (Docker) and orchestration (Kubernetes). Experience with logging and observability stacks (ELK, Datadog, Grafana, Splunk, OpenTelemetry)
Knowledge of REST APIs and how to debug them (Postman, curl, browser dev tools)
Familiarity with CI/CD pipelines (GitHub Actions, Azure DevOps, GitLab CI)
Prior experience in a SaaS or B2B product environment
Swedish language skills

Personal attributes

Curious by default — you want to know why something broke, not just how to make the symptom go away
Comfortable holding two threads at once: the customer who needs an answer now, and the underlying defect that needs a proper fix
Disciplined writer — your tickets, postmortems, and documentation make life easier for the next person. Direct and honest in communication, internally and with customers
Treats AI tools as leverage, not as a crutch — verifies output, understands the code that gets generated, and improves prompts over time

About The Team

You'll join our Support Engineering team in Gothenburg — a technical group that works at the intersection of engineering and customer success
We're the people the rest of the company turns to when something genuinely hard breaks, and we work closely with Engineering, Product, and Customer Success to make sure issues get resolved properly, not just closed
How we work: we treat every incident as a chance to learn, document thoroughly so problems don't cost us twice, pair on hard tickets, and push fixes back into the product rather than working around them
We use AI tools heavily as part of our daily workflow and share what works across the team
You can expect real ownership of problems from first report to root cause, direct access to the engineers who built the system, and room to grow into adjacent technical roles over time
We're not a call centre, and we're not a feature factory — we're a team that takes pride in solving real problems well

For further information about Microdeb
, you can visit our website at https://microdeb.se/en/

We thank all applicants for their interest; however only the candidates selected for an interview will be contacted.

environments remain secure, reliable and future-ready.

Har du byggt och vidareutvecklat Azureplattformar i komplexa hybridmiljöer och vill fortsätta arbeta nära tekniken? Hos Akademiska Hus får du en tekniskt ledande och hands-on roll med stort inflytande över hur vår framtida infrastruktur ska standardiseras, automatiseras och säkras. Här bidrar du både till långsiktiga tekniska vägval och till att lösningarna faktiskt implementeras och fungerar.

DU KOMMER ATT

Akademiska Hus har gjort en omfattande förflyttning från traditionell on-prem-infrastruktur till Microsoft Azure. Samtidigt finns en stor, verksamhetskritisk systemmiljö kvar on-prem. Resultatet är en komplex hybridinfrastruktur där molntjänster och traditionell IT behöver fungera tillsammans – säkert, stabilt och effektivt.

Nu går vi in i nästa fas. Det innebär ökad automatisering och repeterbarhet, tydligare standarder och plattformsmönster, förbättrad governance och säkerhetsstyrning samt en mer enhetlig hybrid- och Azureplattform med mindre beroende av manuella arbetssätt.

Som Cloud & Infrastructure Engineer får du en central roll i denna utveckling. Det är en tekniskt ledande engineer-roll där tyngdpunkten ligger på eget genomförande. Du designar, implementerar och felsöker lösningar samtidigt som du samlar teamet kring tekniska frågor, skapar framdrift och stöttar kollegor genom kunskapsdelning och vägledning.

Teamet består av tolv personer i Göteborg och Stockholm, däribland fyra IT-teknikspecialister och tre nätverkstekniker. Tillsammans finns bred kompetens inom bland annat Azure, IAM, serverhallar och virtualisering, VDI, övervakning, brandväggar, SOC, VPN och nätverk. Du arbetar även nära arkitekter och har mandat att påverka tekniska lösningar, arbetssätt och plattformens fortsatta utveckling.

Du kommer bland annat att:

Designa, implementera och vidareutveckla lösningar i Azure och den hybrida infrastrukturen.
Arbeta hands-on med bland annat Compute, Networking, Storage, Identity och Security.
Utveckla automation och Infrastructure as Code för repeterbara och standardiserade leveranser.
Arbeta med Active Directory, Entra ID och Conditional Access i en komplex hybridmiljö.
Felsöka avancerade tekniska problem och driva lösningar från analys till genomförande.
Bidra till plattformsmönster, tekniska standarder, arkitektur och långsiktiga vägval.
Arbeta med governance, loggning, säkerhetsstyrning och kostnadsoptimering.
Ta ett tekniskt ledarskap och bidra till teamets gemensamma kompetens och utveckling.

DIN PROFIL

Vi söker dig med gedigen erfarenhet av IT-infrastruktur och av förflyttningen från traditionell on-prem till Azure och hybrid cloud. Kanske började du inom Windows Server, Active Directory, virtualisering och traditionell serverdrift. Med tiden har Azure blivit en allt större del av ditt ansvar och du har arbetat med migreringar, hybridlösningar, identitet, nätverk, säkerhet och automation.

I dag kan du se helheten och bidra till tekniska vägval, men vill fortfarande arbeta nära tekniken. Det viktiga är inte vilka titlar du har haft, utan att du förstår resan eftersom du själv har gjort den.

För rollen behöver du ha:

Flerårig erfarenhet av Azure i komplexa produktionsmiljöer.
Gedigen hands-on erfarenhet av hybrid Azure/on-prem.
God kompetens inom nätverk, identitet och säkerhet.
Erfarenhet av automation och Infrastructure as Code, exempelvis Terraform.
Erfarenhet av Active Directory, Entra ID, Conditional Access och PowerShell.
Förmåga att felsöka avancerade problem, genomföra lösningar och ta tekniskt ansvar.
Mycket god kommunikativ förmåga på svenska och engelska.

Det är meriterande om du har erfarenhet av Azure Virtual Desktop, Application Gateway, Application Proxy, Linux, DNS samt PKI och certifikathantering. Relevanta Azure-certifieringar är också meriterande.

Som person är du nyfiken, lösningsorienterad och trygg i din tekniska kompetens. Du tycker om att förstå hur saker fungerar på djupet och utmanar gärna befintliga lösningar när du ser en bättre väg framåt. Samtidigt är du prestigelös, delar med dig av din kunskap och skapar framdrift tillsammans med andra.

Tjänsten kan vara placerad i Göteborg eller Stockholm. Akademiska Hus erbjuder ett flexibelt arbetssätt där utgångspunkten är att du arbetar ungefär hälften av tiden på kontoret. Upplägget planeras tillsammans med närmaste chef utifrån uppdraget. För den som vill finns möjlighet att resa mellan Göteborg och Stockholm för att träffa kollegorna på den andra orten

VILL DU VETA MER?

OM AKADEMISKA HUS

Akademiska Hus är ett av Sveriges största fastighetsbolag och ägs av svenska staten. Tillsammans med universitet och högskolor utvecklar och förvaltar vi kunskapsmiljöer som bidrar till forskning, utbildning och innovation över hela Sverige.Våra fastigheter rymmer allt från undervisningslokaler och kontor till avancerade laboratorier och forskningsmiljöer. We are Stravito and this is the problem we solve.

Stravito transforms how Consumer Insights professionals and Brand Managers work by building AI that automates their core workflows while eliminating hallucinations. We help world-leading organizations across industries accelerate strategic decision-making by turning millions of market research documents into intelligent systems that generate reports, discover insights proactively, and synthesize knowledge across vast content libraries.

The Mission

Build the data backbone that powers billion-dollar decisions at world-leading companies. We're looking for a Backend Engineer to architect and evolve the content systems that handle millions of market research documents and enable strategic decisions at the world's largest brands.

Your mission is to grow our robust, scalable content foundation that enables seamless access to business-critical content through APIs and reliable processing capabilities that other teams build upon.

Our platform processes a massive amount of market research documents and data points, powering intelligent workflows for the core work our users do at global brands.

What Makes This Role Unique

Foundation for AI innovation: Build the content infrastructure that enables our AI brain to process the data that matters.
Enterprise-scale challenges: Handle content ingestion from global industry elading companies with diverse requirements
Ownership: Your decisions impact how thousands of professionals access business-critical insights
Cross-team enablement: Create and evolve the APIs and data models that empower our customer-facing product teams to innovate.

What You’ll Do

Transform How Fortune 500 Companies Access Their Research Intelligence

Connect diverse ecosystems: Build and maintain robust integrations that seamlessly ingest content from diverse enterprise systems
Design for scale: Create content processing systems that handle millions of documents while maintaining low API response times
Enable AI innovation: Build the data models that power our AI brain's ability to synthesize insights across massive content libraries
Set the technical foundation: Establish patterns, standards, and interfaces that enable product teams to rapidly build customer-facing features
Optimize for performance: Ensure reliable, performant content systems across all ingestion channels

What We Need

Back-end expertise: Strong experience designing and building distributed systems and handling large-scale content processing. We care more about your engineering fundamentals than any specific language or framework
Cloud-native mindset: Hands-on experience running services in modern cloud environments (AWS, GCP, Azure, or similar), with containerization and infrastructure as code. Familiarity with modern CI/CD practices is important
Integration mastery: Proven track record of building reliable APIs and integration patterns for diverse data sources and formats
System thinking: Ability to design scalable, maintainable data models that empower other teams to build on top of them

The salary range for this role depends on location and will proactively be shared with you in the first interview.

What’s in it for you?

Join a remote-first, globally distributed team of 100+ professionals from 30+ nationalities, united by our core values: simplicity first, an 'own it, do it' mentality, embracing different perspectives, and enjoying the journey together. Ready to build the AI that powers Fortune 500 strategy? Join us.

We bring all of a company's customer and market knowledge into one place, making it findable, usable, and ready to act on, so insights teams can make sharper, fact-based decisions. jobs.title: System Architect Core & Credits
jobs.description:
We are strengthening our architecture capabilities and are looking for a System Architect for Core & Credits. In this role, you will help shape the technical direction of our credit solutions while working closely with Team Credit and fellow architects across the organization. You will combine hands-on development with architectural responsibility, contributing both to day-to-day delivery and to the long-term evolution of our products.

Personal Skills

We are looking for a proactive and self-driven person with strong analytical skills, integrity, and the ability to see the bigger picture. You communicate clearly, collaborate well with others, and combine a business-oriented mindset with solid technical understanding.

Main Responsibilities

As System Architect, you will take part in both hands-on development and architectural work. You will support the team by clarifying requirements, designing technical solutions, guiding implementation, and helping ensure that our systems remain secure, maintainable, scalable, and aligned with the product roadmap.

Define And Analyze System Requirements

– Define and analyze functional and non-functional system requirements in close collaboration with system users, product owners, and other stakeholders.

– Translate requirements into clear guidance for developers and application managers through models, prototypes, guidelines, and instructions.

Develop Technical Roadmap

– Develop, maintain, and communicate the technical roadmap for your area of responsibility.

– Actively reduce existing technical debt and help prevent new technical debt from being introduced.

– Drive system changes in line with the roadmap and help ensure that development progresses in a coordinated and sustainable way.

Evaluate Cost and Time

– Assess cost, time, and value when evaluating manual routines, hardware, third-party products, existing software, or new development.

Architectural Design and System Decomposition

– Design and evolve the fundamental system structure that supports ongoing product development.

– Support developers and application managers in resolving issues in a way that is consistent with the architectural direction.

– Make technical decisions within your area of responsibility, in alignment with the roadmap and relevant stakeholders.

– Align with your immediate manager before decisions that may involve additional costs. Decisions of a significant nature are made by the company's Chief Architect or Management team.

– Guide teams in evaluating both human-created and AI-assisted design or code suggestions, ensuring that solutions are sound, secure, maintainable, scalable, and aligned with the overall architecture.

Customer and Sales Engagement

– Support new sales and upselling activities for both new and existing customers.

– Help answer solution-related questions and contribute technical insight in customer dialogue.

Desired Education And Experience

– University-level education in software development, or equivalent practical experience.

– Extensive experience and strong expertise in software design and development.

– Must have experience: working in an IBM i environment and with RPGLE as a programming language.

– Merited experience: Working with a Java technology stack and frameworks such as Spring Boot and Spring for building production-ready environments and REST APIs.

– Merited experience: AWS or other cloud public clouds.

Business domain knowledge within credits is merited.
Proficiency in agile software development.
Proficiency in data security.
Fluency in English is required. Swedish is desirable, and Finnish is considered a bonus.
You have a pragmatic AI-first mindset and are positive about using AI as support for productivity and analysis, while applying professional judgment and taking ownership of the final result.

Could this be your next step? If you are motivated by combining hands-on development with architectural responsibility, we would be happy to hear from you.

The role can be based in either Mariehamn, Helsinki, Turku, Stockholm

For further information, please contact Technical Development Manager Sebastian Skogman by email at sebastian.skogman@crosskey.fi or HR Manager Monika Sigmark by email at monika.sigmark@crosskey.fi We are reviewing applications on an ongoing basis, so please send your application as soon as possible, but no later than 30 September 2026.

jobs.title: Data Platform Engineer, Solna
jobs.description:
Are you passionate about the infrastructure of scalable, secure, and future-proof data platforms that power analytics, AI, and business-critical insights? Do you thrive in environments where automation, cloud technologies, and platform reliability are at the core of everything you do? We're looking for a Data Platform Engineer who wants to play a pivotal role in shaping and operating a modern Azure and Databricks-based data platform that enables data-driven decision-making, advanced analytics, and AI innovation at scale.

About The Role

In this role, you will be responsible for designing, building, and maintaining the infrastructure that supports analytics, reporting, AI, and data product development. You will help establish platform standards, develop automation capabilities, and ensure the platform remains secure, scalable, and resilient. Working closely with Data Architects, Data Engineers, Enterprise Architects, and Security teams, you will drive the evolution of a modern cloud-based platform that enables seamless data ingestion, processing, and consumption across the organization.

As a key member of the team, you will manage and optimize Azure Databricks, Azure Data Lake, networking, and supporting platform services. You will implement Infrastructure as Code using Terraform, build and maintain CI/CD pipelines, and create observability frameworks that provide transparency into platform health, performance, and cost efficiency. You will also play an important role in troubleshooting complex issues, improving operational excellence, supporting disaster recovery planning, and enabling AI and machine learning capabilities through robust platform engineering practices.

Beyond the technical responsibilities, you will act as a trusted subject matter expert, helping engineering teams adopt cloud platform best practices while continuously driving improvements in reliability, security, governance, and operational efficiency.

We're looking for someone who combines a strong engineering foundation with hands-on experience building and operating the infrastructure of enterprise-scale cloud platforms.

Bachelor’s degree in computer science, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related field.
5+ years of experience in Platform Engineering, Cloud Engineering, Infrastructure Engineering, Site Reliability Engineering (SRE), or similar roles.
Proven experience designing, implementing, and operating secure, scalable, and resilient cloud infrastructure in Azure.
Experience supporting modern data platforms, analytics, AI, and machine learning workloads.

Key Technical Skills

We're looking for someone with strong expertise across several of the following areas:

Azure cloud and data platforms, including Azure Databricks Administration, Azure Data Lake, data integration services, and analytics workloads.
Infrastructure as Code and platform automation, including Terraform, Git, CI/CD, automated provisioning, and configuration management.
Containerized and cloud-native environments, including Kubernetes and Docker.
Cloud networking and identity management, including Azure Networking, Entra ID/IAM, DNS, connectivity, private networking, routing, and firewalls.
Security, compliance, and governance, including implementation of security controls and governance frameworks within regulated environments.
Observability and platform operations, including monitoring, troubleshooting, high availability, platform reliability, and cost optimization (FinOps).
Scripting and automation, using Python, PowerShell, or Bash.

Nice to have

Experience with any of the following would be considered an advantage:

Microsoft Purview and Apache Airflow.
MLOps and Azure AI Services.
Multi-cloud environments.
Azure Solutions Architect, Azure Administrator, or Databricks Platform Administrator certifications.
Experience from the logistics industry.

Language Requirements

Fluent in English, both written and spoken
Swedish, Danish, Finnish, or Norwegian is considered an advantage

Who you are

You are a curious and proactive engineer who enjoys solving complex challenges and building reliable platforms that create value at scale. With a strong analytical mindset and a passion for troubleshooting, you thrive in environments where continuous improvement, automation, and operational excellence are key. You take a structured approach to problem-solving, have a natural sense of ownership, and are committed to delivering high-quality solutions. At the same time, you're a collaborative team player who builds strong relationships across Engineering, Architecture, Security, and Business teams, enabling effective stakeholder engagement and driving results through cross-functional collaboration.

jobs.title: Cloud & Infrastructure Engineer
jobs.description:
Har du byggt och vidareutvecklat Azureplattformar i komplexa hybridmiljöer och vill fortsätta arbeta nära tekniken? Hos Akademiska Hus får du en tekniskt ledande och hands-on roll med stort inflytande över hur vår framtida infrastruktur ska standardiseras, automatiseras och säkras. Här bidrar du både till långsiktiga tekniska vägval och till att lösningarna faktiskt implementeras och fungerar.

DU KOMMER ATT

Akademiska Hus har gjort en omfattande förflyttning från traditionell on-prem-infrastruktur till Microsoft Azure. Samtidigt finns en stor, verksamhetskritisk systemmiljö kvar on-prem. Resultatet är en komplex hybridinfrastruktur där molntjänster och traditionell IT behöver fungera tillsammans – säkert, stabilt och effektivt.

Nu går vi in i nästa fas. Det innebär ökad automatisering och repeterbarhet, tydligare standarder och plattformsmönster, förbättrad governance och säkerhetsstyrning samt en mer enhetlig hybrid- och Azureplattform med mindre beroende av manuella arbetssätt.

Som Cloud & Infrastructure Engineer får du en central roll i denna utveckling. Det är en tekniskt ledande engineer-roll där tyngdpunkten ligger på eget genomförande. Du designar, implementerar och felsöker lösningar samtidigt som du samlar teamet kring tekniska frågor, skapar framdrift och stöttar kollegor genom kunskapsdelning och vägledning.

Teamet består av tolv personer i Göteborg och Stockholm, däribland fyra IT-teknikspecialister och tre nätverkstekniker. Tillsammans finns bred kompetens inom bland annat Azure, IAM, serverhallar och virtualisering, VDI, övervakning, brandväggar, SOC, VPN och nätverk. Du arbetar även nära arkitekter och har mandat att påverka tekniska lösningar, arbetssätt och plattformens fortsatta utveckling.

Du kommer bland annat att:

Designa, implementera och vidareutveckla lösningar i Azure och den hybrida infrastrukturen.
Arbeta hands-on med bland annat Compute, Networking, Storage, Identity och Security.
Utveckla automation och Infrastructure as Code för repeterbara och standardiserade leveranser.
Arbeta med Active Directory, Entra ID och Conditional Access i en komplex hybridmiljö.
Felsöka avancerade tekniska problem och driva lösningar från analys till genomförande.
Bidra till plattformsmönster, tekniska standarder, arkitektur och långsiktiga vägval.
Arbeta med governance, loggning, säkerhetsstyrning och kostnadsoptimering.
Ta ett tekniskt ledarskap och bidra till teamets gemensamma kompetens och utveckling.

DIN PROFIL

Vi söker dig med gedigen erfarenhet av IT-infrastruktur och av förflyttningen från traditionell on-prem till Azure och hybrid cloud. Kanske började du inom Windows Server, Active Directory, virtualisering och traditionell serverdrift. Med tiden har Azure blivit en allt större del av ditt ansvar och du har arbetat med migreringar, hybridlösningar, identitet, nätverk, säkerhet och automation.

I dag kan du se helheten och bidra till tekniska vägval, men vill fortfarande arbeta nära tekniken. Det viktiga är inte vilka titlar du har haft, utan att du förstår resan eftersom du själv har gjort den.

För rollen behöver du ha:

Flerårig erfarenhet av Azure i komplexa produktionsmiljöer.
Gedigen hands-on erfarenhet av hybrid Azure/on-prem.
God kompetens inom nätverk, identitet och säkerhet.
Erfarenhet av automation och Infrastructure as Code, exempelvis Terraform.
Erfarenhet av Active Directory, Entra ID, Conditional Access och PowerShell.
Förmåga att felsöka avancerade problem, genomföra lösningar och ta tekniskt ansvar.
Mycket god kommunikativ förmåga på svenska och engelska.

Det är meriterande om du har erfarenhet av Azure Virtual Desktop, Application Gateway, Application Proxy, Linux, DNS samt PKI och certifikathantering. Relevanta Azure-certifieringar är också meriterande.

Som person är du nyfiken, lösningsorienterad och trygg i din tekniska kompetens. Du tycker om att förstå hur saker fungerar på djupet och utmanar gärna befintliga lösningar när du ser en bättre väg framåt. Samtidigt är du prestigelös, delar med dig av din kunskap och skapar framdrift tillsammans med andra.

Tjänsten kan vara placerad i Göteborg eller Stockholm. Akademiska Hus erbjuder ett flexibelt arbetssätt där utgångspunkten är att du arbetar ungefär hälften av tiden på kontoret. Upplägget planeras tillsammans med närmaste chef utifrån uppdraget. För den som vill finns möjlighet att resa mellan Göteborg och Stockholm för att träffa kollegorna på den andra orten.

VILL DU VETA MER?

Har du frågor eller funderingar? Kontakta gärna rekryteringskonsult Johanna Värmfors på johanna.varmfors@nexergroup.com eller +46 730 821 230, alternativt Artan Bitiqi på artan.bitiqi@nexergroup.com eller +46 723 61 28 44.

OM AKADEMISKA HUS

Akademiska Hus är ett av Sveriges största fastighetsbolag och ägs av svenska staten. Tillsammans med universitet och högskolor utvecklar och förvaltar vi kunskapsmiljöer som bidrar till forskning, utbildning och innovation över hela Sverige.Våra fastigheter rymmer allt från undervisningslokaler och kontor till avancerade laboratorier och forskningsmiljöer. Bakom verksamheten finns en omfattande digital och teknisk infrastruktur som är avgörande för att våra miljöer ska fungera och fortsätta utvecklas.

Hos Akademiska Hus får du arbeta i en organisation med ett långsiktigt perspektiv och samtidigt vara en del av en pågående teknisk utveckling. Här finns både komplexiteten i en stor IT-miljö och möjligheten att påverka hur framtidens lösningar ska utformas.

jobs.title: Software and Solution Architect
jobs.description:
Join EQT Tech’s Architectural function, where you’ll play a critical role in future-proofing and scaling one of our cross-functional value streams—Fintech.

This is a unique opportunity to design and drive the technology supporting our financial operations — ensuring seamless integrations, efficiency, and innovation. If you're a strategic thinker with a strong technical foundation and a passion for designing scalable systems, we’d love to hear from you.

About The Tech Team – Fintech Value Stream

The Fintech Value Stream strives to improve and automate key financial processes to deliver a best-in-class experience for a broad range of business domains. We’re a cross-functional team collaborating closely with stakeholders across EQT to ensure data and technology strategically support business outcomes. Our team includes tech leads, data professionals, product managers and architects who together shape the future of finance operations through scalable, data-driven solutions.

What You’ll Do

As a Software and Solution Architect, you will play a key role in shaping EQT’s technical landscape within the Fintech Value Stream. Your primary responsibility will be to collaborate with Tech Leads, Engineers, and external partners to design and implement solutions that drive efficiency and scalability across EQT’s investment technology.

Beyond your work in the Fintech Value Stream, you'll also collaborate closely with peers in the Architecture function to shape EQT Tech's long-term architectural direction, ensuring consistency, reusability, and strategic alignment across value streams.

Key Responsibilities

Partner with tech leads and engineers to support the Fintech Value Stream in new projects & initiatives, engaging in technical discussions with both third-party service providers and internal teams to ensure a structured approach to solution development
Assess the current architecture, team capabilities, and resource allocation to determine the best approach for future implementations
Develop new architectural solutions and enhance existing ones to ensure they are harmonized, scalable, and efficient for all of EQT
Establish technical standards, best practices, and improved ways of working across EQT’s Tech teams
Collaborate with other Value Streams (Investment & Client) and Platform Teams to define interfaces, ownership, and capabilities within the Fintech domain
Design system integrations, ensuring seamless connectivity between internal systems, new external systems, and vendors
Work closely with the Head of Architecture and the Head of Fintech, supporting key strategic initiatives

Who are you?

We’re looking for an experienced Software and Solution Architect with a strong technical foundation and a strategic mindset. You should have a passion for problem-solving, system design, and technical leadership. You likely have 8–12 years of experience across software engineering and architecture, including time spent designing systems in regulated or data-sensitive environments.

Desired Skills & Experience

Strong software engineering background, with hands-on experience designing and maintaining complex, high-availability systems that handle sensitive data
Strong understanding of system integrations, APIs, and data architectures
Proven ability to drive implementation from initial requirements to high-level solution design and progress tracking

jobs.description:
Are you passionate about making a sustainable impact in the world of electric transport? Do you thrive in an innovative and entrepreneurial environment? Then you might be the new regional assistant to Erinion!

At Erinion, part of the Scania Group, we are leading the global shift towards a more sustainable transport system by shaping the future within charging and e-mobility.

Our business

We offer private and semi-public charging solutions to build, own and operate infrastructure at customer sites to enhance their operational efficiency, minimize cost and increase flexibility. Erinion is on a fast-paced growth trajectory, if you thrive in dynamic environments fuelled by innovation and collaboration, then Erinion is the place for you!

Role Summary

As a Senior Backend Developer, you will play a key role in building and evolving Erinion Connect, our cloud-native Charging Management System (CMS) for smart charging and energy management in commercial transport.

Working closely with Product, Engineering, Analytics and Applied AI teams, as well as a strategic technology partner, you will design and deliver scalable backend services, integrations and cloud-native solutions that support Erinion's growth.

We're looking for an experienced engineer who combines strong backend expertise with architectural thinking. AI-assisted development tools are part of our daily workflow, but we value engineers who can independently drive technical decisions and build robust, scalable systems.

This is a backend-first role, with approximately 70% of the work focused on platform and integration engineering
and the flexibility to contribute across the stack when needed.

Job Responsibilities

Build and enhance backend services using Python and Node.js/TypeScript.
Design scalable APIs, integrations, and event-driven architectures.
Develop solutions for smart charging, energy management, and fleet platforms.
Integrate Erinion Connect with TMS, FMS, ERP, and telematics systems.
Contribute to platform architecture and long-term product evolution.
Support React-based frontend development when needed.
Use AI-assisted development tools to accelerate software delivery.

Who You Are

5+ years of experience in backend software engineering.
Strong experience with Python and/or Node.js (TypeScript).
Experience designing and building cloud-native applications on AWS.
Solid understanding of software architecture, distributed systems and integration patterns.
Experience with PostgreSQL, DynamoDB and cloud storage solutions.
Experience building REST APIs, microservices and event-driven systems.
Ability to make sound technical and architectural decisions independently.
Experience using AI-assisted coding tools in day-to-day development.
Fluent English.

Nice to have

React experience.
Java experience.
Experience with TMS, FMS, ERP or telematics integrations.
Knowledge of OCPP, OCPI or EV charging technologies.
Experience with TimescaleDB.
Startup or scale-up experience.

We welcome applicants from all backgrounds – your unique experience and perspectives is valuable to us.

Core Technology Stack

Languages
: Python, Node.js, TypeScript, Java, Frontend
: React

Cloud & Infrastructure:
AWS (Lambda, API Gateway, SQS, Step Functions, EventBridge, Cognito, S3), CloudFormation, Docker, GitLab CI

Databases:
PostgreSQL, DynamoDB, S3, TimescaleDB (nice to have)

Architecture & Integration:
REST APIs, Microservices, Event-driven Architecture, WebSockets

AI Tooling:
Claude Code, Codex, AI-assisted Development

Our offer

Join our passionate team in Stockholm city, at Drottninggatan 29, and be a driving force in the future of sustainable transportation. At Erinion, you won't just be a part of the change, you'll be pioneering it. We offer a competitive compensation package, alongside unparalleled professional growth opportunities. This is an early-stage company where your ideas are valued, your contributions have a significant impact, and you have the chance to develop and grow alongside Erinion.

Application

We look forward to receiving your application, consisting of your CV in English and kindly ask you not to share a cover letter to ensure an efficient and unbiased recruitment process for all parties.

Apply as soon as possible, no later than 2026-10-01. Screening will take place on an ongoing basis during the application period. Logical and personality tests may be used as part of the selection process, and a background check may be required for this role.

If you have questions or would like more information, please contact: Sebastian Glaas, Talent Acquisition Spcialist, sebastian.x.glaas@scania.com or Henrik Karlsson, Head of Technology, henrik.xy.karlsson@scania.com

Experience from the automotive industry.
Experience working with complex products. The Scania products are specification based product individuals.

jobs.description:

Locations - Sweden, Denmark, Finland (Hybrid/Remote)

At Databricks, we are on a mission to empower our customers to solve the world's toughest data problems with the Databricks Data Intelligence Platform. As a Delivery Solutions Architect (DSA), you are a trusted technical advisor to key customers, providing expert guidance that translates data, analytics and AI challenges into high-impact business value. You help design, implement, and scale data and AI solutions, focusing on architecture, operational excellence, and customer enablement. Internally, you will collaborate with our sales and field engineering teams to accelerate the adoption and growth of the Databricks Platform in your customers.

Delivery Solutions Architects (DSAs) Are Trusted Technical Advisors Embedded Within The Customer Organization, Providing Expert Guidance That Translates Data And AI Challenges Into High-impact Business Value. They Help You Design, Implement, And Scale Data And AI Solutions, Focusing On Architecture, Operational Excellence, And Team Enablement. DSAs Focus On

Designing secure, scalable architecture
Aligning people, processes, and technology
Establishing trusted advisor relationships
Leveraging the broader ecosystem of Databricks experts

This is a hybrid technical and commercial role. Technically, the expectations are that you become the post-sales technical lead and trusted advisor across all Databricks products for the customer’s top priority use cases. This requires you to use your technical skills and credibility to engage and communicate with technical/technical leadership stakeholders in our customer organizations, do architecture reviews, help with performance and cost optimizations, demonstrate new capabilities, remove blockers, etc. In parallel, it is commercial in the sense that you will drive growth in your assigned customers and use cases through leading your customers' stakeholders, building executive relationships, orchestrating other focused/specialized teams within Databricks, and creating and driving onboarding plans.

While not a hands-on-keyboard role, this is a highly technical position where architectural skills in fields such as Data Architecture, Data Engineering, Data Warehousing or Data Science are essential.

You will report directly to a DSA Manager within the Field Engineering organization.

The Impact You Will Have

Be the Databricks Architect working with customer technical teams working on use cases/data products, from development to go-live, addressing any technical challenges and blockers and providing guidance, best practices and enablement
Lead the post-technical win technical account strategy and execution plan for the majority of Databricks use cases within our most strategic accounts
Be the internal point of contact for any questions related to production/go live status of agreed upon use cases within an account, often for multiple use cases within the largest and most complex organizations
Leverage both Shared Services, User Education, Onboarding/Technical Services and Support resources, along with escalating to expert-level technical teams to address the tasks that are beyond your scope of activities or expertise
Create and execute a point-of-view as to how key use cases can be accelerated into production, coordinating with Professional Services (PS) resources on the delivery of PS Engagement proposals
Navigate Databricks Product and Engineering teams for new product Innovations, private previews and upgrade needs, presenting them to the customers when applicable for their ongoing developments
internal and external updates - KPI reporting on the status of usage and customer health, risks and blockers, product adoption and use case progression - to your Field Engineering leadership

What We Look For

Programming experience in PySpark, Python and Databricks (or similar data platform)
Understanding and hands-on experience of solution architecture-related distributed data and analytics systems
5+ years of experience where you have been accountable for delivery of projects in Data, Analytics or AI and where you can contribute to technical debate and design choices with customers
Experience in a customer-facing pre-sales, technical architecture, customer success, or consulting roles
Understanding of how to attribute business value and outcomes to specific project deliverables
Technical program coordination including account and stakeholder management
Experience resolving complex and important escalation with senior customer technical stakeholders
Track record of overachievement against quota, Goals or similar objective targets
Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Engineering, or equivalent experience through work experience
Can travel up to 30%

Databricks is the Data and AI company. More than 20,000 organizations worldwide — including adidas, AT&T, Bayer, Block, Mastercard, Rivian, Unilever, and 70% of the Fortune 500 — rely on the Databricks Data + AI Platform to build and scale data and AI apps, analytics and agents. Headquartered in San Francisco with 30+ offices around the globe, Databricks offers a unified platform that includes Genie, Lakebase, Agent Bricks, Lakeflow, Lakehouse, and Unity Catalog. jobs.title: AI Software Developer i Stockholm
jobs.description:
Vi tror på- och vill förverkliga en AI- och datadriven framtid. Vi söker AI Software Developers som vill vara med och hjälpa våra kunder inom olika branscher att omvandla AI-experiment till skalbara, säkra och värdeskapande lösningar.

Hos oss blir du del av ett växande område med runt 20 konsulter inom Cloud, AI och systemutveckling. Samtidigt får du kollegor från hela Solita med expertis i allt från data, strategi och mycket mer att dela kunskap och perspektiv med, läs mer om det här.

När vi växer gör dina möjligheter också det, du får vara med och påverka kulturen, affären och din roll.

En dag på Solita

En dag på Solita kan börja med ett standup-möte med ditt team på kunduppdraget, ibland består det av fler kollegor från Solita. Är det fredag kanske du jobbar från Solitas kontor i Stockholm för att starta dagen med frukost. Andra dagar jobbar du från kundens kontor eller hemifrån.

Sen kliver du in i ditt arbete: när du stöter på ett problem söker du upp en lång diskussionstråd i slack med insikter från kollegor som haft samma problem. Andra gånger passar du på att fråga en kollega vid kaffemaskinen om deras perspektiv för att komma vidare. Du kan också delta i våra interna utbildningsmöten, där vi delar kunskap om allt från nya teknologier och arbetssätt till välmående. Vissa dagar avslutar du med AW, filmkväll, brädspel eller annan aktivitet du och kollegor tycker är kul.

Din roll som AI Software Developer

Du är med i hela utvecklingscykeln, inte sällan från tidigt pre-sales stadie eller i förstudier, för att utveckla, driftsätta och optimera agent-baserade och datadrivna system som hjälper kunder fatta bättre beslut eller automatisera processer på ett intelligent sätt. Exempelvis kan du arbeta med prompt optimering, designa och implementera RAG-arkitektur, utveckla AI-agenter, MCP-servrar, APIer och backend lösningar för att integrera befintliga system till LLM-tjänster. Läs mer om att jobba med AI på Solita här.

Utöver moderna systemutveckling-tekniker kommer du arbeta med diverse AI-verktyg och ramverk som exempelvis LangChain, Tensorflow, AI Foundry och Semantic Kernel för att nämna några. Då vi jobbar teknikagnostiskt får du stor frihet att forma teknikval och arkitektur för att möta affärsbehov. Läs mer om hur kollegor jobbar och diskuterar kring olika teknikval i vår Dev blog här.

Känner du igen dig i följande?

Du kan kommunicera på svenska och engelska i tal och skrift. Det är ett plus om du varit konsult tidigare men det huvudsakliga är din förmåga att snabbt komma in i nya sammanhang och lära dig. Du är trygg i rollen tack vare din erfarenhet av både systemutveckling (särskilt om du jobbat i C# .NET eller Java Spring Boot) samt:

RAG- eller AI-agentarkitektur
Att bygga AI-drivna applikationer med moderna ramverk som ex. Semantic Kernel, LangChain eller liknande.
Att implementera molnbaserade AI-tjänster och produktionssätta AI-lösningar med hjälp av DevSecOps och IaC.

Vi letar inte bara efter tekniska skills, vi vill jobba med dig som tar ansvar för att bygga rätt lösningar på rätt sätt genom att utmana med omtanke. Du ser kod som ett hantverk, inte bara ett medel till funktion: du bryr dig om kvalitet, läsbarhet och hållbarhet. Du kommer trivas hos oss om du tycker om att dela med dig av din kunskap lika mycket som du är nyfiken på- och lyfter andras. .

Vad vi erbjuder

Vår företagskultur är väldigt viktig för oss. Vi värdesätter låg hierarki, självständighet och ansvar, värdeskapande arbete och trevliga kollegor. Här kan du läsa mer om vår kultur, och här kan du bläddra bland våra tech-bloggar.
Meningsfulla projekt: Arbeta i en agil miljö där du kan påverka teknikval och arbetssätt för att skapa de bästa lösningarna
Flexibilitet och autonomi för att utforma ditt arbete med flextider– läs mer från vår blogg.
Ständig utveckling: Vi erbjuder kontinuerlig kompetensutveckling för att säkerställa att våra medarbetare ligger längst fram i teknikutvecklingen.
Innovativ kultur: Arbeta tillsammans med några av de främsta experterna inom data, analys och utveckling

Utöver detta får du även ta del av följande förmåner:

💰 Fast lön oberoende av beläggningsgrad med möjlighet till löneväxling till ditt pensionssparande
🏦 Pensionsavsättning i linje med ITP1 samt möjlighet till löneväxling till ditt pensionssparande vid inkomst över 8,07 inkomstbasbelopp
🏖️ 30 semesterdagar
😃 Sjukvårdsförsäkring för både din mentala och fysiska hälsa som täcker dig även utanför tjänstetid
🏋️ ♀️ Friskvårdsbidrag på 5000 kr via Benifex (tidigare Benify).
💻 Ett brett nätverk av erfarna specialister från olika områden inom tech att samarbeta med
🔗 Intern coach för att stödja ditt välbefinnande
🪩 After Work och hobbyaktiviteter
🥐 Fredagsfrukostar

Vilka är vi?

Solita är ett värderingsstyrt konsultbolag med över 2000 medarbetare i 9 länder, varav ca 230 i Sverige. Vår storlek gör oss tillräckligt stora för att vara en stabil och innovativ arbetsgivare, men samtidigt tillräckligt små för att värna om våra medarbetare och kunder. Med bred kompetens inom digital transformation erbjuder vi en dynamisk arbetsmiljö. Hos oss får du friheten att utvecklas, både professionellt och personligt.

Intresserad av att höra mer?

Låter det som en spännande möjlighet? Skicka in din ansökan och bli en del av vårt team som ligger i framkant av AI-utveckling!
Om du har några frågor, skriv gärna till Rebecca Hammel på LinkedIn eller mailadressen rebecca.hammel@solita.se. Du kan också kontakta rekryteringsansvarig, Louise Doverholt på LinkedIn eller mailadressen louise.doverholt@solita.se .

Hur ser processen ut?

I rekryteringsprocessen tror vi på en snabb och effektiv process. Du ansöker med CV eller LinkedIn och svarar på några korta frågor. Vi går igenom ansökningar löpande. Om vi ser en potentiell matchning, bjuder vi in dig till ett första möte för att lära känna dig och berätta mer om vår kultur och våra värderingar på Solita. I andra intervjun fokuserar vi på din tekniska kompetens och din erfarenhet. Om allt går bra tar vi oss vidare till sista steget där vi presenterar ett erbjudande och välkomnar dig som ny Solitan!

Placeringsort för denna roll är i Stockholm, Sverige

Designa och utveckla integrationer i Azure
Jobba nära kund med kravställning och förståelse för verksamhetens behov
Bidra till plattformsutveckling och kunskapsdelning i vårt integrationscommunity
Utforska hur AI-agenter och orkestrerade flöden kan stötta integrationsarbetet hela vägen från krav till produktion
På sikt växa mot en roll som integrationsarkitekt med fokus på Azure och plattformsarkitektur

Vem vi tror att du är

Vi vet att år på CV:t inte säger allt, samtidigt påverkar det uppdrags-möjligheter – en grundförutsättning som trygg arbetsgivare. För att matcha våra uppdrag ser vi gärna att du har:

Några års erfarenhet av integrations- eller systemutveckling
Praktisk erfarenhet av Azure Integration Services (t.ex. Logic Apps, Functions, Service Bus, API Management)
God förmåga att kommunicera på svenska

Ingen är perfekt, inte ens vi.

Därför uppskattar vi transparens tidigt. Håller du med om dessa “trade-offs” kan vi vara en match:

Trygghet med fast lön slår provisionsbaserad ersättning 💰
Utveckling ser du som ett landskap att utforska, inte en enkelriktad titeltrappa 🗺️
Inlyssnande och ärliga ledare & sälj-team hellre än tomma löften eller längre tid utan uppdrag 🫶🏻
Att skapa värde för kund är viktigare än att jobba med ens favorit-teknikstack 💎

Nyfiken på nästa steg?

Vi letar inte efter perfekta CV:n, utan efter erfarna integrations- och molnprofiler som vill växa i konsultrollen. Skicka in din ansökan med CV eller LinkedIn och svara på några korta frågor som gör att vi snabbare kan få prata med dig! 📨

Din arbetsort kan vara Stockholm, Göteborg eller Malmö
.

Under juli månad kan vår återkoppling dröja något längre än vanligt då vi njuter av sommarledigheter. Vi hör av oss senast i augusti. Tack för ditt tålamod och önskar dig en riktigt fin sommar!

Lästips under tiden 📑

Vi vill gärna berätta massa mer men försöker hålla oss kortfattade till en början. Om du inte kan hålla dig tills vi hörs länkar vi tips på mer läsning här.

Trygghet med fast lön slår provisionsbaserad ersättning 💰
Utveckling ser du som ett landskap att utforska, inte en enkelriktad titeltrappa 🗺️
Inlyssnande och ärliga ledare & sälj-team hellre än tomma löften eller längre tid utan uppdrag 🫶🏻
Att skapa värde för kund är viktigare än att jobba med ens favorit-teknikstack 💎

Nyfiken på nästa steg?

Vi letar inte efter perfekta CV:n, utan efter erfarna integrations- och molnprofiler som vill växa i konsultrollen. Skicka in din ansökan med CV eller LinkedIn och svara på några korta frågor som gör att vi snabbare kan få prata med dig! 📨

.

Lästips under tiden 📑

Vi vill gärna berätta massa mer men försöker hålla oss kortfattade till en början. Om du inte kan hålla dig tills vi hörs länkar vi tips på mer läsning här.
