jobs.location: Fredericia, Region of Southern Denmark, Denmark
jobs.description:
I Domestic Payment Capturing har vi ansvaret for brugeroplevelsen og de services, der gør det muligt at oprette indlandsbetalinger sikkert, stabilt og effektivt for både privat og erhverv.

Det er et område med stor betydning for både brugere, banker og forretning og med mange spændende tekniske og domænemæssige problemstillinger.

Rollen: Byg robuste services med fokus på både kode, brugere og drift

Som Senior Backend Developer bliver du en del af teamet bag oprettelse af indlandsbetalinger. Du kommer til at udvikle API’er, arbejde med test, vedligeholde eksisterende kode og bidrage til nyudvikling af moderne services i et agilt setup.

Du indgår i en rolle, hvor du både løser opgaver på egen hånd og samarbejder tæt med andre. Du er med til at planlægge og eksekvere opgaver i sprint, bryde større problemstillinger ned i mindre leverancer og skabe fremdrift på en måde, hvor teamet kan følge med, bidrage og bygge videre.

En vigtig del af rollen er at bidrage til høj kvalitet gennem clean code, automatisering af test og drift samt en god forståelse for security, compliance, observability og robusthed. Du er også med til at udvikle teamets arbejde med Domain Driven Design, Event Driven Design og moderne servicearkitektur.

Hvordan succes ser ud efter 6–12 måneder

Efter 6–12 måneder har du opbygget en solid forståelse for betalingsdomænet og kan finde rundt i centrale data, flows og afhængigheder:

Du leverer på udviklingsopgaver og bidrager i refinement, reviews, retrospectives og teamets løbende prioriteringer.
Du hjælper med at omsætte komplekse behov til tekniske løsninger, der kan udvikles, testes og releases sikkert.
Du gør risici, afhængigheder og usikkerheder synlige i tide og bidrager med forslag til, hvordan teamet kan håndtere dem.
Du bidrager også til teamets arbejde med DDD og moderne serviceudvikling – både gennem kode, sparring, reviews og konkrete forbedringsforslag.

Succes handler ikke om at kende alt fra start, men om at lære domænet, dele viden og skabe værdi sammen med teamet.

Teamet: Et engageret fagligt fællesskab, hvor viden deles åbent

Du bliver en del af Domestic Payment Capturing, et team på 14 personer med høj faglighed og dyb domæneviden: en Product Owner, to forretningskonsulenter, ti softwareudviklere og en manager.

Vi arbejder i et agilt setup inspireret af Scrum med to-ugers sprint, daglige standups og faste ceremonier. Hverdagen er præget af tæt samarbejde, åben sparring og en kultur, hvor vi hjælper hinanden, når opgaverne bliver komplekse. Det er helt forventeligt at stille spørgsmål, dele synspunkter og udfordre løsninger på en respektfuld måde – både i hverdagen og i forbindelse med reviews og retrospectives.

Som seniorprofil bidrager du ikke kun med kode, men også med ro, overblik og faglig sparring. Du kommunikerer tekniske emner klart til både udviklere, forretningskolleger og andre interessenter, og du hjælper med at skabe en arbejdsform, hvor flere kan bidrage og løfte nye opgaver.

Teamet har p.t. faste hjemmearbejdsdage tirsdag og fredag og arbejder fleksibelt, når hverdagen kræver det.

Profilen vi søger: Solid backend-erfaring og lyst til at udvikle andre

Du har mindst fem års professionel erfaring som softwareudvikler og en relevant baggrund som eksempelvis datalog, softwareingeniør eller datamatiker.
Du har solid erfaring med Spring Boot eller andet OOP som C#/.NET, Node.js eller lignend.
Du har praktisk erfaring med API-design, test og værktøjer som Postman eller Insomnia.
Du arbejder med CI/CD, automatisering og kvalitet som en naturlig del af udviklingsprocessen.
Derudover ser vi, at du har arbejdet med microservices, observability og drift af services i et komplekst miljø - og måske også haft de første erfaringer med Agentic AI.

Som person er du nysgerrig, omhyggelig og motiveret af at skabe løsninger, der fungerer i praksis. Du trives med at forstå både teknik, brugerbehov og forretningsmæssig kontekst, og du deler gerne din viden, så andre kan bygge videre på den. Du behøver ikke kunne alt på forhånd, men du skal have lyst til at lære, stille gode spørgsmål og bidrage til fælles tekniske valg.

Udviklingsmuligheder: Fordyb dig i komplekse systemer og moderne arkitektur

Rollen giver dig mulighed for at udvikle dig i et komplekst betalingsdomæne med store datamængder, høj samfundsmæssig relevans og tydelige krav til kvalitet, sikkerhed og stabilitet.

Du får mulighed for at tage ansvar for egne services og produkter og fordybe dig fagligt inden for moderne backendudvikling, cloud, eventbaseret arkitektur, DDD, observability og automatisering.

Du får også mulighed for at påvirke teamets tekniske retning og bidrage til best practices i et område med mange nye opgaver og høj ledelsesmæssig opmærksomhed.

Klar til at være med til at forme indlandsbetalinger?

Har du lyst til at bruge din backend-erfaring til at bygge robuste services, dele viden og bidrage til et team, der lykkes sammen, vil vi gerne høre fra dig.

Velkommen til Bankdata

Bankdata bygger software til finanssektoren. Vi er næsten 1000 kolleger på holdet, og vi udvikler digitale produkter, platforme og infrastruktur, som ca. hver tredje dansker, 200.000 virksomheder og flere tusinde bankansatte bruger hver dag.

Vi tror på struktureret personlig udvikling, et solidt kollegialt fællesskab og at ambitiøse medarbejdere med fleksible og bæredygtige arbejdsliv præsterer bedre. Bliv klogere på arbejdslivet i Bankdata her
.

Hos Bankdata arbejder vi målrettet med at fremme mangfoldighed og diversitet blandt vores medarbejdere, og vi opfordrer derfor alle uanset kønsidentitet, alder og kulturel baggrund til at søge job hos os.

Bankdata er en af Danmarks vigtigste teknologivirksomheder. Vi går på arbejde for at finde teknologiske svar på finanssektorens forretningsproblemer. For at udvikle og bygge fremtidens digitale bank.

jobs.description:
Job Description

Trackman is the leading brand in its field, trusted by elite athletes worldwide. We’re growing and looking for a Senior Full Stack SDET who is passionate about quality engineering and excited to help test and improve world-class sports technology products.

This senior, full-stack quality engineering role spans backend API testing and frontend (Windows and web) application testing. You’ll combine strong automation skills with the ability to define end-to-end quality strategies across the Trackman ecosystem—from radar data pipelines to TM Performance Studio used by athletes and coaches worldwide.

You’ll join an international team and help elevate quality practices by mentoring peers, partnering closely with developers, product owners, and UI/UX designers, and championing a quality-first approach throughout the development lifecycle.

Key Responsibilities

Design, build, and maintain robust test automation frameworks for both backend APIs (REST/GraphQL), web applications and Windows desktop applications
Architect end-to-end test strategies covering integration, system, performance, and regression testing
Lead test planning and review sessions within Agile/Scrum ceremonies alongside developers and product owners
Drive quality across the full stack: from data ingestion APIs and cloud services through to client-facing Windows/Web applications
Define and enforce test coverage standards, reporting metrics, and quality gates within CI/CD pipelines (Azure DevOps)
Explore and implement AI-assisted testing techniques — including AI-generated test cases, intelligent test prioritisation, and anomaly detection — to increase testing efficiency and coverage
Mentor and guide junior QA engineers and SDETs across the team
Collaborate with DevOps and platform engineers to embed testing earlier in the development pipeline (shift-left)
Participate in design reviews and contribute to technical architecture discussions from a testability perspective
Conduct exploratory and risk-based testing to uncover edge cases beyond automated suites

Job Requirements

The Ideal Candidate

Holds a relevant degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or equivalent (bachelor's level minimum)
Has 5+ years of experience in quality engineering or SDET roles, with proven seniority in at least two of: backend API testing, desktop/Windows application testing, or test framework architecture
Is highly proficient in C# for test automation, with strong understanding of object-oriented design principles.
Has hands-on experience with API testing tools and frameworks (e.g., RestEaze, Postman, Playwright, SpecFlow, or similar)
Has experience testing Windows/Web based applications and understands UI automation frameworks
Is experienced with Azure DevOps or equivalent CI/CD platforms for pipeline integration and test reporting
Demonstrates strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with an ability to diagnose complex, cross-layer defects

AI & Emerging Technologies

Has experience with and understands how AI and machine learning concepts can be applied within a quality engineering context

It Will Also Be a Plus If You Have

Experience in the gaming or sports technology industry
Knowledge of radar, computer vision, or sensor data systems
Golf knowledge or broader sports interest — you don't need to be a pro, but a genuine passion for sports helps!

We Offer

A senior, high-impact role in which you will directly shape Trackman's quality engineering culture and practices
The chance to work with and test the world's leading sports tracking technology, trusted by elite athletes across golf, baseball, and football
A collaborative, cross-functional team with 40+ highly skilled colleagues from more than 35 nationalities
Exposure to cutting-edge technology — radar, computer vision, real-time data, and AI — in a unique product domain
An open, informal, and ambitious company culture where great ideas are heard and innovation is encouraged
Continuous learning and growth opportunities as Trackman scales
Social activities and a vibrant team culture

The Office

We are located at DTU Science Park in Hørsholm. We take great pride in the state-of-art building we have designed! The office features bright meeting rooms, coffee areas to catch up with colleagues, a large testing arena with simulators available for employees and a fitness center, everything surrounded by a beautiful forest and respecting the environment. We made sure to utilize the newest technologies to be energy efficient and be mindful of ventilation and sound propagation. The cherry on top is our canteen: with an indoor and outdoor area to enjoy the fresh food prepared by our own kitchen staff.

Join the home of a powerful sports brand and a one-of-a-kind technology

Our proprietary technology is based on expert knowledge about radar, computer vision, data, and software engineering. Our solutions are developed by specialists who endlessly explore and challenge new technical boundaries. Trackman’s blend of cutting-edge technology, sports, and continued growth make our company an outstanding place to work.

Our work culture is entrepreneurial, ambitious, and rewarding as you get to collaborate with inspiring colleagues and interact with the leaders of golf, baseball, and football. Based on a unique brand reputation, we are proud to work in close partnership with the top athletes, organizations, and teams that rely on our technology to stay ahead of the race.

We are a Danish company founded, owned, and managed since 2003 by three entrepreneurs with a strong passion for sports. Today, we have a global footprint with our headquarters located in Denmark (Hørsholm) and offices in New York, Phoenix, Seoul and Tokyo. We employ over 1000+ people worldwide, half of which work in Denmark, where most hardware and software products are developed, tested, and manufactured.

Where innovation happens

At Trackman, we know that great people make great products. We believe that teams thrive, and innovation sparks in an atmosphere where people are encouraged to think for themselves, where everybody’s voices are heard, and where the best ideas prevail in the pursuit of exceptional solutions. This mix makes Trackman an inspiring company – for our customers and colleagues.

Share our Passion!

Applications are continuously assessed, so please send your application as soon as possible.

jobs.description:
Game Engineer - Tech Pod

SYBO
is part of the Miniclip family and known for the widely popular game, Subway Surfers - the most downloaded mobile game in the world, with over four and a half billion downloads. Located in the heart of Copenhagen, we aim to create playful moments that inspire our fans to care.

Hundreds of millions of players play Subway Surfers
each month, and enjoy smooth gameplay, new features and a concept that’s now worked for over fourteen (Yes, 14!) years - and we’re looking for a talented Game Engineer for our Tech Pod
to make sure the game and the technology behind it keeps running.

As a Game Engineer - Tech Pod, you’ll work closely with engineers and other disciplines to develop the systems, integrations, and technical foundations behind Subway Surfers. You’ll have the opportunity to take ownership, contribute to technical decisions, and help us continuously improve the game, its technology, and the way we build it.

Nothing’s worse than playing an unstable game. If unstable gaming annoys you, make you'll take enjoyment in making stable games for others. More below!

Responsibilities

Develop and maintain systems, platform capabilities, and SDK integrations that enable us to deliver new features and content for Subway Surfers using Unity, C#, and native code
Collaborate with other Engineers to take technical solutions from concept through implementation and release
Write clean, maintainable code and contribute to the long-term health of the Subway Surfers codebase
Review code and collaborate with other Engineers to share knowledge and maintain engineering quality
Debug and resolve issues across Unity, native platform code, backend integrations, and live systems
Integrate Subway Surfers with SYBO's platform and backend services, bringing shared platform capabilities into the game
Integrate and maintain third-party SDKs and services across iOS and Android
Contribute to improving our CI/CD pipelines, tools, workflows, and development practices, including Jenkins

Life at SYBO

In your first month
, you’ll get to know SYBO, Subway Surfers, our technology, and how the team works. You’ll work closely with the Technical Owner and other Engineers in the Tech Pod, familiarize yourself with the codebase, development and release pipelines, platform integrations, and key technical systems, and start making your first contributions.

In your first three months
, you’ll be contributing independently to systems and integrations and taking an active role in the team’s development process. You’ll work with both SYBO platform services and third-party SDKs, participate in technical discussions around implementation, system design, and architecture, and become increasingly comfortable working across the Subway Surfers technology stack.

In your first twelve months
, you’ll be a trusted and impactful member of the Subway Surfers team, contributing to technical systems and integrations from planning through release. You’ll help shape solutions across the game, platform integrations, and development pipeline that allow us to reliably deliver Subway Surfers to hundreds of millions of players.

Requirements

Strong knowledge of OOP languages, primarily C#
Solid experience developing games in Unity, ideally for mobile
Good understanding of software engineering principles, data structures, algorithms, and common design patterns
Experience writing native code for iOS and Android
Experience working with version control systems such as Git
Experience integrating client applications with backend services and APIs
Experience working in Agile methodologies

Bonus points

Experience with mobile build and release processes for the App Store and Google Play
Experience working with CI/CD pipelines and tools such as Jenkins

About SYBO

We're SYBO, the mobile games studio behind the legendary Subway Surfers, with over 4.5 billion downloads worldwide! Join our team in the heart of Copenhagen, where creativity flourishes in our new, state-of-the-art studio.

If you join us, you'll have the opportunity to dive into exciting and creative projects alongside a diverse group of like-minded colleagues from over 40 countries across the globe.

We truly believe you perform your best, when you have the equipment you need - and our IT team is always on hand to ensure you have access to the latest tools and gear, enabling you to be at your best - even remotely with a home-office budget!

We also pride ourselves in taking care of your well-being, offering a delicious lunch buffet, a variety of healthy snacks, and regular social events to keep the energy flowing.

Not in Copenhagen? Not a problem! We have in-house relocation specialists who will help you relocate, and feel right at home in Copenhagen and at SYBO!

SYBO is committed to providing equal opportunities to all applicants, regardless of race, religion, sex, national origin, age, disability, genetic information, marital status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law.

jobs.description:
Are you at the beginning of your software development career and motivated to develop reliable solutions that support research and drug development?

Minerva Imaging is seeking a Junior Python Developer with an interest in backend development to join our innovative Digital Solutions and Technology department.
Whether you are newly graduated or have a few years of experience, we offer the opportunity to grow your skills while working with experienced colleagues in a collaborative development team.

About the Role

In this role, you will primarily work with our core internal application for managing and streamlining data capture and reporting across research workflows, and a new initiative using data from this application. You will work closely with the development team on shared solutions while also taking responsibility for smaller, clearly defined development tasks of your own. Together, you will develop new features, improve existing functionality, and help ensure that our applications remain reliable, maintainable, and aligned with real operational needs. You will also collaborate with colleagues across the organization to understand requirements and continuously improve our internal solutions.

Key Responsibilities

Develop and maintain functionality in our internal Python applications as part of the development team.
Collaborate with operations, research and other departments to understand requirements and contribute to practical solutions.
Develop clear, maintainable, and efficient code in Python and Django with guidance from senior colleagues.
Create and maintain documentation for the solutions you help develop.
Participate in testing, troubleshooting, code reviews, and continuous improvement of code quality and development practices.
Use AI-assisted development tools in a structured, secure, compliant, and measurable way.
Contribute actively to the development team by asking questions, sharing knowledge, and learning from feedback.

Qualifications

A completed Datamatiker education, Datatekniker med speciale i programmering education, or a comparable software development education.
Experience with Python from education, an internship, student work, personal projects, or professional employment.
Basic understanding of object-oriented programming, databases, APIs, and version control.
Interest in backend and frontend development and web applications. Experience with Django is an advantage but not a requirement.
A structured and curious approach to problem-solving, with a willingness to learn and ask for help when needed.
Ability to work both independently and as part of a team.
Professional communication skills in English.

Preferred Qualifications

Experience with Django or another web framework.
Experience with Git and collaborative development workflows.
Basic experience with SQL and relational databases.
Familiarity with HTML, CSS, JavaScript, HTMX, Alpine.js, or modern front-end frameworks.
Familiarity with automated testing, DevOps, or CI/CD.
Experience with AI-assisted software development.
Understanding of secure and compliant AI usage, including traceability and avoidance of data leakage.
Experience within life sciences or regulated environments.
Professional communication skills in Danish, as you will collaborate mostly with Danish-speaking colleagues and users.

On-Site Requirement
This position is on-site, and the successful candidate must be able to participate in on-site interviews and work at the offices in our facility in Ølstykke.

Minerva offers:

We believe in creating an agile working environment, so we have flexible working options including the option of working from home. We care about our employees’ well-being and offer health insurance and a quality conscious lunch scheme and monthly social activities.
We are an informal organization with a strong focus on open and honest communication. We value humour and a natural care for one another.

Application:

Please submit your application to us no later than 31-10-2026. The application must include a motivated cover letter and a CV addressing the listed qualifications. Applications will be evaluated continuously.
If you have questions regarding the position, please contact Jacob Breiting Sönnichsen at jbs@minervaimaging.com

About Minerva Imaging:

Minerva Imaging is a scientifically driven and fully integrated Contract Research Organization (CRO) and Contract Development and Manufacturing Organization (CDMO) specializing in targeted radionuclide therapies.

We support translational research and drug development through the use of advanced preclinical animal models within oncology and cardiovascular diseases, combined with state-of-the-art in vivo molecular imaging. By working in close partnership with our sponsors, we seek to understand their scientific challenges and jointly identify how our expertise, technologies, and methods can deliver robust and meaningful answers.

Our modern facility in Ølstykke, Denmark offers best-in-class, fully integrated radiopharmaceutical research, development, and manufacturing capabilities - covering the entire value chain from early research to clinical supply.

Backed by Nordic Capital since 2026, Minerva Imaging is executing an ambitious growth strategy aimed at strengthening our position as a market leader within targeted radionuclide therapies. This growth journey offers exciting opportunities for individuals who want to contribute to cutting-edge science in a dynamic and international environment.

Minerva Imaging is an equal opportunity employer, and we welcome applications from qualified candidates regardless of background or experience. In accordance with our recruitment policy, all candidates are required to provide a personal criminal record as part of the hiring process.

Follow us on LinkedIn for the latest news updates or visit www.minervaimaging.com for more information.

For at imødekomme den stigende efterspørgsel og vækst på virksomhedens helhedsløsninger søges der nu en fagligt stærk og innovativ BC-udvikler.

Moderne ERP-udvikling i Microsoft Dynamics 365 Business Central

Brænder du for Business Central-udvikling, og ønsker du at arbejde med moderne ERP-løsninger?
Så er dette en spændende mulighed for at bringe dine udviklingskompetencer og din tekniske forretningsforståelse i spil hos en af Danmarks førende Microsoft-partnere inden for ERP-løsninger. Der tilbydes en alsidig stilling med stor frihed, fagligt ansvar og mulighed for at præge løsningerne fra idé til implementering. Festina Finance develops modern, high‑performance software used by banks and financial institutions across the Nordics and Europe. Our Advisor platform is a 360° financial advisory solution that helps bank and pension advisors guide customers through credit, mortgage, pension, wealth, and investment decisions.
Advisor is designed to be country‑agnostic and is already live in Denmark, with active expansion into the Nordics, EU, and the UK. We are now looking for a skilled Software Developer to help shape the next generation of the platform.

Why This Role Matters

Financial advisors rely on Advisor to deliver precise, compliant, and trustworthy guidance to their customers. The platform must handle complex financial logic, integrate seamlessly with banking systems, and scale across countries, products, and regulatory environments.

As a developer on the Advisor team, you will:
build the financial modelling foundation that powers real advisory conversations
ensure that forecasts, key figures, and recommendations are correct and explainable
design integrations that connect Advisor to the broader banking ecosystem
contribute to a platform used daily by advisors across multiple markets

Your work directly influences how financial decisions are made, from mortgages and pensions to investments and long‑term planning.

About the Role

You will join a cross‑functional team of developers, business analysts, and domain experts working on the core of the Advisor platform. The role combines deep domain logic with solid engineering practices, and you will work across modelling, integrations, data flows, and system behavior.
You will be involved in the full development life cycle: from understanding requirements and refining domain logic to implementing features, improving performance, and ensuring long‑term maintainability.

What You Will Work On

Develop and maintain the 360° financial modelling foundation across credit, pensions, wealth, and investments
Build and improve integrations with external banking systems and financial APIs
Work with complex data models in a layered, multi‑customer, multi‑country architecture
Collaborate with analysts, domain experts, and customers to turn requirements into production‑ready code
Ensure code quality through testing, documentation, and thorough code review

How We Build Software

Java‑based backend with strong domain‑driven design principles
Cloud‑native architecture containerized with Docker and orchestrated on Kubernetes
Multi‑tenant, layered platform designed for country‑ and customer‑specific extensibility
REST APIs with OpenAPI specifications
Strong emphasis on automated testing, static analysis, CI/CD, and code quality
Increasingly AI‑augmented workflows we invest actively in AI tooling and expect developers to help shape how we use it

What You Bring

You are a developer who enjoys working with domain‑rich systems and solving real business problems through high‑quality engineering.
You have experience with, or a genuine interest in the financial domain, whether that’s banking, credit, pension, insurance, or similar areas.
We welcome applicants at different stages of their career whether you are fresh out of university and ready to learn, or you bring some hands-on experience and want to take the next step.
You’re naturally curious and enjoy learning new domains, technologies, or better ways of solving problems. Collaboration comes easily to you, and you like working closely with developers, analysts, domain experts, and customers. You communicate openly, take initiative, and aren’t afraid to ask questions or challenge assumptions when something doesn’t add up.
Most importantly, you care about the why behind what you build not just the how and you take pride in delivering solutions that are robust, well‑designed, and built to last.

jobs.title: Senior Software Developer
jobs.location: Copenhagen, Capital Region of Denmark, Denmark
jobs.description:
With a passion for life

Join our diverse teams of passionate people and a career that allows you to develop both personally and professionally. At Getinge we exist to make life-saving technology accessible for more people. To make a true difference for our customers – and to save more lives, we need team players, forward thinkers, and game changers.

Are you looking for an inspiring career? You just found it.

Plenty of developers have tried an AI agent. Fewer have run several in parallel, built their own tooling to keep them on track, and worked out exactly where they shine and where they still fall over. If you are on top of these things and want to contribute to the build-up of an agentic software organization, we should talk.

Getinge is looking for Senior .NET Developers in Copenhagen. You will be building software that hospitals around the world depend on every day, and you will be helping shape how a large software organization adopts AI. We have several positions open.

What You Would Be Building

Getinge is a global MedTech company, and our teams in Copenhagen, Hamburg and Aarhus build software that runs at the heart of a modern hospital. Our solutions track surgical instruments through sterile reprocessing with full traceability, orchestrate fleets of robots and reprocessing equipment, plan and optimize the surgical day, coordinate patient flow and staff in real time, and keep thousands of connected medical devices running in the field.

Our software is mission-critical, deeply integrated with hospital IT and physical equipment, and built to a high standard of quality. It is also software where the impact is immediate and real: better use of an operating room, an instrument set that arrives on time, a surgery that goes ahead instead of being cancelled. Not everyone gets to end the week knowing their work helped someone get treated.

What We Work With

Our teams work primarily in C#/.Net &Blazor, with focus on containerization and cloud deployment to Azure, across the organization that spans web and mobile applications, cloud services, real-time systems, and integration with physical equipment.

We are not looking for a checklist match for all of it. What matters is that you are strong in .NET, that you are comfortable working across a stack rather than in one corner of it, and that you pick new things up quickly. The exact mix varies by team, and we will find the right fit together.

Where we are with AI

We are currently in the process of accelerating our software factory with AI. Our teams have been exploring AI-assisted and agentic development processes for some time and are implementing our learnings. However, we are seeking additional fresh perspectives on the matter. This is where you come in.

If you have real experience here and strong opinions about what works, you will find both room to use them and colleagues who will argue back.

Our developers have access to the latest models and a meaningful budget for AI tooling and usage, and we are also looking at introducing new and improved methods and tools to improve our way of working.

What You Will Do

Design, build, and maintain robust .NET services and applications for mission-critical hospital software.
Build and integrate agentic AI capabilities – designing, orchestrating, and evaluating AI agents and LLM-driven workflows in our products and in how we work.
Drive AI adoption in your team and across the organization, setting the standard for how modern tooling improves quality, speed, and value delivered.
Contribute to system architecture, code quality, and engineering practices.
Work closely with product owners, architects, UX/UI, and developers across multiple sites.

You will bring

Strong .NET expertise – deep, hands-on experience building and maintaining production software in C# and modern .NET.
Breadth and adaptability – you are happy to work across the stack and into the cloud, and you are not thrown by a technology you have not used before.
Real depth with AI in practice – you use AI tools in your daily work, you are hands-on with agents and LLM-driven workflows, and you can point to things you have actually built with them. We care more about what you have done and how you think about it than about years on a CV.
A proactive, positive, and constructive mindset – you take ownership from start to finish, communicate openly, and make the people around you better.
The ability to build maintainable, high-quality solutions and to work independently as well as in a team.

Nice to have

Experience with hardware–software integration, robotics, or embedded systems.
Experience with event-driven architecture, messaging, or distributed systems.
Experience working in Agile teams on regulated or safety-critical products.

What We Offer

Getinge is a leading global provider of products and systems that improve healthcare quality and efficiency, with the ambition to be the most desired MedTech company in the world. You would join our Digital Health Solutions department, which counts around 165 people across Denmark, Germany, and the UK, plus a further 100 colleagues in Getinge offices globally.

A smart working environment with shared desks, several work-from-home days per week, and a budget for your home office setup.
Flexible working hours.
Competitive benefits including health insurance and pension.
Opportunities for professional growth and continuous learning.
A collaborative, inclusive, and motivating culture.

Application

Applications will be reviewed continually, and we therefore recommend sending us your application as soon as possible, but no later than 17-10-2026

We kindly ask you to submit your application in our recruitment system by clicking the “apply now” button. Due to GDPR regulations we do not accept applications via e-mail.

If you have any questions regarding the role, please contact Talent Acquisition Partner Joakim Martinsson at joakim.martinsson@getinge.com

We look forward to receiving your application. We hope you will join us on our journey to become the world’s most desired MedTech company.

About Us 

With a firm belief that every person and community should have access to the best possible care, Getinge provides hospitals and life science institutions with products and solutions aiming to improve clinical results and optimize workflows. The offering includes products and solutions for intensive care, cardiovascular procedures, operating rooms, sterile reprocessing and life science. Getinge employs over 12,000 people worldwide and the products are sold in more than 135 countries.

Reasonable accommodations are available upon request for candidates taking part in all aspects of the selection process.

The DevOps Engineer will maintain scalable, secure, and highly available cloud infrastructure on AWS. This role is responsible for supporting development stacks in Java and .NET, automating deployment pipelines using tools such as Jenkins, optimizing system performance, and ensuring reliability through robust monitoring and incident response practices. Working closely with development, platform, and DBA teams, the engineer will enable efficient CI/CD workflows, container orchestration using Docker and Kubernetes, and database performance optimization for relational database systems (Oracle, MS SQL Server, PostgreSQL). The role also drives continuous improvement by adopting cloud-native technologies, enhancing security and compliance standards, and promoting DevOps best practices across the organization.

Accountabilities:

Maintain scalable, secure AWS infrastructure supporting diverse application stacks and database engines.
Support software development teams by integrating Java and .NET build, test, and release processes into automated delivery pipelines.
Build and optimize CI/CD pipelines using Jenkins to enable reliable and automated deployments.
Implement and manage containerized environments using Docker and Kubernetes (e.g., EKS).
Monitor, analyze, and fine-tune database performance, query execution plans, and resource utilization across enterprise database platforms (Oracle, MS SQL Server, PostgreSQL).
Ensure high availability, rapid incident response, and continuous optimization of cloud and database workloads.
Collaborate with cross-functional teams to improve automation, software delivery, database optimization, and security practices.

Responsibilities:

Manage application build and deployment lifecycles for Java and .NET applications.
Develop and maintain CI/CD pipelines using Jenkins for automated build, test, and deployment.
Provision and manage AWS infrastructure and managed database services.
Analyze slow queries, review execution plans, and implement performance fine-tuning strategies (e.g., indexing, query refactoring, table partitioning, parameter group tuning) for Oracle, MS SQL Server, and PostgreSQL.
Deploy and manage containerized applications using Docker and Kubernetes, ensuring proper runtime configuration for JVM memory and .NET application environments.
Monitor system and database performance, troubleshooting bottlenecks, high CPU/memory utilization, and connection pooling issues to ensure maximum availability.
Implement and enforce security, access control, backup/recovery strategies, and operational best practices across dev, test, and production environments.

Team Scope / Stakeholders:

Collaborate with Java and .NET Software Engineering teams to streamline build configurations, application packaging, and release workflows.
Work with Database Administration (DBA) teams to optimize SQL queries, improve database performance, and enable efficient release processes.
Partner with Cloud/Platform Engineering to design and maintain scalable AWS infrastructure.
Work closely with QA and Testing teams to integrate automated performance and integration testing within CI/CD pipelines.
Engage with Security teams to ensure compliance with security policies, database access control, and data protection standards.
Support Product Owners and Business stakeholders by ensuring reliable, high-performing, and timely delivery of applications and services.

Requirements:

Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
3–5+ years of experience in DevOps, cloud engineering, or database reliability roles.

Programming & Development Skills:

Strong knowledge of Java development ecosystems and build tooling (e.g., Maven, Gradle, JVM tuning).
Strong knowledge of .NET / C# development ecosystems and build tooling (e.g., .NET CLI, MSBuild, .NET Core / .NET 6+).
Proficiency in scripting and operational programming (e.g., Python, Bash, Shell) for automation.
Proficient in writing, debugging, and optimizing complex SQL queries.

Cloud, DevOps & Database Skills:

Hands-on experience with AWS services (e.g., EC2, S3, RDS, IAM, EKS).
Strong experience in CI/CD tools, particularly Jenkins, and version control systems (e.g., Git).
Strong experience in relational database query optimization and performance fine-tuning for Oracle, MS SQL Server, and PostgreSQL (e.g., execution plan analysis, indexing strategies, deadlocks, lock escalation, buffer pool usage).
Proficiency in database performance monitoring tools (e.g., AWS RDS Performance Insights, Oracle AWR/ADDM, SQL Server Execution Plans/Profiler, PostgreSQL EXPLAIN ANALYZE / pg_stat_statements).
Proficiency in Infrastructure as Code tools such as Terraform or CloudFormation.
Experience with containerization and orchestration using Docker and Kubernetes.
Familiarity with application and infrastructure monitoring tools (e.g., CloudWatch, Prometheus, Grafana).
Proven ability to troubleshoot complex systems, diagnose performance bottlenecks, and work in a fast-paced, collaborative environment.

Who we are

Do you want to join our Geo-data revolution? Fugro’s global reach and unique know-how will put the world at your fingertips. Our love of exploration and technical expertise help us to provide our clients with invaluable insights. We source and make sense of the most relevant Geo-data for their needs, so they can design, build and operate their assets more safely, sustainably and efficiently. But we’re always looking for new talent to take the next step with us. For bright minds who enjoy meaningful work and want to push our pioneering spirit further. For individuals who can take the initiative but work well within a team.

The AI Architect is the technical authority responsible for designing secure, scalable and cost-efficient AI architectures for APAC deployments. The role defines technical standards, patterns and guardrails across models, data pipelines, APIs, cloud infrastructure and security layers, ensuring solutions align with global governance while meeting APAC data sovereignty and regulatory requirements. The role provides technical direction to the team, supporting the design, build, maintenance and continuous improvement of advanced AI and automation solutions. You will design and maintain the architecture for the AI enabled Marine Ground Digital Twin Platform.

This is a 3-year fixed term contract for placement in Singapore, and only open to SG/PR candidates.

Architecture Design & Standards

Design scalable, secure and cost-efficient AI system architectures for regional deployments.
Define and enforce technical standards, design patterns and architectural guardrails for the team.
Lead build vs buy vs integrate decisions, evaluating platforms and vendors.
Produce architecture artefacts (solution designs, data flows, integration maps, technical roadmaps).

Cloud & Infrastructure

This is a unique opportunity to shape the future of AI in semiconductor manufacturing and directly contribute to Micron's vision of autonomous, data-driven operations worldwide.

GIC is one of the world's largest sovereign wealth funds. Strategy, Architecture, and Transformation Group

The Strategy, Architecture & Transformation (SAT) group shapes and drives GIC’s technology strategy, ensuring alignment with business priorities and enterprise goals. Bringing together expertise in strategy, architecture, engineering, and transformation, the team strengthens governance, promotes consistency, and accelerates delivery across the Technology Group. Through modern practices and close collaboration, SAT leads the development of an architectural strategy that reinforces oversight and accountability while enabling reliable, scalable solutions and informed decision making across the Technology Group and, more broadly, across GIC.

Developer Experience

The Developer Experience team builds and operates the products and platforms that support the developer experience across GIC's Technology Group. The team is organised around three product pillars:

Project Management Tooling — Platforms such as Jira and Confluence that support project tracking, collaboration, and workflow management across the Technology Group.
Cloud Development Environments & IDEs — Cloud-based development environments, AI-assisted coding tools, developer toolchains (CLIs, SDKs, IDE extensions, devcontainer features), and agentic development capabilities.
DevSecOps & CI/CD — CI/CD pipelines, artifact management, security scanning integration, infrastructure-as-code, and secure software delivery tooling.

What impact can you make in this role?

As a Product Engineer responsible for Developer Acceleration, you will build and operate the infrastructure that enables hundreds of employees to be productive through our agentic cloud development platform. By joining this team, you will have a direct impact on the velocity and quality of software engineering at GIC. You will evolve our agentic cloud development platform, shape the next generation of the agentic SDLC, and transform how software is built and delivered across GIC.

You are a platform engineer who is also an AI-native developer: you use coding agents as core engineering tools across specification, design, implementation, testing, and review, while applying sound engineering judgement and remaining accountable for the quality, security, and operability of the software you ship.

What will you do as a Product Engineer (Developer Acceleration)?

You will work across three connected areas: platform and infrastructure engineering, developer tooling and governance, and AI-native development and agent enablement.
Operate and evolve the agentic cloud development platform, covering infrastructure, networking, deployment automation, devcontainer lifecycle, observability, security, and governance.
Address developer needs, resolve platform issues, and build processes and integrations that connect the platform with enterprise development services and systems.
Govern the developer tools estate — evaluate, onboard, secure, and manage the lifecycle of IDEs, extensions, SDKs, CLIs, and AI coding tools through clear guardrails and paved paths.
Drive AI-native development across GIC — establish reusable practices, context engineering, MCP integrations, and reference workflows, and provide clear guidance and enablement to accelerate adoption across teams.
Build and integrate the agentic SDLC platform — develop agent execution and human review workflows that connect project management tools, source control, and CI/CD to enable end-to-end delivery.
Collaborate with infra and security teams to ensure platform capabilities meet requirements for observability, resilience, and compliance.

Experience
6+ years of experience in software, platform, or infrastructure engineering, including hands-on ownership of developer platforms or large-scale distributed systems in production.
2+ years of experience leading complex, cross-team engineering initiatives as an engineer or technical lead.
Strong programming proficiency in one or more of Python, Java, C#/.NET, or JavaScript/TypeScript.
Strong AWS expertise, including EC2, VPC networking, IAM, EKS or ECS, CloudWatch, and S3.
Strong experience with infrastructure as code and automation using Terraform and/or AWS CloudFormation, CI/CD pipelines, and GitOps practices.
Deep familiarity with containerised development, including devcontainers, image build pipelines, and dependency management.
Security-first engineering experience covering network segmentation, least-privilege access, and operation in regulated technology environments.
Demonstrated AI-native development practice — hands-on use of coding agents across the software development lifecycle, with the ability to recognise their limitations and validate AI-generated code before release.
Clear technical communication — able to write guidance, run enablement sessions, and explain trade-offs to technical and non-technical audiences.

Demonstrated ability to think about engineering work through a product lens — understanding users, measuring outcomes, and iterating based on feedback.

Experience working in agile teams with a focus on incremental delivery.

Governance & Ways of Working
Ability to balance developer experience and autonomy with enterprise requirements for security, standardisation, and cost control.
Strong stakeholder management skills, with the ability to work across engineering, platform, and cybersecurity teams.
Comfortable navigating competing priorities and driving alignment.

Personal Attributes
Clear and effective communicator, both written and verbal.
Pragmatic, structured, and outcome-focused.

Suvoda is a global clinical trial technology company shaping digital experiences that enable clinical trial sponsor and site professionals to take full command over the inherent logistical complexity behind mission-critical and time-sensitive patient interactions in life-sustaining studies for therapeutic areas such as oncology, central nervous system, and rare disease.

Supporting clinical trials means supporting unique experiments that are inherently complex, high-stakes, and dynamic. It is imperative that Suvoda staff working with clients, end-users, or the systems that client and end-users interact with understand the clinical trial industry, regulations, Suvoda’s software products and processes, and especially the specificities of the unique trial in question before taking any actions they may alter the data of the system in question.

Responsibilities

Work within a cross-functional project team to develop Interactive Response Technology (IRT) for randomization and drug supply management
Review user requirements specifications, verifying that all requirements can be implemented with the Suvoda software in the required timeframe
Assist with the creation of implementation design and technical design documentation
Develop software systems that are reliable, maintainable, and efficient, with emphasis on patient safety and integrity of clinical study data
Manage the deployment of Suvoda IRT systems into all environments, completing all required documentation
Assist the support team with troubleshooting and resolution of issues reported on production systems
Participate in the product research and development process by providing the engineering team with new solutions and ideas based on project experience
Generate ideas for innovative technological solutions to increase the quality of Suvoda system
Perform other related duties as required

Requirements

Bachelor’s degree preferred
At least 2 years of experience in a similar role
Prior working experience in developing web applications with C#, .NET (Framework or Core), SQL Server, Model View Controller (MVC) and Entity Framework (EF)
High achieving personality
Desire to learn and grow
Strong work ethic
Sense of ownership
Proactive attitude
Time management and organizational skills
Attention to detail

We are aware that an individual(s) are fraudulently representing themselves as Suvoda recruiters and/or hiring managers. Suvoda will never request personal information such as your bank account number, credit card number, drivers license or social security number — or request payment from you — during the job application or interview process. Any emails from the Suvoda recruiting team will come from a @suvoda.com email address. You can learn more about these types of fraud by referring to this FTC consumer alert.

As set forth in Suvoda’s Equal Employment Opportunity policy, we do not discriminate on the basis of any protected group status under any applicable law.

We don’t simply hire employees. We invest in them. When you work at Chatham, we empower you — offering professional development opportunities to help you grow in your career, no matter if you've been here for five months or 15 years. As a Full Stack Engineer within the Product Engineering department, you will contribute to the design, development, and operation of applications used by Chatham’s clients and internal teams.

In This Role You Will

Develop innovative, high-quality, and robust financial applications and microservices as part of our growing application development team.
Work as a member of an Agile Scrum team that owns the development and ongoing evolution of a specific product or platform.
Collaborate with software engineering teams, designers, quantitative analysts, product owners, product managers, and business stakeholders.

Create automated unit, integration, and front-end tests using frameworks such as xUnit, Moq, NSubstitute, Cypress, and Playwright.
Implement and improve build, test, and deployment workflows through CI/CD pipelines using Docker, YAML, and GitHub Actions.
Contribute to technical design discussions, code reviews, troubleshooting, and continuous improvement across the software development lifecycle.

Your Impact

As a Full Stack Engineer, you will play an important role in building and evolving Chatham’s technology platforms. You will deliver reliable, scalable, and maintainable software that supports both client-facing products and internal

business applications.

Your work will directly contribute to product functionality, user experience, platform quality, and engineering efficiency. You will help translate complex business requirements into effective technical solutions while contributing to a collaborative and continuously improving engineering culture.

Experience working with complex applications.

Strong collaboration and interpersonal skills.

Knowledge of Domain-Driven Design.
Experience with Ruby or Python.
Experience with microservices or event-driven systems.
Experience with Docker or Kubernetes.
Familiarity with Terraform, Bicep, or other Infrastructure as Code tools.
Experience with Azure services such as Azure Container Apps, Service Bus, Azure SQL, Key Vault, or Application Insights.
Experience in financial services or another complex business domain.
Experience working with distributed or geographically dispersed teams.

Chatham Financial is the leading independent capital markets advisor, delivering an integrated blend of expert advice and powerful technology to help you reduce risk and seize opportunity. With decades of capital markets strategy, execution, monitoring, and performance expertise, we serve as an unwavering advocate for your best interests and your innovation partner. Our technology platform unifies data across assets, debt, and derivatives, giving you unmatched agility, transparency, and insight.

It’s clear ahead.

Could that be you?

Join UiPath to build and evolve products that drive company growth. You'll develop and maintain an internal observability platform that shapes our commercial strategy through usage analytics, create a seamless e-commerce experience giving clients instant product access and work on RPA development infrastructure with pipelines and source control.

You'll work as a full-stack engineer with .NET, TypeScript, and SQL, handling development through deployment. You'll tackle real engineering challenges-from building new features to optimizing data flows and ensuring system reliability. We offer opportunities to learn data engineering, and diverse technologies across our portfolio. If you're eager to build, continuously learn, and make an impact, this role offers that opportunity.

What You'll Do At UiPath

Plan, design, develop, and test software systems or applications for enhancements and new features, including cloud-based tools.
Collaborate with cross-functional teams across UiPath to design and engineer product areas and services.
Ensure technical deliverables meet expectations for quality, security, scalability, modifiability, extensibility, and testability.
Contribute to the establishment of effective and agile engineering practices.
Identify performance bottlenecks and bugs; implement solutions to address them.
Plan feature development, design system components, and contribute to the engineering roadmap.
Maintain code quality, organization, and automation.

What You'll Bring To The Team

4+ years of experience in a software engineering role using high-level languages (C#, C++, Java, Python, Rust, etc.)
Strong grasp of object-oriented programming and architectural design patterns.
Knowledge of multithreading, synchronization, and asynchronous programming.
Solid understanding of data structures and algorithms.
Ability to write well-tested, high-quality code.
Familiarity with the latest versions of .NET and C# features.
Experience with other languages and technologies: C++, NodeJS, JavaScript, Angular, XAML.
Cloud services experience with one or more of: Azure (preferred), AWS, GCP.
Experience with data processing platforms and ETL/ELT pipelines (e.g. Snowflake, Azure Data Factory, Databricks, Spark, dbt).
Familiarity with modern data warehousing concepts, dimensional modeling, and analytics engineering best practices.

Maybe you don’t tick all the boxes above—but still think you’d be great for the job? Go ahead, apply anyway. Please. Because we know that experience comes in all shapes and sizes—and passion can’t be learned.

jobs.title: Software Engineer (AI-Native)
jobs.description:
Software Engineer

Despre noi

Suntem un start-up care sprijină SOLOprenorii în drumul lor spre succes. Peste 30.000 de freelanceri, medici, IT-iști și antreprenori români au ales în ultimii 5 ani să își gestioneze PFA-ul cu SOLO, și asta ne face și mai ambițioși. Vrem să ajungem cât mai curând la 100.000 de clienți activi. Misiunea noastră este să transformăm birocrația într-un sistem simplu, digital și automatizat.

Despre ce este rolul?

Construim un produs folosit deja de zeci de mii de oameni și vrem să-l ducem la următorul nivel.

Problema pe care o rezolvăm nu e simplă: legislație complicată, multe excepții și așteptări mari de la utilizatori.

Căutăm un engineer care vrea să contribuie la soluții reale și să crească într-un mediu cu impact direct în produs.

Misiunea ta în acest rol

Vei lucra pe probleme reale ale utilizatorilor noștri , unele bine definite, altele în curs de clarificare
Vei contribui la implementarea și îmbunătățirea sistemelor existente
Vei colabora cu echipa pentru a livra funcționalități în producție
Vei participa la decizii tehnice și vei învăța cum să le iei în timp
Vei folosi AI în workflow-ul tău pentru a crește viteza și calitatea

Ce ne dorim de la tine

2–4 ani experiență în dezvoltare software;
Experiență cu backend (ideal .NET Core, dar nu obligatoriu);
Experiență cu baze de date relaționale și modelare de date;
Capacitatea de a lucra pe probleme care nu sunt complet definite;
Interes pentru produs și modul în care este folosit de utilizatori;
Te folosești de AI (Cursor, Claude, Copilot sau similar) pentru a-ți îmbunătăți modul de lucru și înveți să validezi output-ul.

Ce oferim

Salariu competitiv (în funcție de nivel);
Zile nelimitate de concediu (pe care le și folosim);
Program flexibil;
Abonament premium la clinicile medicale Regina Maria;
Abonament Bookster;
Acces la tool-uri AI (Claude, Cursor, Copilot etc.) și buget de utilizare;
Lucrăm hibrid din București. Poți lucra până la 2 zile pe săptămână de acasă. În perioada de probă, te așteptăm zilnic la birou: e cea mai rapidă cale să înțelegi contextul, să cunoști echipa, și să ajungi să livrezi pe cont propriu.

Despre cum lucrăm în general

Modul În Care Lucrăm Este Influențat De Valorile În Care Credem Și Pe Care Ne Propunem Să Le Aplicăm În Tot Ce Facem

Creșterea continuă și accelerată e ceva fundamental - ne așteptăm de la fiecare coleg să își dorească să se dezvolte și să profite pe deplin de toate resursele pe care le punem la dispoziție pentru învățare. Apoi, ne așteptăm ca fiecare coleg să fie interesat mai ales de rezultat, nu doar de efort în sine.
Clientul este în centrul activității noastre: îi înțelegem nevoia reală, îl tratăm cu empatie și alegem soluții simple și clare pentru el. Facem toate acestea în timp ce ne comportăm cu bunăvoință unii față de alții, oferim și acceptăm feedback și menținem și consolidăm un spirit de echipă în care să ne regăsim cu toții.
Fiind un start-up, ne dorim alături oameni energici, curajosi, autonomi, cu o gândire dincolo de tipare, cu simțul umorului și cu o mare flexibilitate mentală, pentru că adesea realitatea din jur și activitățile noastre de zi cu zi se schimbă din mers în timp ce direcția rămâne clară: suntem aici pentru a sprijini SOLOprenorii.

at ORTEC LogiqCare, you will have a unique opportunity to explore the many facets of software engineering within an innovative, international organization.

is the business unit offering this role. GIDS delivers global omni-channel investor servicing, including contact centre, using digital services.

The Opportunity

We are looking to hire Mid and Senior AI Developers
to drive the technical evolution of our automation capability, moving beyond traditional RPA limits to build entirely new, highly sophisticated solutions that were previously impossible.

In this role, you will design and build resilient, code-first frameworks using Python, C# .NET, and Typescript
. You will own the technical design of end-to-end solutions, using Blue Prism Work HQ to manage RPA and Agentic processes.

This is a hands-on software engineering role for developers who want to pioneer next-generation intelligent automation, build complex tool-use infrastructure from scratch, and establish the development standards for a growing team.

What You Will Get To Do:

AI-Driven Development: Build, optimize, and maintain scalable automation workflows using Claude Code and modern AI development tools to accelerate software delivery and agentic workflows.
GenAI & Agentic Orchestration: Develop and deploy autonomous AI agents and skills that interact with advanced Large Language Models (LLMs) via the SS&C AI Gateway, seamlessly blending them with WHQ Agents and Digital Workers.
Modern UI Automation: Design and build robust, resilient automation frameworks targeting desktop applications via FlaUI and modern web systems using Playwright, completely moving away from legacy application spying techniques.
Enterprise Work Queue Management: Design and optimize high-throughput automation architectures utilizing Blue Prism v7 Work Queues (Work HQ) to manage transactional data, case locking, and exception handling for hybrid AI-human workflows.

Standards, Governance & Trust: Adhere to GIDS best practices, ensuring all automation components, WHQ Agents, and generative AI integrations comply with enterprise-grade security, data privacy, and ethical AI guardrails.

What You Will Bring:

Critical Software Engineering Skills

Python: Critical Requirement. Expert proficiency for AI/LLM tooling, data processing, and scripting agentic or web-based automation workflows (e.g., Playwright, LangChain).
C# .NET: Critical Requirement. Robust experience for building enterprise-grade backend integrations, custom automation solutions, and handling native desktop interactions via FlaUI.
TypeScript: Critical Requirement. Strong proficiency for modern web-based automation with Playwright, cloud functions, and front-end/API orchestration within advanced AI platforms.

Mandatory Database & SQL Competency

PostgreSQL: Mandatory Requirement. Advanced experience in designing, querying, and managing relational databases for transactional logging, configuration, and enterprise scaling.
MS SQL: Mandatory Requirement. Deep proficiency with Microsoft SQL Server, complex queries, indexing, and stored procedures to support backend enterprise systems.

Generative AI & Intelligent Automation

AI Development Tools: Hands-on experience with Claude Code, Anthropic APIs, and open-source AI frameworks to build autonomous systems.
Platform Integration: Proficiency in integrating enterprise environments, WHQ Agents, and Digital Workers with cloud-based AI ecosystems (e.g., AWS Bedrock, Azure OpenAI, Google Vertex AI).
Data Transformation: Expert knowledge in processing complex, unstructured data (emails, multi-page PDFs, legal documents) using GenAI extraction and advanced OCR tools.
Prompt Engineering: Deep understanding of advanced prompting techniques (Chain-of-Thought, Few-Shot, Retrieval-Augmented Generation) and token management.

Core Platform & Framework Infrastructure

UI Automation Libraries: Advanced, hands-on experience with Playwright for high-performance web testing/automation and FlaUI for reliable accessibility-based desktop automation.
Blue Prism Ecosystem: Strong experience with Blue Prism Enterprise v7.x (v7.4 or above preferred) with an emphasis on Control Room management, deployment, and backend API usage rather than traditional client-side studio development.
Queue Architecture: Mastery of Work Queues (Work HQ) configuration, priority tagging, and multi-robot queue consumption models.

Preferred Experience

Vector Databases: Nice-to-have experience with vector storage systems (e.g., Pinecone, Milvus, pgvector) to implement semantic search and advanced RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation) patterns.
Blue Prism Professional Developer Certification.
Experience transitioning traditional RPA architectures into code-first, AI-driven automation ecosystems involving hybrid WHQ Agents and Digital Workers.
Familiarity with Agile delivery methodologies, CI/CD pipelines, and LLMOps/DevOps practices.
Understanding of VPC environments (Azure / AWS)

PALMET Bilgi Teknolojileri, yaklaşık 2,5 milyonmüşteriye hizmet veren PALMET Grubu'nun teknoloji motorudur. Doğalgaz dağıtımından enerji üretimine uzanan kritik operasyonları destekleyen kurumsal yazılım ürünleri geliştiririz. Yüksek erişilebilirlik, veri yoğunluklu işlemler ve yapay zekâ entegrasyonu gündemimizin merkezindedir.

Bu rolde katman geliştiren değil; mimari kararlar alan, sistemin bütününü sahiplenen ve ekibin teknik kalitesini yukarı taşıyan bir Senior Fullstack Software Engineer arıyoruz. Altyapı ve DevSecOps süreçleri ayrı bir ekip tarafından yönetilmektedir; bu rol geliştirdiği mikroservislerin doğru containerize edilmesinden, GitLab CI/CD pipeline'ına uyumlu teslim edilmesinden ve platform standartlarına uymaktan sorumludur.

Sorumluluklar

• Kurumsal enerji uygulamalarının uçtan uca (frontend + backend + veritabanı) tasarımı ve geliştirilmesi
• Domain-Driven Design (DDD) prensipleriyle bounded context, aggregate ve domain event modellemesi yapmak
• Microservice mimarisi kapsamında servis sınırlarını belirlemek, servisler arası iletişim (REST / gRPC / message queue) tasarlamak
• RabbitMQ / Kafka gibi mesaj kuyruğu altyapılarıyla event-driven akışlar kurmak ve yönetmek
• Redis / distributed cache stratejileri tasarlamak; cache invalidation ve consistency politikalarını uygulamak
• MinIO / S3-uyumlu nesne depolama entegrasyonu; bucket politikaları, presigned URL ve uygulama katmanı kullanımı
• Entity Framework Core ile ORM katmanı kurmak; migration yönetimi, lazy/eager loading optimizasyonu ve N+1 sorunu çözümü
• MSSQL üzerinde T-SQL, stored procedure ve sorgu optimizasyonu; index stratejisi geliştirmek
• Geliştirdiği servisleri Dockerfile standartlarına uygun containerize etmek; DevOps ekibinin belirlediği GitLab CI/CD pipeline'ına uyumlu çalışmak
• CORS politikalarını uygulama katmanında doğru yapılandırmak; reverse proxy ve API gateway arkasında çalışacak servisleri buna göre tasarlamak
• Load balancer ve reverse proxy önünde çalışacak servislerin stateless, health-check uyumlu ve graceful shutdown destekli geliştirilmesini sağlamak
• Unit / integration test yazımı; code coverage hedeflerini belirlemek ve karşılamak (xUnit, NUnit, Moq)
• RESTful API tasarımı (OpenAPI/Swagger), versiyonlama ve geriye dönük uyumluluk yönetimi
• Yapay zekâ destekli özelliklerin ürünlere entegrasyonu; log analizi, anomali tespiti ve akıllı öneri mekanizmaları geliştirmek
• Code review kültürünü sürdürmek; teknik dokümantasyon ve ADR (Architecture Decision Record) yazmak

Aranan Nitelikler

• Bilgisayar Mühendisliği, Yazılım Mühendisliği veya ilgili bölümden mezun
• En az 5 yıl yazılım geliştirme deneyimi; bunun en az 2 yılı üretim ortamında fullstack projelerde
• Backend: C# / .NET 6+ — DDD, CQRS, Clean Architecture deneyimi
• ORM: Entity Framework Core — migration, performans optimizasyonu, repository pattern
• Frontend: React, Angular veya Vue.js ile üretim ölçekli SPA geliştirme deneyimi
• Mesajlaşma: RabbitMQ veya Kafka ile event-driven / async iletişim deneyimi
• Cache: Redis veya benzeri distributed cache altyapısı kullanımı
• Nesne Depolama: MinIO (S3-uyumlu) — SDK entegrasyonu, bucket yönetimi, presigned URL kullanımı
• Veritabanı: MSSQL / PostgreSQL — T-SQL, stored procedure, index ve sorgu optimizasyonu
• API & Ağ: REST API tasarımı, CORS yönetimi; reverse proxy ve API gateway arkasında çalışacak servis geliştirme
• Test: Unit ve integration test yazımı, code coverage metrikleri takibi
• Containerization: Dockerfile yazımı, image optimizasyonu, multi-stage build
• CI/CD: GitLab CI pipeline'ına uyumlu çalışma; merge request, branch stratejisi, environment değişkeni yönetimi
• Versiyon Kontrol: Git-flow, branch stratejisi, GitLab merge request süreci
• Analitik düşünce yapısı, teknik sahiplenme ve çözüm odaklılık

Tercihen

• gRPC ile servisler arası iletişim deneyimi
• Kubernetes ortamında çalışan servisler geliştirme deneyimi (Helm values, liveness/readiness probe, resource limit tanımları)
• OpenTelemetry ile distributed tracing ve structured logging deneyimi
• OAuth2 / OpenID Connect — Keycloak entegrasyonu
• On-premise LLM inference (Ollama, vLLM vb.) veya model entegrasyonu deneyimi
• Enerji, finans veya telecom gibi regulated / mission-critical sektörlerde proje deneyimi
• Teknik mentorluk veya küçük ekip yönlendirme tecrübesi

Enerji altyapısının dijital omurgasını cloud-native ve event-driven mimarilerle yeniden inşa ederken, yapay zekâ destekli yeni nesil ürünler geliştirmek isteyen mühendisleri ekibimize bekliyoruz.

Vegasoft, Londra merkezli bir yazılım stüdyosu. B2B müşteriler için yüksek performanslı web platformları, özel yazılım çözümleri ve dönüşüm odaklı e-ticaret sistemleri geliştiriyoruz. Şu anda iki ürünümüzü aynı anda inşa ediyoruz ve ekibimizi büyütüyoruz.

Bu pozisyonda geleneksel anlamda sadece kod yazmayacaksın. Cursor, Claude Code, GitHub Copilot, v0 gibi araçları kullanarak gerçek projeler üzerinde çalışacak ve ortaya canlıya çıkan ürünler koyacaksın.

Üzerinde çalışacağın ürünler

İki ekipten birinde yer alacaksın:

AI Sesli Asistan — işletmelerin gelen telefonlarını karşılayan, bilgi veren ve rezervasyon alan bir sistem. Konuşma tabanlı yapay zekâ, güncel işletme verisi üzerinden doğru cevap üretme, backend servisleri ve telefon entegrasyonu.

Üretim Operasyon Kulesi — fabrikalar için üretim izleme platformu. Makine ve sensörlerden veri toplama, gerçek zamanlı gösterge ekranları ve arıza daha duruşa yol açmadan tahmin edilmesi.

Ayrıca stajyerlerden biri vegasoft.co.uk sitesinin yeniden yapımını uçtan uca üstlenecek: tasarım, geliştirme, yayına alma. Herkese açık, adının geçtiği ve ileride her işverene gösterebileceğin bir referans işi.

Bu rolde neler yapacaksın

- AI destekli geliştirme süreçleriyle gerçek projeler üzerinde çalışacaksın
- Fikirleri hızlıca prototiplere ve çalışan uygulamalara dönüştüreceksin
- AI'ın ürettiği kodu inceleyecek, test edecek, hatasını bulacak ve sahipleneceksin
- API'ler ve farklı servisler arasında entegrasyonlar geliştireceksin
- Denediğin yeni AI araçlarını ekiple paylaşacaksın
- Ürettiğin çözümün gerçek kullanıcılara ulaşmasını göreceksin

İki teknik parkurdan birini seçebilirsin

Web ve ürün parkuru: React / TypeScript, Node.js veya .NET / C#, REST API, SQL.
Yapay zekâ ve veri parkuru: Python, dil modelleriyle çalışma, güncel veri üzerinden cevap üretme (RAG), veri işleme.

Her ikisinde de uzman olman gerekmiyor. Birinde temel bilgin olması veya öğrenmeye ciddi istekli olman yeterli.

Senden ne bekliyoruz

AI ile üretme alışkanlığı. Claude, ChatGPT, Cursor, Copilot gibi araçları kullanıyor olman ya da öğrenmeye gerçekten istekli olman. Sadece prompt yazmak değil: çıkan sonucu değerlendirebilmen, düzeltebilmen ve ortaya çalışan bir şey koyabilmen. AI'ın yazdığı kod senin sorumluluğundur — "AI böyle yazdı" bir açıklama değildir.

Problem çözme. Karşına çıkan bir problemi araştırmayı, denemeyi ve çözüm üretmeyi sevmen.

Öğrenme isteği. Bilmediğin bir konuya girmekten çekinmemen.

İletişim. Uzaktan çalışan bir ekipte net yazmak ve tıkandığında sormak. Sessizce beklemek burada en pahalı alışkanlık.

Git ve GitHub. Temel seviye yeterli.

İngilizce. Teknik dokümantasyon okuyabilecek seviye.

Artı değer sayılır, zorunlu değil

Docker · GitHub Actions / CI-CD · Next.js · ASP.NET Core · Flutter ile mobil · vektör veritabanları · gömülü sistemler veya endüstriyel haberleşme protokolleri · Figma ile arayüz tasarımı

Bizim için ne önemli

Her şeyi biliyor olmanı beklemiyoruz. Merakın, öğrenme hızın ve bir şeyler üretme isteğin çok daha önemli.

Daha önce yaptığın bir web sitesi, mobil uygulama, GitHub projesi ya da AI ile geliştirdiğin küçük bir çalışma varsa paylaş. Kusursuz bir portfolyo beklemiyoruz; bir şeyler denemiş ve ortaya bir şey çıkarmış olman yeterli.

Sana ne sunuyoruz

- Alıştırma değil, canlıya çıkan ticari ürünler üzerinde gerçek geliştirme işi
- Mühendislik liderimizden kod incelemesi ve teknik mentorluk
- Kendi işini sunduğun haftalık demolar
- Staj sonunda uluslararası geçerliliği olan referans mektubu
- AI-first bir geliştirme kültürünün içinde çalışma imkanı
- Tamamen uzaktan, esnek saatler

Koşullar, açıkça

Bu staj gönüllü ve ücretsizdir. Zorunlu staj başvurularına da açığız. Erken aşama bir stüdyoyuz ve şu an ne sunabildiğimiz konusunda dürüst olmayı tercih ediyoruz: gerçek sorumluluk, gerçek mentorluk ve gösterebileceğin iş. Haftada yaklaşık 15-20 saat ve en az üç ay bekliyoruz. Bu sana uymuyorsa gayet anlayışla karşılarız.

Başvuru

CV'ni ve varsa GitHub hesabını hr@vegasoft.co.uk adresine gönder. İki üç cümleyle hangi ekibe ilgi duyduğunu ve nedenini yaz. AI araçlarını kullanarak bir şey geliştirdiysen bağlantısını ekle.

Position Summary

The Senior Software Architect is a senior technical leadership role within the iGaming Platform team. This is not a "heads-down coding" role, nor is it a purely advisory one — it sits at the intersection of hands-on delivery and architectural ownership. You will be expected to make and defend design decisions, lead cross-team technical alignment, and ensure the platform scales, integrates, and operates reliably at global scale.

You bring established architecture experience, deep software engineering instincts, and the credibility to influence without authority across multiple platform portfolios. You will contribute to the Architecture Review Board (ARB), own Architectural Decision Records (ADRs), and play a central role in shaping how the OpenGaming platform evolves.

Architectural Leadership

Own and produce Architectural Decision Records (ADRs) for significant design decisions, ensuring rationale, context, and consequences are documented and retained
Participate actively in the Architecture Review Board (ARB), reviewing solution designs across platform portfolios and applying the L&W Architectural Standards
Define and enforce architecture patterns, integration contracts, and non-functional requirements (NFRs) across the Nova platform and adjacent systems
Contribute to the Tech Atlas, Asset Registry, and governance artefacts that underpin L&W's architecture practice
Lead threat modelling exercises using structured approaches (STRIDE, Threagile) and translate outcomes into actionable security requirements

Technical Design & Delivery

Produce high-quality solution designs — from C4 context and container diagrams through to component and sequence-level detail — that can be directly implemented by engineering teams
Design and evolve RESTful and event-driven APIs using OpenAPI specifications, establishing contracts that support independent team delivery
Architect integrations with third-party systems including payment providers, identity services, regulatory reporting endpoints, and operator platforms
Provide technical governance over CI/CD pipeline design, environment architecture, and deployment strategies using GitHub Actions, Kustomize, and ArgoCD
Hands-on prototyping and proof-of-concept development when needed to de-risk architectural decisions

Engineering Quality & Standards

Define and champion non-functional standards: performance baselines, resilience patterns, observability requirements, and security controls
Lead or contribute to performance and load testing design, interpreting results in the context of SLAs and platform growth targets
Establish and evolve coding and integration standards across Java/Spring services on the platform
Drive adoption of structured security practices through the Security Champions programme and DevSecOps tooling integration

Collaboration & Influence

Provide technical mentorship to Associate and mid-level architects and senior engineers, building architectural thinking across the team
Translate complex technical positions into clear, concise communication for delivery leads, product managers, and executive stakeholders
Drive alignment between iGaming and wider L&W engineering teams on shared concerns: API strategy, data platforms, observability, and shared services
Participate in hiring and technical assessment processes for engineering and architecture candidates

Qualifications

Degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related technical discipline, or demonstrably equivalent experience. Professional certifications (AWS, Azure, GCP) are valued but not a substitute for practical architecture experience.

7+ years in software engineering with at least 3 years in an explicit architecture role — designing systems, not just building them
Proven track record of owning architectural decisions end-to-end: from initial discovery and option analysis through to documented ADR and post-implementation review
Strong Java/Spring Boot background with demonstrable experience designing cloud-native microservices at scale
Experience designing and operating event-driven systems using Kafka or equivalent messaging platforms
Hands-on exposure to API gateway technologies and federated API management across multiple consumer profiles
Experience operating in a regulated or compliance-driven environment (gaming, fintech, payments, or similar)
Demonstrable experience working within or contributing to a governance process — ARB, design authority, technical steering, or equivalent
Comfortable producing architecture artefacts independently: C4 diagrams, ADRs, threat models, NFR matrices

The opportunity to interact with global teams on a regular basis and the possibility to switch teams and projects as you and our business continues to develop and grow.

Introduction

Chez ArcelorMittal Belgique, nous produisons de l’acier en utilisant des techniques d’automatisation et d’optimisation de pointe
. La section Logistic Industrial Applications, qui fait partie du département Digital Solutions & Innovation, assure l’informatisation et l’automatisation des processus logistiques
. Notre département est responsable du développement et de la maintenance de logiciels de gestion des stocks, de suivi des processus logistiques et d’exécution des missions de transport.

En quoi consiste la fonction?

En tant que spécialiste en informatique industrielle, vous intégrez un environnement IT stimulant et technologique, dédié à l’optimisation continue des processus logistiques. Vous serez amené(e) à:
Collaborer au sein d'une équipe responsable des logiciels logistiques industriels
. Vous commencerez par travailler sur le projet Artemis, qui développe un logiciel de gestion et suivi des missions de transport pour différentes installations de production européennes.
Être en contact étroit avec les membres des différents départements logistiques, en les accompagnant face aux défis numériques. Vous analyserez leurs demandes et les concrétiserez de manière autonome.
Rechercher continuellement des améliorations
en proposant des technologies innovantes et en optimisant les processus existants.
Travailler de manière autonome
au sein de votre équipe pour assurer un soutien optimal et trouver des solutions efficaces.

Vous êtes titulaire d'un diplôme de master
.
Vous communiquez couramment en français
et en anglais
(la connaissance du néerlandais est un atout.
Votre passion pour l'informatique
vous motive à rester informé(e) des nouvelles technologies et de l'architecture logicielle.
Vos compétences interpersonnelles
vous permettent de vous intégrer facilement dans des équipes variées.
