Willing to learn new things and to share knowledge with others.
Great problem-solving skills, with a solution-focused mindset.

What We Offer

Flexible homework scheme: remote work available;

Flex benefits Policy;

LIFE AT IMPACT

jobs.description:
At SolarWinds, we’re a people-first company. Our purpose is to enrich the lives of the people we serve—including our employees, customers, shareholders, partners, and communities. Join us in our mission to help customers accelerate business transformation with simple, powerful, and secure solutions.
The ideal candidate thrives in an innovative, fast-paced environment and is collaborative, accountable, ready, and empathetic. We’re looking for individuals who believe they can accomplish more as a team and create lasting growth for themselves and others. We hire based on attitude, competency, and commitment. Solarians are ready to advance our world-class solutions in a fast-paced environment and accept the challenge to lead with purpose. If you’re looking to build your career with an exceptional team, you’ve come to the right place. Join SolarWinds and grow with us!
Role Overview  

The Field Database Solutions Engineer is an independent, customer-centric problem-solver and storyteller who owns the pre-sales technical strategy for all database opportunities across EMEA. As a key member of the Sales team, you will combine deep database expertise with consultative selling skills to understand customer challenges, design tailored database monitoring and performance solutions, and articulate business value that compels customers to choose SolarWinds.  
This is a field-based role with a strong on-site customer presence, requiring regular travel  (mainly in  Dubai
but also  across the region )  to engage with enterprise customers, channel partners, and key accounts. You will operate with high autonomy, serve as a trusted technical advisor for all database-related engagements, and play a critical role in driving revenue growth across the EMEA Database business.  

Key Responsibilities  

Pre-Sales Ownership: Own the end-to-end SE strategy for database-focused customer engagements across EMEA, including meeting agenda design, story arc, technical approach, and follow-through.  
Product Demonstrations & Webinars: Conduct compelling online and on-site demonstrations of SolarWinds Database Performance Analyzer (DPA), SQL Sentry, Database Observability(DBO), and related database solutions, tailoring messaging to the customer's specific database challenges and environment.  
Technical Discovery & Solution Design: Lead deep discovery sessions with customers to understand their database landscape, performance pain points, and operational goals. Assess the customer's current database infrastructure and recommend solutions that improve performance, scalability, and operational efficiency, defining project scope, success criteria, and timelines.  
Value Articulation: Clearly articulate the value proposition of SolarWinds database solutions in the context of the customer's unique requirements, using consultative and value-based selling techniques. Translate technical database metrics into business outcomes that resonate with both technical and executive stakeholders.  
Technical Advisory: Advise Inside and Outside Sales in all technical pre-sales functions related to database monitoring and management, providing expert guidance to Account Executives and Channel Partners on the optimal database solutions to address customer requirements.  
Complex POC Execution: Design and execute complex Proof of Concept (POC) and Proof of Value (POV) engagements across multi-database environments (SQL Server, Oracle, MySQL, PostgreSQL, and others), including cloud and hybrid scenarios. Anticipate and mitigate technical and organisational risk throughout the evaluation process.  
Product Configuration & Troubleshooting: Perform advanced pre-sales technical support duties, including DPA/DBO/SQL Sentry configuration, agent deployment, environment setup, and troubleshooting of customer issues during evaluations.  
Customer & Product Feedback: Convey structured customer feedback, including feature requests, competitive intelligence, and product issues, to Product Management and Development teams. Help shape internal best practices based on field experience with database customers.  
Continuous Learning & Enablement: Maintain and continually upgrade deep technical understanding of the SolarWinds database product portfolio and broader database technologies. Provide training, mentoring, and knowledge transfer to other team members, and deliver Sales/Partner enablement sessions as required.  
Events & Field Presence: Present at partner events, trade shows, and industry conferences. Travel to partner sites for training and enablement. Maintain a strong on-site presence with key database customers across the EMEA region.  

Required Skills & Experience  

3- 4  years in a dedicated pre-sales or solutions engineering capacity, ideally within a software vendor or systems integrator environment, with a strong focus on database technologies.  
Deep database expertise across one or more of the following: Microsoft SQL Server, Oracle, MySQL, PostgreSQL, NoSQL databases (MongoDB, Cassandra),  SAP HANA,  and/or IBM DB2.  
Solid understanding of database performance monitoring, query tuning, indexing strategies, wait-type analysis, and capacity planning.  
A strong blend of technical ability, sales acumen, and exceptional customer interaction skill, comfortable leading executive-level conversations and deep technical database workshops alike.  
Fluent English speaker with exceptional oral and written communication and presentation skills. The ability to distil complex database performance topics into clear, compelling narratives is critical. Arabic language is preferred 

Proven experience with cloud-based database services including AWS RDS, Azure SQL Database, Azure SQL Managed Instance, Google Cloud SQL, and Aurora. Understanding of hybrid cloud database architectures is highly desirable.  
Strong reasoning, analytical, and technical troubleshooting skills with the ability to navigate complex customer database environments.  
Bachelor's degree in a relevant Business, Computing, or Engineering discipline or equivalent professional experience.  

Desirable Qualifications:  

Relevant industry certifications or accreditations (e.g., Microsoft Certified: Azure Database Administrator Associate, Oracle Certified Professional, AWS Certified Database – Specialty, MCSA/MCSE, or SolarWinds SCP certifications). We value continuous professional development and would love to see evidence of your commitment to learning.  
Experience with database DevOps practices, CI/CD pipelines for database changes, and Database Reliability Engineering (DBRE) methodologies.  
Familiarity with value-based selling methodologies (e.g., MEDDIC, Challenger, Solution Selling).  
Experience responding to RFI/RFP/RFx processes.  
Understanding of the competitive landscape in the database performance monitoring space.

jobs.title: Senior Unity Developer - Core Game Tech (f/m/d)
jobs.description:
We are Kolibri Games - a mobile games developer from Berlin. We believe that with the best people, we can make games that players will enjoy for years to come.

Our games have defined the idle genre, and bring enjoyment to hundreds of millions of players all around the world. This is possible due to the talented people who make us who we are. ‘Kolibris’, as we call ourselves, are on a mission to continue making great games and we're looking for new talent to join our team. We strive to offer you a fair recruitment process and a great candidate experience, as well as a friendly environment to work in, with plenty of opportunities to learn and grow.

Senior Unity Developer - Core Game Tech (f/m/d)

We are looking for a Senior Unity Developer to join our Core Game Tech (CGT) Team — the small, senior team behind the technology that every Kolibri game runs on.

Our work spans consulting game teams on technical decisions, investigating problems where nobody has defined the requirements yet, and building the systems and integrations that the games depend on. That ranges from compliance features and third-party SDKs to shared systems, standardization and keeping our engine and tooling current.

You'll work in a small specialized team alongside technical decision makers to have strong impact on all the games across our portfolio.

If you like being the person who takes on the technical problems other teams can't, and you don't shy away from constantly diving into new unknowns, learning new skills and driving topics forward, this role is for you.

Responsibilities

Design and build the shared systems multiple live games with dynamic events and scheduled content for millions of users run on
Drive third-party integrations and keep the portfolio current: evaluate and integrate SDKs, drive SDK and Unity version upgrades, and understand the impact across every game before it lands
Advise game teams as their technical counterpart, driving standardization and winning adoption of shared solutions on the strength of the work and the argument
Deliver compliance and privacy features across the portfolio, such as age assurance APIs, CMP implementations and GDPR data deletion flows
Investigate open-ended technical problems and turn regulations, vendor changes and internal needs into concrete technical requirements

Required Skills

(Ideally 5+ years of professional) Software development experience in C# and Unity3D. Experience in non-gaming contexts is also relevant; we value your expertise, so do not hesitate to apply
You have a wide understanding of how Unity works, you are familiar with native implementations, understand backend interactions, and performance investigations are your bread and butter. The most important skill is to be able to jump into the unknown and get familiar
Strong written and spoken communication, and the credibility to make teams you don't sit with want to adopt your solutions
Experience building libraries, packages, APIs or tooling that other developers consume, and an instinct for what makes them adoptable
Ability to plan, communicate, and execute technical solutions in a way that is both understandable for other developers as well as non technical stakeholders
Ability to derive requirements yourself from ambiguous or external sources — regulation, platform policy, vendor documentation — rather than working from a written spec
A genuine appetite for constantly learning new areas of the stack

Desirable Skills

Experience debugging below the C# layer into Android and iOS platform code, and profiling performance on mobile
Exposure to compliance, privacy or platform policy work — GDPR, CMP, age assurance, ATT or similar
Familiarity with reactive or async programming and dependency injection frameworks, e.g. UniRx, Zenject, UniTask
A passion for games and an understanding of the mobile market, like F2P and LiveOps
Strong familiarity with using LLMs in different areas of game development to support your efforts and achieve stronger results
Familiarity with Firebase Crashlytics and an understanding of ANRs

Kolibri Games is an equal opportunity employer. We come from 40 different countries and many different backgrounds. We celebrate diversity and we are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees, regardless of their age, gender identity, sexual orientation, ethnicity, religion, physical appearance or disability.

We look forward to hearing from you!

Olo is a leading SaaS platform accelerating digital transformation in the restaurant industry, by helping customers deliver more personalised and profitable guest experiences. As a result, our digital ordering, payment, loyalty and guest engagement solutions enable brands to do more with less and make every guest feel like a regular.

While our roots are in NYC, we’re intentionally investing in Belfast and Northern Ireland as a key hub, with an established leadership presence, a local team, and community for the long term. This role is fully remote, offering you flexibility to work from anywhere within NI.

Your new role

In this role, you’ll join as a Software Engineer on the ‘ Menu’ team, which is part of the wider ‘ Order’ engineering group.

The Menu team owns and operates all of the systems involved with managing, publishing and accessing billions of menu records. Menus change in real time and their accuracy is essential for the proper operation of our customer’s businesses. Consequently, the Menu team’s scope includes some of the most sophisticated and performance sensitive parts of Olo’s infrastructure. A deep understanding of garbage collection, network latency, and database internals comes with the territory. If you are looking for a challenge, you will find it here.

How You’ll Make An Impact

Demonstrate a solid understanding of the Menu team's domain and technology stack, contributing to discussions and development decisions with growing independence.
Handle small-to-medium features independently and begin taking ownership of moderately complex tasks with some guidance.
Write clean, maintainable code and actively participate in peer code reviews, providing constructive feedback and adhering to coding standards.
Collaborate closely with Product to refine requirements, helping to shape solutions that meet business needs effectively.
Focus on delivering high-quality software solutions within established timelines, emphasising best practices in software development.
Engage in troubleshooting and debugging efforts, showing an ability to resolve common and moderately complex issues with minimal support.
Assist in the deployment and monitoring of services, learning how to manage and troubleshoot issues in production environments.
Contribute to building and maintaining reliable distributed systems, implementing resilience mechanisms as appropriate.
Participate actively in team ceremonies and demonstrate initiative by taking ownership of tasks and helping to unblock others when possible.
Engage in continuous learning and self-improvement by exploring new technologies and best practices relevant to the team's work.
Use Claude Code and GitHub Copilot extensively as part of your daily workflow, and grow your skills through hands-on AI training designed to help you become highly effective with modern AI coding agents and IDEs.
Demonstrate ownership of the team's delivery pipeline, ensuring that code quality, testing standards, and deployment practices are continuously optimised.
Active participation in on-call duties is required, with specific responsibilities determined by your assigned team and area of expertise.

What Will Set You Up For Success

Bachelor’s Degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
3+ years of experience in software engineering.
Proficient in the .Net/C# ecosystem and capable of independently implementing moderately complex features and algorithms.

Olo is a leading restaurant technology provider with ordering, payment, and guest engagement solutions that help brands increase orders, streamline operations, and improve the guest experience. Each day, Olo processes millions of orders on its open SaaS platform, gathering the right data from each touchpoint into a single source—so restaurants can better understand and better serve every guest on every channel, every time. jobs.title: Engineering Manager
jobs.description:
Join TRG Screen: Building World-Class Teams. One Expert at a Time.

Are you ready to be part of a dynamic team at the forefront of subscription spend management innovation?

At TRG Screen, we're not just redefining how organizations manage their subscription expenses – we're shaping the future of the industry. With cutting-edge solutions and a commitment to excellence, we empower businesses around the globe to optimize their subscription investments and drive sustainable growth.

Join us in our mission to revolutionize subscription management and make a meaningful impact on the way businesses access and utilize critical information. At TRG Screen, your talent and ambition will find a home, where opportunities for growth and advancement abound.

About TRG Screen

TRG Screen is the leading provider of market data and subscription management technology and automation solutions, tailored to the unique needs of financial institutions and legal firms. Our integrated suite of solutions includes market data and subscription spend management, usage management, compliance reporting, and comprehensive managed services, which hundreds of clients worldwide use to remove cumbersome and inaccurate manual processes and gain control over market data and subscription costs at scale. For more than 25 years, TRG Screen has enabled businesses who rely on market data to monitor and strategically manage spending and usage of data and information services, including market data, research, software licenses, consulting and other necessary corporate expenses. TRG Screen solutions give decisionmakers full transparency into subscription spend and usage, enabling them to proactively manage subscription costs at scale, conduct more informed vendor negotiations, improve governance, and avoid unnecessary spending on these mission-critical business services. TRG Screen is headquartered in New York City, with offices in Europe and Asia, as well as a 24x7 client support center in Bangalore, India.

TRG Screen is a portfolio company of Vista Equity Partners, one of the world’s largest and most respected private equity firms.

The Role

Location: Belfast, Northern Ireland

Reporting to the Director of Software Engineering, the Manager of Software Engineering will lead globally distributed engineering teams at TRG Screen, building a high-performance culture of operational excellence while scaling engineering operations to meet evolving business goals.

This role is responsible for translating engineering strategy into execution—optimizing development processes, providing technical leadership to guide platform modernization, and delivering secure, reliable, scalable solutions. The Manager will own team-level KPI tracking, champion AI-powered code-generation tools to elevate productivity and fuel continuous improvement, and serve as a key connector between engineering teams and cross-functional stakeholders.

This is a people-first leadership role for someone who has grown beyond hands-on delivery but remains technically credible—capable of conducting meaningful code reviews, mentoring engineers at every level, and shaping a culture of engineering excellence across distributed teams.

Responsibilities

People leadership – Coach and develop direct reports through 1:1s, timely feedback, and career planning. Own performance management end-to-end, contribute to hiring, and enable Technical Leads to focus on their highest-leverage technical work.
Delivery – Set clear direction and realistic timelines, manage the roadmap with Product and Design, and proactively handle risks, blockers, and dependencies and escalate as needed to DOE. Own team delivery health metrics (print velocity, bug metrics) and provide visibility to DOE.
Process – Champion Agile practices, ceremonies, and ensure the team has space to act on improvements. Lead incident management and champion a blameless culture.
Technology – Engage in technical discussions at team level, ensure designs are properly evaluated, and keep team decisions consistent with TRG Screen’s architectural principles and engineering strategy.
AI governance – Actively drive AI adoption within the team, build capability and measure uptake. Hold the team accountable for AI code quality and own AI feature delivery. Ensure AI is used responsibly and in line with TRG Screen’s AI governance standards.
Security & communication – Treat secure coding and supply-chain hygiene as standard work. Foster a culture of clear communication, knowledge sharing, and constructive feedback across the team and stakeholders.

Required

Skills and Qualifications

5 years of relevant industry experience building production-grade software solutions using an enterprise-grade stack. C# / .NET experience is preferred, though candidates with a strong background in comparable languages such as Java or Go are welcome to apply.
2+ years of people-management experience, with a proven ability to coach and develop engineers at varying levels.
Strong understanding of Agile methodologies, Continuous Delivery, developer velocity, and DevOps concepts.
Demonstrable experience managing team performance – setting expectations, conducting reviews, and supporting career growth.
Track record of managing delivery – planning, tracking, and communicating progress clearly to stakeholders at multiple levels.
Comfortable engaging in technical discussions at team level; able to represent and be accountable for the team’s technical output.
Strong written and verbal communication skills; able to tailor communication to technical and non-technical audiences.
Experience working in cross-functional environments alongside Product Management, Design, and Client Success.

Preferred

Background in financial services, market data, or a regulated technology environment.
Experience with CI/CD pipelines, Azure DevOps, or equivalent tooling.
Familiarity with AI developer tooling (e.g. Cursor, GitHub Copilot) and experience driving adoption responsibly within an engineering team.
Exposure to cloud platforms, with AWS preferred.
Experience participating in security reviews, DDQs, or ISO 27001 audit processes.
Experience leading or contributing to technology modernisation programmes – including legacy migration, re-platforming, or the introduction of modern engineering practices into established codebases.

Leadership Qualities

People-first mindset – genuine investment in the growth and wellbeing of the team.
Clear decision-maker who takes ownership and learns from mistakes without defensiveness.
Comfortable operating in ambiguity; able to act responsibly without the full picture.
Economic thinker – able to frame trade-offs clearly and make pragmatic, business-aligned decisions.
Proactive problem solver who anticipates issues before they escalate.
Builds trust quickly across functions and levels; communicates with candour and respect.

Join TRG Screen and unlock your potential in an environment where innovation thrives, opportunities abound, and your contributions make a difference. We are an equal opportunities employer. We recognise and value the power of diversity in our workplace and are committed to being an employer of choice for everyone. We welcome and encourage applicants from all backgrounds. All applications for employment are considered strictly on the basis of merit.

At TRG Screen, we understand that diverse and inclusive teams are not just beneficial, they are essential to our success. We recognize that embracing diverse perspectives, backgrounds, and experiences fosters innovation, enhances problem-solving capabilities, and drives better business outcomes. By cultivating a culture of inclusion where every voice is heard and valued, we empower our world class teams to thrive, excel, and drive positive change.

We are proud of our diverse workforce and are dedicated to creating a safe and welcoming environment for all employees. People from various ethnicities, ages, genders, and abilities are encouraged to apply.

Privacy Notice for Applicants

TRG Screen is committed to protecting your privacy and handling your personal information responsibly. Information you provide during the recruitment process will be collected, processed, and stored in accordance with our Privacy Policy.

We encourage all applicants to review our Privacy Policy to understand how we collect, use, and protect your personal data throughout the recruitment process. Our Privacy Policy is available at: www.trgscreen.com/privacy-policy.

By submitting an application, you acknowledge that you have read and understood our Privacy Policy.

Job description
Role Type: Hybrid working
The Team

The Audit Technology team at KPMG is driving innovation at the intersection of auditing and advanced technological solutions, reshaping the future of audit delivery. By combining expertise in Artificial Intelligence, Data Engineering, Data Analytics, and Software Development, the team is revolutionising the auditing process to deliver smarter, faster, and more reliable outcomes.

Our mission is to design and implement robust, intelligent, and scalable technologies that not only streamline workflows but also enhance audit quality and generate actionable insights for auditors and clients. Through harnessing the power of cutting-edge tools, we aim to transform traditional audit practices into dynamic, forward-thinking processes that are built for the complexities of the modern business environment.

Our team, supported by KPMG’s global network, serves as the driving force behind this transformative journey. Focused on innovation, this team is dedicated to engineering solutions today that anticipate the challenges and opportunities of tomorrow, ensuring that audit services remain at the forefront of technological progression.

The Role

As a Principal AI Engineer, you will play a pivotal role in transforming advanced AI concepts into impactful, production-ready solutions within the Audit Technology team. You will lead a dedicated AI engineering squad, working closely with data scientists, data engineers, software developers, cloud architects, and audit professionals to build and scale AI-driven systems that enhance audit quality, efficiency, and insight generation.

From developing robust proof-of-concepts to deploying enterprise-grade solutions, you will apply your expertise in AI engineering, cloud platforms, and technologies such as Generative AI, Azure, Databricks to embed intelligence into critical audit workflows and products.

In addition to technical leadership, you will shape the growth of the team—mentoring engineers, promoting best practices, and fostering a culture of collaboration, innovation, and continuous improvement. You will stay at the forefront of AI engineering trends, advocate for modern development methodologies, and drive knowledge-sharing across both the technology and audit domains.

Responsibilities

Leadership & Mentorship: Lead a high-performing AI engineering team comprising software engineers and AI practitioners. Provide hands-on technical direction, foster career growth, and cultivate a collaborative culture that emphasizes engineering excellence, innovation, and continuous improvement.
Scalable AI Engineering: Drive the design, development, and deployment of production-grade AI systems tailored to audit applications. Ensure solutions are scalable, reliable, and maintainable by applying strong software engineering principles, MLOps practices, and cloud-native development.
End-to-End AI Solution Delivery: Oversee the full lifecycle of AI product engineering—from architectural design and prototyping to CI/CD-enabled deployment—using modern platforms and tools such as Azure ML, Databricks, MLflow, LangChain and LangGraph. Champion automation, testing, and observability across pipelines.
Operational Excellence: Define reusable development patterns, enforce coding standards, and promote MLOps best practices that support version control, performance optimisation, and maintainability.
Cross-Disciplinary Collaboration: Partner closely with data scientists, product managers, platform engineers, and QA teams to align on technical requirements, delivery timelines, and integration plans. Ensure AI capabilities are well-embedded within core audit platforms and services.
AI Governance & Risk Management: Implement engineering controls to support responsible AI use, including model monitoring, explainability, security, and auditability. Contribute to the operationalisation of AI governance frameworks to ensure regulatory and ethical compliance.
Capability Building & Knowledge Sharing: Drive initiatives to enhance internal capabilities, empowering team members and the broader Audit Technology function with the skills and knowledge to adopt and adapt AI innovations effectively.

Requirements

Bachelor (preferably master or PhD) in Computer Science, Artificial Intelligence, Data Science, Statistics, Engineering, or a related technical field — or equivalent professional experience.
Strong knowledge of generative AI, machine learning, deep learning, natural language processing and other relevant AI fields.
Proven track record of designing, developing, and deploying AI systems in production environments.
Proficient in Python and key ML libraries (e.g. PyTorch, PySpark, scikit-learn, Hugging Face Transformers).
Hands-on experience with modern data platforms and AI tooling such as Azure ML, Databricks, MLflow, LangChain, LangGraph.
Proven experience with modern engineering practices Git, version control, unit testing and containerisation.
Familiarity with agile work methodologies and tools like Jira and Confluence.
Exceptional leadership and communication skills, with the ability to convey complex technical concepts to diverse audiences.
Advanced certifications in AI, machine learning, cloud computing or data engineering are highly advantageous.
Professional accounting qualification preferred, however not a requirement.

Why Audit at KPMG?

Audit is the largest of our UK practices. Some of the world’s biggest companies rely on us to provide independent insight, challenge and expertise, so the work we undertake affects investment decisions, inspires confidence in public sector expenditure and supports our economic growth. Today, more than ever in disruptive times, audit is a function needed by society, and in the future, so we can capitalise, and grow. As part of the Audit team, you’ll be helping to build the confidence and trust that business and society need to thrive. We want to lead the conversation when it comes to shaping the future of the profession. And given the scale and variety of our audit engagements in both the UK and globally, we are well placed to create change. If you share our commitment to achieving excellence and working to the highest audit standards, are a natural collaborator who values different perspectives and relishes the opportunity to develop and progress - then KPMG could be the place where you can thrive.

US-based home medical equipment providers and hospitals run on tight schedules — missed deliveries, billing errors, and documentation gaps have real consequences. We're building a centralized SaaS platform that handles the operational backbone for these providers: scheduling, invoicing, documentation, and medical item logistics. The system is live, growing, and needs someone who can hold the line when things get complex.
A new team member will be in charge of:

Own the L3 escalation layer — be the last technical stop before an issue reaches the development team, and make sure most don't need to.
Diagnose and resolve deep-level issues across backend services, APIs, and databases, with a clear path to permanent fixes — not just workarounds.
Drive root cause analysis in close collaboration with dev and DevOps, turning recurring incidents into documented, solved problems.
Keep the knowledge base current — incidents, solutions, and patterns that actually help the next person on shift.
Support releases and bug fix validation from the operational side, including CI/CD touchpoints.

Does this relate to you?

3–5+ years in IT support roles, with hands-on experience in SaaS or enterprise application environments.
Solid experience troubleshooting .NET-based applications — C# and ASP.NET Core specifically. This is a hard requirement.
Strong grasp of microservices architecture — you understand how services talk to each other and where things break down.
Comfortable working with MySQL or PostgreSQL at a diagnostic level — reading query plans, spotting data issues, tracing DB-side failures.
Familiar with API troubleshooting, authentication flows, and authorization patterns — you know what a broken token or a misconfigured scope looks like.
Experience with ticketing systems and incident management workflows (JIRA or similar) — you know how to work an SLA without losing the thread.
Upper-Intermediate English or above — enough to communicate clearly with a US-based client team in writing and on calls.

jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer – SECTRO
jobs.description:
Stillingsbeskrivelse

Do you want to helps us transform the way passengers and baggage move through airports? Do you want to play a key role in developing the high-level control software that powers the next generation automated screening solutions?

Then join us as our new Senior Software Engineer

Join BEUMER Group and Shape the Future of Airport Security

The global aviation industry is facing increasing demands for security, operational efficiency, and passenger experience. SECTRO is BEUMER Group’s strategic response to these challenges, combining advanced automation, intelligent system integration, and scalable software solutions to create the future of airport security screening. As SECTRO continues its transition from development into industrialization and execution, software has become a critical success factor in delivering a standardized, configurable, and globally scalable product portfolio.

Your Role

As our Senior Software Engineer, you will serve as the primary technical authority and go-to person for High-Level Control (HLC) within SECTRO. You will be responsible for maintaining an overall overview of the HLC tools, ensuring alignment across projects and products, and driving the evolution of our software platform. The role combines technical leadership, stakeholder management, roadmap development, and hands-on execution. You will be part of a global and cross-functional engineering setup, collaborating closely with software, automation, and system engineers, as well as external partners and suppliers.

Key Responsibilities

Act as the technical focal point and subject matter expert for HLC solutions across the SECTRO product portfolio.
Maintain the overall overview of the HLC landscape, ensuring consistency, standardization, and scalability across projects.
Drive technical decision-making and architectural direction for HLC software solutions for SECTRO.
Contribute to defining and maintaining the SECTRO roadmap.
Translate business needs, project requirements, and technology opportunities into actionable development initiatives.
Lead the design, development, and implementation of High-Level Control software solutions.
Collaborate with external suppliers and technology partners to ensure seamless integration.
Support project teams with expert guidance throughout design, implementation, commissioning, and operational phases.

Technology Stack

As a Senior Software Engineer, you will get the chance to work with the following Tech-stack:

Microservice-based architecture
C# 14+
.NET 10 and ASP.NET Core
REST APIs and service-oriented integrations
Docker and Kubernetes
CI/CD using GitLab and Helm Charts
Git and GitLab source control management
Distributed systems and cloud-native design principles
SQL-based data management and configuration handling
Integration with industrial automation platforms and High-Level Control systems

What You Bring

We imagine you a degree withing Software Engineering, Computer Science, Automation Engineering, or related technical field and have extensive experience within complex industrial, logistics, automation, or mission-critical environments.

Moreover We Expect You To Have

Knowledge of software architecture, system integration, and interface design.
Experience with High-Level Control systems, distributed software platforms, or similar solutions.
Proven ability to drive technical direction and coordinate activities across global and multidisciplinary teams.
Strong analytical skills and a structured approach to problem solving.
Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills.
A proactive mindset with a high degree of ownership, accountability, and technical leadership.

You are fluent both in both written and spoken English.

Interested?

If you have any questions regarding this position, please do not hesitate to contact TPO & Team Manager, SECTRO Christian Kjer Elkjær at +45 3176 7183 or Talent Acquisition Lead Søren Vestergaard Holm at +45 3176 0448.

BEUMER Group

Conveying, loading, palletising, packing, sortation and distribution – BEUMER Group is a leader within the development and manufacture of high-technological intralogistics systems for global markets. Our employees stand out from others thanks to their ability to supply innovative solutions to our customers. They can do this because they know the industry and are passionate about continuously developing and expanding their knowledge. We support these high standards through teamwork, mutual respect and a work culture based on trust that fosters stability and security for all of our employees. Our common goal is to implement outstanding and innovative projects worldwide.

jobs.title: SW Engineer
jobs.description:
About Us

Visa is a world leader in payments technology, facilitating transactions between consumers, merchants, financial institutions and government entities across more than 200 countries and territories, dedicated to uplifting everyone, everywhere by being the best way to pay and be paid.

At Visa, you'll have the opportunity to create impact at scale — tackling meaningful challenges, growing your skills and seeing your contributions impact lives around the world.

Join Visa and do work that matters – to you, to your community, and to the world. Progress starts with you.

Job Description

Visa’s Technology Organization is a collaborative community of problem solvers and innovators dedicated to reshaping the future of commerce. We operate the world’s most sophisticated processing networks as the leader in digital payments, supporting up to 65,000 secure transactions per second across a global network of over 100 million merchant locations and nearly 15,000 financial institutions, empowering billions of cardholders worldwide.

The Opportunity

We are looking for dedicated, curious, and energetic Software Engineers who embrace solving complex challenges on a global scale. As a Associate Software Engineer at Product Reliability Engineering team, you will be an integral part of a multi-functional full stack engineering team inventing, designing, building, and testing agentic solutions and software products that will operate at global scale to predict and prevent real time reliability challenges in a rapidly evolving technology environment at Visa’s scale. You will get to see how your efforts shaping the digital future of fintech transactions and ensuring a reliability of 99.9999% and beyond.

The Work Itself

Build Agentic Solutions using world’s most advanced LLM models from Anthropic, OpenAI and others
Build Deep Learning solutions using AI-ML Platforms for real time transactions at a scale of 100K+ TPS and for peta bytes of Data.
Design code and systems that touch 40% of the world population while influencing Visa’s internal standards for scalability, security, and reusability
Collaborate multi-functionally to create design artifacts and develop best-in-class software solutions for Visa’s commercial products and services.
Actively contributes to product reliability improvements, valuable service technology, and new operations flows in diverse agile squads
Opportunities to make a difference on a global or local scale through mentorship and continued learning and experiments.

Essential Functions

Demonstrates in-depth technical proficiency to accurately interpret and address project requirements.
Identifies and contributes to the development and solution strategies to team members that improve the design and functionality of interface features across one or more project features, under minimal guidance.
Collaborates with others to support the piloting of new technology capabilities and features that enhance the customer experience across commercial products.
Supports ongoing innovation by developing scalable, maintainable, and efficient systems aligned with organizational objectives and global technology standards.

This is a hybrid position. Expectation of days in office will be confirmed by your hiring manager.

Visa requires at least 3 days in office, expectations of these days will be confirmed by your Hiring Manager.

Qualifications

Basic Qualifications: Bachelor’s Degree in Computer Science, or related technology-engineering discipline. Preferred Qualifications: 1-2 years of work experience with a Bachelor’s degree or Advanced Degree (e.g. Masters, MBA, JD, MD) in Computer Science, or related technology-engineering discipline. Exposure in developing agentic solutions using Cline, Claude, GitHub Copilot, Power Automate etc. Experience in Software Development with Agile and full SDLC using programming languages such as (e.g., Java, GO, Python, Scala, Java scripts, .Net) etc. Development experience in building and using Microservices with HTTP, REST, JSON. Experience with a Relational database and-or NoSQL database. Proficient in GIT-Stash, Maven and Jenkins. Exposure in streaming platform like Kafka. Exposure with tools development, automation (CI-CD, Auto Deployment, System Availability, etc.), logging and monitoring. Knowledge of large scale data analytics and statistical modelling. Strong analytical, problem solving and communication skills. The Skills You Bring: Energy and Experience: A growth mindset that is curious and passionate about technologies and enjoys challenging projects on a global scale Challenge the Status Quo: Comfort in pushing the boundaries, ‘hacking’ beyond traditional solutions Language Expertise: Expertise in anyone programing language (e.g., Java, C#, C++, GO, Python, Scala, Java scripts, .Net) Builder: Experience building and deploying modern services and web applications with quality and scalability Learner: Constant drive to learn new technologies such as coding with GenAI, new backend, front-end, test and devops technologies. Partnership: Experience collaborating with Product, Test, Dev-ops, and Agile-Scrum teams

Visa is an EEO Employer

Qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, gender identity, disability or protected veteran status. Visa will also consider for employment qualified applicants with criminal histories in a manner consistent with EEOC guidelines and applicable local law.

jobs.title: Product Support Developer
jobs.description:
Company Description

CoreOps Solutions is a Company based at Santo Domingo, Dominican Republic. Providing service to world leading companies in designing and developing software solutions for our clients.

Role Description

This is a full-time remote role for a Software Engineer located in Santo Domingo. The Software Engineer will be responsible for designing, developing, testing, and implementing software solutions for our clients. The role will require collaboration with cross-functional teams to identify business requirements and provide customized software solutions that meet client needs, as well as staying up-to-date with the latest industry trends and best practices.

jobs.title: AI First Developer
jobs.description:
About Smartcat

Smartcat is building the future of work, where human expertise meets digital teammates to drive 10x to 1000x productivity gains for the world’s leading enterprises.

We’re on the frontier of an entirely new category: Agentic AI. We enable enterprises to build high-performing hybrid workforces made up of both humans and AI agents. These AI agents aren’t generic copilots. They’re fully trained digital teammates that learn from your best people, your content, and your business strategy—ready to get to work from day one.

Our platform combines generative AI, human-in-the-loop workflows, and a living Enterprise Skill Graph that continuously learns and improves. Whether you're launching a product globally, onboarding new hires, translating learning content, or aligning legal teams across regions, Smartcat turns knowledge into action and action into scale.

Over 1,000 companies, including 20% of the Fortune 500, rely on Smartcat to bring their business to the world—instantly, accurately, and in every language. As a Series C company with consistently high year-over-year growth, we’re scaling fast and investing in people who want to shape the future of work with us.

Join us in unlocking global potential, one human and agent team at a time.

WHY YOU SHOULD JOIN OUR TEAM

We are building the future of software development — AI-First is the new standard
. You won’t be “experimenting”; you’ll be delivering. Fast. Smart. Relentless. Join the core team that will prove AI-driven engineering is the only way forward. If you love challenges, own your outcomes, and are obsessed with delivery, you’ll thrive here.

MISSION

As an AI-First Engineer, your mission is to deliver production-quality features at a speed and scale that traditional teams cannot match. You will apply AI aggressively across every stage
of the development lifecycle — from requirements and design to coding, testing, and release — and establish a new engineering benchmark for the company.

OUTCOMES

Consistently deliver high-quality, production-grade features faster than traditional teams.
Build and optimize AI-first workflows that integrate AI across all development stages.
Raise the bar for speed, quality, and ownership in product delivery.
Be a core contributor to the new engineering culture built on AI-First principles.

How You’ll Ramp

By Day 30:

Deeply understand our AWS, .NET, Python, MongoDB tech stack and delivery model.
Start shipping real features using AI at every stage: coding, testing, documenting, releasing.
Contribute to improving workflows for even faster delivery.

By Day 60:

Independently own the full lifecycle of feature delivery through AI-first methods.
Identify and drive improvements in velocity, automation, and team efficiency.
Partner with Product and Tech Leads to aggressively accelerate time-to-market.

By Day 90:

Deliver features faster and with higher quality than baseline teams.
Actively mentor others on using AI as a multiplier across development.
Become a key driver of the AI-First engineering standard inside the company.

WHAT YOU’VE ACCOMPLISHED:

Proven track record
of delivering production-grade products using AI-driven approach.
Mastery in using AI tools
(Copilot/Cursor/WindSurf (etc, you choose), GPT APIs, LLMs) across the entire development lifecycle — design, code generation, testing, documentation, and release.
Strong technical foundation in AWS, .NET, Python, and MongoDB.
Obsessed with delivery: you ship, you improve, you own the outcome.
Comfortable moving fast, taking ownership, and constantly pushing for better, faster, smarter execution.

Why joining Smartcat might be your best move so far

A global, connected team
We’re a team of 200+ people across 30+ countries, working together through a hub-and-spoke model anchored in eight key locations: New York, London, Lisbon, Costa Rica, Serbia, Armenia, Georgia, and Spain. Most of our roles are remote-friendly, giving you the flexibility to do your best work from where you thrive. For customer-facing teams, we prioritize proximity to our customers, ensuring we stay deeply connected to their needs and deliver an exceptional experience. No matter where you’re based, you’ll be part of a highly collaborative, globally-distributed team that values ownership, speed, and meaningful impact.
Be part of an AI Native Organization
We are highly innovative, using AI across all areas of the organization to accelerate decision-making and free people to focus on strategy and high-impact work. We embrace new ideas and encourage all Smartcaters, regardless of level or department, to manage their own AI Agents. At Smartcat you’ll shape how AI transforms the workplace and play an integral role in ensuring Smartcat remains a leader in AI innovation.
Innovating a $100 Billion industry
Smartcat is reshaping the $100B multilingual content industry with an AI-powered platform that makes it easy for companies to create, translate, and localize global content at scale. Our platform enables enterprise teams to move away from slow, traditional outsourcing methods, and achieve fast, high-quality results, at a fraction of the cost.
Join the rocketship to scale-up 10x and beyond together
We are looking for someone to become an integral part of our team and play a crucial role in the most exciting part of our journey: transitioning from a post-Series C startup to a company exceeding $100M in ARR and $1B in valuation. Our journey isn’t for the faint of heart. We are growing at 130% YoY, thanks to our strong product-market fit and high-performing team, and plan to accelerate from here.

At Smartcat, we are committed to building a culture that highlights respect and appreciation for each individual's unique background and perspective, while maintaining a strong focus on results and engagement. new_jobs.title: .NET developer
new_jobs.description:
Wil jij werken aan software die daadwerkelijk impact heeft in de fysieke wereld? Ben je een ervaren .NET Developer die energie krijgt van IoT, real-time data, cloud-native software en schaalbare systemen? Dan is dit een interessante kans.

Voor een innovatieve en snelgroeiende technologieorganisatie in de omgeving van Amersfoort, zijn wij op zoek naar een ervaren .NET Developer.

Over de organisatie

Het bedrijf ontwikkelt innovatieve technologische oplossingen die bijdragen aan de veiligheid, monitoring en bescherming van waardevolle assets.

De technologie zorgt ervoor dat waardevolle assets kunnen worden gevolgd, beveiligd en indien nodig teruggevonden. Hierbij wordt gewerkt met een combinatie van IoT-hardware, firmware, cloudsoftware, mobiele applicaties en real-time data.

Als .NET developer kom je terecht in een technische omgeving waarin hardware en software nauw met elkaar samenwerken. Je werkt samen met engineers vanuit verschillende disciplines en hebt direct invloed op de verdere ontwikkeling van de producten.

Jouw rol

Als .NET Developer werk je aan de verdere ontwikkeling van een schaalbaar IoT-platform.
Je bouwt mee aan moderne back-end systemen en gebruiksvriendelijke interfaces waarmee real-time data van een groot aantal verbonden apparaten wordt verwerkt en inzichtelijk gemaakt.

Je werkzaamheden zijn onder andere:
Ontwikkelen van schaalbare en cloud-native applicaties;
Bouwen van moderne back-end systemen met C# en .NET;
Verwerken van real-time data afkomstig van IoT-devices;
Ontwikkelen van API's en backend-functionaliteiten;
Visualiseren van data in dashboards en gebruiksvriendelijke interfaces;
Bouwen aan systemen die miljoenen connected devices kunnen ondersteunen;
Meedenken over architectuur en de keuze voor nieuwe technologieën.

De technische omgeving

Je werkt in een moderne Microsoft-omgeving met een sterke focus op schaalbaarheid, performance en cloud-native development.

Belangrijke technologieën zijn:
C#
.NET / .NET Core
Microsoft Azure
Azure Messaging Services
SQL en NoSQL databases
Serverless toepassingen
Containers
CI/CD
Test automation
Azure DevOps
Git

Aan de front-end wordt gewerkt met:
TypeScript / JavaScript
HTML
CSS
Vue
React
Angular

Wie zoeken wij?

Je bent een ervaren .NET developer die graag inhoudelijk wordt uitgedaagd en energie krijgt van complexe technische vraagstukken.

Je bent nieuwsgierig, analytisch en vindt het leuk om je vast te bijten in nieuwe technologieën. Daarnaast durf je verantwoordelijkheid te nemen en denk je graag mee over hoe software en architectuur slimmer kunnen worden ingericht.

Wij zoeken iemand die beschikt over:
Minimaal 4 à 5 jaar ervaring met C# en .NET;
Ervaring met Microsoft-technologieën en Azure;
Kennis van moderne webtechnologieën zoals TypeScript/JavaScript, HTML en CSS;
Ervaring met één of meerdere frameworks zoals React, Vue of Angular;
Ervaring met SQL en/of NoSQL databases;
Kennis van serverless en containerized applications;
Ervaring met CI/CD en testautomatisering;
Kennis van SOLID-principes en software design patterns;
Ervaring met Azure DevOps en Git.

Daarnaast ben je communicatief vaardig en kun je complexe technische vraagstukken helder uitleggen aan collega's met verschillende technische achtergronden.

Wat kun je verwachten?

Je komt terecht bij een innovatieve en groeiende technologieorganisatie waar je veel ruimte krijgt om technisch mee te denken en daadwerkelijk impact te maken.

Je kunt rekenen op:
Een uitdagende functie binnen een snelgroeiende techorganisatie;
Een brutosalaris tussen de €4.000,- - €6.000,- (op basis van 40 uur ex vakantiegeld);
Veel technische vrijheid en verantwoordelijkheid;
Flexibele werktijden en thuiswerkmogelijkheden (2 dagen minimaal op kantoor);
Complexe technische uitdagingen rondom schaalbaarheid en real-time data;
Een dynamische en informele werkomgeving;
Een kantooromgeving in Amersfoort, goed bereikbaar met de auto, het OV en de fiets.

Ook indien je niet aan alle gestelde eisen voldoet kom ik graag met je in contact om de mogelijkheden te bespreken.

new_jobs.title: Solution Architect
new_jobs.description:
Ben jij een ervaren Solution Architect met een stevige achtergrond in softwareontwikkeling, engineering of een vergelijkbare technische discipline? Heb je diepgaande kennis van de Microsoft .NET-stack en wil je richting geven aan complexe IT-oplossingen die cruciaal zijn voor bedrijven, consumenten én Douane-medewerkers? Lees dan snel verder!

Dit doe je bij de Douane

Als Solution Architect werk je binnen de keten RAD & DDV (Rapid Application Development & Digitale Dienstverlening) van de afdeling Data & Digitalisering. Binnen deze omgeving realiseer je samen met collega’s Douane-specifieke digitale oplossingen. Er is al een uitgebreid applicatielandschap opgezet en jij krijgt de kans om dit verder te professionaliseren en op te schalen. Je bent verantwoordelijk voor de solutionarchitectuur binnen jouw keten en werkt in een omgeving waar maatwerksoftwareontwikkeling en -integratie met bestaande systemen en standaardsoftware samenkomen.

Je vertaalt businessvraagstukken naar toekomstbestendige technische oplossingen en adviseert stakeholders over de impact, haalbaarheid en consequenties van architectuur- en ontwerpkeuzes. Onze toolbox is divers, dus help je om keuzes te maken voor de inzet van (fullstack)maatwerk, RPA of LowCode of combinaties ervan. Je zorgt dat nieuwe initiatieven passen binnen de architectuurkaders van de Douane en aansluiten op de behoeften van gebruikers en de doelstellingen van de organisatie.

Je maakt solutionarchitecturen en werkt deze uit tot concrete technische ontwerpen. Je brengt daarbij requirements, security, performance, beheersbaarheid, schaalbaarheid, integratie en kosten samen en maakt expliciete trade-offs. Je bent geen architect die op afstand adviseert: je bent inhoudelijk betrokken bij het ontwerpen van oplossingen en kunt technische keuzes tot op implementatieniveau doorgronden en hiervoor draagvlak creëren bij je stakeholders.

Je werkt nauw samen met product owners, business analisten, ontwikkelteams, leveranciers, architecten van andere IT-ketens en met domein- en enterprise architecten. Daarbij bewaak je de samenhang tussen oplossingen, stimuleer je hergebruik waar mogelijk en geef je richting aan de technische keuzes die worden gemaakt. Je stemt architectuurkeuzes af met domein- en enterprise-architecten en draagt actief bij aan de samenhang van het bredere IT-landschap van de Douane.

Je hebt zelf met je voeten in de klei van softwareontwikkeling gestaan. Daardoor begrijp je hoe oplossingen daadwerkelijk worden gebouwd en welke uitdagingen daarbij komen kijken. Je weet wat de impact is van architectuurkeuzes op ontwikkelteams en bent een gelijkwaardige gesprekspartner voor hen op het gebied van onder andere .NET, integraties, containerisatie en Microsoft-technologie. Dan help je de om technische richting te bepalen, werkbare implementaties van securityconcepten uit te denken en richting te geven aan infrastructuur-keuzes (“hoe en waar de boel op draait”, wat een container kan zijn, etc.). Binnenkort wordt een LowCode platform aan onze toolbox toegevoegd. Op het gebied van AI werk je actief mee aan het (leren) inzetten van “AI-assisted development/engineering” (e.g. code genereren) en de inzet verstandige inzet van AI in onze applicaties en operationele processen.

Een bijzondere baan, omdat...

Je architectuurkeuzes maakt voor oplossingen die direct bijdragen aan de uitvoering van de maatschappelijke opdracht van de Douane.
Je richting geeft aan complexe technische vraagstukken rondom maatwerksoftware, standaardsoftware, integraties en automatisering.
Je werkt aan complexe vernieuwingsopgaven waarbij bestaande legacy-systemen stap voor stap worden gemoderniseerd zonder de continuïteit van primaire processen in een 24/7-organisatie uit het oog te verliezen.
Je opereert in een omgeving waarin maatschappelijke en internationale ontwikkelingen invloed kunnen hebben op prioriteiten, besluitvorming en technologische keuzes.
Je de verbindende schakel bent tussen business, architectuur en softwareontwikkeling.
Je richting geeft aan technische en architectuurkeuzes binnen het domein en een gezaghebbende gesprekspartner bent voor architecten, ontwikkelaars en stakeholders.

"Je opereert in een omgeving waar businessvraagstukken zoals het toezicht op e-commerce springen om opschaalbare IT-oplossingen. Oplossingen die je moet aansluiten op kritieke processen en tegelijkertijd in een omvangrijk landschap ruimte maakt voor vernieuwing. Daarbij kunnen ontwikkelingen in de (geo)politiek leiden tot nieuwe prioriteiten, gewijzigde kaders of andere technologiekeuzes. Juist die dynamiek, gecombineerd met de noodzaak om de Douane verder digitaal te transformeren, maakt deze functie zo uitdagend." Nanning de Jong, Ketenmanager RAD & DDV

Wanneer past deze baan bij je?

Je hebt wo-werk- en denkniveau en hebt tenminste vier jaar ervaring als Solution Architect binnen complexe IT-omgevingen en beschikt over diepgaande kennis van moderne softwarearchitectuur.
Je hebt een technische achtergrond in softwareontwikkeling, engineering of een vergelijkbare technische discipline en beschikt over diepgaande kennis van de Microsoft .NET-stack. Hierdoor ben je een volwaardige gesprekspartner voor ontwikkelaars en andere technische specialisten.
Je hebt ervaring met Microsoft-technologieën, API-architecturen, integratiepatronen, containerisatie.
Het is een pré als je ervaring hebt met RPA, LowCode, AI, OpenShift / Kubernetes en kwaliteitsplatformen zoals SonarQube. We werken met een breed spectrum aan oplossingen en tools.
Je hebt ervaring met het ontwerpen van oplossingen waarin maatwerksoftware en commerciële standaardoplossingen samenkomen.
Je weet je weg te vinden in grote organisaties met complexe besluitvorming, veel afhankelijkheden en een mix van legacy en moderne technologie.
Je schakelt makkelijk tussen architectuurvraagstukken, technische keuzes en de praktische gevolgen daarvan voor ontwikkelteams.

Jouw competenties

organisatiesensitiviteit

netwerken

overtuigingskracht

analyseren

omgevingsbewustzijn

De afdeling - Douane Directie Informatietechnologie

IT Data & Digitalisering

IT Data & Digitalisering (IT D&D) levert producten en diensten op het gebied van data, sensors en bijbehorende functionaliteit om de Douane processen te ondersteunen. Hiermee maken ze het fundament om datagedreven werken mogelijk te maken, zodat waardevolle beslissingen genomen kunnen worden op basis van volledige, juiste en tijdige informatie. Ze verbeteren daarnaast ook de digitale dienstverlening, zodat bedrijven volledig digitaal zaken kunnen doen met de Douane. Het maakt daarbij niet uit via welk kanaal ze in contact zijn met de douane, de gebruikerservaring is uniform en op elkaar afgestemd.

De Kerntaken Van IT Data & Digitalisering Zijn

Waarde leveren voor de Douane organisatie door IT-applicaties en producten op een snelle, effectieve en breed inzetbare manier te ontwikkelen.
Gegevens uit interne en externe bronnen actueel en in samenhang beschikbaar maken voor rapportages, analyses en informatieverstrekking. Het Douane Dataplatform (DDP) speelt hierin een belangrijke rol.
Het koppelen van data en het ontwikkelen van geavanceerde algoritmes, zodat risico’s via scan-, detectie en camerasystemen kunnen worden gedetecteerd. Door regie op het eigen netwerk uit te voeren wordt de effectiviteit op het toezicht van goederen en de veiligheid vergroot.
Het digitaliseren van de centrale informatievoorziening van de Douane.

Dat Doen Ze Met De Teams

Data
Rapid application development
Digitalisering
Sensoren

Rapid Application Development.

Dit team zet vier verschillende methodieken in om producten te ontwikkelen.

Robotic Process Automation (RPA) is een technologie om met behulp van ‘software robots’ procestaken te automatiseren. Deze technologie geeft de mogelijkheid om handmatig repeterend werk op de werkvloer te automatiseren, dat door diverse oorzaken met de bestaande digitale middelen onvoldoende wordt ondersteund.
Low-code technologie is een methode om software visueel te ontwerpen in plaats van in codetaal.
Full-stack technologie zorgt voor maatwerk.
Standaard producten die geïntegreerd kunnen worden in het Douane applicatielandschap.

De organisatie

Douane

De Douane is een handhavingsdienst, stelt de verschuldigde douanerechten en accijnzen vast en heft en int deze. De geïnde bedragen worden afgedragen aan de Nederlandse schatkist en de EU. De Douane zorgt er ook voor dat de samenleving zo goed mogelijk wordt beschermd tegen onveilige en ongewenste goederen. Hieronder valt een breed scala aan taken op het terrein van veiligheid, milieu, flora en fauna, gezondheid en cultuur. Én de Douane draagt bij aan het versterken van de concurrentiepositie van Nederland en de EU door toe te zien op de naleving van Europese maatregelen voor marktordening en te zorgen voor een snelle en goede douaneafhandeling, resulterend in zo min mogelijk oponthoud en lage administratieve lasten.

Het werkterrein van de Douane is opgedeeld in landelijke directies en bureaus, het Douane Dienstencentrum (DDC), het Douane Landelijk Tactisch Centrum (DLTC) en acht regiokantoren. De regiokantoren bevinden zich in Amsterdam, Rotterdam, Breda, Groningen, Arnhem, Eindhoven en op twee locaties op de luchthaven Schiphol. De landelijke directies en bureaus zien toe op de eenheid van beleid en uitvoering op het gebied van handhaving, operaties, financiën en control, informatievoorziening en mens en middelen. Daarnaast bewaken zij de samenhang binnen Douane Nederland. Het DLTC stuurt de handhaving aan op basis van risicobeheersing. De informatietechnologie-keten zorgt voor de veiligheid, stabiliteit en continuïteit van de IT-dienstverlening. Het DDC levert producten en diensten op het gebied van bedrijfsvoering aan de douanekantoren.

Bijzonderheden

We ontvangen je brief en cv graag in een Word- of PDF-bestand. Neem in de bestandsnaam jouw voor- en achternaam op. Als je een beroep doet op een voorrangspositie, stuur dan ook een kopie van die kennisgeving mee.

Onze selectieprocedure voor deze functie ziet er als volgt uit:

Allereerst wordt beoordeeld of een voorrangskandidaat binnen de Rijksoverheid in aanmerking komt voor deze functie.
Daarna wordt beoordeeld of jouw cv en motivatiebrief voldoen aan de gestelde functie-eisen. Als dat het geval is, vindt op woensdag 15 oktober de brief-en cv-selectie plaats.
Op woensdagochtend 21 oktober vinden de selectiegesprekken plaats op ons kantoor in Utrecht. Het is fijn als je hier rekening mee houdt in de agenda.

Onderaan deze vacature vind je meer uitleg over de stappen die je doorloopt in de sollicitatieprocedure.

De voorkeur gaat uit naar kandidaten die het meest aansluiten bij het opgestelde profiel. Dit heeft betrekking op zowel de genoemde kennis en werkervaring als op het opleidingsniveau. Vermeld deze daarom duidelijk in je cv.

De Douane zet zich in voor de banenafspraak: zoveel mogelijk banen realiseren voor mensen met een arbeidsbeperking. Val jij in deze doelgroep? Wij zullen je ondersteunen zodat je optimaal kunt functioneren, en daarmee jouw bijdrage aan Nederland kunt leveren. Of het nu gaat om aanpassingen op je werkplek, bepaalde voorzieningen in het vervoer of bijvoorbeeld vergoedingen van het UWV: samen met jou, je leidinggevende én een jobcoach gaan wij kijken naar jouw kwaliteiten en mogelijkheden om een passend werkpakket uit te voeren. As part of a digital product team, under close supervision, this job collaborates with cross functional teams to help implement new software features to meet user needs and business goals and upgrade existing software to improve performance and functionality through writing clean, efficient and scalable code and troubleshooting and debugging standard issues. Die Unit Cloud Services agiert auf nationaler und internationaler Ebene für mittelständische und große Unternehmen. Wir betreiben T Cloud Public! T Cloud Public ist Europas #1 Cloud Provider, ein Cloud-Standardprodukt auf Basis von Open-Source-Community-Software und angetrieben durch die Prinzipien von DevSecOps. Schlanke Strukturen, agile Methoden, hochmotivierte Teams und ein äußerst dynamisches Geschäftsumfeld bestimmen unser Handeln. Mit dieser kundenorientierten und agilen Ausrichtung sind wir der Ankerpunkt für das Public-Cloud-Geschäft in der Deutschen Telekom Gruppe.

Wir werden daran gemessen, eine sichere, stabile und innovative Plattform bereitzustellen. Gemeinsam mit unserem Plattformpartner und weiteren Partnern aus dem OpenStack-Ökosystem arbeiten wir daran, ein hochinnovatives Public-Cloud-Produkt auf Basis europäischer Sicherheits- und Datenschutzstandards zu schaffen.

Wir suchen Menschen, die Profis und Evangelisten mit großer Begeisterung für Cloud-Technologie sind und sich den Herausforderungen stellen, die durch die Entwicklung und den Betrieb einer Hyperscale-Public-Cloud entstehen.

Wir bieten einzigartige Einblicke darin, wie eine große Public Cloud unter der Haube funktioniert, interkulturelle Teamarbeit, flache Hierarchien und einen eigenständigen Arbeitsstil.

Deine Aufgaben

Als Architect verstehst du die neuesten Entwicklungen in der Cloud- und Container-Technologie. Kundenorientiert entwickelst und erweiterst du die Plattform unserer Open Telekom Cloud.

Die Plattformarchitektur verbessern und dabei IT-Sicherheit ernst nehmen.

Praktisch an der Konsole arbeiten, um deine Architekturarbeit zu untermauern.

Abgeschlossenes Studium in einem technischen, ingenieurwissenschaftlichen oder naturwissenschaftlichen Fach oder vergleichbare Berufsausbildung.
5 Jahre Berufserfahrung in der IT mit Schwerpunkt auf modernen Cloud-Technologien.
Sehr gute Kenntnisse von Software-, Cloud- und Container-Architekturen.
Erfahrung in der Infrastrukturautomatisierung.
Fundierte Kenntnisse in Linux, Systemtools und netzwerkbezogenen Services.
Ausgeprägte Kundenorientierung.
Kenntnisse agiler Entwicklungsprozesse.
Mentoring- und Präsentationsfähigkeiten.
Fähigkeit, technische Lösungen zu bewerten und kreative Ansätze zu entwickeln.
OpenStack- und Programmiererfahrung in Open-Source-Projekten sind von Vorteil.
Sehr gute schriftliche und mündliche Englisch- oder Deutschkenntnisse.

Gestalte deinen Arbeitsalltag flexibel mit Gleitzeit und der Möglichkeit zum mobilen Arbeiten, um Berufs- und Privatleben optimal zu vereinbaren.

Attraktives Gehaltspaket:
Profitiere von einer wettbewerbsfähigen Vergütung, einer betrieblichen Altersvorsorge und weiteren Sozialleistungen.

Wir fördern deine Karriere durch vielfältige Weiterbildungsmöglichkeiten, Zertifizierungen (insbesondere in Cloud-Technologien und Architektur), Konferenzen und interne Entwicklungsprogramme.

Innovation und Technologie:
Arbeite an vorderster Front mit modernsten Cloud-Technologien (Public Cloud, Kubernetes, IaC) und gestalte aktiv die digitale Zukunft mit.

Teamgeist und Kollegialität:
Eine offene und wertschätzende Unternehmenskultur, in der Zusammenarbeit, Wissensaustausch und gegenseitige Unterstützung großgeschrieben werden.

Work-Life-Balance:
Genieße 30 Tage Urlaub, umfassende Gesundheitsangebote und Programme zur Vereinbarkeit von Beruf und Familie.

Moderne Arbeitsumgebung:
Ausgestattet mit State-of-the-Art-Equipment und inspirierenden Arbeitsplätzen in unseren Büros oder komfortables mobiles Arbeiten.

new_jobs.title: Advisory Solution Architect - Nutanix Database Service (m/f/d)
new_jobs.description:
Hungry, Honest, Humble, with Heart!

The Opportunity

Nutanix is seeking a pre-sales Solution Architect for Nutanix Database Service (NDB) to drive the growth of our Database-as-a-Service (DBaaS) portfolio across the EMEA Central region. In this high-impact pre-sales role, you will serve as the premier database subject matter expert within our technical sales organization.

Working closely with account teams, partners, consultants, product managers and engineering groups, you will educate enterprise customers, architect tailored database automation solutions, execute hands-on technical validation, and drive regional sales targets across the region, in pair with a Sales Specialist.

Your Role

Lead Technical Engagements: Act as the primary technical authority and trusted advisor for Nutanix Database Service (NDB), guiding enterprise customers from initial discovery through technical decision-making.
Execute Technical Validation: Plan, deploy, configure, and maintain NDB during Proof of Concept (POC) engagements to demonstrate quantifiable business and technical value.
Architect Enterprise Solutions: Collaborate with field sales, systems engineers, and Nutanix Consulting Services to design scalable database as a service architectures that integrate with existing customer environments and with other Nutanix solutions.
Drive Product Feedback Loops: Synthesize field learnings, customer feature requests, and regional sales blockers to directly influence Nutanix product management, engineering, and marketing roadmaps.
Drive adoption of the solution: Work as the trusted advisor of Enterprise customers, to make sure NDB is implemented and used at the full of its features, helping customers to solve their management issues with NDB.
Thought Leadership & Community: Establish yourself as a DBaaS expert by participating in internal technical communities, presenting at industry conferences, and publishing reference architectures, blogs, and technical whitepapers.

What You Will Bring

Database Expertise: 5+ years of experience as a DBA, Database Architect, or Technical Pre-Sales Engineer with deep hands-on experience in enterprise database systems (e.g., MS SQL, PostgreSQL, Oracle, MongoDB, or other NoSQL/virtualized database solutions).
Cloud & Modern Infrastructure Knowledge: Good knowledge of major public cloud platforms architectures (AWS, Azure, GCP), alongside a strong grasp of data center architecture (virtualisation, storage, networking), modern apps (using Kubernetes) and good knowledge of automation/DevOps practices.
Pre-Sales Track Record: Proven experience driving complex technical sales cycles, running hands-on evaluation deployments, and positioning technical capabilities against enterprise business outcomes.
Communication & Presentation: Outstanding written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to build rapport and credibly present to both technical teams (DBAs, infrastructure leads) and executive decision-makers.
Languages: Native or fluent proficiency in both German and English (written and spoken). Additional European languages are a plus.
Location & Mobility: Must be legally based in Germany (remote position) with the willingness and ability to travel across the EMEA Central region for customer meetings, events, and workshops.

Work Arrangement

Remote: This position is primarily remote. There is no specific in-office requirement, however, there may be circumstances where you may be required to come into a local office for a specific purpose, and/or to travel to other locations based on business needs.

new_jobs.title: Application Support Engineer (m/w/d)
new_jobs.description:
WORUM ES GEHT

Du baust dabei mit an unseren GovTech-Lösungen der nächsten Generation, die den Alltag von Millionen von Menschen einfacher machen. Unterstütze uns bei der Umsetzung unserer Vision, den Staat fit für das 21. Jahrhundert zu machen. Denn starke und funktionierende Institutionen sind die Grundlage einer funktionierenden Demokratie. Schließ Dich uns an und werde Teil der SINC Familie.

Bei uns bist Du die zentrale Schnittstelle zwischen Kundenbetrieb und Entwicklung. Du arbeitest an echten Produktionssystemen in komplexen On-Premise-Umgebungen – und hast direkten Einfluss auf Stabilität und Qualität unserer Software.

DEINE AUFGABEN

Als Application Support Engineer (m/w/d) bist Du erste Anlaufstelle für technische Probleme im Kundenbetrieb und sorgst für eine schnelle und strukturierte Bearbeitung von Supportfällen.
Deine zentrale Aufgabe ist die Analyse von Incidents unter Einbeziehung von Logs, Systemen, Datenbanken und Containern.
Du stellst sicher, dass Tickets vollständig, nachvollziehbar und reproduzierbar sind.
Probleme löst du eigenständig oder übergibst komplexe Fälle strukturiert an die Entwicklung.
Darüber hinaus koordinierst Du Supportfälle im 2nd- und 3rd-Level und agierst als Bindeglied zwischen Kundenbetrieb und Entwicklung.
Ein weiterer Schwerpunkt liegt im Aufbau von Know-how durch saubere Dokumentation und aktive Wissensweitergabe im Team.

WAS DU MITBRINGST

Nach Deinem Studium oder Deiner Ausbildung im IT-Umfeld hast Du bereits fundierte praktische Erfahrungen in der Betreuung von komplexen Infrastrukturen, IT-Prozessen und Applikationen gesammelt.
Erfahrung im Umgang mit IT-Systemen (z. B. Server, Netzwerke, Anwendungen).
Außerdem hast Du Spaß an Fehlersuche und Ursachenanalyse
Ein gewisses Grundverständnis von Softwareentwicklung (z. B. APIs, Datenflüsse, Fehlerbilder).
Du hast Erfahrung mit Logs, Debugging oder Monitoring.
Erfahrung im 2nd/3rd-Level-Support.
Du arbeitest strukturiert, lösungsorientiert und behältst auch in kritischen Situationen den Überblick.

HIERMIT ARBEITEN WIR

Betriebssysteme: Windows Server
Ticketsystem: Jira, Azure DevOps
Dokumentationssystem: Confluence
Programmiersprache: C#
Datenbanken: Microsoft SQL Server, Oracle, PostgreSQL
Container: Docker, Kubernetes (OpenShift)
Kommunikationsplattform: Rocket Chat, Microsoft Teams

WAS WIR BIETEN

Du möchtest Beruf und Privatleben unter einen Hut bekommen? Wunderbar. Genieße flexible Arbeitszeiten. Remotearbeit nach Kundenanforderung möglich.
Wir bezahlen heute schon Dein zukünftiges Ich. Wenn Du mal in Rente gehst, haben wir jeden Monat 338€ für Dich im Rahmen der betrieblichen Altersvorsorge zur Seite gelegt.
Du genießt gutes Essen? Dann profitiere hierbei von unserer Essenszulage.
Wir investieren in Dich durch regelmäßige Fort- und Weiterbildungen. Das Beste daran: Du entscheidest mit, wie Dein weiterer Weg aussehen kann.
Du connectest Dich gerne mit Deinen Kollegen? Das unterstützen wir als Firmenwert absolut, nur so kannst Du von Deinen erfahrenen Kollegen lernen und neue Aufgabenfelder für Dich entdecken.
Komm schnell von A nach B mit Deinem eigenen JobRad.
Ob Weinfest oder Weihnachtsfeier - wir feiern zusammen. Beim Sommerfest freuen wir uns zusätzlich über den Besuch deiner Familie.
Ob „old school“ LAN-Partys, Bouldern, Grillabende in unserem Garten oder Trampolinhalle, lass Deiner Fantasie freien Lauf, wir freuen uns auf neue Vorschläge. Du brauchst mal schnell den Kopf frei? Nutze den Tischkicker, den Billardtisch oder den Basketballkorb. Oder laufe innerhalb von 30m an das Rheinufer und lass die Seele baumeln und atme einmal tief durch.

INTERESSE AN DIESEM JOB?

Dann lass uns rausfinden, ob wir zueinander passen. Entwickel Deine tollen Ideen nicht länger für den Papierkorb, sondern für einen sinnvollen Zweck.

Alternativ kannst Du uns die Bewerbung auch an bewerbung@sinc.de schicken.

Wenn noch Fragen offen sind, dann melde Dich gerne direkt bei Mateusz.
