Bei T-Systems bieten wir unseren Geschäftskunden die richtigen Systemlösungen für ihr digitales Business. Mit unserem Portfolio stellen wir sicher, dass digitale Transformation Komplexität reduziert, Kosten einspart und die alltägliche Arbeit erleichtert. Unsere Schwerpunkte sind Konnektivität, Digital, Cloud & Infrastruktur sowie Sicherheit - Let's power higher performance!

Die Unit Cloud Services agiert auf nationaler und internationaler Ebene für mittelständische und große Unternehmen. Wir entwickeln, vermarkten und betreiben agile, cloud-native, zukunftsorientierte Produkte und Services für die digitale Welt. Wir verstehen uns als Innovationstreiber und machen das Geschäft unserer Kunden fit für die digitale Zukunft. Unsere Mission: Gemeinsam mit unseren Kunden gestalten wir die sicherste, einfachste und effizienteste Transformation in eine digitalisierte und cloud-native Zukunft.

Dein Bereich

Wir betreiben T Cloud Public! T Cloud Public ist Europas #1 Cloud Provider, ein Cloud-Standardprodukt auf Basis von Open-Source-Community-Software und angetrieben durch die Prinzipien von DevSecOps. Schlanke Strukturen, agile Methoden, hochmotivierte Teams und ein äußerst dynamisches Geschäftsumfeld bestimmen unser Handeln. Mit dieser kundenorientierten und agilen Ausrichtung sind wir der Ankerpunkt für das Public-Cloud-Geschäft in der Deutschen Telekom Gruppe.

Wir werden daran gemessen, eine sichere, stabile und innovative Plattform bereitzustellen. Gemeinsam mit unserem Plattformpartner und weiteren Partnern aus dem OpenStack-Ökosystem arbeiten wir daran, ein hochinnovatives Public-Cloud-Produkt auf Basis europäischer Sicherheits- und Datenschutzstandards zu schaffen.

Wir suchen Menschen, die Profis und Evangelisten mit großer Begeisterung für Cloud-Technologie sind und sich den Herausforderungen stellen, die durch die Entwicklung und den Betrieb einer Hyperscale-Public-Cloud entstehen.

Wir bieten einzigartige Einblicke darin, wie eine große Public Cloud unter der Haube funktioniert, interkulturelle Teamarbeit, flache Hierarchien und einen eigenständigen Arbeitsstil.

Deine Aufgaben

Als Architect verstehst du die neuesten Entwicklungen in der Cloud- und Container-Technologie. Kundenorientiert entwickelst und erweiterst du die Plattform unserer Open Telekom Cloud.

Du möchtest:

Die Plattformarchitektur verbessern und dabei IT-Sicherheit ernst nehmen.
Vertiefte Kenntnisse im Bereich Hardware Security Modules wären von Vorteil.
Innovative Plattform- und Software-as-a-Service-Features entwerfen und entwickeln.
Als vertrauenswürdige:r Berater:in für OpenStack-basierte Public-Cloud-Technologie agieren.
Praktisch an der Konsole arbeiten, um deine Architekturarbeit zu untermauern.
Konsequente Automatisierung mit gängigen Automatisierungsframeworks vorantreiben.
In einem Team von Spezialist:innen arbeiten, in dem sich alle gegenseitig offen und vertrauensvoll unterstützen.

Dein Profil

Abgeschlossenes Studium in einem technischen, ingenieurwissenschaftlichen oder naturwissenschaftlichen Fach oder vergleichbare Berufsausbildung.
5 Jahre Berufserfahrung in der IT mit Schwerpunkt auf modernen Cloud-Technologien.
Sehr gute Kenntnisse von Software-, Cloud- und Container-Architekturen.
Erfahrung in der Infrastrukturautomatisierung.
Fundierte Kenntnisse in Linux, Systemtools und netzwerkbezogenen Services.
Ausgeprägte Kundenorientierung.
Kenntnisse agiler Entwicklungsprozesse.
Mentoring- und Präsentationsfähigkeiten.
Fähigkeit, technische Lösungen zu bewerten und kreative Ansätze zu entwickeln.
OpenStack- und Programmiererfahrung in Open-Source-Projekten sind von Vorteil.
Sehr gute schriftliche und mündliche Englisch- oder Deutschkenntnisse.
Du arbeitest innerhalb der Europäischen Union, um die Anforderungen unserer Kunden an Datensicherheit und Datenschutz zu erfüllen.

Was wir bieten

Flexible Arbeitsmodelle:
Gestalte deinen Arbeitsalltag flexibel mit Gleitzeit und der Möglichkeit zum mobilen Arbeiten, um Berufs- und Privatleben optimal zu vereinbaren.

Attraktives Gehaltspaket:
Profitiere von einer wettbewerbsfähigen Vergütung, einer betrieblichen Altersvorsorge und weiteren Sozialleistungen.

Individuelle Entwicklung:
Wir fördern deine Karriere durch vielfältige Weiterbildungsmöglichkeiten, Zertifizierungen (insbesondere in Cloud-Technologien und Architektur), Konferenzen und interne Entwicklungsprogramme.

Innovation und Technologie:
Arbeite an vorderster Front mit modernsten Cloud-Technologien (Public Cloud, Kubernetes, IaC) und gestalte aktiv die digitale Zukunft mit.

Teamgeist und Kollegialität:
Eine offene und wertschätzende Unternehmenskultur, in der Zusammenarbeit, Wissensaustausch und gegenseitige Unterstützung großgeschrieben werden.

Work-Life-Balance:
Genieße 30 Tage Urlaub, umfassende Gesundheitsangebote und Programme zur Vereinbarkeit von Beruf und Familie.

Moderne Arbeitsumgebung:
Ausgestattet mit State-of-the-Art-Equipment und inspirierenden Arbeitsplätzen in unseren Büros oder komfortables mobiles Arbeiten.

ABOUT ORGANOX:

OrganOx is a commercial stage organ technology company dedicated to developing technologies to improve outcomes for patients with acute or chronic organ failure. The company was established as a spin out of the University of Oxford in 2008 and is now part of the Terumo Group. OrganOx is a pioneer in normothermic machine perfusion (NMP). It's flagship platform, the metra®, is available for use in the U.S., Europe, Canada, and Australia. It has been utilized in over 7,000 liver transplants to date to keep donor livers in a metabolically active state outside the body enabling longer preservation times and functional assessment of the organ prior to transplant, leading to an increased number of organs available for transplant. Founded in 1921, Terumo Corporation (TSE:4543) strives to fulfil its mission of "Contributing to Society through Healthcare" by providing a comprehensive range of solutions in the fields of therapeutic procedures, hospital operations, and life sciences in more than 160 countries and regions.

Hands-on experience designing, building, and supporting Microsoft Azure solutions within a regulated enterprise environment.
Experience creating and maintaining CI/CD pipelines and deployment templates in Azure DevOps.

Experience supporting live production platforms, including monitoring, logging, and operational support.

new_jobs.description:
Job Description

Grade UE08: £50,253 to £61,759 per annum, pro rata if part time

Information Services Group / Web and Communications (WAC)

Full-time: 35 hours per week

Fixed-term: for 1 year

Shape What Happens Next. Be Part Of Something Bigger.

Make a meaningful impact

Here, you can continue to make a difference in everything around you. Take on new challenges, grow your career, be recognised for your contributions, and benefit from our commitment to your wellbeing. Be part of something bigger — where your work has real impact and your development matters. There are so many reasons to take your next step with us.

Professional Services

The University of Edinburgh is a world-class organisation. We are a large University covering a wide range of activities. In Professional Services, we support the University’s research and teaching, offering many career and role specialisms.

The Opportunity

We're looking for a Senior Web Developer to help lead the continuous development and ongoing support of the University's central web services, principally the Web Publishing Platform (EdWeb 2) — the open-source, Drupal-based service behind nearly 170 environments and over 600 subsites, curated by more than 1,200 editors and reaching around 30 million users a year from across the world.

This is a senior, technically leading role. You'll set technical direction, architect and build complex enterprise-level features in Drupal, and champion the development, testing and coding standards that keep a platform of this scale robust. You'll also mentor and support the mid-level and junior developers around you — sharing knowledge and helping the whole team deliver high-quality software "small and often", through an agile, continuous-improvement approach.

You'll join the Website and Communications (WAC) team, a highly collaborative and supportive part of Information Services. We work in the open: EdWeb 2 and the University's Student & Staff Portal (MyEd) are both built on open-source software, reflecting the University's commitment to open software and data across its services.

We'd love to hear from someone with deep Drupal and PHP expertise and strong front-end skills, who's a creative, adaptable problem-solver with a genuine enthusiasm for emerging technologies and for bringing them into mainstream use, someone excited to shape a platform the whole University relies on.

People have always been at the heart of our work. Our people are at the centre of the University community and everything we do. We value colleagues with drive, determination and a passion for what they do. We are a place where everyone is welcome and offer a range of policies and benefits designed to support you in building the right meaningful flexibility that works for you.

A career with us has a range of other benefits that can be tailored to your lifestyle:

Professional development and subject matter expertise
Opportunities to develop new skills and broaden your experience
Responsibility and autonomy
Contributing to the work and purpose of the University.

This post is full-time (35 hours per week); however, we are open to considering part-time or flexible working patterns, such as compressed hours or longer breaks in the working day.

The team office location is at the west edge of the University’s central campus, in 5 Forrest Hill, Edinburgh, EH1 2QL.

The role follows a hybrid working pattern, combining time working from home with regular time on campus: we ask that colleagues spend at least two days a week on-site, one of which is our shared team anchor day, so the team can collaborate, support one another and stay connected in person.

View the full job description (opens in a new browser tab)

How To Apply

We welcome informal enquiries about the role, to find out more, please email Gareth Alexander (Web Development Team Manager) at gareth.alexander@ed.ac.uk

Please Include The Following Documents In Your Application

CV
Cover letter

As a valued member of our team, you can expect:

A competitive salary
An exciting, positive, creative, challenging and rewarding place to work.
To be part of a diverse and vibrant international community.
Comprehensive Staff Benefits, including generous annual leave entitlement, a defined benefits pension scheme, a wide range of staff discounts, family-friendly initiatives, and flexible work options. Check out the full list on our staff benefits page (opens in a new tab) and use our reward calculator to discover the value of your pay and benefits.

Championing equality, diversity, and inclusion

The University of Edinburgh holds a Silver Athena SWAN award in recognition of our commitment to advance gender equality in higher education. We are members of the Race Equality Charter, and we are also a Stonewall Proud Employer, actively promoting LGBTQ+ equality.

The University is committed to equality, diversity and inclusion. If you have the right skills for the job, we want to hear from you. We encourage applications from the right candidates regardless of age, gender identity, disability, sexual orientation, religion, belief or race.

Prior to any employment commencing with the University, you will be required to evidence your right to work in the UK. Further information is available on our right to work webpages
(opens new browser tab)

On this occasion the University will not consider applicants requiring sponsorship for this role. International workers will therefore only be able to take up this role if they can demonstrate an alternative right to work in the UK.

Key dates to note

The closing date for applications is 2 October 2026.

Unless stated otherwise, the closing time for applications is 11:59 pm UK time. If you are applying outside the UK , the closing time on our adverts automatically adjusts to your browser’s local time zone.

Interviews will be held at Forrest Hill (In-person)
the week commencing 12th October.

About Us

As a world-leading research-intensive University, we are here to address tomorrow’s greatest challenges. Between now and 2030 we will do that with a values-led approach to teaching, research and innovation, and through the strength of our relationships, both locally and globally.

About The Team

The Learning, Teaching & Web Services Directorate (LTW) brings together technology enhanced learning, e-learning, the University website, web services, graphics, multimedia, digital skills training and classroom technology teams to support learning, teaching and outreach for an enhanced student experience.

We provide a wide range of technology and support services for innovative learning and teaching, including classroom tools, virtual learning environment (VLE), blended learning, bespoke development, online video, open educational resources (OER), taught online Masters programmes, massive open online courses (MOOCs), feedback and assessment. We manage the continuing expansion and diversification of the University website, student portal, and provide digital technology services in 400 teaching rooms and study spaces across the campus.

Every year we host student internships, projects and events which promote innovation and align with the University strategic aims to promote new ways of working in learning, teaching and research.

THE NEXT CHAPTER STARTS WITH YOU

Junior Software Engineer

Build your software engineering career while helping power the next chapter of Vanquis

We’ve invested significantly in modernising our technology landscape and strengthening our engineering capabilities. Now, we’re looking for a Junior Software Engineer who is ready to learn, contribute and grow with us.

Working within our Solution Engineering function, you’ll support the design, development, testing, deployment and ongoing support of software components, APIs, integrations and automation.

You’ll work alongside experienced engineers, take ownership of clearly defined technical tasks and build practical experience across the software delivery lifecycle. Through coaching, structured learning and hands-on delivery, you’ll develop the capabilities needed to progress towards a Software Engineer role

There's More to the Story

Vanquis is evolving.

We’re investing in our people, modernising how we work, strengthening customer experiences and building new capabilities across the business. This is an opportunity to contribute to meaningful technology delivery while developing your skills and career

How you’ll make an impact:  

✅ Develop software components, APIs, integrations and automation with support from experienced engineers

✅ Turn requirements and technical designs into secure, reliable and maintainable solutions

✅ Complete development tasks, configuration changes, defect fixes and technical improvements

✅ Create unit tests, technical documentation and support information for your work

✅ Take part in peer reviews, testing and defect investigation, applying feedback to improve quality

✅ Support release preparation, deployment validation, monitoring and post-release checks

✅ Work with colleagues across engineering, architecture, product, testing, security, data and operations

✅ Build your technical confidence through practical experience, coaching and structured learning

Why this role matters:

Technology & Change is a strategic priority for Vanquis. As a Junior Software Engineer, you’ll contribute to the solutions, integrations and automation that support our customers, colleagues and essential business services.

You’ll work closely with Software Engineers, Senior Software Engineers, architects and the Software Engineering Manager, while gaining exposure to product owners, business analysts, test engineers, security, operations, data and release teams.

Your work will help us deliver reliable technology changes, improve quality and maintainability, identify risks and defects early, and support controlled releases into production.

The Engineering Principles we build around:

⚙️ Quality from the Start:
Testing, documentation and peer review are part of how we deliver.

🔒 Secure by Design:
Security, privacy and responsible data handling are built into our solutions.

🤝 Shared Ownership:
Engineering and delivery colleagues work together from requirements through to support.

🚀 Continuous Improvement:
We identify recurring issues and look for practical ways to improve.

📚 Continuous Learning:
Coaching, feedback and hands-on experience help our people develop

The tools and technologies helping us shape what’s next

☁️ Salesforce:
Configuration, security, declarative automation, Apex and Lightning components

🔗 MuleSoft and APIs:
API-led connectivity, REST and SOAP services, integrations and data transformation

⚙️ Engineering Practices:
Source control, automated testing, CI/CD and controlled environments

🚀 Delivery and Release:
Agile delivery, peer review, deployment validation and monitoring  

You don’t need to be an expert in every area. This is a development opportunity where you’ll build your knowledge through structured learning and practical experience.

Essential experience

We’re interested in your potential, curiosity and willingness to learn. You’ll need:

A genuine interest in software engineering, Salesforce, MuleSoft, APIs, integrations or technology delivery
Some practical exposure to software development, configuration, testing, debugging or technical problem-solving
The ability to follow technical guidance, agreed designs and established standards
A structured approach to investigating problems and identifying possible solutions
Good organisation and the ability to manage assigned tasks and communicate progress
A collaborative approach, with the confidence to ask questions and learn from feedback
An understanding of the importance of confidentiality, security and responsible data handling

Useful, but not essential

Experience or developing knowledge of Salesforce or MuleSoft
Awareness of APIs, REST or SOAP services and integration concepts
An understanding of source control, automated testing, CI/CD or deployment processes
Experience of Agile delivery practices
Trailhead badges, practical labs, portfolio projects or other structured technology learning
A Salesforce or MuleSoft foundation credential, or progress towards one
A degree, apprenticeship or equivalent qualification in Computer Science, Software Engineering or a related subject
Awareness of financial services or regulated technology delivery

Please don’t count yourself out if you don’t meet every point. What matters most is your interest in technology, evidence of practical learning and motivation to build your software engineering career.

Career development:

This role is designed to help you build the technical, delivery and professional capabilities needed to progress towards a Software Engineer position.

You’ll learn through practical delivery, coaching, peer review, feedback, structured development and relevant certification activity. As your confidence and technical judgement grow, you’ll have opportunities to take ownership of broader and more complex work.

Why Vanquis?

🏆 Great Place to Work Certified

🏆 Financial Times Best Employers 2025 & 2026

🏆 Armed Forces Friendly Employer (Bronze)

🏠 Flexible Hybrid Working

💜 Inclusive Culture

on Contribution

🎓 LinkedIn Learning

🙌 Two Volunteering Days

👨 👩 👧 Enhanced Family Leave

🎂 Paid Birthday Leave

🚀 Career Development Opportunities

Ready to shape what’s next?

If you’re looking for an opportunity to start or continue your software engineering career, gain experience across modern engineering technologies and learn from experienced colleagues, we’d love to hear from you.

The Next Chapter Starts With You.

new_jobs.title: Solution Architect
new_jobs.description:
Introduction

At IBM Consulting UK FutureNow, you’ll build a career at the forefront of hybrid cloud and AI, working with leading clients across the public and private sectors.

You’ll collaborate with top industry professionals, gain hands on experience with cutting edge technologies, and deliver solutions that create real business impact. From day one, you’ll work on meaningful, high profile programmes that stretch your skills and accelerate your growth.

We invest heavily in you—supporting continuous learning, in demand skills development, and long term career progression. You’ll thrive in a flexible, inclusive environment that values curiosity, encourages reinvention, and recognises what makes you unique.

We Offer

Tools and policies to support your work-life balance from flexible working approaches, sabbatical programs, paid paternity leave, maternity leave and an innovative maternity returners scheme
More traditional benefits, such as 25 days holiday (in addition to public holidays), private medical, dental & optical cover, online shopping discounts, an Employee Assistance Program, life assurance and a group pension plan through salary sacrifice.

Your Role And Responsibilities

We are seeking IT Architects to lead the design and implementation of hybrid cloud application modernisation projects with our Public Sector clients. You will provide technical leadership for migrating existing applications to cloud and for building new cloud native solutions.

Your Responsibilities Will Include

Providing, architectural, consultative and engineering support for our customers’ journeys to the cloud
Bringing industry insight to deliver innovative solutions, that are tailored to the specific needs of our customers
Leadership for transformations of enterprise complex projects, from system requirements through delivery and production/deployment, providing architectural and hands-on technical leadership to ensure overall solution integrity
Building strong relationships with our clients and acting as a trusted advisor

Preferred Education

Bachelor's Degree

Required Technical And Professional Expertise

You will be familiar with AWS or/and Azure and be comfortable with Microservice architectures and a range of cloud, devops and integration technologies. You will have worked on hybrid cloud complex systems integration projects designing elements of the target cloud solution and its integration with existing on-premise applications.

You will be comfortable working in ‘rainbow’ teams with multiple different suppliers or as part of a wholly IBM team. Your background is likely to be a mix of large-scale waterfall deliveries and more agile projects. You will be a hands-on professional with a proven track-record in keeping your skills up to date, ideally evidenced through recognized certifications.

Proficiency in designing and implementing hybrid cloud solutions combining on-premises and cloud-based services.

Experience in creating architecture diagrams component models and technology stacks for hybrid environments.

Deep understanding of major cloud providers (e.g. AWS Azure Google Cloud) and their respective services.

Familiarity with cloud-native services serverless computing and managed services.

Experience in designing managing and optimizing on-premises infrastructure including virtualization storage and networking.

Knowledge of on-premises automation tools (e.g. Ansible Puppet Chef).

Proficiency in designing and implementing secure connectivity solutions (e.g. VPNs Direct Connect VPN Gateways).

Experience in integrating on-premi

Public cloud technologies (AWS, Azure, IBM Cloud, Kubernetes etc.)
Strong understanding & delivery experience of cloud native architectures
Extensive experience using agile delivery methods, i.e. Scrum
Good understanding of scaled agile delivery methods, i.e. SAFe or LeSS

This role is subject to pre-employment screening in line with the UK Government’s Baseline Personnel Security Standard (BPSS). An additional range of Personal Security Controls referred to as National Security Vetting (NVS) may apply, this could include meeting the eligibility requirements for The Security Check (SC) or Developed Vetting (DV).

Preferred Technical And Professional Experience

Good knowledge of system design & delivery
Java & JavaScript frameworks eg Spring Boot, React, Angular, J2EE
Enterprise integration technologies (Kafka, MQ, IBM Streams, ESBs, ETL etc)
Enterprise level persistence technologies (Oracle, Postgres, DB2, NoSQL, Redis, Graph etc.)
Estimation experience (top down, bottom up, planning poker etc.)
Experienced in architectural languages or frameworks e.g. UML, Zachman, TOGAF
Understanding of Automation in the development, testing and operations context.

Being a best-in-class SaaS company, we understand that bringing in new ideas and innovative technology is mission critical. At BlackLine we are always working with new, cutting-edge technology that encourages our teams to learn something new and expand their creativity and technical skillset that will accelerate their careers.
This role is specifically for our AI-powered Invoice-to-Cash (I2C) solution, a market-leading platform that uses intelligent automation to help companies collect cash faster, unlock working capital, and supercharge efficiency in their accounts receivable processes.
Work, Play and Grow at BlackLine!

As one of the founding engineers of our new Engineering Hub in Krakow
, you are joining at a moment that rarely comes twice in a career. You will be an early shaper of this hub's engineering culture, setting standards, mentoring future teammates, and leaving a mark on a product used by finance teams across the globe.
You will bring strong hands-on engineering skills and a growth mindset to a team that moves fast and takes quality seriously. In our mission to deliver autonomous finance, you will leverage modern AI development tools like Claude and Cursor as force multipliers, shipping high-impact features on a mission-critical enterprise platform.
You'll Get To
Build and Ship High-Impact Features
: Take full ownership of complex features from concept to production, writing clean, performant, and well-tested code for a mission-critical enterprise application.
Embrace AI-Accelerated Development
: Utilize agentic development tools (e.g., Cursor, Claude) to radically accelerate the design, coding, and testing lifecycle for your team.
Drive Technical Design
: Design and implement scalable, robust, and maintainable solutions for our core SaaS platform, ensuring the long-term health of our codebase.
Collaborate and Influence
: Partner closely with product managers, designers, and other engineers to refine requirements, contribute to the technical roadmap, and deliver exceptional value to our customers.
Engineer for Enterprise Scale
: Ensure our systems are built with a relentless focus on performance, reliability, and security to meet the demands of a global user base.
Mentor and Elevate
: Act as a technical leader and mentor within the team, elevating the engineering bar through code reviews, knowledge sharing, and establishing best practices

Technical/Specialized Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities
Demonstrated expertise in using AI-driven development tools (e.g., Cursor, Claude) to significantly improve software engineering velocity and quality
Strong experience designing, building, and deploying production-grade, scalable, and secure SaaS applications.
Proficiency in C# is required, with a deep understanding of software architecture, data structures, and algorithms.
A proven track record of driving complex projects from ambiguous requirements to successful launch.
A strong foundation in modern software development practices, including CI/CD, automated testing, and infrastructure-as-code.
A strong observability mindset—logging, metrics, and distributed tracing across microservices.
Excellent written and verbal communication skills; comfortable working across time zones.

We’re Even More Excited If You Have
Proven ability to translate complex business problems into simple, elegant technical solutions.

Proficiency in Python or C# and experience with relevant libraries and frameworks (e.g., Hugging Face Transformers, LangChain, LangGraph, PyTorch).

A deep understanding of dataset engineering, including data curation, augmentation, and synthesis. Proven experience in designing and building end-to-end Generative AI systems, from data ingestion and model orchestration to scalable deployment and continuous monitoring.
A strong grasp of LLMOps principles and hands-on experience with tools and platforms for managing the entire lifecycle of Large Language Models in production.
Experience with Model Composition (MCP) techniques, demonstrating an ability to solve complex problems by intelligently combining multiple specialized models or AI agents.
Deep knowledge of Responsible AI principles and practical experience in implementing robust guardrails, safety filters, and ethical considerations into generative models to ensure fairness, transparency, and accountability.

new_jobs.description:
Dołącz do Etteplan

W Etteplan wierzymy, że technologia ma sens tylko wtedy, gdy pomaga rozwiązywać realne problemy biznesowe. Tworzymy i rozwijamy rozwiązania software'owe dla klientów z różnych gałęzi przemysłu, łącząc kompetencje z obszaru software, inżynierii i digitalizacji.

Obecnie poszukujemy Senior Java Developera
, który dołączy do projektu realizowanego dla międzynarodowego klienta z sektora przemysłowego i będzie współtworzył rozwiązania wykorzystywane w codziennej działalności organizacji działających na rynkach międzynarodowych.

O projekcie

Dołączysz do zespołu rozwijającego platformę wspierającą procesy produkcyjne oraz zarządzanie dokumentacją i jakością w środowisku przemysłowym. Rozwiązanie wykorzystywane jest przez międzynarodowe organizacje i odgrywa istotną rolę w ich codziennej działalności operacyjnej.

Projekt obejmuje zarówno rozwój nowych funkcjonalności, jak i utrzymanie oraz stopniową modernizację istniejących rozwiązań. Nie jest to wyłącznie development ani wyłącznie maintenance - zależy nam na osobach, które potrafią spojrzeć na system całościowo, proponować usprawnienia i brać odpowiedzialność za jakość dostarczanych rozwiązań.

Na co dzień będziesz współpracować z międzynarodowym zespołem oraz ekspertami biznesowymi i technicznymi po stronie klienta.

Jak wykorzystujemy AI?

W tym projekcie narzędzia AI są naturalnym elementem codziennej pracy zespołu. Wspierają analizę kodu, implementację nowych funkcjonalności, automatyzację powtarzalnych zadań oraz zwiększanie efektywności procesu wytwarzania oprogramowania.

Szukamy osoby, która świadomie wykorzystuje rozwiązania AI jako wsparcie swojej pracy i chce rozwijać ten sposób tworzenia oprogramowania.

Dlaczego warto?

W tej roli:

rozwijasz rozwiązania wykorzystywane przez międzynarodową organizację z sektora przemysłowego,
masz realny wpływ na kierunek rozwoju systemu oraz jakość dostarczanych rozwiązań,
pracujesz w środowisku, które ceni samodzielność, inicjatywę i odpowiedzialność zamiast szczegółowego zarządzania zadaniami,
współpracujesz bezpośrednio z doświadczonym zespołem oraz klientem,
wykorzystujesz nowoczesne narzędzia AI wspierające proces tworzenia oprogramowania,
masz możliwość okazjonalnych wyjazdów służbowych do Finlandii lub Norwegii.

W tej roli będziesz odpowiadać za:

rozwój oraz utrzymanie aplikacji opartych o Javę,
implementację nowych funkcjonalności oraz analizę i usuwanie błędów,
pracę z relacyjnymi bazami danych oraz warstwą dostępu do danych,
integrację aplikacji z pozostałymi komponentami środowiska klienta,
współpracę z zespołami technicznymi i biznesowymi,
dbanie o jakość kodu, wydajność oraz dobre praktyki inżynierskie,
proponowanie usprawnień oraz aktywny udział w rozwoju systemu,
wykorzystywanie narzędzi AI wspierających proces wytwarzania oprogramowania.

Jesteś naszym brakującym ogniwem, jeśli:

masz kilkuletnie doświadczenie komercyjne jako Senior Java Developer,
bardzo dobrze znasz Javę oraz środowisko WildFly,
posiadasz praktyczne doświadczenie z Hibernate, JPA lub innymi rozwiązaniami ORM,
pracowałeś/-aś z bazami danych Microsoft SQL Server oraz Oracle,
rozumiesz zagadnienia związane ze środowiskami kontenerowymi, maszynami wirtualnymi oraz infrastrukturą aplikacyjną,
lubisz przejmować odpowiedzialność za realizowane rozwiązania i doprowadzać zadania do końca,
dobrze odnajdujesz się zarówno przy rozwoju nowych funkcjonalności, jak i utrzymaniu istniejących systemów,
wykorzystujesz narzędzia AI jako wsparcie codziennej pracy programistycznej,
swobodnie komunikujesz się w języku angielskim.

Docenimy również doświadczenie w jednym lub kilku z poniższych obszarów:

integracja systemów z wykorzystaniem brokerów komunikatów, takich jak RabbitMQ,
rozwój i utrzymanie aplikacji działających w środowiskach produkcyjnych,
projektowanie lub rozwój systemów o rozproszonej architekturze,
współpraca z klientami z sektora przemysłowego lub produkcyjnego,
wykorzystanie narzędzi AI do automatyzacji i usprawniania procesu developmentu,
zainteresowanie tematyką spawalnictwa lub doświadczenie zdobyte w branży przemysłowej.

W Etteplan możesz liczyć na:

rozwój poprzez pracę w międzynarodowym środowisku i różnorodnych projektach oraz wymianę wiedzy w grupach kompetencyjnych,
budżet szkoleniowy i indywidualną ścieżkę rozwoju wspieraną przez regularne spotkania z managerem,
prywatną opiekę medyczną Medicover, kartę MultiSport, grupowe ubezpieczenie na życie oraz dofinansowanie do posiłków,
elastyczne godziny pracy i możliwość współpracy w modelu hybrydowym,
udział w inicjatywach technologicznych oraz społecznościach eksperckich,
możliwość okazjonalnych wyjazdów służbowych do krajów nordyckich.

Jak przebiega proces rekrutacyjny?

Aplikacja Prześlij nam swoje CV (najlepiej w języku angielskim). W formularzu poprosimy Cię również o informację o oczekiwaniach finansowych, preferowanej formie współpracy oraz dostępności.
Analiza aplikacji Przyjrzymy się Twojemu doświadczeniu i sprawdzimy, jak odpowiada ono potrzebom projektu.
Rozmowa z HR (online) Podczas około godzinnego spotkania porozmawiamy o Twoim doświadczeniu, motywacji oraz oczekiwaniach, a także opowiemy więcej o projekcie i sposobie pracy zespołu.
Rozmowa techniczna (online) Spotkasz się z przedstawicielami zespołu projektowego. Porozmawiamy o Twoich doświadczeniach z Javą, realizowanych projektach oraz podejściu do rozwiązywania problemów technicznych.
Decyzja i feedback Niezależnie od wyniku procesu wrócimy do Ciebie z informacją zwrotną.

Możesz też zajrzeć na naszą stronę internetową lub Facebooka i zobaczyć, co ciekawego się u nas dzieje!

Nasza firma wdrożyła procedury ochrony sygnalistów zgodnie z obowiązującą ustawą. Każda osoba ma prawo zgłaszać nieprawidłowości w bezpieczny sposób, a zgłoszenia są objęte pełną ochroną prawną. Więcej informacji: https://www.etteplan.com/pl/kodeks-postepowania/

new_jobs.description:
Company Description

Inetum Polska
is part of the global Inetum Group and plays a key role in driving the digital transformation of businesses and public institutions. Operating in cities such as Warsaw, Poznan, Katowice, Lublin, Rzeszow, Lodz the company offers a wide range of IT services. Inetum Polska actively supports employee development by fully funding training, certifications, and participation in technology conferences. Additionally, the company is involved in local social initiatives, such as charitable projects and promoting an active lifestyle. It prides itself on fostering a diverse and inclusive work environment, ensuring equal opportunities for all.

Globally, Inetum operates in 19 countries and employs over 28,000 professionals. The company focuses on four key areas:

Consulting (Inetum Consulting): Strategic advisory services that help organizations define and implement innovative solutions.
Infrastructure and Application Management (Inetum Technologies): Designing and managing IT systems tailored to clients’ individual needs.
Software Implementation (Inetum Solutions): Deploying partner solutions from industry leaders like Microsoft, SAP, Salesforce, and ServiceNow.
Custom Software Development (Inetum Software): Creating unique software solutions to meet specific client needs.

With strategic partnerships with major technology giants, including Microsoft, SAP, Salesforce, and ServiceNow, Inetum delivers advanced technological solutions tailored to customer requirements. In 2023, Inetum reported revenues of €2.5 billion, underscoring its strong position in the digital services market.

Inetum distinguishes itself by offering a comprehensive range of benefits that meet the diverse needs of employees, providing flexibility, support and commitment. Here's what makes working at Inetum unique:

Flexible and hybrid work:

Flexible working hours.
Hybrid work model, allowing employees to divide their time between home and modern offices in key Polish cities.

Attractive financial benefits:

A cafeteria system that allows employees to personalize benefits by choosing from a variety of options.
Generous referral bonuses, offering up to PLN6,000 for referring specialists.
Additional revenue sharing opportunities for initiating partnerships with new clients.

Professional development and team support:

Ongoing guidance from a dedicated Team Manager for each employee.
Tailored technical mentoring from an assigned technical leader, depending on individual expertise and project needs.

Community and Well-Being:

Dedicated team-building budget for online and on-site team events.
Opportunities to participate in charitable initiatives and local sports programs.
A supportive and inclusive work culture with an emphasis on diversity and mutual respect.

Job Description

We're looking for a JVM Software Engineer to join our team. In this role, you'll be instrumental in developing, maintaining, and enhancing IoT solutions built on the Cumulocity platform. If you have a strong background in Java, microservices, and a desire to work with cutting-edge IoT technologies, we encourage you to apply!

Main tasks:

Develop and configure IoT applications primarily based on the Cumulocity platform (Administration, Device Management, Cockpit).
Design and implement software components that align with business needs, company standards, and security best practices.
Support and maintain existing IoT solutions, focusing on performance, scalability, and code quality.
Contribute to the implementation and maintenance of CI/CD pipelines.
Participate in software architecture design discussions, collaborating closely with architects.
Lead functional or technical scopes within the team, promoting best practices and fostering a culture of excellence.
Produce comprehensive technical documentation and actively share knowledge with the team.
Support the recruitment and onboarding of new developers.

Qualifications

Strong proficiency in Java (Spring Boot, Java Persistence API) with significant experience in microservices (multi-tenant) and SOA/cloud architectures.
Foundational understanding and practical experience with Docker, Kubernetes, Azure DevOps, Git, and SonarQube (user-level knowledge for development purposes).
Experience with RESTful APIs and queue/event-based communication (e.g., RabbitMQ, Kafka, ActiveMQ, Azure Service Bus, or Azure IoT Hub). Familiarity with web services (REST, OpenAPI specification) and device protocols (HTTP).
Understanding and practical application of OAuth and RBAC.
Experience with PostgreSQL, MongoDB, and Redis.
Proficiency in JUnit and Mockito.
Good command of technical and professional English.
Experience working within Agile methodologies (SCRUM).

Nice to have requirements:

Direct experience with Cumulocity (Administration, Device Management, Cockpit).
Familiarity with MQTT, CoAP, TALQ.
Other programming languages: knowledge of Node.js, Python, C++.
Experience with Vitest, Jest.
Knowledge of LAN / LPWAN wireless technologies (e.g., NB-IoT, LoRaWAN).

Build The Cloud Platform That’s Transforming Electronics Design. Altium offers the opportunity to conceive and build new product features for electronics engineers, and add your own ideas to the world’s most collaborative and efficient electronics design platform.

Handle tech challenges different from most others on the market, a mixture of complex engineering software, microelectronics and cloud services

new_jobs.title: Copilot Studio Developer
new_jobs.description:
Location: Katowice/Wrocław/Warsaw - 2 days in office / 3 days remote

Let us introduce you the job offer by EY GDS Poland – a member of the global integrated service delivery center network by EY.

Copilot Studio Developer
works within a technologically versatile team located in Poland, providing consulting services to biggest market players in EMEIA region and around the globe.

The opportunity

With a constant growth of our business and customers’ needs we are willing to move our projects on the new track. We are able to offer you a senior developer role with opportunity to support your further professional growth. You will work as part of a team that designs, develops, tests, deploys and supports different types of solutions using Power Platform, RPA and other modern technologies. You will work with the most recognizable and influential players on the financial markets within the challenging projects.

Your Key Responsibilities

In this role you will predominantly:

Design, develop, test, and deploy automations and transform business processes using Power Platform stack
Design, develop, test, and deploy Power Apps tools
Design, develop, test, and deploy agentic solutions using Microsoft Copilot Studio, focusing on low-code approaches.
Integrate Copilot Studio solutions with various business systems, leveraging the Power Platform and other relevant technologies.
Provide support and maintenance to the existing automations and applications
Collaborate with business stakeholders to understand their needs, identify opportunities for AI-powered automation, and translate requirements into effective technical solutions.
Stay up-to-date with the latest advancements in Copilot Studio, Power Platform, and related AI technologies.

Skills And Attributes For Success

We are looking for experienced individuals with RPA and/or Power Platform skills, ready to further develop their technical and consulting skills across a variety of business processes, who are able to work independently but also as a part of a team.

To qualify for the role, you must have

Proven experience in implementing Power Platform solutions using Canvas Apps, Model Driven Apps, Power Pages (Portal), Power Automate
Proven experience in creating agents in Copilot Studio
Proven track record integrating Power Platform solutions with enterprise systems via REST APIs, Azure Functions, or Logic Apps.
Ability to translate business requirements into technical specs and manage projects independently.
Excellent communication skills in English; comfortable engaging both technical and non-technical stakeholders.

Ideally, you’ll also have

Experience in using Autogen or Microsoft Agent Framework
Experience with .Net framework.
Solid scripting or coding in JavaScript or C# for custom connectors and UI tweaks.
SQL Server or Azure SQL schema design and performance tuning.
Power Platform or Azure AI certification (PL-200 / AI-102 or similar).
Experience facilitating technical workshops or hackathons.

What We Look For

We love working with people who are passionate about their job and have great interpersonal skills, who are ready to face new professional challenges. Are you a person with a good sense of humor and open to significantly extend your skillset? If yes, it’s a role for you.

What We Offer

EY Global Delivery Services (GDS) is a dynamic and truly global delivery network. We work across nine locations – Argentina, Hungary, India, the Philippines, Poland, Sri Lanka, Mexico, Spain and the United Kingdom – and with teams from all EY service lines, geographies and sectors, playing a vital role in the delivery of the EY growth strategy. In GDS, you will collaborate with EY teams on exciting projects and work with well-known brands from across the globe. We’ll introduce you to an ever-expanding ecosystem of people, learning, skills and insights that will stay with you throughout your career.

Continuous learning: You’ll develop the mindset and skills to navigate whatever comes next.
Success as defined by you: We’ll provide the tools and flexibility, so you can make a meaningful impact, your way.
Transformative leadership: We’ll give you the insights, coaching and confidence to be the leader the world needs.
Diverse and inclusive culture: You’ll be embraced for who you are and empowered to use your voice to help others find theirs.

EY exists to build a better working world, helping to create long-term value for clients, people and society and build trust in the capital markets.

Dołącz do Etteplan

W Etteplan wierzymy, że technologia ma sens tylko wtedy, gdy pomaga rozwiązywać realne problemy biznesowe. Tworzymy i rozwijamy rozwiązania software'owe dla klientów z różnych gałęzi przemysłu, łącząc kompetencje z obszaru software, inżynierii i digitalizacji.

Obecnie poszukujemy Senior Java Developera
, który dołączy do projektu realizowanego dla międzynarodowego klienta z sektora przemysłowego i będzie współtworzył rozwiązania wykorzystywane w codziennej działalności organizacji działających na rynkach międzynarodowych.

O projekcie

Dołączysz do zespołu rozwijającego platformę wspierającą procesy produkcyjne oraz zarządzanie dokumentacją i jakością w środowisku przemysłowym. Rozwiązanie wykorzystywane jest przez międzynarodowe organizacje i odgrywa istotną rolę w ich codziennej działalności operacyjnej.

Projekt obejmuje zarówno rozwój nowych funkcjonalności, jak i utrzymanie oraz stopniową modernizację istniejących rozwiązań. Nie jest to wyłącznie development ani wyłącznie maintenance - zależy nam na osobach, które potrafią spojrzeć na system całościowo, proponować usprawnienia i brać odpowiedzialność za jakość dostarczanych rozwiązań.

Na co dzień będziesz współpracować z międzynarodowym zespołem oraz ekspertami biznesowymi i technicznymi po stronie klienta.

Jak wykorzystujemy AI?

W tym projekcie narzędzia AI są naturalnym elementem codziennej pracy zespołu. Wspierają analizę kodu, implementację nowych funkcjonalności, automatyzację powtarzalnych zadań oraz zwiększanie efektywności procesu wytwarzania oprogramowania.

Szukamy osoby, która świadomie wykorzystuje rozwiązania AI jako wsparcie swojej pracy i chce rozwijać ten sposób tworzenia oprogramowania.

Dlaczego warto?

W tej roli:

rozwijasz rozwiązania wykorzystywane przez międzynarodową organizację z sektora przemysłowego,
masz realny wpływ na kierunek rozwoju systemu oraz jakość dostarczanych rozwiązań,
pracujesz w środowisku, które ceni samodzielność, inicjatywę i odpowiedzialność zamiast szczegółowego zarządzania zadaniami,
współpracujesz bezpośrednio z doświadczonym zespołem oraz klientem,
wykorzystujesz nowoczesne narzędzia AI wspierające proces tworzenia oprogramowania,
masz możliwość okazjonalnych wyjazdów służbowych do Finlandii lub Norwegii.

W tej roli będziesz odpowiadać za:

rozwój oraz utrzymanie aplikacji opartych o Javę,
implementację nowych funkcjonalności oraz analizę i usuwanie błędów,
pracę z relacyjnymi bazami danych oraz warstwą dostępu do danych,
integrację aplikacji z pozostałymi komponentami środowiska klienta,
współpracę z zespołami technicznymi i biznesowymi,
dbanie o jakość kodu, wydajność oraz dobre praktyki inżynierskie,
proponowanie usprawnień oraz aktywny udział w rozwoju systemu,
wykorzystywanie narzędzi AI wspierających proces wytwarzania oprogramowania.

Jesteś naszym brakującym ogniwem, jeśli:

masz kilkuletnie doświadczenie komercyjne jako Senior Java Developer,
bardzo dobrze znasz Javę oraz środowisko WildFly,
posiadasz praktyczne doświadczenie z Hibernate, JPA lub innymi rozwiązaniami ORM,
pracowałeś/-aś z bazami danych Microsoft SQL Server oraz Oracle,
rozumiesz zagadnienia związane ze środowiskami kontenerowymi, maszynami wirtualnymi oraz infrastrukturą aplikacyjną,
lubisz przejmować odpowiedzialność za realizowane rozwiązania i doprowadzać zadania do końca,
dobrze odnajdujesz się zarówno przy rozwoju nowych funkcjonalności, jak i utrzymaniu istniejących systemów,
wykorzystujesz narzędzia AI jako wsparcie codziennej pracy programistycznej,
swobodnie komunikujesz się w języku angielskim.

Docenimy również doświadczenie w jednym lub kilku z poniższych obszarów:

integracja systemów z wykorzystaniem brokerów komunikatów, takich jak RabbitMQ,
rozwój i utrzymanie aplikacji działających w środowiskach produkcyjnych,
projektowanie lub rozwój systemów o rozproszonej architekturze,
współpraca z klientami z sektora przemysłowego lub produkcyjnego,
wykorzystanie narzędzi AI do automatyzacji i usprawniania procesu developmentu,
zainteresowanie tematyką spawalnictwa lub doświadczenie zdobyte w branży przemysłowej.

W Etteplan możesz liczyć na:

rozwój poprzez pracę w międzynarodowym środowisku i różnorodnych projektach oraz wymianę wiedzy w grupach kompetencyjnych,
budżet szkoleniowy i indywidualną ścieżkę rozwoju wspieraną przez regularne spotkania z managerem,
prywatną opiekę medyczną Medicover, kartę MultiSport, grupowe ubezpieczenie na życie oraz dofinansowanie do posiłków,
elastyczne godziny pracy i możliwość współpracy w modelu hybrydowym,
udział w inicjatywach technologicznych oraz społecznościach eksperckich,
możliwość okazjonalnych wyjazdów służbowych do krajów nordyckich.

Jak przebiega proces rekrutacyjny?

Aplikacja Prześlij nam swoje CV (najlepiej w języku angielskim). W formularzu poprosimy Cię również o informację o oczekiwaniach finansowych, preferowanej formie współpracy oraz dostępności.
Analiza aplikacji Przyjrzymy się Twojemu doświadczeniu i sprawdzimy, jak odpowiada ono potrzebom projektu.
Rozmowa z HR (online) Podczas około godzinnego spotkania porozmawiamy o Twoim doświadczeniu, motywacji oraz oczekiwaniach, a także opowiemy więcej o projekcie i sposobie pracy zespołu.
Rozmowa techniczna (online) Spotkasz się z przedstawicielami zespołu projektowego. Porozmawiamy o Twoich doświadczeniach z Javą, realizowanych projektach oraz podejściu do rozwiązywania problemów technicznych.
Decyzja i feedback Niezależnie od wyniku procesu wrócimy do Ciebie z informacją zwrotną.

Możesz też zajrzeć na naszą stronę internetową lub Facebooka i zobaczyć, co ciekawego się u nas dzieje!

Nasza firma wdrożyła procedury ochrony sygnalistów zgodnie z obowiązującą ustawą. Każda osoba ma prawo zgłaszać nieprawidłowości w bezpieczny sposób, a zgłoszenia są objęte pełną ochroną prawną. Więcej informacji: https://www.etteplan.com/pl/kodeks-postepowania/

new_jobs.title: System Developer - Portfolio Investments Applications
new_jobs.description:
Myntro is a company in the middle of a transformation, shifting toward a more product- and technology-driven, data-enabled business. We are looking for a System Developer who wants to join that journey and help build our future. Are you a curious builder who enjoys creating new systems, navigating complexity, and using modern technology to solve real business problems? Then keep reading!

About The Role

As a System Developer at Myntro, you'll join a small DevOps team with end-to-end ownership of applications and systems at the heart of our debt portfolio investment business. Working closely with our investment team, you'll help turn complex portfolio data into reliable systems that support valuation, purchasing decisions, and portfolio management.

Our current focus is building a new investment platform and the services around it. You'll have real opportunities to design and build new capabilities, while also improving and maintaining the existing systems that keep the business running. You'll contribute across the development lifecycle and help shape technical decisions with both immediate and long-term impact.

In this role, you will:

Design, build, and maintain systems, services, and integrations for our debt portfolio investment business.
Develop a new investment platform that supports portfolio valuation, purchasing, and management.
Take ownership from design and implementation through deployment, operation, and continuous improvement.
Build with C#/.NET, SQL, Azure services, and microservice and event-driven architectures.
Improve and simplify existing applications and data flows in a complex technical landscape.
Contribute to architecture, Azure infrastructure, code quality, testing, observability, and how we build.

Who You Are

We are looking for someone who is curious, self-driven, and likes real engineering work. You enjoy understanding both the business problem and how systems actually behave, finding weak points, and making them better. You're comfortable exploring unfamiliar areas and learning what you need to move the work forward.

You take ownership, care about quality, and like building things that hold up in production. You're pragmatic and collaborative, but you don't wait for someone else to define every step. You can move between new development, architecture, infrastructure, data, and existing applications based on what the problem requires.

AI-assisted development isn't new to you; it's already part of how you work. You have your own setup, your own opinions, and you're paying attention to where the craft is heading. That matters here. We're actively building AI into both how we develop and what we deliver, and we need people who are already leaning in, not catching up.

We see that you likely have:

A degree in Computer Science, or equivalent practical experience.
3+ years of software development experience, ideally in production-critical environments.
Strong .NET/C# development skills.
Solid understanding of SQL, data modelling, and data flows.
Hands-on experience with Azure, cloud infrastructure, and microservice architectures.
Good communication skills in Swedish and English.

Experience in investment systems, finance, or debt portfolios is not required. What matters is that you're interested in learning the business context and applying your engineering skills to it.

Why join Myntro?

At Myntro, you'll work in a small team with broad ownership and close access to the people who use what you build. The new investment platform is important to how we value, purchase, and manage debt portfolios, and there is still plenty to design, build, and shape.

This is a good place if you are looking for variety, responsibility, and the opportunity to combine software development with architecture, cloud infrastructure, data, and real business problems. You'll be part of a team that's expected to think, build, operate, and improve together.

Our culture is built on care, accountability, and the belief that the best results come from working together. Collaboration, customer focus, personal accountability, and simplicity are how we actually make decisions, not just words on a wall.

Interested? Welcome to apply!

Sounds like your next challenge? We review applications and interview on a rolling basis, so don't wait too long to apply. The role is full-time and based at our head office in central Gothenburg.

For questions regarding the role or recruitment process, please contact Azra Semic, our Talent Acquisition Specialist – azra.semic@myntro.com.

We look forward to receiving your application!

new_jobs.title: Software Engineer - Checkout
new_jobs.description:
What We Do At Qliro

At Qliro we deliver safe and simple payments. We are a dedicated partner to our merchants who serve their customers every day. We believe that if our merchants grow, we grow. We are a company of dedicated, friendly and highly competent people that together have redefined what Qliro and payments can be. We are now on a journey of scaling our business both here in Sweden and the Nordics.

What we are looking for

We are opening a Software Engineer
position in our Checkout team
, responsible for building and evolving checkout solutions for our merchants, while ensuring a safe and simple payment experience for their customers.

You will join a full‑stack team that values innovation, collaboration, and having fun at work.

Our tech stack includes:

✅ React, Redux, C# (.NET 8/10)

✅ AWS, SQL, DynamoDB, Terraform

✅ Observability with Grafana and Kibana

✅ AI development with Claude

You can expect to:

Work on a variety of exciting payment‑related projects, processing millions in SEK every day for thousands of customers, with a strong focus on usability, scalability, and security.
Use technologies such as .NET, React, Redux, AWS, GitLab, Terraform, and more.
Work with modern, AI‑assisted development tools such as Claude to improve productivity, code quality, and collaboration.
Contribute throughout the entire product lifecycle: design, implementation, testing, release, and maintenance.
Take part in architectural discussions and drive technical improvements.
Collaborate continuously: we strongly believe in teamwork, thoughtful code reviews and shared ownership.
Learn continuously, both on the job and through our learning platform, and share knowledge with your colleagues.
Have fun while working in a fast‑growing area and organisation.

What we are looking for:

You are an experienced software engineer who takes ownership, drives initiatives, collaborates closely with stakeholders, and actively contributes to architectural discussions and technical decision‑making.
You have experience with our tech stack or similar technologies and are confident working across both frontend and backend.
You are curious and pragmatic about AI, and enjoy exploring how tools like Claude can be used to support better engineering practices and decision‑making.
You value knowledge sharing and see learning and helping each other grow as a natural part of teamwork.
You are willing to participate in the team’s on‑call rotation (with extra compensation).
Experience from financial institutions, payments, or e‑commerce, whether technical or non‑technical, is a strong advantage.
You communicate fluently and confidently in English, both verbally and in writing. Swedish is not a prerequisite.

WOW in everything we do

Qliro is the place for those who are curious, passionate, and love collaboration. Together, we create wow in everything we do. We want you to feel comfortable being yourself and bringing your unique perspectives. At Qliro, there is a place for you, whoever you are. We believe differences make us stronger.

We value flexibility and remote work, while also believing in the power of meeting in real life. With a mix of remote work and office collaboration, we aim to create a flexible workplace that works for both you and Qliro.

Does this sound like your next role? What are you waiting for - apply now!

Qliro is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will be considered for employment without regard to gender, gender identity or expression, national origin, religion or other beliefs, disability, sexual orientation or age .

Description

Customer Support Engineer – Hybrid – Gothenburg, Sweden

We seek a Customer Support Engineer to join our team at Microdeb in Gothenburg, Sweden!

About The Role

We're looking for a Support Engineer to join our team in Gothenburg. This is not a ticket-shuffling role. You'll be the person customers rely on when something breaks, when a query won't return, when a deployment misbehaves — and you'll have the technical depth to actually fix it, not just escalate it. You'll work across SQL databases, light development tasks, and customer-facing troubleshooting, with modern AI tools as a core part of how you work.

What You'll Do

Own customer issues end-to-end, from first contact through root cause and resolution.

Answer and handle incoming customer support calls as part of the day-to-day role, providing first-line technical assistance, troubleshooting issues, and taking ownership of follow-up through to resolution.

Diagnose and resolve database problems: query performance, indexing, locking, data integrity, backup and recovery.

Write and review SQL — from quick investigative queries to stored procedures and schema changes.

Read, debug, and occasionally patch application code to identify the source of issues.

Reproduce bugs in test environments, file detailed reports for engineering, and follow through. Build internal tools, scripts, and automations that reduce repeat work and speed up diagnosis.

Use AI tools (Claude, Copilot, internal LLM workflows) to accelerate investigation, draft responses, generate queries, and analyze logs.

Improve documentation and runbooks so the next person resolves the same issue faster.

What We're Looking For

Solid hands-on experience as a DBA or in a database-heavy support or engineering role. Strong SQL skills — you can write complex queries, read execution plans, and tune performance without reaching for a tutorial. Working knowledge of at least one general-purpose language (Python, C#, Java, JavaScript, or similar) — enough to read a codebase, debug, and write small fixes or tools. Fluency with AI-assisted workflows: you already use LLMs daily for coding, investigation, and writing, and you have opinions about where they help and where they don't. A bias for action: you'd rather dig in and reproduce the issue than wait for more information. Clear written and verbal communication in Swedish and English — you can explain a technical problem to a non-technical customer and to a senior engineer in the same day. Based in or willing to relocate to Gothenburg.

Nice to have

Experience with cloud databases (Azure SQL, AWS RDS, Snowflake, or similar). Familiarity with observability tools (Datadog, Grafana, OpenTelemetry). Exposure to CI/CD and infrastructure-as-code. Swedish language skills are a must for this role.

Why this role

You'll see more of the product, the codebase, and real customer problems than almost any other role. Support engineers here move into platform, backend, or SRE roles when they want to. We invest in AI tooling and expect everyone to use it well — not as a gimmick, but as leverage.

Here is a little window into our company:
Microdeb is a leading provider of integrated payment and order management solutions, helping businesses modernize their payment ecosystems. With years of experience, a dedicated team of experts, and a passion for technology, we continuously innovate to meet the evolving needs of our clients. Microdeb was acquired by Valsoft and now operates under the Aspire Software portfolio. Aspire Software, the operational arm of Valsoft, operates and manages Valsoft’s global portfolio of wholly owned software companies, providing mission-critical solutions across multiple verticals. By implementing industry best practices, Aspire delivers a time-sensitive integration process, and the operation of a decentralized model has allowed it to become a hub for creating rapid growth by reinvesting in its portfolio.

The successful candidate will be based anywhere in Sweden, working in a hybrid work model from our office in Gothenburg!

Required

:

Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Information Systems, or equivalent practical experience
2+ years in a technical support, DBA, or software engineering role with direct customer or stakeholder contact
Demonstrable SQL expertise: joins, window functions, CTEs, indexing strategy, query plan analysis, and performance tuning on a major RDBMS (SQL Server, PostgreSQL, MySQL, or Oracle)

Working knowledge of Git and standard development workflows (branches, pull requests, code review)
Experience using AI coding assistants and LLMs as part of a daily workflow — writing prompts that produce useful output, knowing when to verify, knowing when not to use them.
Strong written and spoken English. Eligible to work in Sweden

Preferred

Experience with cloud-hosted databases (Azure SQL, AWS RDS or Aurora, Google Cloud SQL, Snowflake, BigQuery)
Familiarity with Linux command line, shell scripting, and basic networking (DNS, TLS, HTTP, firewalls)
Exposure to containerization (Docker) and orchestration (Kubernetes). Experience with logging and observability stacks (ELK, Datadog, Grafana, Splunk, OpenTelemetry)

Swedish language skills

Personal attributes

Curious by default — you want to know why something broke, not just how to make the symptom go away
Comfortable holding two threads at once: the customer who needs an answer now, and the underlying defect that needs a proper fix
Disciplined writer — your tickets, postmortems, and documentation make life easier for the next person. Direct and honest in communication, internally and with customers
Treats AI tools as leverage, not as a crutch — verifies output, understands the code that gets generated, and improves prompts over time

We're not a call centre, and we're not a feature factory — we're a team that takes pride in solving real problems well

Developing AI solutions has been one of the most rewarding experiences of my career: it’s rare to work on something that simultaneously feels like exploring something entirely new and building the future.”

Read more of our developers’ thoughts on ‘How AI is reshaping software projects’ from our website, and get to know our very own LLM platform FunctionAI that our experts use in project deliveries.

What we are looking for

We hope you share our passion for writing high-quality code and collaborating in cross-functional teams. You don’t need to have worked under the title “AI Developer” before: what matters most is your curiosity towards AI, strong technical skills, and the ability to bridge software development and AI in your daily work.

We Expect You To Have

A strong background in software development: at least 5 years of professional experience in full-stack software development using Java, TypeScript, C# or Python.

Why Solita is a great place to work

Freedom and flexibility: We know there is more to life than work. That is why we value flexibility and support a healthy work–life balance through trust, autonomy, and a culture that puts people first.
People first: Your wellbeing matters to us as much as your skills. We offer flexible ways of working, comprehensive employee benefits, and dedicated People Leads who provide support in all kinds of everyday situations.
Benefits for every need: Pick the devices that suit you best, enjoy extensive occupational healthcare, relax with regular massages, work with our in-house coaches, or recharge through our hobby clubs and community activities.
Fair and transparent pay: We believe great teamwork happens when there’s no pressure from billing-based salary models: that is why we offer a fixed monthly salary and encourage collaboration and shared success.

new_jobs.title: AI Architect
new_jobs.description:
We are currently looking for an AI Architect to join our AI, Analytics & Agents business area in Finland.

At Solita AI, Analytics & Agents community, we support our customers throughout their entire AI journey, from early ideation to scaling AI adoption across the whole organization. We believe that impactful AI solutions are created through multidisciplinary collaboration, combining business and process expertise, cutting-edge technology & AI expertise, and human-centered design. Generative AI and the application of large language models are an increasingly important part of our solutions.

We take a holistic approach to our customers’ challenges and help them build sustainable, production-ready AI solutions that deliver value in real use cases.

Your role in a nutshell

As an AI Architect, you take lead responsibility for designing, developing, and driving production‑grade AI solutions for our customers. You combine hands‑on architectural work with project‑level technical leadership, acting as both the solution architect and a senior technical contributor.

In this role, you own the overall AI solution architecture: mapping the current state of data, analytics and AI capabilities, defining future target architectures, identifying opportunities, and creating concrete, actionable roadmaps. You will be involved in all phases of the project, from ideation, and solution design to production deployment, and continuous development.

Your work places a strong emphasis on LLM-based and generative AI solutions that are embedded into real business processes. You ensure that AI solutions are designed as part of a broader IT and enterprise architecture with clear attention to security, scalability, reliability and responsible AI.

You lead AI architecture work in large projects and across teams, collaborating closely with Data Scientists, AI/ML Engineers, Cloud Architects, data specialists and business stakeholders. While you are expected to be hands-on when needed, your key responsibility is to own the overall AI solution architecture, make critical technical decisions, and ensure high‑quality outcomes.

In addition, you contribute to Solita’s technical leadership in applied AI by shaping best practices, supporting pre‑sales and solution planning, mentoring colleagues, and influencing how production‑grade AI is delivered across customer projects.

We will discuss the exact scope and focus of your role based on your experience, skills, and interests. Depending on your level of experience and responsibility, your monthly salary will range from 5800 € to 7200 €.

In practice your work includes:

Taking technical lead responsibility in AI projects, acting as a hands‑on AI Architect and guiding the overall solution from concept and implementation to production.
Working closely with customers in a consultative role, translating business needs and constraints into concrete technical designs and implementation plans.
Designing and developing LLM‑based and generative AI solutions, such as knowledge and information retrieval systems, agent‑based workflows, systems that increase the level of automation in (customer) service processes and document processing solutions.
Defining end‑to‑end AI system designs, including data flows, model orchestration, system integrations, evaluation, guardrails, and human‑AI interaction.
Designing cloud‑based AI and LLM platforms, primarily on Azure, leveraging services such as Azure AI / ML, Databricks, and cloud‑native infrastructure.
Leading architectural decisions related to scalability, security, cost efficiency, reliability, and responsible AI, in alignment with broader IT and enterprise architecture.
Participating in pre‑sales and early project phases, supporting solution scoping, technical proposals, and architecture planning in collaboration with sales.

What helps you succeed in this role

Proven experience in designing and implementing AI/ML solutions in production environments, especially with generative AI and LLM technologies.
Solid experience in mapping out architecture-level AI solutions for both business decision-makers and the implementing experts in an understandable way.
You understand deeply the logic and practicalities related to AI solutions, and non-deterministic solutions in general, and their successful development.
Hands-on experience as an AI Architect, ML Architect, Lead AI/ML Engineer or similar role, with clear responsibility for architectural decisions.
Experience with generative AI and agent architectures, including LLM technologies (e.g. Azure OpenAI / Foundry, Databricks Agent Bricks, LangChain, Semantic Kernel), RAG methods, and multi-agent solutions.
Experience in production deployment and solution operations using technologies such as Azure AI/ML Services, Databricks, MLOps/LLMOps, evaluation and guardrail tools.
Architectural and hands-on experience with cloud-based AI platforms (Azure, AWS), including building cloud infrastructure using IaC tools.
Programming skills, especially with Python but other languages such as Java or C# are also beneficial.
Ability to act as a trusted consultant, guiding and challenging our customers and collaborating effectively with teams.
Passion for solving customer needs and exploring the latest AI technologies and methods (e.g. multi-agent architectures and collaboration mechanisms, self-optimizing AI agents, agent skills, advanced knowledge and memory management solutions, etc.)
Fluent working proficiency in English.
Ability to communicate clearly with both technical experts and business stakeholders and to lead discussions around architecture
Solita's values (caring, casualness, courage, and passion) align with what you value in your work community and colleagues.

What do we offer?

Challenging, meaningful, and impactful projects with a wide variety of clients, from global companies to public organizations.
A diverse community of exceptional professionals who love to learn, challenge and support each other. You won’t be left alone.
A relaxed, caring and trust-based culture where you can be yourself.
A workplace with both freedom and responsibility. That’s what our employees see as one of the biggest benefits at Solita.
Freedom to work either remotely in Finland, in our customers’ premises, or in our offices across Finland – which option suits best at a given time.
Mentoring, coaching, and cross-unit learning opportunities to grow your expertise through Solita's multidisciplinary collaboration, long-term client work, or domain specialization (e.g., Retail, Industrial, Health).

Read more about our projects and insights from our professionals:

Solita employs several dozen professionals in data science & AI/ML engineering who work on domestic and international projects in Finland and the Nordic countries. Our professionals work as in-depth experts in their respective fields in various customer projects, e.g. in projects like this or for example at KONE.

“ At KONE we are for example supporting them to develop an intelligent maintenance service called KONE 24/7 Connected Services. An exciting project around machine learning and sensor data from more than 150,000 elevators. ” – Mikael Ruohonen, AI, Analytics & Agents, Business Lead

On a journey towards AI-driven HR service solutions across 50 countries – Solita

We would be happy to discuss what kind of role and project setup would best match your skills and goals. Please note that this role requires you to be located in Finland. Solita does not support relocation.

Our recruitment consists of phone screening and two rounds of interviews where you will meet our team and learn more about working at Solita. You will be given the opportunity to show your skills and ask us questions. The purpose is to get to know each other better.

new_jobs.title: Founding Engineer
new_jobs.description:
What Join us in building a new generation of financial services. Vahva's belief is simple: financial services work best when customers' and companies' interests are fully aligned. We're starting with insurance, because we think it's one of the clearest places to prove that financial services can be done differently, and better. Insurance is our starting point, not our end goal.

Why us Vahva is a Finnish fintech company built to put customers first, starting with how insurance works. We see insurance as a modern financial product, not a legacy category to maintain. Insurance and cashback are the beginning of a long, healthy customer relationship, one we build our wider portfolio of products around.
We're a seed-stage company, which means your voice shapes where we go next. You'll have real influence over decisions and over our customers' lives. We're building the founding team now. Join us.

What you'll do Build Vahva's consumer platform from the ground up, working side by side with the founder. You are the founding engineer in a growth-stage company bringing a new kind of insurance concept to market, first in Finland under the Vahva brand.
Ship product end-to-end: design, implement, deploy, and operate the services behind our cashback and insurance products (vahva.fi), which reward customers with real money for claim-free months, and the car-insurance products the platform grows into.
Shape the architecture of a platform that has to be reliable, secure, and scalable in a regulated industry, and ready to expand from Finland to the Nordics and beyond.
Take AI-first engineering from idea to practice: build AI into the platform and into how we work, from the ground up rather than bolted on afterward.
Set the engineering culture and lay the foundations the future team will build on: how we build, test, ship, and run software.
Work openly and close to our earliest users, who help develop the service with us; what they experience each month is the direct result of what you ship.

What we look for A senior product engineer who has built and run production systems end-to-end and is comfortable being the one who makes it work, from API design through distributed and event-driven architectures to operating enterprise-grade, cloud-native systems in production.
Experience taking an early-stage product from zero to launch: you make pragmatic calls, cut the right corners, and keep quality where it matters.
An AI-native way of building: AI-assisted development tools (Claude, GitHub Copilot, or similar coding agents) are already part of how you work, and you've designed, built, or orchestrated AI agents and agentic workflows, with a solid grasp of prompt and context engineering, RAG patterns, tool-calling agents, and multi-agent systems.
The foundations that let a small team ship fast and safely: infrastructure-as-code, CI/CD and automated deployments, and a working command of observability, security engineering, and cloud governance.
An ownership mindset: you want the responsibility and the upside of a founding role, not a ticket queue. You take end-to-end responsibility for outcomes, from delivery quality and reliability to long-term maintainability, and you create leverage for every engineer who joins after you.
Care for the trust our product runs on: money, insurance, and personal data demand security and correctness. Experience with fintech or other regulated domains is a clear advantage.
Fluent English; Finnish is a strong plus in a product built first for the Finnish market.

Technologies Applicants are expected to have knowledge of:
TypeScript
Node.js
React
PostgreSQL
Building cloud-based B2C products
AI engineering, applied from the ground up

Where we are today We're moving from pre-launch to launch and are now onboarding our first paying customers. This is a rare opportunity to join with zero technical legacy: you'll define how things are truly done, together with our earliest customers.

How to apply Apply with the form below: name, email, phone and CV. In your CV or cover note, tell us about something you've built and shipped end-to-end: what you chose, what you cut, and how it ran in production. Total compensation is competitive for a founding role, and equity in the company is available on top of salary.

Process CV review. Although we are an AI-native company, people review the CVs. AI doesn't.
