Solitan Data Science, Machine Learning & AI -yhteisössä tuemme asiakkaitamme koko tekoälymatkan läpi – ideoinnin alusta aina tekoälyn hyödyntämisen skaalaamiseen koko organisaatiossa. Uskomme, että vaikuttavat tekoälyratkaisut syntyvät monialaisessa yhteistyössä – yhdistäen liiketoiminta- ja prosessiosaamisen, huipputeknologian sekä ihmislähtöisen suunnittelun. Erityisesti generatiivinen tekoäly (GenAI) ja suurten kielimallien (LLM) soveltaminen ovat kokoajan kasvava osa ratkaisujamme.

Otamme kokonaisvaltaisen näkökulman asiakkaidemme haasteisiin ja autamme heitä rakentamaan kestäviä, tuotantokelpoisia AI-ratkaisuja, jotka tuottavat arvoa oikeissa käyttökohteissa.

Työsi pähkinänkuoressa

AI / ML Engineerin roolissa suunnittelet ja toteutat älykkäitä ratkaisuja hyödyntäen generatiivista tekoälyä, agenttipohjaisia arkkitehtuureja ja uusimpia menetelmiä. Työ sisältää muun muassa LLM-teknologioiden hyödyntämisen, agenttien suunnittelun, monimutkaistenkin työprosessien tehostamisen sekä ihmisen ja tekoälyn yhteistyön kehittämisen käytännön asiakasratkaisuissa. Olet mukana projektin kaikissa vaiheissa: ideoinnista, datan tutkimisesta ja ratkaisumallien kehittämisestä aina tuotantoon vientiin ja jatkokehitykseen.

Työsi pitää sisällään muun muassa

AI-ratkaisujen suunnittelua ja toteuttamista asiakkaille – esimerkiksi asiakaspalveluprosessin tehostamista, tiedonhakuavustajia tai dokumenttiprosessien tehostamista LLM-teknologialla
Pilvipohjaisten LLM- ja koneoppimisalustojen rakentamista ja mallien käyttöönottoa julkipilvialustoilla, kuten Azure, AWS tai GCP
MLOpsin ja CI/CD-putkien suunnittelua ja toteutusta
Konsultointia ja teknistä sparrailua asiakkaiden kanssa – usein lähellä liiketoimintaa ja päätöksentekoa

Työskentelet osana kokeneiden AI/ML-arkkitehtien, datakonsulttien ja ohjelmistokehittäjien muodostamaa tiimiä. Ratkaisut rakennetaan yhteistyössä, mutta roolissasi pääset ottamaan vastuuta ja vaikuttamaan kokonaisuuteen alusta asti.

Keskustelemme kanssasi roolin tarkemmasta vastuusta ja painotuksista aiemman kokemuksesi, osaamisesi ja kiinnostuksesi perusteella. Riippuen lopullisen roolisi kokemus- ja vastuutasosta, kuukausipalkkasi on noin 4300–5800 euroa.

Toivomme sinulta:

Käytännön kokemusta AI/ML-ratkaisujen suunnittelusta ja toteutuksesta tuotantoympäristöissä – erityisesti generatiivisen tekoälyn ja LLM-teknologian parista
Generatiivinen tekoäly ja agenttiarkkitehtuurit: LLM-teknologiat (esim. Azure OpenAI / Foundry, Databricks Agent Bricks, LangChain, Semantic Kernel), RAG-menetelmät ja multi-agent -ratkaisut)
Kokemusta pilvipalveluista (Azure / AWS / GCP) ja pilvi-infrastruktuurin rakentamisesta ML-tarpeisiin IaC-työkaluilla
Kokemusta tuotantoon viennistä ja ratkaisujen hallinnasta mm. seuraavilla teknologioilla: Azure AI/ML Services, Databricks, MLOps/LLMOps, evaluointi- ja guardrail-työkalut.
Ohjelmointiosaamista, erityisesti Python – mutta myös esimerkiksi Java- tai C#-tausta tukee tehtävässä
Kokemusta CI/CD-prosesseista ja DevOps-työskentelystä
Intohimoa asiakkaiden tarpeiden ratkaisuun ja uusimpien teknologioiden tai menetelmien tutkimiseen (esim. Multi-agent -arkkitehtuurit ja yhteistyömekanismit, itseoptimoivat AI-agentit, AI-agenttien taidot, kehittyneet tiedon- ja muistinhallintaratkaisut, jne.)
Sujuvaa suomen ja englannin kielen taitoa

Lisäksi arvostamme:

Kykyä työskennellä asiakasrajapinnassa, kiteyttää liiketoiminnan tarpeita ja muotoilla niihin sopivia teknisiä ratkaisuja
Kokemusta konsultatiivisesta työotteesta – kykyä kuunnella, keskustella, sparrata ja muodostaa ratkaisuehdotuksia

Näin me pidämme sinusta huolta:

Arvomme ovat välittäminen, rentous, rohkeus ja intohimo. Työntekijämme ovat valinneet ne itse, ja ehkäpä juuri siksi arvoihin perustuva toiminta näkyy ja tuntuu joka päivä. Tässä on muutamia esimerkkejä:

Välittäminen:
Kulttuurimme on luotu niin, että vaikeissa tilanteissa saat helposti tukea koko työyhteisöltä, et vain omalta projektiryhmältäsi.
Rentous:
Vaikka olemme jo melko suuri yritys, ilmapiiri on kodikas ja rento ja hierarkia on matala.
Rohkeus:
Rakennamme aitoja kumppanuuksia asiakkaidemme kanssa. Tämä vaatii joskus rohkeutta olla eri mieltä asiakkaan kanssa ja sanoa se myös ääneen.
Intohimo:
Solitalla työtä tehdään suurella intohimolla, mutta samalla pidetään hauskaa. Olemme ylpeitä työmme laadusta.

Lue lisää projekteistamme ja asiantuntijoidemme näkemyksistä:

https://www.solita.fi/work/data-and-ai-strategy-helps-yit-boost-productivity/

Job Description

Build the operational applications that power the future of intelligent manufacturing.

Join Agilent's Global OT & AI Engineering organization and help develop modern operational applications that transform how work is performed across our global operations.

As a Digital Solutions Engineer – Operational Applications, you will design, develop, and maintain intuitive digital applications that empower operators, engineers, technicians, supervisors, and manufacturing leaders with real-time access to information, workflows, and intelligent decision support.

Your solutions will extend enterprise capabilities beyond traditional desktop applications by delivering secure, connected, and user-centric operational experiences across mobile devices, tablets, industrial workstations, and other frontline technologies.

Working closely with Application Experience Engineers, Platform Engineers, Data Engineers, AI & Data Scientists, Smart Factory Engineers, and business stakeholders, you will build applications that simplify operational processes, improve workforce productivity, and accelerate Agilent's digital transformation.

We welcome candidates across multiple career stages. Responsibilities and technical ownership will be aligned with your experience, expertise, and demonstrated capabilities.

About Global OT & AI Engineering

Global OT & AI Engineering develops the digital platforms that power intelligent operations across Agilent's global manufacturing network.

Our organization combines software engineering, cloud technologies, Artificial Intelligence, enterprise data platforms, industrial automation, and Smart Factory solutions to create scalable digital capabilities that improve operational visibility, accelerate decision-making, and enable continuous improvement.

Our mission is to build the digital operating system for intelligent manufacturing.

Our portfolio includes:

Global Operations Control Tower
Enterprise Data Platform (GOLake)
AI & Decision Intelligence Platform
Smart Factory Applications
Operational Applications
Manufacturing Knowledge Platform
Digital Twin Solutions
Enterprise KPI Platform
AI-powered Digital Coworkers

About The Role

Operational excellence depends on providing the right information to the right people at the right time.

As a Digital Solutions Engineer – Operational Applications, you will develop applications that connect frontline employees with enterprise systems, operational data, and intelligent services. Whether supporting manufacturing execution, quality inspections, maintenance activities, warehouse operations, engineering workflows, or operational approvals, your applications will help simplify work and improve decision-making across Agilent's manufacturing network.

You'll work closely with multidisciplinary engineering teams to build secure, scalable, and intuitive operational applications that integrate seamlessly with enterprise platforms, AI capabilities, and Smart Factory technologies.

Key Responsibilities

Operational Application Development

Design, develop, and maintain modern operational applications that support manufacturing, quality, supply chain, engineering, warehouse, logistics, and operational workflows.
Build intuitive applications that improve productivity, simplify frontline activities, and enhance user experience.
Develop reusable application components that accelerate delivery across multiple operational solutions.
Ensure applications are responsive, secure, accessible, and optimized for operational environments.

Workforce Productivity Solutions

Develop digital work instructions, operational checklists, inspection applications, maintenance workflows, inventory transactions, approvals, and task management solutions.
Deliver intuitive user experiences that reduce manual effort and improve operational consistency.
Support offline capabilities and reliable synchronization where network connectivity may be limited.
Design solutions that enable users to complete operational tasks efficiently across various devices.

Enterprise Integration

Integrate operational applications with enterprise platforms including SAP, MES, enterprise data platforms, AI services, and backend APIs.
Collaborate with Platform Engineers to consume secure enterprise services.
Work with Data Engineers to deliver trusted operational information.

User Experience & Adoption

Design simple, intuitive workflows that improve adoption and reduce training effort.
Continuously enhance application usability through user feedback and iterative improvements.
Promote consistent user experience across operational applications.

Innovation & Emerging Technologies

Evaluate emerging technologies that improve operational productivity, including enterprise mobility, wearable devices, barcode and QR technologies, camera integration, voice interaction, and AI-assisted user experiences.
Prototype innovative digital capabilities that enhance frontline operations and operational efficiency.
Contribute to Agilent's long-term Operational Applications strategy by identifying opportunities to simplify work through technology.

Cross-functional Collaboration

Partner with Manufacturing, Supply Chain, Quality, Engineering, and Operational Excellence teams to understand operational requirements and deliver practical digital solutions.
Collaborate closely with Application Experience Engineers, Platform Engineers, Smart Factory Engineers, Data Engineers, and AI specialists to develop integrated enterprise applications.
Participate in Agile development, architecture discussions, technical reviews, and continuous improvement initiatives.

Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Information Technology, Mobile Computing, or a related discipline.
Experience developing enterprise applications using modern web, mobile, or cross-platform technologies.

new_jobs.title: Solution Architect Expert (m/v/x).
new_jobs.description:
Taken en verantwoordelijkheden

Als Solution Architect draag je bij aan het ontwerpen van het IT-landschap van de organisatie op basis van de business-strategie. Je fungeert als de belangrijkste schakel tussen de business en IT voor strategische initiatieven en bent ook de technische leider van een transversale squad die verantwoordelijk is voor een portfolio van kritieke businesstoepassingen.

Je komt bij een team dat momenteel bestaat uit een product owner, een scrum master, een analist en een ontwikkelaar. In deze rol leg je de technische visie vast, stuur je architecturale beslissingen aan, mentor je teamleden en waarborg je de duurzaamheid op lange termijn van de oplossingen die onder jouw verantwoordelijkheid vallen.

Een bijzondere uitdaging van deze positie is dat de squad meer dan 40 kritieke businesstoepassingen beheert, inclusief verschillende legacy systemen en moderne, op Azure gebaseerde, oplossingen. Je moet in staat zijn om aan meerdere projecten tegelijkertijd te werken en daarbij de operationele stabiliteit waarborgen en de lopende transformatie-initiatieven ondersteunen.

Taken en verantwoordelijkheden

Betrokkenheid bij de ontwikkeling van projecten

Helpen businessbehoeften en -vereisten in kaart brengen tijdens workshops en ontdekkingssessies.
Verschillende oplossingsopties evalueren en de meest geschikte architectuur aanbevelen op basis van de business-strategie, architecturale principes, kosten, risico’s en overgangsplannen.
Oplossingsarchitecturen definiëren, documenteren en communiceren aan belanghebbenden uit zowel de business als de IT, en de bijbehorende architecturale modellen en documentatie opstellen en bijhouden.
De gevolgen en onderlinge afhankelijkheden tussen bestaande toepassingen, lopende projecten en toekomstige initiatieven identificeren, en prioritering binnen de roadmap van de organisatie ondersteunen.
Businessvereisten omzetten in haalbare technische oplossingen en implementeringsroadmaps.
Bijdragen aan discussies over technisch ontwerp, en ontwikkelingsstandaarden en beste praktijken vaststellen.
Ondersteuning bieden bij financiële prognoses, het inschatten van de benodigde inspanningen, het identificeren van risico’s en het opstellen van plannen voor risicobeperking.

Technische Leiderschap

Optreden als de technische leider van de squad en advies geven over architecturale en technische beslissingen.
Ontwikkelaars en andere teamleden coachen, mentoren en ondersteunen in het versterken van hun technische expertise.
Beste praktijken voor software engineering, codekwaliteit, beveiliging, onderhoudbaarheid en schaalbaarheid bevorderen.
Technische reviews leiden en ervoor zorgen dat de architecturale standaarden worden nageleefd.
Het oplossen en verhelpen van complexe technische kwesties in het volledige toepassingenlandschap ondersteunen.
Initiatieven voor voortdurende verbetering binnen het team aansturen.

Jouw profiel

Ervaring en opleiding

Masterdiploma in computerwetenschappen of gelijkwaardig door ervaring.
Minstens 5 jaar ervaring als Solution Architect, Technical Lead, Senior ontwikkelaar, of een gelijkaardige rol, idealiter in complexe bedrijfsomgevingen.
Ervaring met agile en SAFe-omgevingen; ervaring in de verzekeringssector, gezondheidszorg of andere sterk gereguleerde sectoren is een grote troef.
Frans of Nederlands is vereist, met een zeer goed begrip van de andere taal, alsook een uitstekende beheersing van het Engels.

Technische Vaardigheden

Uitstekende kennis van oplossings- en integratiearchitectuur, met een sterke achtergrond in softwareontwikkeling en levenscyclusbeheer van toepassingen.
Sterke ervaring met .NET/C# en uitgebreide kennis van JavaScript/TypeScript, inclusief Angular en Single Page Applications (SPA).
Hoge bekwaamheid in Microsoft SQL Server, Azure SQL en T-SQL.
Hands-on ervaring met Microsoft Azure-diensten, cloud-native architecturen en REST API’s; ervaring met Azure Functions, Logic Apps, Event-driven Architecture of Azure PaaS is een groot voordeel.
Ervaring met het implementeren van DevOps-praktijken en CI/CD-pipelines, met een sterk begrip van Git; vertrouwdheid met Infrastructure as Code, Azure DevOps Pipelines, Docker en containerisatie is een pluspunt.
Kennis van ArchiMate, BPMN en UML (certificering is een troef).
Ervaring met kostenramingen, risicobeheer en technische governance.

Niet-technische profielvereisten

Sterke analytische en probleemoplossende vaardigheden, met een gestructureerde en georganiseerde aanpak.
Het vermogen om verschillende projecten en prioriteiten tegelijkertijd te beheren, en om zelfstandig te werken met beperkt toezicht.
Een resultaat- en klantgerichte instelling, met een groot verantwoordelijkheidsgevoel en een sterke teamgeest.
Uitstekende vaardigheden op het gebied van interpersoonlijke communicatie en het omgaan met stakeholders, met het vermogen om complexe technische concepten over te brengen aan zowel technische als niet-technische doelgroepen.

Beschrijving van de jobaanbieding

Een topjob in een zinvolle sector
Een solidaire organisatie waar het fijn werken is
Een moderne werkomgeving, in een toegankelijke groene omgeving, ongeacht je favoriete vervoerswijze
Een goed evenwicht tussen privéleven en werk, met flexibele werktijden en de mogelijkheid om tot 3 dagen per week thuis te werken
Initiatieven die het welzijn bevorderen en de onderlinge band versterken: yoga, padel, inspirerende workshops, filmavonden, seizoensgebonden drinks, rondetafelgesprekken in het Nederlands of Frans, …
Een plek waar iedereen zichzelf kan zijn en gelijke kansen krijgt om zich te ontwikkelen
Een aantrekkelijk loonpakket
Een contract van onbepaalde duur
Toegang tot het Flexible Income Plan waarmee je zelf je loonpakket kan beheren in functie van je behoeften en je situatie
Talrijke extralegale voordelen, zoals aansluiting bij Dentalia Up en Hospitalia Plus, maaltijdcheques, ecocheques, groepsverzekering en een gsm
Een bedrijfswagen of een mobiliteitsbudget
37 dagen verlof per jaar
Een grondige opleiding over de ziekenfondssector bij aankomst en regelmatig opleidingen in de loop van je carrière

Tâches et responsabilités

En tant que Solution Architect, vous contribuerez à la conception du paysage IT de l’organisation sur la base de la stratégie business. Vous servirez de lien principal entre le business et l’IT pour les initiatives stratégiques, tout en assumant le rôle de leader technique d’une squad transversale chargée d’un portefeuille d’applications business critiques.

Vous rejoindrez une équipe actuellement composée d’un Product Owner, d’un Scrum Master, d’un analyste et d’un développeur. Dans ce rôle, vous serez chargé de définir la vision technique, d’orienter les décisions architecturales, d’encadrer les membres de l’équipe et de garantir la pérennité à long terme des solutions relevant de votre responsabilité.

L’un des défis particuliers de ce poste réside dans le fait que la squad gère plus de 40 applications business critiques, dont plusieurs systèmes hérités et des solutions modernes basées sur Azure. Vous devrez être en mesure de travailler sur plusieurs projets tout en garantissant la stabilité opérationnelle et en soutenant les initiatives de transformation en cours.

Tâches et responsabilités

Implication dans le développement de projets

Contribuer à la formulation des besoins et des exigences métier lors d’ateliers et de sessions de découverte.
Évaluer différentes options de solution et recommander l’architecture la plus appropriée sur la base de la stratégie métier, des principes architecturaux, des coûts, des risques et des plans de transition
Définir, documenter et communiquer les architectures de solution aux parties prenantes business et IT, et mettre en place et maintenir les modèles architecturaux et la documentation associés.
Identifier les impacts et les dépendances entre les applications existantes, les projets en cours et les initiatives futures, et contribuer à la hiérarchisation des priorités dans le cadre de la feuille de route de l’organisation.
Traduire les exigences métier en solutions techniques concrètes et en feuilles de route d’implémentation.
Participer aux discussions sur la conception technique et établir des normes de développement ainsi que des bonnes pratiques.
Contribuer aux prévisions financières, à l’estimation des efforts, à l’identification des risques et à la planification des mesures d’atténuation.

Leadership technique

Assumer le rôle de responsable technique de la squad et fournir des conseils sur les décisions architecturales et techniques.
Coacher, encadrer et soutenir les développeurs et les autres membres de l'équipe afin de renforcer leur expertise technique.
Promouvoir les meilleures pratiques en matière d'ingénierie logicielle, qualité du code, sécurité, maintenabilité et évolutivité.
Diriger les revues techniques et veiller au respect des normes architecturales.
Contribuer au dépannage et à la résolution des problèmes techniques complexes au sein de l'ensemble du paysage applicatif.
Piloter des initiatives d'amélioration continue au sein de l'équipe

Description du profil

Expérience et formation

Master en informatique ou équivalent par expérience.
Au moins 5 ans d’expérience en tant que Solution Architect, Technical Lead, Senior Developer ou dans un poste similaire, de préférence dans des environnements d’entreprise complexes.
Expérience dans des environnements Agile et SAFe ; une expérience dans les secteurs de l’assurance, des soins de santé ou d’autres secteurs fortement réglementés constitue un atout majeur.
Français ou néerlandais requis, avec une très bonne compréhension de l’autre langue, ainsi qu’une excellente maîtrise de l’anglais.

Compétences techniques

Excellente connaissance en architecture d’intégration et de solution, avec une solide expérience en développement logiciel et en gestion du cycle de vie des applications.
Solide expérience avec .NET/C# et connaissance approfondie de JavaScript/TypeScript, notamment Angular et les applications monopages (SPA).
Maîtrise approfondie de Microsoft SQL Server, Azure SQL et T-SQL.
Expérience pratique des services Microsoft Azure, des architectures cloud natives et des REST API ; une expérience avec Azure Functions, Logic Apps, l’architecture orientée événements ou Azure PaaS constitue un atout majeur.
Expérience dans l’implémentation de pratiques DevOps et de pipelines CI/CD, avec une solide compréhension de Git ; la maîtrise de l’« Infrastructure as Code », d’Azure DevOps Pipelines, de Docker et de la conteneurisation est un atout.
Connaissance d’ArchiMate, de BPMN et d’UML (une certification est un atout).
Expérience en estimation des coûts, en gestion des risques et en gouvernance technique.

Exigences non techniques relatives au profil

Forte capacité d'analyse et de résolution de problèmes, associée à une approche structurée et organisée.
Capacité à gérer simultanément plusieurs projets et priorités, en travaillant de manière autonome avec un encadrement limité.
Esprit axé sur les résultats et orienté client, avec un sens aigu des responsabilités et un fort esprit d'équipe.
Excellentes compétences interpersonnelles, de communication et de gestion des parties prenantes, notamment la capacité à expliquer des concepts techniques complexes à des publics tant techniques que non techniques.

Description de l'offre

Un job au top dans un secteur qui a du sens.
Une organisation solidaire où il fait bon travailler.
Un cadre de travail moderne, dans un écrin de verdure accessible, et ce quel que soit votre solution de mobilité préférée.
Un équilibre vie privée-vie professionnelle préservé, avec des horaires de travail flexibles et la possibilité de télétravailler jusqu’à 3 jours par semaine.
Des initiatives qui favorisent le bien-être et renforcent la connexion : yoga, padel, ateliers inspirants, séances ciné, drinks saisonniers, tables rondes en néerlandais ou français…
Un lieu où chacun vient comme il est et a les mêmes chances de se développer.

We believe that the combination of AI and human expertise is essential for delivering effective managed security that is tailored to a customer’s unique environment, operational constraints, and risks.

Our MXDR service combines powerful proprietary AI with a one-of-a-kind collaboration model to continuously build a deep understanding of our customers’ environments, informing how we prevent, detect, and respond to threats. Our unrivaled Microsoft expertise allows customers to achieve these outcomes with the Microsoft Security tools they already own. The result is highly localized managed protection that empowers security teams to be faster, smarter, and more cost efficient than ever before.

Continuous protection. AI-powered Nonstop SecOps. That’s Ontinue.

Role Overview

We’re looking for a Backend Engineer to help build the systems behind Ontinue’s internal and customer-facing experiences. This is not a classic “just build APIs” role. You’ll work on services and systems that power product experiences, investigation workflows, and customer-facing platforms — with real business logic, storage, event-driven architecture, and performance-sensitive data flows.

We’re moving fast, and we’re doing it with a strong AI-first mindset. That means we don’t expect every solution to be built in the traditional way. We’re looking for someone who is comfortable working with AI-assisted development tools, open to new technologies, and eager to help shape a more efficient way of building software. The right person will bring solid engineering fundamentals, together with a product mindset and the flexibility to adapt how work gets done.

Key Responsibilities

Build and evolve backend services that support both internal tools and customer-facing experiences
Design and implement APIs, event-driven workflows, and services in .NET / C#
Work with Azure services such as Service Bus, Azure Functions, Azure Storage, and related cloud services
Help shape the systems behind products used by SOC analysts, internal teams, and customers
Contribute to backend parts of frontend-heavy product initiatives where business logic, data, and system behavior matter
Improve existing systems while also helping create new services and features
Work closely with frontend engineers, product stakeholders, and other teams to deliver thoughtful solutions
Use AI-assisted development tools in your day-to-day work to increase speed, quality, and leverage
Help us evolve how engineering works in an AI-enabled environment
Contribute to our CI/CD and infrastructure workflows, including Terraform where applicable
Play a meaningful role in cybersecurity by helping make security operations more efficient and effective in a space that is always relevant

Required

Required Experience & Skills

At least 4 years of professional software engineering experience
Strong experience with .NET and C#
Practical experience with Azure and cloud-based service development
Experience building or maintaining event-driven systems
Solid software engineering fundamentals, including writing maintainable code, understanding system behavior, and working thoughtfully with testing, debugging, and architecture
Comfortable working in a collaborative product environment where requirements can evolve
Curious, adaptable, and open to working in new ways, especially with AI-assisted development
A mindset that combines engineering rigor with product thinking
Clear communicator who enjoys working across teams and sharing feedback

Preferred

A degree in computer science, software engineering, or a related field
Frontend exposure or experience working closely with frontend-heavy teams
Experience with automated testing and test strategy
Experience with Terraform or infrastructure-as-code workflows
Experience working on product-oriented software rather than purely platform/backend infrastructure
Experience with distributed systems, microservices, or data-heavy systems
Familiarity with modern developer tooling and AI-enabled workflow

What We Offer

We have been recognized as a top place to work! In addition to a competitive salary, we also offer great benefits and access to management and Microsoft training.

Come as you are! We search for amazing people of diverse backgrounds, experiences, abilities, and perspectives. Ontinue welcomes and encourages diversity in the workplace regardless of race, gender, religion, age, sexual orientation, disability, or veteran status.

Next Steps

If you have the skills and experience required and feel that Ontinue is a place you can belong, we would love to get to know you better! Please drop an application to this role and our talent acquisition manager will be in touch to discuss further.

Job Reference 405_26_MNG_ISS_NET

Starting date: ASAP

Position Mid-Level Full Stack WEB Developer (.NET)

Closing Date Thursday, 15 October, ****

About BSC The Barcelona Supercomputing Center - Centro Nacional de Supercomputación (BSC-CNS) is the leading supercomputing center in Spain.

It houses MareNostrum, one of the most powerful supercomputers in Europe, was a founding and hosting member of the former European HPC infrastructure PRACE (Partnership for Advanced Computing in Europe), and is now hosting entity for EuroHPC JU, the Joint Undertaking that leads large-scale investments and HPC provision in Europe.

The mission of BSC is to research, develop and manage information technologies in order to facilitate scientific progress.

BSC combines HPC service provision and R&D into both computer and computational science (life, earth and engineering sciences) under one roof, and currently has over **** staff from 60 countries.

Look At The BSC Experience BSC-CNS YouTube Channel

We are particularly interested for this role in the strengths and lived experiences of women and underrepresented groups to help us avoid perpetuating biases and oversights in science and IT research.

In instances of equal merit, the incorporation of the under-represented sex will be favoured.

We promote Equity, Diversity and Inclusion, fostering an environment where each and every one of us is appreciated for who we are, regardless of our differences.

If you consider that you do not meet all the requirements, we encourage you to continue applying for the job offer.

We value diversity of experiences and skills, and you could bring unique perspectives to our team.

Context And Mission We are looking for a Mid-Level Full Stack Developer with experience in .

NET to join an internal platform used for time tracking and reporting in audit processes.

The selected candidate will be responsible for maintaining, improving, and supporting the application.

Key Duties

Develop end-to-end features using .

NET Core / .

NET 6+ on the backend and Razor Views + HTML on the frontend

Participate in architecture design and technical decision-making

Contribute to code quality improvements, code reviews, and best practices

Integrate REST APIs and work with SQL databases

Provide support to the financial justification team regarding the platform

Requirements

Education

Degree in Computer Engineering, Information Technology, or similar

Essential Knowledge And Professional Experience

2–4 years of experience with C# and .

NET Core / .

NET 6+

Experience with Entity Framework and SQL Server

Experience working with Razor Views

Strong knowledge of HTML, CSS, JavaScript, jQuery

Experience with web deployment (Kestrel/HTTPS) and SMTP/authentication setup

Working fluency in Spanish and English is required, Catalan will be a plus.

Additional Knowledge And Professional Experience

Understanding of REST APIs

Nice To Have

ASP.NET Identity

Quartz.NET for scheduled jobs

QuestPDF or similar PDF generation libraries

EPPlus for Excel/CSV exports

SMTP / automated email sending

Serilog

Competences

Autonomy & Proactivity: Ability to work independently and take initiative in development tasks.

Technical Ownership: End-to-end responsibility for development, testing, and maintenance.

Problem Solving: Diagnose and resolve issues.

Clean Code & Best Practices: Experience with .

NET best practices, design patterns, and Git.

Communication & Collaboration: Clear communication with technical and non-technical staff

Conditions

The position will be located at BSC within the Management Department

We offer a full-time contract (35h/week), a good working environment, a highly stimulating environment with state-of-the-art infrastructure, flexible working hours, extensive training plan, restaurant tickets, private health insurance, support to the relocation procedures

Duration: Open-ended contract due to technical and scientific activities linked to the project and budget duration

Holidays: 22 days of holidays + 6 personal days + 24th and 31st of December per our collective agreement

Salary: we offer a competitive salary commensurate with the qualifications and experience of the candidate and according to the cost of living in Barcelona

Starting date: ASAP

Applications procedure and process

A full CV in English including contact details

A cover/motivation letter with a statement of interest in English, clearly specifying for which specific area and topics the applicant wishes to be considered.

Additionally, two references for further contacts must be included.

Applications without this document will not be considered.

Development of the recruitment process

Curriculum Analysis: Evaluation of previous experience and/or scientific history, degree, training, and other professional information relevant to the position.

40 points

Interview phase: The highest-rated candidates at the curriculum level will be invited to the interview phase, conducted by the corresponding department and Human Resources.

In this phase, technical competencies, knowledge, skills, and professional experience related to the position, as well as the required personal competencies, will be evaluated.

60 points.

The vacancy will remain open until a suitable candidate has been hired.

Applications will be regularly reviewed and potential candidates will be contacted.

OTM-R principles for selection processes BSC-CNS is committed to the principles of the Code of Conduct for the Recruitment of Researchers of the European Commission and the Open, Transparent and Merit-based Recruitment principles (OTM-R).

This is applied for any potential candidate in all our processes, for example by creating gender-balanced recruitment panels and recognizing career breaks etc.

We are pleased to consider all qualified applicants for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability or any other basis protected by applicable state or local law.

new_jobs.title: Senior Product Software Engineer - AI Native
new_jobs.description:
Join us at Wolters Kluwer and be part of a dynamic global technology company that makes a difference every day. We’re innovators with impact. We provide expert software and information solutions that the world’s leading professionals rely on, in the moments that matter most.

We are currently looking for a Senior Product Software Engineer - AI Native
to join our team.

About the Role:

The Senior Product Software Engineer (AI native) will own software solutions from discovery through production, translating customer and business needs into secure, reliable, scalable, and maintainable software products. Takes ambiguous team-level problems and works across stakeholders to define requirements, shape solution approaches, coordinate dependencies, and deliver successful outcomes. Exercises sound engineering judgment and uses approved AI-assisted development and automation tools where appropriate, while remaining accountable for the quality, correctness, security, and operational readiness of all work approved or released. Serves as a technical resource within the team and helps strengthen the capability of less experienced engineers.

Essential Duties and Responsibilities:

End-to-End Solution Ownership: Own software solutions from discovery through production, translating customer, business, and technical requirements into sustainable outcomes.
Problem Definition and Solution Design: Analyze ambiguous requirements, clarify objectives, evaluate alternatives, and determine solution strategies.
Software Development: Design, develop, test, implement, maintain, and improve software applications, services, and platforms using direct and approved AI-assisted approaches.
AI-Assisted Engineering: Apply approved AI-assisted techniques while validating outputs and maintaining accountability for architecture, quality, security, and operational readiness.
Specification Development: Document requirements, design approaches, acceptance criteria, dependencies, risks, and implementation considerations.
Verification and Validation: Determine and execute testing and verification approaches based on complexity, risk, and business impact.
Technical Guidance: Provide technical guidance through design reviews, code reviews, knowledge sharing, mentoring, and engineering best practices.
Troubleshooting and Production Support: Diagnose and resolve cross-component, production, and system-level issues and implement sustainable corrective actions.
Security and Compliance: Apply security, privacy, compliance, and data-protection requirements throughout the lifecycle.
Product and Stakeholder Collaboration: Partner with product, design, architecture, operations, security, and business stakeholders to shape solutions.
Performance and Reliability Improvement: Improve performance, scalability, reliability, resiliency, and maintainability while reducing operational risk.
Continuous Improvement: Improve engineering processes, delivery effectiveness, and team capability through automation, standardization, and knowledge sharing.
Customer and Business Awareness: Consider customer impact, product strategy, operational implications, and business outcomes in technical decisions.

AI-Native Engineering Accountability:

Applies specification-driven and evaluation-driven approaches to ambiguous work. Provides context, constraints, and evaluation criteria, validates generated output, and coaches others on appropriate responsible use.

Verification and Quality Accountability:

Every engineer remains accountable for the work approved or released, regardless of whether the work was produced directly or with approved AI assistance. AI-generated output remains unverified input until it has been reviewed and validated through practices appropriate to the associated risk.

Determine the testing and validation needed within the assigned area.
Ensure solutions meet quality, reliability, security, compliance, and operational expectations.
Define and evaluate acceptance criteria.
Produce appropriate evidence of readiness for production use.
Identify, manage, and escalate technical risks.

Job Qualifications:

Education (Required): Bachelor’s degree in a relevant field, or equivalent demonstrated experience.
Work Experience (Required): 4-6 years of relevant experience in product software engineering.

Skills:

Software Engineering: The ability to design, develop, and maintain software systems and applications by applying principles and techniques of computer science, engineering, and mathematical analysis. This includes the capacity to understand user requirements, create and test software, and resolve software-related issues.
Software Development: The ability to produce working software that meets its requirements, whether by writing it, directing approved tools that generate it, or reviewing and taking accountability for contributed work. Includes designing, testing, implementing, and the ability to read, trace, and diagnose code regardless of who or what produced it.
Programming: Ability to build software that achieves intended outcomes by writing code, directing approved code-generation tools, or both. Includes the ability to interpret specifications, apply specification-driven development (SDD) practices, and read, trace, test, debug, and improve code regardless of its origin.
Specification Driven Development: The ability to translate customer needs, business objectives, and product intent into clear, structured, and testable specifications that guide design, engineering, validation, and delivery. Uses specifications as the primary mechanism to align stakeholders, reduce ambiguity, enable AI-assisted development, and ensure solutions deliver the intended customer and business outcomes.
Problem Solving: The ability to understand a complex situation or issue and devise a solution by defining the problem, identifying potential strategies, and choosing and implementing the most effective course of action.
Analysis: The ability to examine complex situations or problems, break them into smaller parts, and understand how the parts work together.
Testing: The skill of evaluating a system or process to identify problems, measure effectiveness, and ensure quality or functionality.
Agile: The ability to respond to change swiftly and effectively, with emphasis on continuous improvement, adaptive planning, and flexibility.
Version Control: The ability to work effectively in a shared codebase using branching, review, and merge practices. Includes writing reviewable changes, reviewing others’ work, maintaining a clean history, and using the repository as a record of why a system is the way it is.
Relational Database: The ability to design, implement, and manipulate relational databases, including proficiency in SQL, database management systems, and database design principles.
APIs: The ability to design, develop, and manage application programming interfaces, including documentation, security, and testing practices that enable software systems to communicate.
Design: The ability to structure software so it is understandable, changeable, secure, operable, and fit for the problem. Includes decomposing systems, defining interfaces and contracts, selecting appropriate patterns, and designing for testability.
Framework: The ability to understand, use, design, and develop complex structures and systems in programming and related engineering contexts.
Documentation: The ability to create, organize, maintain, and communicate technical information so it is current, accessible, and useful.
Application Security Principles: The ability to apply application security controls that prevent, detect, and respond to vulnerabilities, including secure coding, access control, authentication, and security testing.
Advanced Technology Adoption and Utilization: Applies specification-driven and evaluation-driven approaches to ambiguous work. Provides context, constraints, and evaluation criteria, validates generated output, and coaches others on appropriate responsible use.

Competencies:

Ownership Mindset: Acts like an owner, takes accountability for outcomes beyond formal role boundaries, and creates disproportionate business value while respecting security, regulatory, financial, and delegated decision-making controls.
Organizational Velocity: Increases speed by removing friction, simplifying decisions, and accelerating execution.
Technical Innovation & Leverage: Creates innovative solutions whose impact far exceeds the effort required to build them.
Engineering Leverage: Improves engineering productivity through tools, platforms, frameworks, and automation.
AI-Native Thinking: Reimagines work and business models through AI-first thinking.
Learning Velocity: Rapidly acquires and applies new capabilities ahead of business needs.
Constructive Disruption: Improves outcomes by challenging assumptions with evidence, pragmatism, and low ego.
Product & Market Instinct: Balances technology decisions with customer, market, and business realities.
Talent Multiplier: Raises standards, attracts talent, develops future leaders, and builds excellence cultures.
Enterprise Mindset: Optimizes for enterprise outcomes rather than local team wins.
Strategic Judgment: Makes high-quality prioritization decisions, especially what not to pursue.
Courage to Take Smart Risks: Balances potential risk with impact, encourages thoughtful experimentation, and facilitates learning from responsible risk-taking.
Inclusive Collaboration: Models inclusion and collaboration by involving team members in decision making, respecting colleagues, and partnering across organizational boundaries.
Inspiration & Alignment: Motivates achievement by aligning individual, team, and organizational goals.
Analytical Skills: Takes a logical and systematic approach to solving problems and contributes quality alternative solutions that add value for the customer.
Functional Expertise: Maintains and applies current knowledge of relevant practices and science in the field of expertise.
Operational Expertise: Identifies opportunities for improved operational efficiency, applies quality standards, and ensures accuracy and completeness of work outputs.

Core Technical Skills:

Strong experience as a Full Stack Software Engineer
Advanced knowledge of:
C#, .NET Framework, .NET Core, ASP.NET Web API
Angular
RESTful APIs and microservices architectures
SQL and relational database design
Redis
Asynchronous messaging systems (RabbitMQ, MassTransit, Azure Service Bus)

Solid understanding of:
OOP, SOLID principles
Domain-Driven Design (DDD)
Clean Code practices

If you think that you have the needed requirements click on the apply button to join us and be the difference
. If making a difference matters to you, then you matter to us.

All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, gender identity, sexual orientation, national origin, disability, or any other protected status, in accordance with local regulations.

Our Interview Practices

To maintain a fair and genuine hiring process, we kindly ask that all candidates participate in interviews without the assistance of AI tools or external prompts. Our interview process is designed to assess your individual skills, experiences, and communication style. We value authenticity and want to ensure we’re getting to know you—not a digital assistant. To help maintain this integrity, we ask to remove virtual backgrounds and include in-person interviews in our hiring process. Please note that use of AI-generated responses or third-party support during interviews will be grounds for disqualification from the recruitment process.

Applicants may be required to appear onsite at a Wolters Kluwer office as part of the recruitment process.

new_jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position

Who We Are

At Roche Diagnostics Solutions (RDS)
, our mission is clear: to diagnose earlier, develop faster, and personalize treatment because every patient is unique. Within Computational Science & Informatics (CSI)
, we are the bridge between our origin and our future, shaping the next era of human health through precise, data-driven diagnostics and precision medicine.

We excel in delivering rigorous, clinically actionable data analysis across our diagnostics portfolio, believing that advancing computational methods and informatics solutions is essential to harnessing dynamic human health data. By listening closely to patients and physicians, and leveraging digitization and cutting-edge technologies, we work collaboratively to turn insights into impact.

This shared spirit creates an environment where ideas grow, new approaches are trialed, and competitive products reach patients faster—ultimately realizing the DIA 10-year vision and our One Roche ambitions so that everyone can access personalized healthcare solutions.

The Opportunity

In this unique role, you will combine high-impact hands-on engineering with servant leadership to guide your development team toward continuous improvement. You will join a highly collaborative team environment where you will drive the full software development lifecycle while championing Agile methodologies.

Key Responsibilities:

Drive all phases of the software development lifecycle, from feasibility studies and application design to testing, bug fixing, and software maintenance
Design, implement, and test high-quality code utilizing C#, WPF, and .NET 8.0 frameworks
Act as a Scrum Master and servant leader for the development team, facilitating progress, resolving blockers, and increasing workplace transparency
Empower the team by applying proven Agile techniques, fostering conflict resolution, situational awareness, and continuous improvement
Collaborate proactively within self-organizing teams to define, estimate, and plan high-impact work packages
Leverage modern AI-supporting tools throughout the entire development lifecycle to optimize coding, testing, and troubleshooting workflows
Review application designs, functionality, and source code to champion technical excellence and drive ongoing enhancements

Who You Are

You are a proactive, collaborative technical professional who excels at navigating ambiguity. You possess a strong analytical mindset, are deeply passionate about exceptional code quality, and thrive when empowering cross-functional teams to succeed.

Qualifications & Skills:

Extensive professional experience in software engineering, with a strong background in C#, WPF, and .NET 8.0 frameworks
Proven experience serving as a Scrum Master or Agile Facilitator for a software development team diligently applying Scrum practices and theory
Certification in Scrum methodologies (such as CSM or PSM I) alongside deep knowledge of servant leadership, facilitation, and team empowerment techniques
Solid experience with SQL Server, including database design and utilizing ORMs like Entity Framework
Practical understanding of modern development ecosystems, including Git/GitHub version control and setting up basic build environments
Exceptional English communication and interpersonal skills, with a natural ability to connect teams and resolve conflicts
A Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, IT, or a related technical field (or equivalent practical experience)

At Roche, you’ll thrive in a culture that values different perspectives and creates a place of belonging, where we challenge ourselves to excel and achieve strong results, together. Let’s create a healthier, brighter future for all.

This is an on-site position and no relocation assistance is provided

Who we are

A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.

Let’s build a healthier future, together.

Roche is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

The Senior Product Software Engineer (AI native) will own software solutions from discovery through production, translating customer and business needs into secure, reliable, scalable, and maintainable software products. Essential Duties and Responsibilities:

End-to-End Solution Ownership: Own software solutions from discovery through production, translating customer, business, and technical requirements into sustainable outcomes.
Problem Definition and Solution Design: Analyze ambiguous requirements, clarify objectives, evaluate alternatives, and determine solution strategies.
Software Development: Design, develop, test, implement, maintain, and improve software applications, services, and platforms using direct and approved AI-assisted approaches.
AI-Assisted Engineering: Apply approved AI-assisted techniques while validating outputs and maintaining accountability for architecture, quality, security, and operational readiness.
Specification Development: Document requirements, design approaches, acceptance criteria, dependencies, risks, and implementation considerations.
Verification and Validation: Determine and execute testing and verification approaches based on complexity, risk, and business impact.
Technical Guidance: Provide technical guidance through design reviews, code reviews, knowledge sharing, mentoring, and engineering best practices.
Troubleshooting and Production Support: Diagnose and resolve cross-component, production, and system-level issues and implement sustainable corrective actions.
Security and Compliance: Apply security, privacy, compliance, and data-protection requirements throughout the lifecycle.
Product and Stakeholder Collaboration: Partner with product, design, architecture, operations, security, and business stakeholders to shape solutions.
Performance and Reliability Improvement: Improve performance, scalability, reliability, resiliency, and maintainability while reducing operational risk.
Continuous Improvement: Improve engineering processes, delivery effectiveness, and team capability through automation, standardization, and knowledge sharing.
Customer and Business Awareness: Consider customer impact, product strategy, operational implications, and business outcomes in technical decisions.

AI-Native Engineering Accountability:

Applies specification-driven and evaluation-driven approaches to ambiguous work. Provides context, constraints, and evaluation criteria, validates generated output, and coaches others on appropriate responsible use.

Verification and Quality Accountability:

Every engineer remains accountable for the work approved or released, regardless of whether the work was produced directly or with approved AI assistance. AI-generated output remains unverified input until it has been reviewed and validated through practices appropriate to the associated risk.

Determine the testing and validation needed within the assigned area.
Ensure solutions meet quality, reliability, security, compliance, and operational expectations.
Define and evaluate acceptance criteria.
Produce appropriate evidence of readiness for production use.
Identify, manage, and escalate technical risks.

Job Qualifications:

Education (Required): Bachelor’s degree in a relevant field, or equivalent demonstrated experience.
Work Experience (Required): 4-6 years of relevant experience in product software engineering.

Skills:

Software Engineering: The ability to design, develop, and maintain software systems and applications by applying principles and techniques of computer science, engineering, and mathematical analysis. This includes the capacity to understand user requirements, create and test software, and resolve software-related issues.
Software Development: The ability to produce working software that meets its requirements, whether by writing it, directing approved tools that generate it, or reviewing and taking accountability for contributed work. Includes designing, testing, implementing, and the ability to read, trace, and diagnose code regardless of who or what produced it.
Programming: Ability to build software that achieves intended outcomes by writing code, directing approved code-generation tools, or both. Includes the ability to interpret specifications, apply specification-driven development (SDD) practices, and read, trace, test, debug, and improve code regardless of its origin.
Specification Driven Development: The ability to translate customer needs, business objectives, and product intent into clear, structured, and testable specifications that guide design, engineering, validation, and delivery. Uses specifications as the primary mechanism to align stakeholders, reduce ambiguity, enable AI-assisted development, and ensure solutions deliver the intended customer and business outcomes.
Problem Solving: The ability to understand a complex situation or issue and devise a solution by defining the problem, identifying potential strategies, and choosing and implementing the most effective course of action.
Analysis: The ability to examine complex situations or problems, break them into smaller parts, and understand how the parts work together.
Testing: The skill of evaluating a system or process to identify problems, measure effectiveness, and ensure quality or functionality.
Agile: The ability to respond to change swiftly and effectively, with emphasis on continuous improvement, adaptive planning, and flexibility.
Version Control: The ability to work effectively in a shared codebase using branching, review, and merge practices. Includes writing reviewable changes, reviewing others’ work, maintaining a clean history, and using the repository as a record of why a system is the way it is.
Relational Database: The ability to design, implement, and manipulate relational databases, including proficiency in SQL, database management systems, and database design principles.
APIs: The ability to design, develop, and manage application programming interfaces, including documentation, security, and testing practices that enable software systems to communicate.
Design: The ability to structure software so it is understandable, changeable, secure, operable, and fit for the problem. Includes decomposing systems, defining interfaces and contracts, selecting appropriate patterns, and designing for testability.
Framework: The ability to understand, use, design, and develop complex structures and systems in programming and related engineering contexts.
Documentation: The ability to create, organize, maintain, and communicate technical information so it is current, accessible, and useful.
Application Security Principles: The ability to apply application security controls that prevent, detect, and respond to vulnerabilities, including secure coding, access control, authentication, and security testing.
Advanced Technology Adoption and Utilization: Applies specification-driven and evaluation-driven approaches to ambiguous work. Provides context, constraints, and evaluation criteria, validates generated output, and coaches others on appropriate responsible use.

Competencies:

Ownership Mindset: Acts like an owner, takes accountability for outcomes beyond formal role boundaries, and creates disproportionate business value while respecting security, regulatory, financial, and delegated decision-making controls.
Organizational Velocity: Increases speed by removing friction, simplifying decisions, and accelerating execution.

Learning Velocity: Rapidly acquires and applies new capabilities ahead of business needs.
Constructive Disruption: Improves outcomes by challenging assumptions with evidence, pragmatism, and low ego.

Talent Multiplier: Raises standards, attracts talent, develops future leaders, and builds excellence cultures.

Strategic Judgment: Makes high-quality prioritization decisions, especially what not to pursue.

Analytical Skills: Takes a logical and systematic approach to solving problems and contributes quality alternative solutions that add value for the customer.
Functional Expertise: Maintains and applies current knowledge of relevant practices and science in the field of expertise.
Operational Expertise: Identifies opportunities for improved operational efficiency, applies quality standards, and ensures accuracy and completeness of work outputs.

Strong experience as a Full Stack Software Engineer

Angular

Additionally, you will lead technical teams, mentor engineers, and contribute to Artefact’s growth by driving innovation and promoting best practices in cloud technology.

What You'll Be Doing …

Lead the design and implementation of cloud infrastructure architectures (cloud, on-premise, hybrid) aligned with business requirements.
Define and enforce best practices for cloud platform deployment and configuration, security, networking, operations and tools selection.
Oversee the integration of cloud platforms with data pipelines, storage, and compute services.
Standardize coding, deployment, and monitoring practices across cloud environments.
Design and implement automated solutions to set up, monitor, and adjust cloud infrastructure efficiently.
Lead problem-solving initiatives for complex technical challenges related to cloud environments.
Provide technical leadership across multiple cloud projects, ensuring efficient resource management.
Foster teamwork by mentoring, coaching and guiding cloud engineers and ensuring knowledge transfer.
Manage client relationships regarding project expectations, timelines, and outcomes.
Contribute to Artefact's growth by maintaining tech partnerships, leading technical proposals to support project planning and identify potential growth areas with existing accounts.

What You'll Need …

Proven experience designing and implementing cloud architectures on Azure at scale
Strong expertise in cloud security, networking, and compliance frameworks.
Led the end-to-end design of highly available, secure, and cost-optimized Azure environments for enterprise customers, leveraging services such as Azure Virtual Network, Azure Kubernetes Service (AKS), and Azure App Service.
Defined multi-region DR/HA architectures using Azure Traffic Manager, paired regions, and Azure Site Recovery, achieving RTOs under 1 hour for mission-critical workloads.
Enable automated patching, scaling, and monitoring tasks via Azure DevOps YAML pipelines and PowerShell DSC, improving operational efficiency.
Deep understanding of cloud cost optimization, monitoring, and high availability design patterns.
Collaborated with data engineers to optimize architectures on Azure Data Lake Storage Gen2, Synapse, and MS Fabric
Strong leadership capabilities with experience managing technical teams and large-scale projects.
Excellent verbal and written communication skills, including experience creating business-focused presentations.
Demonstrated problem-solving abilities for complex, multi-disciplinary cloud projects.
Experience managing senior stakeholders and navigating client discussions effectively.
Ability to mentor, coach, and develop technical teams in cloud engineering best practices.

new_jobs.title: Field Solutions Engineer - Database
new_jobs.description:
At SolarWinds, we’re a people-first company. Our purpose is to enrich the lives of the people we serve—including our employees, customers, shareholders, partners, and communities. Join us in our mission to help customers accelerate business transformation with simple, powerful, and secure solutions.
The ideal candidate thrives in an innovative, fast-paced environment and is collaborative, accountable, ready, and empathetic. We’re looking for individuals who believe they can accomplish more as a team and create lasting growth for themselves and others. We hire based on attitude, competency, and commitment. Solarians are ready to advance our world-class solutions in a fast-paced environment and accept the challenge to lead with purpose. If you’re looking to build your career with an exceptional team, you’ve come to the right place. Join SolarWinds and grow with us!
Role Overview  

The Field Database Solutions Engineer is an independent, customer-centric problem-solver and storyteller who owns the pre-sales technical strategy for all database opportunities across EMEA. As a key member of the Sales team, you will combine deep database expertise with consultative selling skills to understand customer challenges, design tailored database monitoring and performance solutions, and articulate business value that compels customers to choose SolarWinds.  
This is a field-based role with a strong on-site customer presence, requiring regular travel  (mainly in  Dubai
but also  across the region )  to engage with enterprise customers, channel partners, and key accounts. You will operate with high autonomy, serve as a trusted technical advisor for all database-related engagements, and play a critical role in driving revenue growth across the EMEA Database business.  

Key Responsibilities  

Pre-Sales Ownership: Own the end-to-end SE strategy for database-focused customer engagements across EMEA, including meeting agenda design, story arc, technical approach, and follow-through.  
Product Demonstrations & Webinars: Conduct compelling online and on-site demonstrations of SolarWinds Database Performance Analyzer (DPA), SQL Sentry, Database Observability(DBO), and related database solutions, tailoring messaging to the customer's specific database challenges and environment.  
Technical Discovery & Solution Design: Lead deep discovery sessions with customers to understand their database landscape, performance pain points, and operational goals. Assess the customer's current database infrastructure and recommend solutions that improve performance, scalability, and operational efficiency, defining project scope, success criteria, and timelines.  
Value Articulation: Clearly articulate the value proposition of SolarWinds database solutions in the context of the customer's unique requirements, using consultative and value-based selling techniques. Translate technical database metrics into business outcomes that resonate with both technical and executive stakeholders.  
Technical Advisory: Advise Inside and Outside Sales in all technical pre-sales functions related to database monitoring and management, providing expert guidance to Account Executives and Channel Partners on the optimal database solutions to address customer requirements.  
Complex POC Execution: Design and execute complex Proof of Concept (POC) and Proof of Value (POV) engagements across multi-database environments (SQL Server, Oracle, MySQL, PostgreSQL, and others), including cloud and hybrid scenarios. Anticipate and mitigate technical and organisational risk throughout the evaluation process.  
Product Configuration & Troubleshooting: Perform advanced pre-sales technical support duties, including DPA/DBO/SQL Sentry configuration, agent deployment, environment setup, and troubleshooting of customer issues during evaluations.  
Customer & Product Feedback: Convey structured customer feedback, including feature requests, competitive intelligence, and product issues, to Product Management and Development teams. Help shape internal best practices based on field experience with database customers.  
Continuous Learning & Enablement: Maintain and continually upgrade deep technical understanding of the SolarWinds database product portfolio and broader database technologies. Provide training, mentoring, and knowledge transfer to other team members, and deliver Sales/Partner enablement sessions as required.  
Events & Field Presence: Present at partner events, trade shows, and industry conferences. Travel to partner sites for training and enablement. Maintain a strong on-site presence with key database customers across the EMEA region.  

Required Skills & Experience  

3- 4  years in a dedicated pre-sales or solutions engineering capacity, ideally within a software vendor or systems integrator environment, with a strong focus on database technologies.  
Deep database expertise across one or more of the following: Microsoft SQL Server, Oracle, MySQL, PostgreSQL, NoSQL databases (MongoDB, Cassandra),  SAP HANA,  and/or IBM DB2.  
Solid understanding of database performance monitoring, query tuning, indexing strategies, wait-type analysis, and capacity planning.  
A strong blend of technical ability, sales acumen, and exceptional customer interaction skill, comfortable leading executive-level conversations and deep technical database workshops alike.  
Fluent English speaker with exceptional oral and written communication and presentation skills. The ability to distil complex database performance topics into clear, compelling narratives is critical. Arabic language is preferred 

Proven experience with cloud-based database services including AWS RDS, Azure SQL Database, Azure SQL Managed Instance, Google Cloud SQL, and Aurora. Understanding of hybrid cloud database architectures is highly desirable.  
Strong reasoning, analytical, and technical troubleshooting skills with the ability to navigate complex customer database environments.  
Bachelor's degree in a relevant Business, Computing, or Engineering discipline or equivalent professional experience.  

Desirable Qualifications:  

Relevant industry certifications or accreditations (e.g., Microsoft Certified: Azure Database Administrator Associate, Oracle Certified Professional, AWS Certified Database – Specialty, MCSA/MCSE, or SolarWinds SCP certifications). We value continuous professional development and would love to see evidence of your commitment to learning.  
Experience with database DevOps practices, CI/CD pipelines for database changes, and Database Reliability Engineering (DBRE) methodologies.  
Familiarity with value-based selling methodologies (e.g., MEDDIC, Challenger, Solution Selling).  
Experience responding to RFI/RFP/RFx processes.  
Understanding of the competitive landscape in the database performance monitoring space.

At RTX, the world's largest aerospace and defense company, 185,000 great minds are united by purpose and inspired to make a difference solving the world’s most complex problems. With our three market leading businesses, world-class operations and investments in research and development, we offer capabilities and opportunity no one else can. Together, we push the boundaries of known science and find new ways to connect and protect our world.
Raytheon brings the strength of more than 100 years of experience and renowned engineering expertise to meet the needs of today’s mission and stay ahead of tomorrow’s threat. We deliver solutions that help our nation and allies defend freedoms and deter aggression, creating a safer, more secure world. Join us and help shape the future of aerospace and defense.

Summary of Role:

Raytheon’s ATMS (Air Traffic Management Systems) Software team is seeking talented, enthusiastic and innovative individuals that thrive within an Agile eco-system to deliver world class solutions that make the world a safer place. Become a part of something greater than yourself by bringing your best in collaboration with other motivated and talented individuals across a diverse set of backgrounds and skill sets.

Main Duties:

As a Senior Software Engineer you will work within our existing software engineering team bringing your experience of real-time embedded software engineering to design, develop, integrate and test systems software to support our worldwide customer base. You will also have opportunity to work on exciting internal R&D projects to support the next generation of ATMS systems.

The main tasks of the role are:

Design and develop product functionality, user interfaces and performance improvements.
Key contributor & reviewer at gate & design reviews.
Act as Subject Matter Expert as part of a wider software and systems engineering group to analyse and resolve software and system defects in response to service requests, incidents, problems and events.
Validating and verifying the design artefacts from internal teams or subcontractors.
Provide input to configuration, safety and quality management as appropriate.
Document design and advise on product support material.
Investigate product issues and develop solutions to customer problems.
Develop test plans and methodologies to ensure product meets Raytheon quality standards.
Lead continuous technical improvement and re-architecting activities.
Assist in updating software design artefacts.
Interfacing with COTS vendors for technical support.
Provide technical support (covering the entire software lifecycle) to Raytheon programmes delivering new capability.

Candidate Requirements:

Essential:
Relevant years' active, hands-on software development experience, working in a Team environment
Relevant years’ experience with C/C++/C# language
Experience in the use of UML in software design and other methodologies
Real-Time Embedded SW programming experience
RTOS knowledge
Knowledge of low-level communication protocols, Ethernet, Serial, PCI Bridge
Hands on fault investigation experience in embedded code environment
Use of tools in software configuration management, requirements definition, high-level and detailed design, defect reporting

Desirable:

Min 2:1 degree in a computer science or related subject
Experience Working in an Agile/SCRUM/DevOps delivery model.
Knowledge of Radar systems.
Hands-on experience in reverse engineering a mature system to take advantage of a modern technology development in hardware, software and firmware.
Competency with design patterns and their application to solve complex problems.
